title: Construction of Stonehenge begins
place_zh: 巨石阵（今英国威尔特郡）
summary: Farmers in southern Britain dug a circular ditch and bank, the first stage of Stonehenge; the great stones were raised over the next thousand years.
summary_zh: 不列颠南部的农耕居民挖出环形壕沟和土堤，这是巨石阵的第一期工程，此后约一千年间巨石陆续竖起。

title: Narmer unifies Upper and Lower Egypt
place_zh: 希拉康波利斯（今埃及阿斯旺省）
summary: Narmer, shown on the Narmer Palette wearing both crowns, united the Nile valley and delta and founded the First Dynasty.
summary_zh: 纳尔迈统一尼罗河谷与三角洲，建立第一王朝，纳尔迈调色板上刻有他头戴上下埃及王冠的形象。

title: Cycladic culture flourishes
place_zh: 纳克索斯岛（今希腊基克拉泽斯群岛）
summary: Islanders of the Cyclades traded by sea and carved the flat, abstract marble figurines that are the best known Aegean art of the early Bronze Age.
summary_zh: 基克拉泽斯群岛居民靠航海贸易为生，雕刻出造型简洁的大理石人像，是爱琴海早期青铜时代最著名的艺术。

title: Yamnaya herders spread from the steppe
summary: Wagon-using herders of the Yamnaya culture spread across the Pontic steppe and into Europe; many scholars link them to the spread of Indo-European languages.
summary_zh: 使用四轮车的颜那亚游牧民从黑海北岸草原向欧洲扩散，许多学者认为他们与印欧语系的传播有关。

title: Proto-Elamite script appears
place_zh: 苏萨（今伊朗胡齐斯坦省）
summary: Scribes at Susa began writing accounts in the Proto-Elamite script, one of the earliest writing systems, which is still undeciphered.
summary_zh: 苏萨的书吏开始用原始埃兰文字记账，这是世界上最早的文字之一，至今尚未破译。

title: Cuneiform writing matures
place_zh: 乌鲁克（今伊拉克穆萨纳省）
summary: Scribes in Uruk and other Sumerian cities developed pictographic signs into cuneiform, pressed into clay tablets for accounts and later for literature.
summary_zh: 乌鲁克等苏美尔城市的书吏把图画符号发展为刻在泥板上的楔形文字，最初用于记账，后来也用来书写文学作品。

title: Sannai-Maruyama settlement flourishes
place_zh: 三内丸山遗址（今日本青森县）
summary: A large Jōmon village in northern Honshu housed hundreds of people for over a thousand years, with big pillar buildings and chestnut groves.
summary_zh: 本州北部的大型绳文聚落延续一千多年，有大型立柱建筑和栗树林，显示采集社会也能长期定居。

title: Namazga culture
place_zh: 纳马兹加丘（今土库曼斯坦卡卡附近）
summary: Farmers of the Namazga culture built mud-brick villages along the Kopet Dag foothills and made painted pottery.
summary_zh: 纳马兹加文化的农民在科佩特山北麓建起泥砖村落，制作彩陶，是中亚南部最重要的早期农业文化。

title: Maize farming spreads in Mesoamerica
title_zh: 玉米种植在中美洲普及
place_zh: 特瓦坎河谷（今墨西哥普夫拉州）
summary: Larger maize cobs bred over thousands of years made farming more rewarding, and foragers in valleys such as Tehuacán relied more and more on planted crops.
summary_zh: 经过数千年选育，玉米穗变大，特瓦坎河谷等地的采集者越来越依赖种植作物，为定居农业打下基础。

title: Early Minoan culture emerges on Crete
place_zh: 米尔托斯（今希腊克里特岛）
summary: Villages on Crete began working copper and trading across the Aegean, laying the ground for the later palace civilization of the Minoans.
summary_zh: 克里特岛的村落开始加工铜器并在爱琴海从事贸易，为后来米诺斯王宫文明的兴起打下基础。

title: First settlement at Troy
place_zh: 希沙利克（今土耳其恰纳卡莱）
summary: A fortified settlement (Troy I) was built on the hill of Hisarlik near the Dardanelles; it was rebuilt in many layers over the next two thousand years.
summary_zh: 达达尼尔海峡附近的希沙利克山丘上建起设防聚落（特洛伊第一层），此后两千年间屡毁屡建，层层叠压。

title: Shahr-e Sukhteh flourishes
place_zh: 被焚之城（今伊朗锡斯坦）
summary: The Bronze Age town of Shahr-e Sukhteh in Sistan grew into a large craft and trading centre linking Iran with Central Asia and the Indus.
summary_zh: 锡斯坦的青铜时代城镇被焚之城发展为大型手工业和贸易中心，连接伊朗、中亚与印度河流域。

title: Flame-style pottery made in Middle Jōmon
place_zh: 笹山遗址（今日本新潟县十日町市）
summary: Potters in the Shinano River area made vessels with flame-like rims, the most elaborate of all Jōmon pottery.
summary_zh: 信浓川流域的陶工制作口沿如火焰般的陶器，是绳文陶器中装饰最繁复的代表。

title: Amsa-dong Neolithic village
place_zh: 岩寺洞（今韩国首尔江东区）
summary: Pit houses and comb-pattern pottery on the Han River at Amsa-dong show settled Neolithic life of fishing and gathering.
summary_zh: 首尔汉江边的岩寺洞遗址发现了大量半地穴式房屋和栉文陶器，反映了新石器时代以渔猎采集为主的定居生活。

title: Bangudae Petroglyphs
summary: Carvings of whales, deer and hunters on a cliff by the Daegok Stream include some of the earliest known depictions of whaling.
summary_zh: 蔚山大谷川崖壁上刻有鲸鱼、鹿和猎人等图像，其中的捕鲸场面是世界上已知最早的捕鲸图像之一。

title: Sarazm proto-urban settlement
place_zh: 萨拉子目（今塔吉克斯坦彭吉肯特附近）
summary: Sarazm in the Zeravshan valley was one of the earliest settlements in Central Asia, trading turquoise, copper and tin across the region.
summary_zh: 泽拉夫尚河谷的萨拉子目是中亚最早的定居点之一，开采和交易绿松石、铜和锡，联系着草原与南方绿洲。

title: Lothagam North pillar cemetery
place_zh: 洛塔甘（今肯尼亚图尔卡纳湖西岸）
summary: Early cattle herders around Lake Turkana built a large communal cemetery marked with stone pillars, the oldest monumental site in East Africa.
summary_zh: 图尔卡纳湖畔的早期牧牛人修建了以石柱为标志的大型公共墓地，是东非已知最早的纪念性建筑。

title: Old Copper Complex
place_zh: 五大湖地区（今美国威斯康星州）
summary: Peoples around the western Great Lakes hammered native copper into tools and ornaments, among the oldest metalworking in the world.
summary_zh: 五大湖西部的居民将天然铜锤打成工具和饰物，是世界上最早的金属加工之一。

title: Aspero mounds built on the Supe coast
place_zh: 阿斯佩罗（今秘鲁利马大区苏佩）
summary: Fishing people at Aspero near the mouth of the Supe River raised platform mounds, an early step toward the Norte Chico towns.
summary_zh: 苏佩河口的渔民在阿斯佩罗修建平台土丘，以海产为生，是北奇科文明早期的重要聚落。

title: Valdivia culture makes early pottery
place_zh: 瓦尔迪维亚（今厄瓜多尔圣埃伦娜省）
summary: Villagers on the coast of Ecuador made some of the oldest pottery in the Americas and small stone and clay figurines.
summary_zh: 厄瓜多尔沿海的瓦尔迪维亚村民制作了美洲最早的陶器之一，还留下许多小型陶土女像。

title: Memphis founded as royal capital
place_zh: 孟菲斯（今埃及吉萨省米特拉希纳）
summary: By tradition Menes founded Memphis at the junction of the valley and delta; it stayed Egypt's capital for most of the Old Kingdom.
summary_zh: 相传美尼斯在河谷与三角洲交界处建立孟菲斯，此后长期是古埃及的都城。

title: Hieroglyphic writing comes into use
place_zh: 阿拜多斯（今埃及索哈杰省）
summary: Egyptian hieroglyphs, first seen on labels from Abydos, developed into a full writing system used for royal records and religion.
summary_zh: 埃及象形文字最早见于阿拜多斯的标签，逐步发展为完整的文字体系，用于王室记录和宗教。

check.n: Was c. 2900 BC; earliest hieroglyphs (Abydos tomb U-j, Narmer era) date to c. 3250-3200 BC per Wikipedia/Wikidata.
check.n_zh: 原作约公元前2900年，据维基百科（阿拜多斯U-j墓等最早铭文约前3250—前3200年）改为前3200年。

title: Corded Ware culture
place_zh: 萨克森-安哈尔特（今德国）
summary: A culture marked by cord-decorated pottery, stone battle-axes and single graves spread across northern and central Europe, partly through migration from the steppe.
summary_zh: 以绳纹装饰陶器、石战斧和单人墓为特征的文化遍布北欧和中欧，部分源于草原人群的迁入。

title: Proto-Elamite tablets at Tepe Yahya
title_zh: 叶海亚丘原始埃兰泥板
place_zh: 叶海亚丘（今伊朗克尔曼省）
summary: Proto-Elamite accounting tablets found at Tepe Yahya, far to the east of Susa, show how widely the Elamite trade network reached.
summary_zh: 在远离苏萨的东部叶海亚丘出土了原始埃兰记账泥板，说明埃兰贸易网络覆盖范围很广。

title: Kot Diji culture
place_zh: 科特迪吉（今巴基斯坦信德省）
summary: Fortified farming towns of the Kot Diji type spread across the Indus valley, laying the ground for the later cities.
summary_zh: 科特迪吉类型的设防农业城镇遍布印度河流域，为后来的大城市奠定了基础。

title: Bell Beaker culture spreads
summary: Bell-shaped drinking cups, copper daggers and archery gear spread from Iberia across western and central Europe, along with metalworking skills.
summary_zh: 钟形陶杯、铜匕首和射箭器具从伊比利亚半岛传遍西欧和中欧，金属加工技术也随之传播。

title: Ploughed field at Kalibangan
place_zh: 卡利班甘（今印度拉贾斯坦邦）
summary: A field with criss-cross plough furrows was found at Kalibangan, one of the oldest ploughed fields known.
summary_zh: 卡利班甘发现了带有纵横犁沟的田地，是已知最早的犁耕田之一，说明当时已使用犁耕作。

title: Gilgamesh rules Uruk
title_zh: 吉尔伽美什统治乌鲁克
place_zh: 乌鲁克（今伊拉克穆萨纳省）
summary: Gilgamesh, remembered as the builder of Uruk's walls, ruled the city and later became the hero of the world's oldest great epic.
summary_zh: 吉尔伽美什相传修建了乌鲁克城墙，后来成为世界上最古老史诗《吉尔伽美什史诗》的主人公。

check.n: Chinese Wikipedia dates Gilgamesh's reign to about 2600 BC, not 2700.
check.n_zh: 中文维基百科称吉尔伽美什统治期大约在公元前2600年，而非2700年。

title: Khasekhemwy restores unity
title_zh: 哈谢海姆威重新统一埃及
place_zh: 希拉康波利斯（今埃及阿斯旺省）
summary: The last king of the Second Dynasty ended a period of division between followers of Horus and Seth, preparing the way for the Old Kingdom.
summary_zh: 第二王朝末代国王哈谢海姆威结束了荷鲁斯与塞特两派的分裂，为古王国的到来铺平道路。

title: Step Pyramid of Djoser built
title_zh: 左塞尔阶梯金字塔建成
summary: Djoser's architect Imhotep built the first large stone building in history, a pyramid of six stacked steps.
summary_zh: 左塞尔王的建筑师伊姆霍特普修建了六层阶梯金字塔，是历史上第一座大型石质建筑。

title: Dholavira settled
place_zh: 多拉维拉（今印度古吉拉特邦）
summary: A settlement grew on Khadir island in the Rann of Kutch that later became one of the largest Harappan cities, with great water reservoirs.
summary_zh: 卡奇沼泽的哈迪尔岛上兴起聚落，后来发展为哈拉帕文明最大的城市之一，以大型蓄水池著称。

title: Rise of Harappa
place_zh: 哈拉帕（今巴基斯坦旁遮普省）
summary: Harappa grew into a planned city of baked brick, giving its name to the Indus Valley Civilisation.
summary_zh: 哈拉帕发展为用烧砖建造的规划城市，印度河流域文明因此又称哈拉帕文明。

title: Rise of Caral
place_zh: 卡拉尔（今秘鲁利马大区苏佩河谷）
summary: Caral grew into a city of pyramids, sunken plazas and houses in the Supe valley, one of the oldest cities in the Americas.
summary_zh: 苏佩河谷的卡拉尔发展为拥有金字塔、下沉式广场和住宅区的城市，是美洲最古老的城市之一。

title: Indus script in use
place_zh: 哈拉帕（今巴基斯坦旁遮普省）
summary: Short inscriptions on seals and pottery used a script of several hundred signs that is still undeciphered.
summary_zh: 印章和陶器上刻有由数百个符号组成的简短铭文，这种文字至今仍未被破译。

title: Royal Cemetery of Ur
place_zh: 乌尔（今伊拉克济加尔省）
summary: Rulers of Ur were buried with gold, lyres, the Standard of Ur and sacrificed attendants, showing the wealth and craft of Sumerian cities.
summary_zh: 乌尔王陵出土黄金器物、竖琴和乌尔军旗，还有大量殉葬者，显示了苏美尔城邦的财富和工艺水平。

title: Lapis lazuli trade from Badakhshan
title_zh: 阿富汗青金石远销西亚
place_zh: 萨尔桑（今阿富汗巴达赫尚省）
summary: Lapis lazuli mined at Sar-i Sang in Badakhshan travelled across the Iranian plateau to the royal tombs of Ur and to Egypt.
summary_zh: 巴达赫尚萨尔桑出产的青金石经伊朗高原运往乌尔王陵和埃及，是古代远程贸易的重要商品。

title: Rakhigarhi
place_zh: 拉吉加里（今印度哈里亚纳邦）
summary: Rakhigarhi on the Ghaggar plain grew into one of the largest Harappan sites; ancient DNA from its burials has informed debates on Indian ancestry.
summary_zh: 加加尔河平原上的拉吉加里成为哈拉帕文明最大的遗址之一，墓葬古DNA为研究南亚人群起源提供了证据。

title: Great Pyramid of Giza completed
summary: The pyramid of Khufu, about 146 metres high, was the tallest human-made structure on earth for nearly four thousand years.
summary_zh: 胡夫金字塔高约146米，在近四千年里一直是世界上最高的人造建筑，位列古代世界七大奇迹。

title: Diary of Merer, the oldest inscribed papyri
place_zh: 加尔夫干河谷（今埃及红海沿岸）
summary: Logbooks of an official who shipped limestone to Giza for the Great Pyramid are the oldest known papyri with writing.
summary_zh: 一名官员记录为胡夫金字塔运送石灰岩的工作日志，是已知最古老的书写纸草文献。

title: Mohenjo-daro at its height
place_zh: 摩亨佐·达罗（今巴基斯坦信德省）
summary: The largest Indus city had grid streets, covered drains and a citadel, and may have held 40,000 people.
summary_zh: 印度河流域最大的城市，街道呈网格状，有加盖排水沟和卫城，人口可能达四万。

title: Kerma culture and the first Nubian kingdom
summary: At Kerma on the Nile above the Third Cataract arose the first kingdom of Nubia, later called Kush by the Egyptians, with huge mud-brick temples and royal tombs.
summary_zh: 尼罗河第三瀑布以南的克尔玛兴起努比亚最早的王国，埃及人称之为库施，留下巨大的泥砖神庙和王陵。

title: Great Sphinx of Giza carved
summary: The Sphinx, a lion with a king's head, was carved from the bedrock beside the pyramid of Khafre.
summary_zh: 狮身人面像在哈夫拉金字塔旁的岩床上雕成，长着狮身和国王的头。

title: Jiroft culture
place_zh: 吉罗夫特（今伊朗克尔曼省）
summary: A Bronze Age culture in the Halil River valley produced finely carved chlorite vessels that were traded as far as Mesopotamia.
summary_zh: 哈利勒河谷的青铜时代文化以精雕的绿泥石器皿闻名，这些器皿远销两河流域。

title: Great Bath of Mohenjo-daro
place_zh: 摩亨佐·达罗（今巴基斯坦信德省）
summary: A watertight brick pool sealed with bitumen was built on the citadel, probably for ritual bathing.
summary_zh: 卫城上修建了用沥青防水的砖砌水池，可能用于宗教沐浴仪式，是已知最早的公共浴池之一。

title: Pearl millet domesticated in the Sahel
summary: Farmers in the southern Sahara and Sahel domesticated pearl millet, a drought-tolerant grain that became a staple of West African farming.
summary_zh: 撒哈拉南缘和萨赫勒的农民驯化了耐旱的珍珠粟，它成为西非农业的主要粮食作物。

title: Stallings Island pottery
place_zh: 斯托林斯岛（今美国佐治亚州）
summary: People on the Savannah River made fiber-tempered pottery, the oldest known pottery in North America.
summary_zh: 萨凡纳河沿岸的居民烧制掺植物纤维的陶器，是北美已知最古老的陶器。

title: Arctic small tool tradition
place_zh: 丹比角（今美国阿拉斯加州）
summary: Hunters with fine stone microblades spread from Alaska across the Canadian Arctic to Greenland, the first people to settle the far north.
summary_zh: 使用精细细石叶的猎人从阿拉斯加向东扩散到加拿大北极和格陵兰，是最早定居极北地区的人群。

title: Maize, beans and squash farming takes shape
title_zh: 玉米、豆类、南瓜混种农业形成
place_zh: 瓦哈卡谷地（今墨西哥瓦哈卡州）
summary: Farmers grew maize, beans and squash together; the three crops fed each other and gave a balanced diet, the base of later Mesoamerican civilization.
summary_zh: 农民把玉米、豆类和南瓜种在一起，三者互相促进生长，提供均衡饮食，成为后来中美洲文明的农业基础。

title: Lagash defeats Umma
place_zh: 吉尔苏（今伊拉克济加尔省泰洛）
summary: King Eannatum of Lagash defeated neighbouring Umma in a long border war over fields and canals, celebrated on the Stele of the Vultures.
summary_zh: 拉格什国王安那吐姆在与温马争夺田地和水渠的边界战争中获胜，鹫碑记录了这场胜利。

title: Lothal dockyard
place_zh: 洛塔尔（今印度古吉拉特邦）
summary: Lothal had a large brick basin linked to a river, often seen as the oldest known dock, serving bead making and sea trade.
summary_zh: 洛塔尔有一座连通河道的大型砖砌水池，常被视为已知最早的船坞，服务于珠饰制作和海上贸易。

title: Archives of Ebla
place_zh: 埃卜拉（今叙利亚伊德利卜省）
summary: The palace archive of Ebla in Syria, some 17,000 tablets, shows a rich trading kingdom outside Mesopotamia writing in cuneiform.
summary_zh: 叙利亚埃卜拉王宫出土约一万七千块泥板，表明两河流域以外也有使用楔形文字的繁荣商业王国。

title: Altyn-Depe becomes a proto-city
place_zh: 阿尔丁丘（今土库曼斯坦）
summary: Altyn-Depe grew into a walled town with craft quarters and a stepped temple platform, one of the first urban centres in Central Asia.
summary_zh: 阿尔丁丘发展为有城墙、手工业区和阶梯式神庙台的城镇，是中亚最早的城市中心之一。

title: Reforms of Urukagina
place_zh: 吉尔苏（今伊拉克济加尔省泰洛）
summary: Urukagina of Lagash curbed officials and priests, cut fees and protected widows and orphans, the earliest known reform text.
summary_zh: 拉格什国王乌鲁卡基那限制官吏和祭司的盘剥，减轻税费，保护孤儿寡妇，留下了已知最早的改革文献。

check.n: Wikipedia gives Urukagina ruling c. 2378-2371 BC (died c. 2368), earlier than the 2350 date.
check.n_zh: 维基百科称乌鲁卡基那约前2378年至前2371年在位（约前2368年卒），早于前2350年。

title: Pyramid Texts carved in the tomb of Unas
summary: Spells for the king's afterlife carved inside Unas's pyramid are the oldest religious texts in the world.
summary_zh: 乌纳斯金字塔内刻写的国王来世咒语，是世界上最古老的宗教文献。

title: Trade with Mesopotamia (Meluhha)
title_zh: 与美索不达米亚的贸易
place_zh: 洛塔尔（今印度古吉拉特邦）
summary: Akkadian texts of Sargon's time record ships from Meluhha, most likely the Indus region, bringing carnelian, timber and ivory.
summary_zh: 萨尔贡时代的阿卡德文献记载来自麦鲁哈（多认为即印度河地区）的船只运来红玉髓、木材和象牙。

title: Sargon founds the Akkadian Empire
title_zh: 萨尔贡建立阿卡德王国
place_zh: 阿卡德（今伊拉克巴格达附近，确址不详）
summary: Sargon of Akkad conquered the Sumerian cities and lands up to Syria, creating the first empire ruled by one king over many peoples.
summary_zh: 阿卡德的萨尔贡征服苏美尔诸城邦并远征叙利亚，建立了历史上第一个统治多个民族的帝国。

title: Legendary founding of Gojoseon by Dangun
summary: Later Korean chronicles date the founding of Gojoseon by the mythical Dangun to 2333 BC. The legend became a symbol of Korean national origins.
summary_zh: 后世朝鲜史书记载传说中的檀君于公元前2333年建立古朝鲜，这一传说成为朝鲜民族起源的象征。

title: Únětice culture and early bronze working
place_zh: 乌涅蒂采（今捷克布拉格附近）
summary: Communities in central Europe began making tin bronze on a large scale and traded metal widely, opening the Bronze Age north of the Alps.
summary_zh: 中欧社会开始大规模冶炼锡青铜并广泛贸易金属，阿尔卑斯山以北由此进入青铜时代。

title: Sargon of Akkad conquers Elam
place_zh: 苏萨（今伊朗胡齐斯坦省）
summary: Sargon of Akkad defeated the kings of Awan and Elam, and Susa came under Akkadian rule for a time.
summary_zh: 阿卡德的萨尔贡击败阿万和埃兰诸王，苏萨一度归阿卡德统治。

title: First pottery in Mesoamerica
place_zh: 特瓦坎河谷（今墨西哥普夫拉州）
summary: Simple fired clay vessels appeared in the Tehuacán Valley and elsewhere, marking the shift toward settled village life.
summary_zh: 特瓦坎河谷等地出现了简单的烧制陶器，标志着人们向定居村落生活转变。

title: Temple of the Crossed Hands at Kotosh
summary: Highland people at Kotosh built small temples with central fire pits, one of which bears a relief of crossed hands.
summary_zh: 高原的科托什人修建了中央设有火坑的小神庙，其中一座墙上刻有交叉双手的浮雕，反映早期宗教仪式。

title: Enheduanna, high priestess of Ur
title_zh: 恩赫杜安娜任乌尔大祭司
place_zh: 乌尔（今伊拉克济加尔省）
summary: Sargon's daughter Enheduanna served as high priestess of the moon god at Ur and wrote hymns, making her the first author known by name.
summary_zh: 萨尔贡之女恩赫杜安娜在乌尔担任月神大祭司并创作颂诗，是历史上第一位留下姓名的作者。

title: Victory Stele of Naram-Sin
summary: Naram-Sin, grandson of Sargon, defeated the Lullubi of the Zagros and called himself a god and King of the Four Quarters.
summary_zh: 萨尔贡之孙纳拉姆辛征服扎格罗斯山区的卢卢比人，自称神明和“四方之王”，胜利石碑记录了此事。

title: Austronesians reach the Philippines
place_zh: 卡加延河谷（今菲律宾吕宋岛）
summary: Austronesian-speaking farmers and seafarers sailed south from Taiwan into the Philippines and later spread across the islands of Southeast Asia.
summary_zh: 说南岛语的农人和航海者从台湾南下进入菲律宾，随后扩散到东南亚各海岛，奠定了今天马来人等族群的基础。

title: Gutians overthrow Akkad
place_zh: 阿卡德（今伊拉克巴格达附近）
summary: Weakened by revolts and drought, the Akkadian Empire fell to the Gutians from the Zagros, who ruled much of Sumer for about a century.
summary_zh: 阿卡德王国因叛乱和干旱而衰弱，被扎格罗斯山区的库提人灭亡，库提人统治苏美尔约一个世纪。

title: Collapse of the Old Kingdom
summary: After the long reign of Pepi II, royal power faded amid low Nile floods and famine, and provincial governors ruled on their own.
summary_zh: 佩皮二世长期统治之后，尼罗河水位低落，饥荒频发，王权衰落，各州长官自行其是。

title: Herakleopolitan dynasties rule the north
title_zh: 赫拉克利奥波利斯王朝
place_zh: 赫拉克利奥波利斯（今埃及贝尼苏韦夫省）
summary: The Ninth and Tenth Dynasties ruled Lower and Middle Egypt from Herakleopolis and fought the rising Theban kings.
summary_zh: 第九、第十王朝以赫拉克利奥波利斯为都，统治下埃及和中埃及，与兴起的底比斯王朝对峙。

title: Intef kings found the Eleventh Dynasty at Thebes
title_zh: 底比斯第十一王朝兴起
summary: Local rulers named Intef took royal titles at Thebes and pushed north, beginning the line that would reunite Egypt.
summary_zh: 名为安特夫的地方统治者在底比斯称王并向北扩张，开启了后来重新统一埃及的王系。

title: Ur-Nammu founds the Third Dynasty of Ur
title_zh: 乌尔纳姆建立乌尔第三王朝
place_zh: 乌尔（今伊拉克济加尔省）
summary: Ur-Nammu took power at Ur and united Sumer and Akkad, founding a centralised state with provincial governors and a large bureaucracy.
summary_zh: 乌尔纳姆在乌尔掌权，统一苏美尔和阿卡德，建立了设有行省总督和庞大官僚机构的中央集权国家。

title: Code of Ur-Nammu
place_zh: 乌尔（今伊拉克济加尔省）
summary: The oldest surviving law code set fines in silver for injuries and fixed rules on marriage, slaves and land.
summary_zh: 这是现存最早的成文法典，规定以白银赔偿伤害，并对婚姻、奴隶和土地等事务作出规定。

title: Ban Chiang culture
place_zh: 班清（今泰国乌隆他尼府）
summary: A long-lived village of rice farmers in northeast Thailand, known for its painted pottery and later for some of the earliest bronze working in the region.
summary_zh: 泰国东北部的稻作村落，以彩绘陶器闻名，后来出现了东南亚最早的青铜冶铸之一，是世界文化遗产。

title: Sintashta culture and the first chariots
title_zh: 辛塔什塔文化与最早的战车
place_zh: 辛塔什塔（今俄罗斯车里雅宾斯克州）
summary: Fortified settlements of the Sintashta culture produced the earliest known spoke-wheeled chariots and large amounts of bronze.
summary_zh: 辛塔什塔文化的设防聚落出现了已知最早的辐条轮战车，并大量冶炼青铜。

title: Puzur-Inshushinak and Linear Elamite
title_zh: 普祖尔-因舒希纳克与线形埃兰文
place_zh: 苏萨（今伊朗胡齐斯坦省）
summary: King Puzur-Inshushinak freed Elam from Mesopotamian rule and set up inscriptions in Linear Elamite, an Elamite script deciphered only in recent years.
summary_zh: 普祖尔-因舒希纳克使埃兰摆脱两河流域控制，留下线形埃兰文铭文，这种文字近年才被破译。

title: Great Ziggurat of Ur
place_zh: 乌尔（今伊拉克济加尔省）
summary: Ur-Nammu and his son Shulgi built the great stepped ziggurat for the moon god Nanna, the best preserved of Mesopotamian temple towers.
summary_zh: 乌尔纳姆和儿子舒尔吉为月神南纳修建阶梯形大塔庙，是两河流域保存最好的塔庙。

title: Yu the Great founds the Xia
summary: In the traditional histories Yu tamed the great flood and passed the throne to his son Qi, starting hereditary rule.
summary_zh: 据传统史书记载，大禹治平洪水，后来把王位传给儿子启，世袭王权由此开始。

title: Yu assembles the lords at Mount Tu
summary: Tradition holds that Yu summoned the leaders of many tribes to Mount Tu, where ten thousand states brought jade and silk, confirming his supremacy.
summary_zh: 相传大禹会诸侯于涂山，“执玉帛者万国”，确立其共主地位。

title: Qi defeats the Youhu at Gan
place_zh: 甘（传统认为在今陕西西安鄠邑一带）
summary: Yu's son Qi takes the throne. The Youhu clan refuses to accept him, and Qi crushes them at Gan, securing hereditary rule.
summary_zh: 禹的儿子启继承王位。有扈氏不服，启在甘地将其击败，巩固了父死子继的王位传承。

title: Yu casts the Nine Tripod Cauldrons
summary: Yu reputedly collected bronze from the nine provinces and cast nine great cauldrons, which became the symbol of legitimate rule over All-under-Heaven.
summary_zh: 相传禹收九牧之金铸九鼎，象征九州，此后九鼎成为王权正统的象征。

title: Mentuhotep II reunites Egypt
title_zh: 孟图霍特普二世统一埃及
place_zh: 代尔拜赫里（今埃及卢克索）
summary: The Theban king defeated Herakleopolis and reunited the country, founding the Middle Kingdom.
summary_zh: 底比斯国王孟图霍特普二世击败赫拉克利奥波利斯王朝，重新统一埃及，开创中王国。

title: Stone city of Shimao
summary: On the Loess Plateau in northern Shaanxi, a walled stone city of more than 400 hectares is at its height, one of the largest settlements of its time in East Asia.
summary_zh: 陕北黄土高原上，一座面积超过400万平方米的石砌城址正处于鼎盛期，是同时代东亚最大的聚落之一。

title: Qi holds the Juntai feast, hereditary rule
summary: Qi, son of Yu, feasted the lords at Juntai after succeeding his father, replacing the abdication system with hereditary dynastic succession.
summary_zh: 禹之子启继位后大享诸侯于钧台，禅让制为世袭制取代，“家天下”由此开始。

title: Elamites sack Ur
place_zh: 乌尔（今伊拉克济加尔省）
summary: Elamite armies captured Ur and carried off its last king Ibbi-Sin, ending the Third Dynasty and the last Sumerian state.
summary_zh: 埃兰军队攻陷乌尔，掳走末代国王伊比辛，乌尔第三王朝灭亡，这也是最后一个苏美尔人国家。

title: Oxus civilisation at its height
title_zh: 阿姆河文明（巴克特里亚-马尔吉亚纳文明）
place_zh: 戈努尔丘（今土库曼斯坦马雷附近）
summary: The Bactria-Margiana Archaeological Complex built fortified palaces and temples at Gonur Depe and traded with Mesopotamia and the Indus.
summary_zh: 巴克特里亚-马尔吉亚纳文明在戈努尔丘等地修建设防宫殿和神庙，与两河流域和印度河流域都有往来。

title: Disaster at Lajia
summary: An earthquake and floods bury a village on the upper Yellow River, preserving people where they fell and a bowl of the oldest known noodles.
summary_zh: 一场地震和随后的洪水掩埋了黄河上游的一座村落，遇难者的姿态和一碗已知最古老的面条都被保存了下来。

title: Ōyu stone circles built
place_zh: 大汤（今日本秋田县鹿角市）
summary: Late Jōmon people arranged river stones into two great rings with a sundial-like centre, probably for burials and rituals.
summary_zh: 绳文后期的人们用河石排成两座巨大的环形石阵，中心有日晷状石组，可能用于墓葬和祭祀。

title: Phùng Nguyên culture
summary: A late Neolithic rice-growing culture of the Red River valley, regarded as an ancestor of the later Đông Sơn culture.
summary_zh: 红河流域晚期新石器时代的稻作文化，出现了早期青铜器，被视为后来东山文化的源头。

title: Khok Phanom Di settlement
summary: A coastal settlement near the Gulf of Thailand whose burials show early rice farming and a rich pottery-making community.
summary_zh: 泰国湾沿岸的新石器时代聚落，墓葬显示早期稻作农业和发达的制陶业，反映稻作文化向南扩散。

title: Stone villages of Dhar Tichitt
summary: Herders and millet farmers built hundreds of walled stone villages along the Tichitt cliffs, one of the earliest complex societies of West Africa.
summary_zh: 牧民和种粟农民沿提希特崖壁修建了数百座石墙村落，是西非最早的复杂社会之一。

title: Taikang loses the realm to Houyi
summary: While King Taikang hunted beyond the Luo River, Houyi of the Youqiong clan seized the Xia capital; Han Zhuo later murdered Yi and usurped power.
summary_zh: 太康畋猎于洛水之外，有穷氏后羿乘机夺取夏政；后寒浞又杀羿篡位。

title: Astronomers Xi and He miss an eclipse
summary: The Book of Documents records that the astronomers Xi and He, drunk and negligent, failed to predict a solar eclipse and were punished under King Zhongkang.
summary_zh: 《尚书·胤征》载仲康时羲和沉湎于酒，未能预报日食而受征讨，为最早的日食记载之一。

title: Shao Kang restores the Xia
summary: In the traditional account, after Taikang lost power to Yi of Youqiong and Yi was killed by Han Zhuo, the young heir Shao Kang wins back the throne.
summary_zh: 据传统记载，太康失国，有穷氏后羿夺取政权，后羿又被寒浞所杀；夏的遗孤少康最终夺回王位。

title: Assyrian merchants at Kanesh
title_zh: 亚述商人在卡内什经商
place_zh: 卡内什（今土耳其开塞利附近）
summary: Merchants from Assur ran a trading colony at Kanesh in Anatolia, exchanging tin and textiles for silver, and left thousands of business letters.
summary_zh: 亚述城商人在安纳托利亚的卡内什设立商站，用锡和纺织品换取白银，留下数以万计的商业泥板书信。

title: Erlitou culture flourishes
summary: A planned site with palace foundations, roads and the earliest Chinese bronze ritual vessels. Many scholars link it to the late Xia capital.
summary_zh: 这里有经过规划的宫殿基址、道路和中国最早的青铜礼器。许多学者认为它就是夏代晚期的都城。

title: First palace built at Knossos
place_zh: 克诺索斯（今希腊克里特岛伊拉克利翁）
summary: The Minoans built the first great palace at Knossos, a center of rule, storage and religion; similar palaces rose at Phaistos and Malia.
summary_zh: 米诺斯人在克诺索斯建起第一座大王宫，集统治、仓储和宗教于一体，费斯托斯和马利亚也建起类似王宫。

title: Decline of the Indus cities
place_zh: 摩亨佐·达罗（今巴基斯坦信德省）
summary: The great cities were gradually abandoned, probably as monsoon rains weakened and rivers shifted, and urban life faded.
summary_zh: 大城市逐渐被废弃，可能与季风减弱和河流改道有关，城市生活随之衰退。

title: Qijia culture works copper
summary: In the upper Yellow River valley, the Qijia people make copper and bronze knives, mirrors and ornaments, part of the early spread of metalworking into China.
summary_zh: 黄河上游的齐家文化先民制作铜和青铜的刀、镜和饰品，这是冶金技术早期传入和扩散到中国境内的一个环节。

title: Drying of the Ghaggar-Hakra
place_zh: 巴纳瓦利（今印度哈里亚纳邦）
summary: The Ghaggar-Hakra river system, home to many Harappan towns, lost its flow, and settlements moved east toward the Ganges plain.
summary_zh: 养育众多哈拉帕城镇的加加尔-哈克拉河水量减少，聚落向东迁往恒河平原。

title: The Story of Sinuhe written
place_zh: 伊塔威（今埃及利什特附近）
summary: This tale of an official who flees to Canaan and returns home in old age became the classic of Egyptian literature.
summary_zh: 讲述一位官员逃往迦南、晚年回归故土的故事，被视为古埃及文学的经典之作。

title: Senusret III conquers Lower Nubia
title_zh: 辛努塞尔特三世征服努比亚
place_zh: 塞姆纳（今苏丹第二瀑布）
summary: Senusret III fixed Egypt's southern border at the Second Cataract with a chain of great mud-brick fortresses facing Kerma.
summary_zh: 辛努塞尔特三世把南部边界定在第二瀑布，修建一系列泥砖要塞以防范科尔玛王国。

title: Babylonian mathematics
title_zh: 古巴比伦数学（普林顿322号泥板）
place_zh: 拉尔萨（今伊拉克济加尔省）
summary: Old Babylonian scribes used a base-60 place-value system and solved equations; the Plimpton 322 tablet lists Pythagorean triples.
summary_zh: 古巴比伦书吏使用六十进制位值记数并能解方程，普林顿322号泥板列出了多组勾股数。

title: Andronovo culture spreads across the steppe
summary: Andronovo herders, probably early Indo-Iranians, spread bronze working, horses and chariots from the Urals to the Yenisei.
summary_zh: 安德罗诺沃文化的牧民可能是早期印度-伊朗人，把青铜冶炼、马和战车从乌拉尔传到叶尼塞河。

title: Eastern Agricultural Complex
place_zh: 密西西比河流域（今美国肯塔基州）
summary: Eastern peoples domesticated squash, sunflower and other local plants, making eastern North America one of the world's independent centers of farming.
summary_zh: 东部居民驯化了南瓜、向日葵等本地植物，使北美东部成为世界上独立起源的农业中心之一。

title: Linear A script in use
place_zh: 费斯托斯（今希腊克里特岛）
summary: Minoan scribes wrote palace records in Linear A, a script that is still undeciphered.
summary_zh: 米诺斯书吏用线形文字A记录王宫账目，这种文字至今仍未被破译。

title: El Paraíso complex built
title_zh: 埃尔帕拉伊索遗址兴建
place: El Paraíso, Chillón Valley, Lima, Peru
place_zh: 埃尔帕拉伊索（今秘鲁利马奇永河谷）
summary: Builders near modern Lima piled up stone buildings in a U-shaped layout, an early form of the plan used by later coastal temples.
summary_zh: 今利马附近的居民修建大型石砌建筑群，呈U形布局，开启了后来沿海神庙常用的建筑形制。

title: Sechín Alto, largest monument of its time
place_zh: 塞钦阿尔托（今秘鲁安卡什大区卡斯马河谷）
summary: In the Casma valley people built a huge platform mound and plazas, then the largest monument in the Americas.
summary_zh: 卡斯马河谷的居民修建了巨大的平台土丘和广场，是当时美洲规模最大的建筑。

title: Hammurabi unites Mesopotamia
title_zh: 汉谟拉比统一两河流域
place_zh: 巴比伦（今伊拉克希拉附近）
summary: Hammurabi of Babylon defeated Larsa and then Mari and Eshnunna, uniting southern and central Mesopotamia under Babylon.
summary_zh: 巴比伦国王汉谟拉比先后击败拉尔萨、马里和埃什努纳，以巴比伦为中心统一了两河流域中南部。

title: Code of Hammurabi
place_zh: 巴比伦（今伊拉克希拉附近）
summary: Hammurabi set up a stele with 282 laws on trade, family, property and punishment, the best known law code of the ancient world.
summary_zh: 汉谟拉比把282条法律刻在石柱上，涉及商业、家庭、财产和刑罚，是古代世界最著名的法典。

title: Indo-Aryan migrations
place_zh: 斯瓦特河谷（今巴基斯坦）
summary: Herders speaking Indo-Aryan languages entered the northwest from Central Asia, bringing horses, chariots and the Vedic religion.
summary_zh: 说印度-雅利安语的游牧民从中亚进入印度西北部，带来了马、战车和吠陀宗教。

title: Poverty Point earthworks
place_zh: 波弗蒂角（今美国路易斯安那州）
summary: Hunter-gatherers built huge concentric earthen ridges and mounds and traded goods over long distances, a rare monument built without farming.
summary_zh: 狩猎采集者修建了巨大的同心半圆土垄和土丘，并进行远程贸易，是罕见的非农业社会大型工程。

title: Phaistos Disc
place_zh: 费斯托斯（今希腊克里特岛）
summary: A clay disc stamped with a spiral of signs was made at Phaistos; it is an early example of printing with movable stamps and remains unread.
summary_zh: 费斯托斯出土的陶土圆盘上用印模压出螺旋排列的符号，是早期活字压印的实例，至今无法释读。

title: Nordic Bronze Age begins
summary: Scandinavia, trading amber for bronze from the south, entered a rich Bronze Age known for fine metalwork, burial mounds and rock carvings.
summary_zh: 斯堪的纳维亚用琥珀换取南方的青铜，进入繁荣的青铜时代，以精美金属器、墓冢和岩画著称。

title: Hyksos rule from Avaris
place_zh: 阿瓦里斯（今埃及东部省达巴丘）
summary: Rulers of West Asian origin took power in the delta, made Avaris their capital and claimed overlordship of Egypt.
summary_zh: 来自西亚的喜克索斯人在三角洲掌权，以阿瓦里斯为都，自称全埃及的宗主。

title: Jie, the last Xia king
summary: The histories describe Jie as a cruel and wasteful ruler who lost the support of his people and of the lords, opening the way for Tang of Shang.
summary_zh: 史书把桀描写成残暴奢侈的君主，他失去了民心和诸侯的拥护，为商汤取而代之铺平了道路。

title: Hattusili I founds the Hittite kingdom
title_zh: 哈图西里一世建立赫梯王国
place_zh: 哈图沙（今土耳其乔鲁姆省）
summary: Hattusili I made Hattusa his capital and began Hittite expansion into Anatolia and Syria.
summary_zh: 哈图西里一世定都哈图沙，开始向安纳托利亚各地和叙利亚扩张，赫梯古王国由此兴起。

title: Earliest known ballcourt at Paso de la Amada
title_zh: 帕索德拉阿马达最早球场
place_zh: 帕索德拉阿马达（今墨西哥恰帕斯州）
summary: Villagers of the Mokaya culture built a ballcourt about 80 metres long, the oldest known court for the Mesoamerican ballgame.
summary_zh: 莫卡亚文化的村民修建了约80米长的球场，这是已知最早的中美洲蹴球场，显示球赛早已具有社会意义。

title: Tang of Shang destroys Kunwu
summary: Before the final war with Jie, Tang of Shang conquered Xia's allies Wei, Gu and Kunwu, stripping the last Xia king of his supporters.
summary_zh: 商汤先后征灭韦、顾、昆吾等夏的同盟方国，剪除夏桀羽翼，为灭夏铺路。

title: Tang of Shang defeats Jie of Xia
summary: The founder of Shang overthrows the last Xia king, remembered in the histories as a tyrant.
summary_zh: 商的开国君主汤推翻了夏朝末代君主桀。史书中，桀是一个暴君的形象。

title: Tang builds the capital at Western Bo
summary: The walled Shang city at Yanshi, just east of Erlitou, is widely identified with Tang's capital Western Bo, built to watch over the conquered Xia heartland.
summary_zh: 偃师商城紧邻二里头，被认为是商汤所都西亳，用以镇抚夏人故地。

title: Nebra sky disc
place_zh: 内布拉（今德国萨克森-安哈尔特）
summary: A bronze disc inlaid with gold sun, moon and stars was buried near Nebra; it is the oldest known concrete picture of the sky.
summary_zh: 内布拉附近埋藏的青铜圆盘上用黄金镶出日、月和星辰，是已知最古老的具体天象图。

title: Eruption of Thera
place_zh: 阿克罗蒂里（今希腊圣托里尼岛）
summary: A huge volcanic eruption on Thera buried the town of Akrotiri in ash and damaged Minoan Crete; its exact date is still debated.
summary_zh: 锡拉岛火山大爆发，火山灰掩埋了阿克罗蒂里城，也使米诺斯人的克里特受到冲击，确切年代仍有争议。

title: Horse and chariot reach Egypt
place_zh: 阿瓦里斯（今埃及东部省）
summary: The Hyksos period brought the horse, the light chariot and the composite bow, which later made Egypt's New Kingdom armies.
summary_zh: 喜克索斯时期，马、轻型战车和复合弓传入埃及，后来成为新王国军队的核心装备。

check.n: Wikipedia says chariots reached Egypt with the Hyksos around 1700 BCE.
check.n_zh: 维基百科称战车约在公元前1700年随希克索斯人传入埃及。

title: Rubber balls offered at El Manatí
place_zh: 埃尔马纳蒂（今墨西哥韦拉克鲁斯州）
summary: Rubber balls left as offerings in a sacred spring are the oldest known; people had learned to process latex into rubber.
summary_zh: 圣泉中作为祭品的橡胶球是已知最早的橡胶球，说明当地人已掌握把乳胶加工成橡胶的技术。

title: Carved warrior stones of Cerro Sechín
place_zh: 塞罗塞钦（今秘鲁安卡什大区卡斯马）
summary: The walls of Cerro Sechín were lined with carved stones showing warriors and cut up victims, early evidence of violence in Andean art.
summary_zh: 塞罗塞钦神庙外墙镶嵌数百块石雕，刻画武士和被肢解的俘虏，是安第斯艺术中较早的战争图像。

title: Hittites sack Babylon
place_zh: 巴比伦（今伊拉克希拉附近）
summary: The Hittite king Mursili I raided far down the Euphrates and sacked Babylon, ending the dynasty of Hammurabi.
summary_zh: 赫梯国王穆尔西里一世沿幼发拉底河远征，攻陷巴比伦，汉谟拉比的王朝就此灭亡。

title: Tang prays for rain at Mulberry Grove
summary: During a seven-year drought, Tang offered himself as a sacrifice at the Mulberry Grove, blaming his own faults; rain reportedly fell at once.
summary_zh: 商初大旱七年，汤剪发断爪，以身为牺牲祷于桑林，自责六事，大雨随即降下。

title: Yi Yin sends King Taijia away
summary: The chief minister Yi Yin removes the misbehaving young king Taijia for three years, then hands power back once he has reformed.
summary_zh: 宰相伊尹把行为失当的年轻商王太甲放逐三年，等他改过之后再把政权交还给他。

title: Rhind Mathematical Papyrus copied
summary: The scribe Ahmes copied a manual of arithmetic, fractions and geometry, the best source on Egyptian mathematics.
summary_zh: 书吏阿赫摩斯抄写了一部算术、分数和几何手册，是研究古埃及数学最重要的资料。

check.n: Chinese Wikipedia dates the papyrus's copying to about 1650 BC.
check.n_zh: 中文维基百科称该纸草书约前1650年抄写。

title: Ahmose I expels the Hyksos
title_zh: 雅赫摩斯一世驱逐喜克索斯人
place_zh: 阿瓦里斯（今埃及东部省）
summary: Ahmose took Avaris, drove the Hyksos into Canaan and founded the Eighteenth Dynasty and the New Kingdom.
summary_zh: 雅赫摩斯一世攻克阿瓦里斯，把喜克索斯人逐回迦南，建立第十八王朝，开启新王国。

title: Shaft graves of Mycenae
title_zh: 迈锡尼竖井墓与阿伽门农面具
place_zh: 迈锡尼（今希腊阿尔戈利斯）
summary: Rulers of Mycenae were buried with gold masks and weapons in shaft graves, showing the rising wealth of the Greek mainland.
summary_zh: 迈锡尼统治者下葬于竖井墓中，随葬黄金面具和兵器，显示希腊本土财富日增。

title: Kassites take over Babylon
place_zh: 巴比伦（今伊拉克希拉附近）
summary: The Kassites from the Zagros took control of Babylon and ruled it for over four centuries, the longest dynasty in its history.
summary_zh: 来自扎格罗斯山区的加喜特人控制巴比伦，统治长达四百多年，是巴比伦历史上最长的王朝。

title: Egypt conquers Kerma
title_zh: 图特摩斯一世征服克尔玛
summary: Thutmose I led Egyptian armies deep into Nubia and destroyed the power of Kerma, bringing Kush under Egyptian rule for some five centuries.
summary_zh: 图特摩斯一世率埃及军队深入努比亚，摧毁克尔玛政权，此后库施受埃及统治约五百年。

title: Composition of the Rigveda
summary: Priests in the Land of Seven Rivers composed the hymns of the Rigveda, the oldest Hindu scripture, passed on orally for centuries.
summary_zh: 七河之地的祭司创作了《梨俱吠陀》颂诗，是印度教最古老的经典，长期靠口头传承。

title: Bantu expansion begins
summary: Bantu-speaking farmers began to move out of their homeland near today's Nigeria-Cameroon border, over the next three millennia spreading farming and later iron across central, eastern and southern Africa.
summary_zh: 操班图语的农民开始从今尼日利亚和喀麦隆交界一带向外迁徙，此后数千年把农业和冶铁带到中非、东非和南部非洲。

check.n: Wikipedia says the Western Stream of Bantu expansion began between 5000 and 3000 BC.
check.n_zh: 维基百科称班图大迁徙西支约始于公元前5000至3000年间。

title: The Shang walled city at Zhengzhou
summary: The early Shang build a huge rammed-earth city at Zhengzhou, with walls nearly 7 km around, palaces and bronze workshops.
summary_zh: 商代前期在郑州建起一座巨大的夯土城，城墙周长近7公里，城内有宫殿和铸铜作坊。

title: Rice farming and Mumun pottery
place_zh: 大坪遗址（今韩国庆尚南道晋州）
summary: Plain Mumun pottery replaced comb-pattern ware, and villagers began to grow rice in dry and paddy fields.
summary_zh: 素面的无纹土器取代了栉文土器，居民开始在旱田和水田中种植水稻，农业成为主要生计。

title: Rise of Mitanni
place_zh: 瓦舒卡尼（今叙利亚哈塞克省）
summary: The Hurrian kingdom of Mitanni, led by an Indo-Aryan elite skilled with chariots, dominated northern Syria and Assyria.
summary_zh: 胡里安人的米坦尼王国由擅长战车的印度雅利安贵族统治，控制了叙利亚北部和亚述。

title: Karasuk culture
place_zh: 米努辛斯克盆地（今俄罗斯西伯利亚）
summary: The Karasuk culture of southern Siberia and eastern Kazakhstan made distinctive bronze knives that show links with northern China.
summary_zh: 西伯利亚南部和哈萨克斯坦东部的卡拉苏克文化以青铜刀著称，与中国北方有明显联系。

title: Yaz culture and the early Iron Age
place_zh: 雅兹丘（今土库曼斯坦马雷绿洲）
summary: The Yaz culture of the southern oases built citadels and irrigation canals, and is often linked with the world of the Avesta.
summary_zh: 南部绿洲的雅兹文化修建城堡和灌溉渠，常被认为与《阿维斯塔》描述的社会有关。

title: San José Mogote becomes Oaxaca's leading village
place_zh: 圣何塞莫戈特（今墨西哥瓦哈卡州）
summary: San José Mogote grew into the largest village of the Valley of Oaxaca, with public buildings and craft workshops, a forerunner of Zapotec society.
summary_zh: 圣何塞莫戈特成长为瓦哈卡谷地最大的村落，建有公共建筑和手工作坊，是萨波特克社会的前身。

title: Cupisnique culture
place_zh: 赫克特佩克河谷（今秘鲁拉利伯塔德大区）
summary: On the north coast the Cupisnique culture built adobe temples and made fine stirrup spout pottery, a forerunner of Chavín art.
summary_zh: 北部沿海的库皮斯尼克文化修建土坯神庙，制作精美的马镫形壶嘴陶器，是查文艺术的先驱。

title: Reign of Hatshepsut
title_zh: 哈特谢普苏特女王统治
place_zh: 代尔拜赫里（今埃及卢克索）
summary: Hatshepsut ruled as a full pharaoh, built her terraced temple at Deir el-Bahari and sent a trading fleet to Punt.
summary_zh: 哈特谢普苏特以法老身份执政，修建代尔拜赫里阶梯神庙，并派船队前往蓬特贸易。

title: Hatshepsut's expedition to Punt
title_zh: 哈特谢普苏特远征蓬特
place: Land of Punt, Red Sea coast of Africa
place_zh: 蓬特（今厄立特里亚至索马里一带）
summary: Queen Hatshepsut sent a fleet down the Red Sea to the Land of Punt, bringing back incense trees, ebony, gold and animals, as shown in reliefs at Deir el-Bahari.
summary_zh: 女法老哈特谢普苏特派船队沿红海南下蓬特，运回乳香树、乌木、黄金和珍奇动物，事见代尔拜赫里神庙浮雕。

title: Battle of Megiddo
summary: Thutmose III defeated a coalition of Canaanite princes, starting campaigns that built Egypt's empire in the Levant.
summary_zh: 图特摩斯三世击败迦南诸侯联军，此后连年远征，建立起埃及在西亚的帝国。

title: Panlongcheng, a Shang outpost on the Yangtze
place_zh: 盘龙城（今湖北武汉黄陂）
summary: A walled town with Shang-style bronzes and palaces stands near the Yangtze, far south of the Shang heartland, probably to control copper and trade routes.
summary_zh: 长江边出现一座带城墙的城邑，有商式青铜器和宫殿，远离商的腹地，很可能是为了控制铜料和交通要道。

title: Mycenaeans take over Knossos
place_zh: 克诺索斯（今希腊克里特岛）
summary: After the Minoan palaces were destroyed, Greek-speaking Mycenaeans took control of Knossos, and Crete became part of the Mycenaean world.
summary_zh: 米诺斯各王宫被毁后，说希腊语的迈锡尼人控制了克诺索斯，克里特岛并入迈锡尼世界。

title: Zhongding moves the capital to Ao
summary: King Zhongding moved the capital to Ao, opening a century of repeated relocations and succession struggles that the Records call the Nine Reigns of Disorder.
summary_zh: 仲丁迁都于隞，此后王位纷争、屡次迁都，史称“九世之乱”，商朝一度衰落。

title: Rise of San Lorenzo, first Olmec centre
place_zh: 圣洛伦索（今墨西哥韦拉克鲁斯州）
summary: San Lorenzo on the Gulf coast became the first great Olmec centre, with platforms, drains and monuments, often called the start of Mesoamerican civilization.
summary_zh: 墨西哥湾沿岸的圣洛伦索成为第一个奥尔梅克大中心，有人工台地、排水渠和石雕，常被视为中美洲文明的开端。

title: Linear B, the earliest written Greek
place_zh: 皮洛斯（今希腊美塞尼亚）
summary: Mycenaean palaces kept records in Linear B; deciphered in 1952, it is the oldest known form of written Greek.
summary_zh: 迈锡尼王宫用线形文字B记账，1952年被破译，是已知最早的希腊语文字。

title: Zu Yi relocates the capital to Xing
summary: After floods at Xiang, King Zu Yi moved the Shang court to Xing and, aided by the minister Wu Xian, briefly restored royal strength.
summary_zh: 河亶甲居相后，祖乙迁都于邢，任用巫贤，商朝复兴。

title: Battle of the Ten Kings
summary: The Rigveda tells how King Sudas of the Bharatas defeated a coalition of ten tribes on the Ravi river.
summary_zh: 《梨俱吠陀》记载婆罗多部落首领苏达斯在拉维河畔击败十个部落的联军。

title: Ugaritic alphabet
place_zh: 乌加里特（今叙利亚拉塔基亚附近）
summary: Scribes at the port of Ugarit wrote an alphabet of 30 signs in cuneiform style, one of the earliest alphabets.
summary_zh: 港口城市乌加里特的书吏用楔形笔画书写只有30个符号的字母文字，是最早的字母之一。

title: Tlatilco culture in the Valley of Mexico
place_zh: 特拉蒂尔科（今墨西哥州）
summary: Farming villages around Lake Texcoco buried their dead with fine pottery figurines, showing early ranked society in central Mexico.
summary_zh: 特斯科科湖畔的农业村落以精美陶俑随葬，反映了墨西哥中部早期社会的等级分化。

check.n: Wikipedia says Tlatilco culture flourished 1250-800 BCE, not from 1400.
check.n_zh: 维基百科称特拉蒂尔科文化繁盛于公元前1250至800年，而非1400年。

title: Akhenaten's religious reform
summary: Akhenaten made the sun disc Aten the sole god, closed the old temples and built a new capital at Amarna.
summary_zh: 埃赫那吞独尊太阳圆盘阿吞，关闭传统神庙，并在阿玛纳营建新都。

title: Amarna letters
summary: Clay tablets in Akkadian record letters between Egypt and Babylon, Mitanni, the Hittites and Canaanite vassals.
summary_zh: 以阿卡德文写成的泥板书信，记录了埃及与巴比伦、米坦尼、赫梯及迦南附庸的往来。

title: Huanbei Shang City
summary: Just north of the later Yin capital, a large square walled city is built and then abandoned, a missing link between early and late Shang.
summary_zh: 在后来殷都的北侧，一座方形大城建成后不久又被废弃，它填补了商代前后期之间的空白。

title: Suppiluliuma I destroys Mitanni
title_zh: 苏庇路里乌玛一世征服米坦尼
place_zh: 卡赫美士（今土耳其与叙利亚边境）
summary: The Hittite king Suppiluliuma I crushed Mitanni and took northern Syria, making the Hittites rivals of Egypt.
summary_zh: 赫梯国王苏庇路里乌玛一世击溃米坦尼，夺取叙利亚北部，赫梯从此与埃及争霸。

title: Tutankhamun restores the old gods
title_zh: 图坦卡蒙恢复传统信仰
summary: The boy king abandoned Amarna, restored the cult of Amun and the old temples, and died young around nineteen.
summary_zh: 少年法老图坦卡蒙放弃阿玛纳，恢复阿蒙神崇拜和传统神庙，约十九岁时早逝。

title: Pan Geng moves the capital to Yin
summary: The Shang settle at Yin, which stays the capital until the dynasty falls. Its ruins are the source of most Shang finds.
summary_zh: 商人定都于殷，此后直到灭亡再没有迁都。商代文物大多出自殷墟。

title: Urnfield culture
summary: Across central Europe people began cremating their dead and burying the ashes in urns in large cemeteries, a custom that spread widely.
summary_zh: 中欧各地开始火葬死者，把骨灰装入陶瓮葬于大型墓地，这一习俗流传甚广。

title: Battle of Kadesh
place_zh: 卡迭石（今叙利亚霍姆斯附近）
summary: Ramesses II of Egypt and the Hittite king Muwatalli II fought one of the largest chariot battles in history; neither side won outright.
summary_zh: 埃及法老拉美西斯二世与赫梯国王穆瓦塔里二世在此进行了史上规模最大的战车会战之一，双方均未取得决定性胜利。

title: Temples of Abu Simbel built
place_zh: 阿布辛贝（今埃及阿斯旺省）
summary: Ramesses II carved two great temples into a Nubian cliff, with four colossal seated statues of himself.
summary_zh: 拉美西斯二世在努比亚的山崖上开凿两座神庙，门前有四尊他本人的巨型坐像。

title: Egyptian-Hittite peace treaty
place_zh: 培尔-拉美西斯（今埃及东部省坎提尔）
summary: Ramesses II and Hattusili III made peace and a mutual defence pact, the earliest surviving international treaty.
summary_zh: 拉美西斯二世与赫梯国王哈图西里三世缔结和约与互助同盟，是现存最早的国际条约。

title: Oracle bone inscriptions
summary: Under King Wu Ding, diviners carve questions to the ancestors on turtle shells and ox bones, the earliest known Chinese writing.
summary_zh: 商王武丁时期，占卜者把向祖先提出的问题刻在龟甲和牛骨上，这是已知最早的汉字。

title: Ziggurat of Chogha Zanbil built
title_zh: 恰高·占比尔神庙塔建成
place_zh: 恰高·占比尔（今伊朗胡齐斯坦省）
summary: King Untash-Napirisha built a religious city with a great ziggurat near Susa, one of the best preserved ziggurats in the world.
summary_zh: 国王温塔什-纳皮里沙在苏萨附近建造宗教城市和巨大神庙塔，是世界上保存最好的塔庙之一。

title: Wu Ding raises the laborer Fu Yue
summary: Wu Ding claimed to have dreamt of a sage and found him among convict wall-builders at Fuyan; as chief minister, Fu Yue helped make Wu Ding's reign the Shang zenith.
summary_zh: 武丁梦得圣人，于傅岩版筑之间得傅说，举以为相，殷道复兴，史称“武丁中兴”。

title: Lion Gate of Mycenae
place_zh: 迈锡尼（今希腊阿尔戈利斯）
summary: Mycenae was ringed with massive Cyclopean walls entered through the Lion Gate, the largest surviving Bronze Age sculpture in Europe.
summary_zh: 迈锡尼城用巨石砌成城墙，正门狮子门上的石雕是欧洲现存最大的青铜时代雕刻。

title: Battle in the Tollense Valley
place_zh: 托伦塞河谷（今德国梅克伦堡）
summary: Thousands of men fought on a river crossing in northern Germany; it is the oldest large battlefield found in Europe.
summary_zh: 数千人在德国北部的一处河流渡口交战，这是欧洲已发现最古老的大规模战场遗址。

title: Wu Ding's war against the Guifang
summary: King Wu Ding fights a three-year war against the Guifang, a powerful people on the northwestern frontier.
summary_zh: 商王武丁对西北边境强大的鬼方发动战争，历时三年才将其征服。

title: Shang campaigns against the Qiang
place_zh: 商西部边地（今晋南豫西）
summary: Oracle bones record large Shang levies against the Qiang, whose captives were frequently sacrificed in royal rituals at Yin.
summary_zh: 甲骨文记载商王屡次征伐羌方，俘获的羌人常被用作祭祀人牲。

title: Sanxingdui bronze culture
summary: A separate bronze civilisation in Sichuan casts huge masks and figures unlike anything made by the Shang.
summary_zh: 四川盆地另有一支青铜文明，铸造出巨大的面具和人像，风格与商人截然不同。

title: Trojan War
place_zh: 特洛伊（今土耳其恰纳卡莱）
summary: Greek legend tells of a ten-year war of the Achaeans against Troy; the destruction of Troy VIIa around this time may lie behind the story.
summary_zh: 希腊传说中阿凯亚人围攻特洛伊十年，同一时期特洛伊第七层A的毁灭可能是这一传说的历史背景。

title: Zoroaster founds Zoroastrianism
title_zh: 琐罗亚斯德创立琐罗亚斯德教
place_zh: 巴克特里亚（今阿富汗巴尔赫）
summary: The prophet Zoroaster composed the Gathas and taught worship of Ahura Mazda as the struggle of good against evil. His dates are much debated.
summary_zh: 先知琐罗亚斯德创作《伽萨》，宣扬崇拜阿胡拉·马兹达和善恶斗争，这就是中国所称的祆教。他的年代争议很大。

title: Olmec colossal heads carved
place_zh: 圣洛伦索（今墨西哥韦拉克鲁斯州）
summary: Olmec sculptors carved huge basalt heads, probably portraits of rulers, hauling the stone many kilometres from the Tuxtla mountains.
summary_zh: 奥尔梅克工匠用玄武岩雕刻巨大人头像，可能是统治者的肖像，石料从数十公里外的图斯特拉山运来。

check.n: Wikipedia says the colossal heads date from at least 900 BCE.
check.n_zh: 维基百科称巨石头像至少可追溯至公元前900年。

title: Fu Hao leads the Shang armies
summary: Fu Hao, a wife of King Wu Ding, commands armies and leads rituals. Her untouched tomb, found in 1976, held nearly 2,000 objects.
summary_zh: 商王武丁的妻子妇好既统率军队，又主持祭祀。她的墓1976年被发现时完好无损，出土了近两千件器物。

title: Fall of the Mycenaean palaces
place_zh: 皮洛斯（今希腊美塞尼亚）
summary: In the wider Late Bronze Age collapse, palaces such as Pylos were burned, Linear B writing ceased and Mycenaean Greece broke apart.
summary_zh: 在青铜时代晚期大崩溃中，皮洛斯等王宫被焚，线形文字B停用，迈锡尼文明瓦解。

title: Rise of the Kuru kingdom
place_zh: 俱卢之野（今印度哈里亚纳邦）
summary: The Kuru became the first state-level society in Vedic India, organising rituals and collecting the Vedic hymns.
summary_zh: 俱卢成为吠陀时代最早的国家形态，统一祭祀仪式并整理吠陀颂诗。

title: Bronze culture flourishes at Xin'gan
summary: A rich tomb at Xin'gan with nearly 500 bronzes shows the Wucheng culture of the Gan River valley developed its own sophisticated bronze tradition alongside the Shang.
summary_zh: 江西新干大洋洲大墓出土青铜器近五百件，显示赣江流域吴城文化拥有与商并行的发达青铜文明。

title: Four-goat square zun cast in the south
summary: The Four-goat square zun, found at Ningxiang in Hunan, is the largest Shang square zun and a masterpiece of piece-mold casting from the middle Yangtze.
summary_zh: 湖南宁乡出土的四羊方尊是现存最大的商代方尊，展现了长江中游高超的分范铸造工艺。

check.n: Wikipedia dates the Four-goat Zun to late Shang, 11th-10th century BC.
check.n_zh: 维基百科称四羊方尊属商代晚期，约前11至前10世纪。

title: Gold vessels of Marlik
summary: Tombs at Marlik in the Alborz foothills held rich gold and silver vessels, showing a wealthy elite in northern Iran at the end of the Bronze Age.
summary_zh: 厄尔布尔士山麓马利克墓葬出土大量金银器，反映青铜时代末期伊朗北部已有富裕的上层贵族。

title: Painted Grey Ware and iron
summary: Villages of the western Ganges plain made fine grey pottery and began to use iron tools, helping clear the forest for farming.
summary_zh: 恒河平原西部村落制作精美的彩绘灰陶并开始使用铁器，促进了开垦森林、发展农业。

title: Early Maya village at Cuello
summary: Cuello in northern Belize is one of the oldest known Maya farming villages, with early pottery and house platforms.
summary_zh: 伯利兹北部的奎略是已知最早的玛雅农业村落之一，留有早期陶器和房屋台基。

title: Casting the Houmuwu ding
summary: Shang bronze casters make an 830-kilogram cauldron for a royal mother, the heaviest bronze vessel known from ancient China.
summary_zh: 商代工匠为一位王室之母铸造了一件重约830公斤的大鼎，这是中国古代已知最重的青铜器。

title: Destruction of Ugarit
place_zh: 乌加里特（今叙利亚拉塔基亚附近）
summary: Ugarit was burned and never rebuilt, one of many cities lost in the Late Bronze Age collapse linked to the Sea Peoples.
summary_zh: 乌加里特被焚毁后再未重建，它是青铜时代晚期大崩溃中毁灭的众多城市之一，常与“海上民族”相联系。

title: Fall of the Hittite Empire
place_zh: 哈图沙（今土耳其乔鲁姆省）
summary: Amid drought, invasions and revolts, Hattusa was abandoned and burned and the Hittite Empire disappeared.
summary_zh: 在干旱、外族入侵和内乱之中，哈图沙被遗弃焚毁，赫梯帝国就此消失。

title: Ramesses III defeats the Sea Peoples
title_zh: 拉美西斯三世击败海上民族
summary: Egypt repelled migrating Sea Peoples by land and sea, a victory shown on the walls of Medinet Habu as Bronze Age states collapsed.
summary_zh: 埃及在陆上和海上击退迁徙的海上民族，哈布城神庙浮雕记录了这场青铜时代末期的战争。

title: Shutruk-Nakhunte sacks Babylon
title_zh: 舒特鲁克-纳洪特洗劫巴比伦
summary: The Elamite king raided Babylonia and carried the stele of Hammurabi's code and other monuments back to Susa, where they were found in 1901.
summary_zh: 埃兰国王攻掠巴比伦尼亚，把《汉谟拉比法典》石碑等文物运回苏萨，1901年在苏萨出土。

title: Strike of the Deir el-Medina tomb builders
place_zh: 代尔麦地那（今埃及卢克索）
summary: Royal tomb workers stopped work when their grain rations were late, the first recorded strike in history.
summary_zh: 为王陵施工的工匠因口粮拖欠而停工，是史上最早有记载的罢工。

title: King Wu Yi insults Heaven
place: Between the Yellow and Wei rivers
summary: King Wu Yi made an effigy of Heaven to gamble against and shot at a leather bag of blood; Sima Qian records he was killed by lightning while hunting.
summary_zh: 武乙为偶人谓之天神而与之博，又以革囊盛血仰射之，后猎于河渭之间被雷震死。

title: Danfu leads the Zhou to Zhouyuan
summary: Pressed by raiders, the Zhou chief Danfu moves his people to the plain below Mount Qi, where the Zhou grow into a strong state.
summary_zh: 受到戎狄侵扰，周族首领古公亶父率众迁到岐山脚下的周原，周人在这里逐渐强大起来。

title: Nebuchadnezzar I sacks Susa
title_zh: 尼布甲尼撒一世攻掠苏萨
place_zh: 苏萨（今伊朗胡齐斯坦省）
summary: Nebuchadnezzar I of Babylon defeated Elam and recovered the statue of Marduk, and Elam fell into a long dark age.
summary_zh: 巴比伦国王尼布甲尼撒一世击败埃兰，夺回马尔杜克神像，埃兰此后长期衰落。

title: King Wen Ding kills Zhou leader Jili
summary: Alarmed by the victories of Zhou's leader Jili over the Rong tribes, the Shang king Wen Ding detained and killed him, souring Shang–Zhou relations.
summary_zh: 周首领季历屡败诸戎，势力日强，商王文丁将其拘禁杀害，商周矛盾激化。

title: Dorian migration
place_zh: 斯巴达（今希腊拉科尼亚）
summary: Greek tradition held that Dorian Greeks moved south into the Peloponnese after the palaces fell; Sparta later saw itself as a Dorian city.
summary_zh: 按希腊传统说法，王宫衰落后多利亚人南下进入伯罗奔尼撒，后来的斯巴达自认是多利亚人城邦。

title: Phoenicians found Gadir
place_zh: 加的斯（今西班牙安达卢西亚）
summary: Phoenician traders from Tyre founded Gadir beyond the Strait of Gibraltar to reach Iberian silver; tradition dates it to 1104 BC, archaeology somewhat later.
summary_zh: 推罗的腓尼基商人在直布罗陀海峡外建立加的斯，以获取伊比利亚白银，传统年代为前1104年。

title: Kuntur Wasi temple and its gold
place_zh: 昆图尔瓦西（今秘鲁卡哈马卡大区）
summary: A highland temple at Kuntur Wasi held some of the oldest worked gold in the Andes, buried with its leaders.
summary_zh: 卡哈马卡高原的昆图尔瓦西神庙墓葬中出土了安第斯地区最早的一批金器。

title: Pools of wine and forests of meat
summary: Later histories portray Di Xin enlarging Zhaoge, hoarding grain at Juqiao, and feasting at pools of wine and hanging meat, while inventing the burning-pillar punishment.
summary_zh: 帝辛扩建朝歌，厚赋敛以实鹿台、钜桥，以酒为池、悬肉为林，又设炮烙之刑。

title: Egypt divided between Tanis and the Theban priests
summary: After Ramesses XI, kings of the Twenty-first Dynasty ruled from Tanis while the high priests of Amun controlled Thebes.
summary_zh: 拉美西斯十一世之后，第二十一王朝国王以塔尼斯为都，阿蒙大祭司则控制底比斯。

title: Di Xin's wars against the Eastern Yi
summary: The last Shang king fights long campaigns against the Yi peoples in the east, winning but draining his strength.
summary_zh: 商朝末代君主帝辛长期征讨东方的夷人，虽然取胜，却耗尽了国力。

title: Jiang Ziya joins King Wen
summary: King Wen met the aged Lü Shang fishing on the Wei River and made him his strategist; as Taigong Wang he planned the overthrow of Shang.
summary_zh: 西伯昌于渭水之滨遇垂钓的吕尚，尊为“太公望”，拜为师，谋划翦商大业。

title: King Wen imprisoned at Youli
summary: Di Xin imprisoned the Zhou leader Chang at Youli, where tradition says he elaborated the 64 hexagrams of the Yijing; Zhou ransomed him with treasures.
summary_zh: 帝辛囚西伯昌于羑里，相传其在狱中推演六十四卦；周人献美女宝马方得赎归。

title: King Wen conquers the state of Li
summary: Zhou's conquest of Li, just west of the Shang capital region, alarmed the minister Zu Yi, whose warning Di Xin dismissed, saying his mandate came from Heaven.
summary_zh: 周伐灭黎国，逼近商都，祖伊惊恐奔告纣王，纣王答曰“我生不有命在天乎”。

title: Phoenician alphabet
place_zh: 比布鲁斯（今黎巴嫩朱拜勒）
summary: Phoenician scribes used 22 consonant letters; traders spread the system, which became the root of Greek, Latin, Aramaic and Arabic scripts.
summary_zh: 腓尼基人使用22个辅音字母，商人把它传播到各地，成为希腊、拉丁、阿拉米和阿拉伯等字母的源头。

title: King Wen of Zhou founds Feng
summary: After conquering Chong, King Wen of Zhou moves his capital east to Feng on the Wei plain, setting up the attack on Shang.
summary_zh: 周文王灭掉崇国后，把都城东迁到渭河平原上的丰邑，为伐商做好了准备。

title: King Wu reviews his allies at Mengjin
summary: Eight hundred lords join King Wu of Zhou at the Mengjin ford, but he judges the time is not yet right and turns back.
summary_zh: 八百诸侯在孟津渡口与周武王会合，但武王认为时机尚未成熟，便率军返回。

title: Bigan is killed for his advice
summary: The king's uncle Bigan warns Di Xin to change his ways and is put to death; other nobles flee or feign madness.
summary_zh: 纣王的叔父比干劝他改过，结果被杀；其他贵族有的出走，有的装疯避祸。

title: Battle of Muye
summary: King Wu of Zhou defeats the last Shang king, who burns himself in his palace. The Zhou justify the conquest as the Mandate of Heaven.
summary_zh: 周武王打败商朝末代君主，纣王在宫中自焚而死。周人把这次征服说成是天命的转移。

title: Taigong Wang founds the state of Qi
summary: Jiang Ziya was enfeoffed in the east at Yingqiu; by simplifying rites, promoting fishing and salt, he built Qi into a prosperous coastal state.
summary_zh: 太公望封于营丘建立齐国，因俗简礼，通商工之业，便鱼盐之利，齐遂成大国。

title: Yan enfeoffed in the far north
summary: The Duke of Shao's line received Yan in the north; bronzes from the Liulihe cemetery confirm the early Zhou capital of Yan near modern Beijing.
summary_zh: 召公奭受封于燕，长子就封；北京房山琉璃河遗址的铭文铜器证实了燕国早期都城。

title: Jizi leads followers to Korea
summary: After the Shang fall, the prince Jizi expounded the Great Plan to King Wu but refused to serve Zhou and went east; tradition says he was enfeoffed in Joseon.
summary_zh: 商亡后箕子向武王陈《洪范》，不愿臣周，东走朝鲜，相传武王因而封之。

title: Boyi and Shuqi starve on Shouyang
summary: Two princes of Guzhu who opposed Zhou's conquest as disloyal refused to eat Zhou grain and starved on Mount Shouyang, becoming paragons of integrity.
summary_zh: 孤竹国伯夷、叔齐叩马谏阻武王伐纣，周灭商后义不食周粟，饿死于首阳山。

title: Zhou grants fiefs to kin and allies
summary: The Zhou kings hand out land to royal relatives and allies, founding states such as Lu, Qi, Yan, Wey and Jin to hold the conquered east.
summary_zh: 周王把土地分给王室亲属和功臣，建立了鲁、齐、燕、卫、晋等诸侯国，用来控制新征服的东方。

title: Rebellion of the Three Guards
place_zh: 商朝故地（今河南安阳一带）
summary: King Wu's brothers, set to watch over the Shang, rise with the Shang prince Wu Geng against the regent Duke of Zhou, who crushes them in a three-year campaign.
summary_zh: 受命监视商人的武王之弟们联合商王子武庚，起兵反对摄政的周公，周公经过三年东征将其平定。

title: The peace of Kings Cheng and Kang
summary: Under Kings Cheng and Kang, Zhou rule settles down. Later writers remember it as a golden age when punishments were not needed for forty years.
summary_zh: 周成王、周康王在位期间，周朝统治趋于稳定。后人把这一时期视为黄金时代，说四十多年没有动用过刑罚。

title: Duke of Zhou's eastern campaign crushes Yan
summary: After suppressing the Three Guards, the Duke of Zhou pushed east, destroying Yan and the Shang-allied Eastern Yi states; Lu was later established on Yan's land.
summary_zh: 平定三监后周公继续东征，灭奄及薄姑等东夷方国，后封伯禽于奄地建立鲁国。

title: Duke of Zhou builds the eastern capital
summary: As regent, the Duke of Zhou crushes a revolt, settles Shang nobles at a new eastern capital and is later credited with the Zhou rites.
summary_zh: 周公摄政期间平定叛乱，把商朝贵族迁到新建的东都；后世还把周代礼制的制定归功于他。

title: The He zun names 'Zhongguo'
summary: A bronze vessel records King Cheng's speech about settling in the centre of the realm; its inscription is the earliest known use of the words 'Zhongguo'.
summary_zh: 一件青铜酒器记录了周成王关于定居天下中心的讲话，铭文中的“中国”二字是这个词已知最早的用例。

title: Duke of Zhou institutes rites and music
summary: The Duke of Zhou is credited with codifying the ritual, kinship and music system of Zhou society, the order Confucius later idealized.
summary_zh: 周公制定礼乐制度，规范宗法、等级与祭祀，成为后世儒家推崇的典范。

title: Duke of Zhou returns power to King Cheng
summary: After seven years as regent, the Duke of Zhou handed full authority back to the grown King Cheng and took his place among the ministers.
summary_zh: 周公摄政七年，成王长成，周公还政于成王，北面就臣位。

title: Shu Yu enfeoffed at Tang (Jin)
summary: King Cheng jokingly gave his brother Shu Yu a paulownia leaf as a token of investiture; held to his word, he enfeoffed him at Tang, origin of Jin.
summary_zh: 成王以桐叶戏封其弟叔虞，史佚曰“天子无戏言”，遂封叔虞于唐，即晋国前身。

title: Varna system takes shape
summary: Society was divided into four varnas: Brahmins, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas and Shudras, a hierarchy described in the Purusha Sukta.
summary_zh: 社会被划分为婆罗门、刹帝利、吠舍、首陀罗四个等级，《原人歌》对此有所描述。

title: Đông Sơn culture
summary: The Bronze Age culture of northern Vietnam, famous for large decorated bronze drums that were traded across Southeast Asia.
summary_zh: 越南北部的青铜文化，以纹饰精美的大型铜鼓闻名，铜鼓流传到东南亚各地，是越南文明的重要源头。

title: Phoenician sea trade
summary: Tyre and Sidon traded purple dye, cedar and glass across the Mediterranean and founded colonies as far as Spain.
summary_zh: 推罗和西顿的商人在地中海各地贩运紫色染料、雪松木和玻璃，并在远至西班牙的地方建立殖民地。

title: David's kingdom of Israel
title_zh: 大卫建立以色列联合王国
summary: By Biblical tradition David united the Israelite tribes and made Jerusalem his capital.
summary_zh: 据《圣经》记载，大卫统一以色列各支派，定都耶路撒冷，建立以色列联合王国。

title: Dolmen building
summary: Bronze Age chiefs were buried under stone dolmens. Korea holds about 40 percent of the world's dolmens, with the largest groups at Gochang, Hwasun and Ganghwa.
summary_zh: 青铜时代的首领葬于支石墓下，朝鲜半岛拥有世界约四成的支石墓，以高敞、和顺、江华最为集中。

title: Later Vedas compiled
place_zh: 俱卢之野（今印度哈里亚纳邦）
summary: The Samaveda, Yajurveda and Atharvaveda were compiled, giving detailed rules for sacrifices, chants and spells.
summary_zh: 《娑摩吠陀》《夜柔吠陀》和《阿闼婆吠陀》编成，详细规定了祭祀、咏唱和咒语。

title: Kamegaoka culture and goggle-eyed dogū
title_zh: 龟冈文化与遮光器土偶
place_zh: 龟冈遗址（今日本青森县津轻市）
summary: In the final Jōmon, the Kamegaoka culture of the north made fine lacquerware and clay dogū figurines with large goggle-like eyes.
summary_zh: 绳文晚期，北方的龟冈文化制作精美漆器和眼部如护目镜的遮光器土偶，是绳文工艺的高峰。

title: Sa Huỳnh culture
summary: An Iron Age culture of central Vietnam known for jar burials and ear ornaments traded around the South China Sea.
summary_zh: 越南中部的铁器时代文化，以瓮棺葬和玉石耳饰闻名，饰品流通于南海周边，可能是占婆人的先民。

title: King Zhao dies on his southern campaign
summary: King Zhao leads armies south against Chu and the Jing peoples. On the last campaign he loses six armies and drowns in the Han River.
summary_zh: 周昭王率军南征楚和荆蛮。最后一次出征时，周军六师覆没，昭王本人也死在汉水中。

title: King Mu's journeys to the west
summary: King Mu campaigns against the Quanrong and, in later legend, drives his eight horses to the far west to meet the Queen Mother of the West.
summary_zh: 周穆王征讨犬戎；后世传说他驾着八匹骏马西行到极远之地，与西王母相会。

title: King Yan of Xu leads the Huai Yi
summary: While King Mu travelled west, Xu led the Huai River peoples against Zhou; tradition says Mu rushed back and, with Chu, defeated King Yan.
summary_zh: 穆王西巡期间，徐偃王率九夷侵周，穆王回师联合楚国击败之。

title: Solomon's Temple
summary: By Biblical tradition King Solomon built the First Temple in Jerusalem, the centre of Israelite worship.
summary_zh: 据《圣经》记载，所罗门王在耶路撒冷修建第一圣殿，使之成为以色列人的崇拜中心。

title: King Mu issues the Lü Xing code
summary: King Mu ordered the Marquis of Lü to draft a penal code allowing fines to redeem punishments, preserved as the 'Lü Xing' chapter of the Book of Documents.
summary_zh: 穆王命吕侯作刑书，以赎刑减轻五刑，此即《尚书·吕刑》。

title: Heroon of Lefkandi
place_zh: 勒夫坎迪（今希腊埃维亚岛）
summary: A large building with rich burials of a warrior and a woman was raised at Lefkandi, showing that Greece was not wholly poor in the Dark Ages.
summary_zh: 勒夫坎迪建起一座大型建筑，内有武士与女子的丰厚墓葬，说明黑暗时代的希腊并非全然贫困。

title: Division of Israel and Judah
place_zh: 示剑（今约旦河西岸纳布卢斯）
summary: After Solomon the northern tribes broke away as the Kingdom of Israel, while Judah kept Jerusalem.
summary_zh: 所罗门死后，北方各支派分离出去建立以色列王国，南方的犹大王国保有耶路撒冷。

title: Chavín de Huántar becomes a religious centre
title_zh: 查文·德万塔尔神庙兴盛
place_zh: 查文·德万塔尔（今秘鲁安卡什大区）
summary: The stone temple of Chavín de Huántar drew pilgrims from far away, and its art style of jaguars, snakes and eagles spread across Peru.
summary_zh: 查文·德万塔尔石砌神庙吸引远方朝圣者，美洲豹、蛇和鹰的图案风格传遍秘鲁，形成第一个文化地平线。

title: La Venta becomes the main Olmec centre
title_zh: 拉文塔成为奥尔梅克中心
place_zh: 拉文塔（今墨西哥塔巴斯科州）
summary: After San Lorenzo declined, La Venta became the leading Olmec city, with an early pyramid, jade offerings and colossal heads.
summary_zh: 圣洛伦索衰落后，拉文塔成为奥尔梅克的主要城市，建有早期金字塔，出土大量玉器祭品和巨石人头像。

title: Shi Qiang pan records Zhou history
summary: A scribe's basin with 284 characters praises the Zhou kings from Wen to Gong and the scribe's own lineage, a key primary source for Western Zhou history.
summary_zh: 史墙盘铭文284字，颂扬文王至恭王的功业及微氏家族史，是西周史重要的第一手资料。

title: Geometric style pottery
place_zh: 凯拉米克斯（今希腊雅典）
summary: Athenian potters decorated vases with bands of meanders and, later, stick-figure funeral scenes, the leading art of early Iron Age Greece.
summary_zh: 雅典陶工用回纹带和后来的人物葬礼场景装饰陶瓶，这是希腊早期铁器时代的主要艺术。

title: Villanovan culture
summary: An early Iron Age culture with cremation urns spread in central and northern Italy; it was the forerunner of the Etruscans.
summary_zh: 以骨灰瓮火葬为特征的早期铁器时代文化分布在意大利中北部，是伊特鲁里亚文明的前身。

title: Feizi is granted the land of Qin
summary: King Xiao rewards the horse breeder Feizi with a small territory called Qin, the beginning of the state that would one day unify China.
summary_zh: 周孝王把一小块名叫“秦”的土地封给善于养马的非子，这就是日后统一中国的秦国的起点。

title: Xiong Qu of Chu names sons kings
summary: Declaring 'I am a barbarian, I do not use Chinese titles', Chu's ruler Xiong Qu made his three sons kings along the Yangtze, defying Zhou.
summary_zh: 楚君熊渠称“我蛮夷也，不与中国之号谥”，立三子为王，与周分庭抗礼。

title: King Yi boils Duke Ai of Qi
summary: On slander from the Lord of Ji, King Yi of Zhou had Duke Ai of Qi boiled alive in a cauldron, a sign of turbulent royal–vassal relations.
summary_zh: 因纪侯谗言，周夷王烹杀齐哀公，周王室与诸侯关系动荡。

check.n: Chinese Wikipedia gives Duke Ai of Qi's death as 890 BC, not 868.
check.n_zh: 中文维基百科称齐哀公卒于前890年，而非前868年。

title: Kingdom of Urartu
summary: Around Lake Van the kingdom of Urartu rose as Assyria's northern rival, known for fortresses and irrigation works.
summary_zh: 凡湖周边兴起乌拉尔图王国，成为亚述北方的劲敌，以要塞和水利工程著称。

title: Battle of Qarqar
place_zh: 卡尔卡尔（今叙利亚哈马省）
summary: Shalmaneser III of Assyria fought a coalition of Damascus, Hamath and King Ahab of Israel; the first Arabs in written history appear here.
summary_zh: 亚述国王沙尔马那塞尔三世与大马士革、哈马和以色列王亚哈的联军交战，阿拉伯人首次见于文字记载。

title: King Li silences his critics
summary: King Li uses a shaman to report people who criticise him and has them killed. People in the capital stop talking and only exchange glances in the street.
summary_zh: 周厉王派巫师监视批评他的人，发现就杀。国人不敢说话，路上相遇只能用眼神示意。

title: Gonghe Regency
summary: King Li is driven out and the realm is run by regents. 841 BCE is the first year of Chinese history with an exact date.
summary_zh: 周厉王被国人赶走，朝政由大臣共同执掌。公元前841年是中国历史上有确切纪年的开端。

title: King Xuan's restoration
summary: After the regency, King Xuan takes the throne and, with able ministers and generals, restores Zhou power against the northern and southern peoples.
summary_zh: 共和行政结束后，周宣王即位，依靠贤臣良将打退了南北各族的进犯，一度恢复了周王室的威势。

title: Campaign against the Xianyun
summary: Yin Jifu leads Zhou chariots against the Xianyun raiders who had pushed close to the capital, and drives them back north.
summary_zh: 尹吉甫率领周军战车反击逼近都城的猃狁，把他们赶回北方。

title: Qin Zhong killed fighting the Western Rong
summary: King Xuan made Qin Zhong a grandee to fight the Western Rong; he died in battle, and his son Duke Zhuang avenged him with Zhou troops.
summary_zh: 宣王命秦仲为大夫伐西戎，秦仲战死；其子庄公率周兵七千破西戎。

title: Lycurgus and the Spartan system
place_zh: 斯巴达（今希腊拉科尼亚）
summary: Spartans credited the half-legendary lawgiver Lycurgus with their strict military training, common meals and mixed constitution.
summary_zh: 斯巴达人把严格的军事训练、公共食堂和混合政体都归功于半传说中的立法者来库古。

check.n: Chinese Wikipedia dates Lycurgus c. 700-630 BC, active 7th century BC.
check.n_zh: 中文维基百科称来古格士约前700年至前630年，活动于前7世纪。

title: Founding of Carthage
summary: Phoenician settlers from Tyre founded Carthage, by legend under Queen Dido, which grew into the leading power of the western Mediterranean.
summary_zh: 来自推罗的腓尼基人建立迦太基，相传由狄多女王率领，后来成为西地中海的强国。

title: Duke Huan founds the state of Zheng
summary: King Xuan gives his younger brother Ji You the fief of Zheng. Later, foreseeing trouble, he moves his family's wealth east.
summary_zh: 周宣王把弟弟姬友封在郑地。后来姬友预见到王室将乱，便把家族财产迁往东方。

title: Greeks adopt the alphabet
summary: Greeks adapted the Phoenician script and added letters for vowels, creating the first full alphabet and the parent of Latin letters.
summary_zh: 希腊人改造腓尼基字母并增加元音字母，形成第一套完整的字母文字，后来拉丁字母即源于此。

title: Hallstatt culture
place_zh: 哈尔施塔特（今奥地利上奥地利州）
summary: Central European Celts grew rich from salt mining and ironworking; the Hallstatt culture marks the start of the Iron Age north of the Alps.
summary_zh: 中欧凯尔特人靠采盐和冶铁致富，哈尔施塔特文化标志着阿尔卑斯山以北进入铁器时代。

title: Early Upanishads
place_zh: 毗提诃（今印度比哈尔邦）
summary: Sages such as Yajnavalkya taught that the self (atman) is one with ultimate reality (brahman), ideas central to later Indian philosophy.
summary_zh: 耶若伏吉耶等哲人提出“梵我一如”思想，成为后世印度哲学的核心。

title: Adena culture
place_zh: 奇利科西（今美国俄亥俄州）
summary: Adena peoples of the Ohio valley made pottery, grew some crops and buried their dead under large earthen mounds.
summary_zh: 俄亥俄河谷的阿德纳人制陶、种植作物，并在大型土丘下埋葬死者。

check.n: Wikipedia says the Adena culture existed from 500 BC to 100 AD.
check.n_zh: 维基百科称阿德纳文化存在于公元前500年至公元100年。

title: Paracas culture
place_zh: 帕拉卡斯半岛（今秘鲁伊卡大区）
summary: On the south coast the Paracas people wove richly coloured textiles, wrapped their dead in many layers and practised skull surgery.
summary_zh: 南部沿海的帕拉卡斯人织造色彩丰富的纺织品，用多层织物包裹死者，还施行开颅手术。

title: Mao Gong ding cast for King Xuan
summary: With 497 characters, the Mao Gong ding bears the longest known bronze inscription, recording King Xuan's charge to the Duke of Mao to govern the realm.
summary_zh: 毛公鼎铭文497字，为现存最长的青铜器铭文，记载宣王对毛公的册命。

title: Destruction of Hasanlu
place_zh: 哈桑卢（今伊朗西阿塞拜疆省）
summary: The fortified town of Hasanlu was burned, probably by Urartu, preserving its famous gold bowl and the skeletons of the Hasanlu Lovers.
summary_zh: 哈桑卢城被焚毁，可能是乌拉尔图所为，著名的金碗和哈桑卢恋人遗骸因此保存下来。

title: Shulba Sutras
summary: Manuals for building fire altars gave geometric rules, including a statement of the Pythagorean theorem.
summary_zh: 修建祭火坛的手册中包含几何规则，其中有勾股定理的表述。

title: Arzhan royal kurgan
summary: The great Arzhan burial mound is one of the earliest Scythian-type royal tombs, with horses sacrificed around the chief.
summary_zh: 阿尔赞大墓是最早的斯基泰式王陵之一，墓主周围殉葬大量马匹，体现了早期骑马游牧社会。

title: Kingdom of D'mt and the temple at Yeha
title_zh: 达莫特王国与耶哈神庙
place_zh: 耶哈（今埃塞俄比亚提格雷州）
summary: The kingdom of D'mt in the northern Ethiopian highlands built the stone temple of Yeha, showing strong links with South Arabia.
summary_zh: 埃塞俄比亚北部高原的达莫特王国修建了耶哈石砌神庙，显示出与南阿拉伯的密切联系。

check.n: Chinese Wikipedia says Yeha appeared around 400 BC.
check.n_zh: 中文维基百科称耶哈约前400年出现。

title: Olmec-style reliefs at Chalcatzingo
place_zh: 查尔卡辛戈（今墨西哥莫雷洛斯州）
summary: Carvings in Olmec style on the cliffs of Chalcatzingo show how Olmec art and beliefs spread far into the central highlands.
summary_zh: 查尔卡辛戈崖壁上的奥尔梅克风格浮雕，说明奥尔梅克艺术和信仰已远播墨西哥中部高原。

title: Nakbe, early Maya monumental centre
place_zh: 纳克贝（今危地马拉佩滕省）
summary: Nakbe in the Mirador Basin raised some of the first large Maya platforms and temples, showing early Maya states taking shape.
summary_zh: 米拉多尔盆地的纳克贝修建了最早一批大型玛雅台基和神庙，显示玛雅早期国家正在形成。

title: The Lanzón carved
place_zh: 查文·德万塔尔（今秘鲁安卡什大区）
summary: A tall granite stone carved as a fanged god was set in the dark galleries at the heart of the Chavín temple.
summary_zh: 查文神庙幽暗地下长廊的中心立起一根花岗岩石柱，刻有獠牙神像，是查文信仰的主神像。

check.n: Wikipedia says the Lanzon was erected circa 500 BCE.
check.n_zh: 维基百科称兰松约于公元前500年竖立。

title: Battle of Qianmu
summary: Late in his reign King Xuan's army is crushed by the Jiang Rong at Qianmu, and the king tries to count the people to rebuild his forces.
summary_zh: 周宣王晚年，王师在千亩被姜戎打得大败，宣王随后在太原清点人口，以图重建军队。

title: King Xuan takes a census at Taiyuan
summary: After losing southern troops at Qianmu, King Xuan counted the population at Taiyuan to raise new levies, despite Zhong Shanfu's warning against the novelty.
summary_zh: 千亩战败后，宣王丧南国之师，于太原料民以补兵员，仲山父谏阻不从。

title: Kingdom of Kush rises at Napata
place_zh: 纳帕塔（今苏丹博尔戈尔山）
summary: After Egyptian rule ended, Nubian kings at Napata under Alara built an independent Kingdom of Kush around the temple of Amun at Jebel Barkal.
summary_zh: 埃及统治结束后，以阿拉拉为首的努比亚国王在纳帕塔建立独立的库施王国，以博尔戈尔山的阿蒙神庙为中心。

title: Earthquake shakes the Three Rivers
summary: A great earthquake strikes the Zhou homeland. The court astrologer Bo Yangfu explains it as an imbalance of yin and yang and predicts the fall of Zhou.
summary_zh: 一场大地震袭击了周人的故土。太史伯阳父用阴阳失调来解释地震，并预言周朝将亡。

title: King You favors Bao Si
summary: King You doted on Bao Si, deposed Queen Shen and Crown Prince Yijiu, and later legend says lit the beacons to amuse her, alienating the lords.
summary_zh: 幽王宠爱褒姒，废申后及太子宜臼，传说烽火戏诸侯，失信于天下，为西周覆灭埋下祸根。

title: First Olympic Games
place_zh: 奥林匹亚（今希腊伊利斯）
summary: Greeks held a footrace at the sanctuary of Zeus at Olympia; the games, held every four years, became a common festival of all Greeks.
summary_zh: 希腊人在奥林匹亚宙斯圣地举行赛跑，此后每四年一届，成为全体希腊人共同的节庆。

title: Fall of Haojing
summary: The Quanrong and rebel lords kill King You, who had lit the beacon fires to amuse his consort. Western Zhou ends.
summary_zh: 犬戎联合反叛的诸侯杀死周幽王——相传他曾为博宠妃一笑而点燃烽火。西周就此结束。

title: King Ping moves the court east
summary: The Zhou court resettles at Luoyi. From now on the king is a figurehead and the great states go their own way.
summary_zh: 周王室迁居洛邑。从此周王只是名义上的天下共主，各大诸侯国各行其是。

title: Qin becomes a full state
summary: Duke Xiang of Qin escorts King Ping east and is made a lord, with a promise of the old Zhou lands west of Mount Qi if he can take them from the Rong.
summary_zh: 秦襄公护送周平王东迁，被正式封为诸侯，平王还许诺：只要能从戎人手中夺回岐山以西的周人故地，就归秦所有。

title: Founding of Rome
place_zh: 帕拉蒂尼山（今意大利罗马）
summary: By Roman tradition Romulus founded Rome on the Palatine Hill on 21 April 753 BC; Romans later counted years from this date.
summary_zh: 按罗马传统，罗慕路斯于前753年4月21日在帕拉蒂尼山建立罗马城，罗马人后来以此纪年。

title: Qin begins keeping official annals
summary: Duke Wen of Qin appointed historians to keep records for the first time, a sign of Qin's adoption of Zhou court culture.
summary_zh: 秦文公十三年，初有史官记事，秦国逐渐吸收周文化。

title: Homeric epics take shape
summary: The Iliad and the Odyssey, credited to Homer, took their written form; they shaped Greek religion, values and education for centuries.
summary_zh: 归于荷马名下的《伊利亚特》和《奥德赛》形成书面文本，此后数百年影响着希腊人的宗教、价值观和教育。

title: Great Dam of Marib
summary: The kingdom of Saba built a great dam at Marib to irrigate the oasis, supporting a wealthy state on the incense trade.
summary_zh: 示巴王国在马里卜修建大坝灌溉绿洲，以乳香贸易致富，成为阿拉伯半岛南部的强国。

title: Reforms of Tiglath-Pileser III
title_zh: 提格拉特帕拉沙尔三世改革
place_zh: 尼姆鲁德（今伊拉克尼尼微省）
summary: Tiglath-Pileser III created a standing army, smaller provinces under governors and mass deportations, turning Assyria into an empire.
summary_zh: 提格拉特帕拉沙尔三世建立常备军，划小行省由总督管辖，并大规模迁徙被征服民族，使亚述成为真正的帝国。

title: First Messenian War
place_zh: 伊托梅山（今希腊美塞尼亚）
summary: Sparta conquered neighboring Messenia and made its people helots, serfs whose labor freed Spartan citizens to train for war.
summary_zh: 斯巴达征服邻邦美塞尼亚，将其居民变为希洛人，靠他们的劳动供养专心习武的斯巴达公民。

title: Corinthians found Syracuse
place_zh: 叙拉古（今意大利西西里岛锡拉库萨）
summary: Colonists from Corinth founded Syracuse in Sicily, part of the wave of Greek colonization that created Magna Graecia in southern Italy.
summary_zh: 科林斯移民在西西里建立叙拉古，这是希腊大殖民浪潮的一部分，意大利南部由此形成大希腊地区。

title: Piye of Kush conquers Egypt
title_zh: 努比亚人建立第二十五王朝
summary: The Kushite king Piye marched north and took Memphis; his successors ruled Egypt as the Twenty-fifth Dynasty.
summary_zh: 库施国王皮耶挥师北上攻占孟菲斯，其继承者以第二十五王朝统治埃及。

title: The Spring and Autumn Annals begin
summary: The court chronicle of Lu starts its year-by-year record in 722 BCE. Later edited by tradition by Confucius, it gives the whole era its name.
summary_zh: 鲁国的官方编年史从公元前722年开始逐年记事。相传后来经孔子修订，这个时代也因此得名“春秋”。

title: Duke Zhuang of Zheng defeats his brother
summary: Duke Zhuang let his ambitious brother Gongshu Duan overreach, then crushed his rebellion at Yan, the opening story of the Zuo Zhuan.
summary_zh: 郑庄公纵容其弟共叔段坐大，待其谋反后于鄢击败之，为《左传》开篇名篇。

title: Assyria destroys the Kingdom of Israel
place_zh: 撒玛利亚（今约旦河西岸）
summary: Assyria took Samaria and deported much of the population, ending the northern Kingdom of Israel and its ten tribes.
summary_zh: 亚述攻陷撒玛利亚并大规模迁走居民，北方以色列王国灭亡，即所谓“失落的十个支派”。

title: Zhou and Zheng exchange hostages
summary: The Zhou king and Duke Zhuang of Zheng exchanged sons as hostages, a humiliating sign that the Son of Heaven now dealt with vassals as equals.
summary_zh: 周平王与郑庄公互换王子为人质，天子与诸侯对等交质，王室威信扫地。

title: Zhouxu murders Wey's ruler
summary: Zhouxu killed his half-brother Duke Huan to seize Wey; the old minister Shi Que had him and his own son executed, 'destroying kin for righteousness'.
summary_zh: 州吁弑兄卫桓公自立，老臣石碏设计诛杀州吁及参与其事的儿子石厚，“大义灭亲”。

title: Hua Du assassinates Duke Shang of Song
summary: Coveting the wife of Kong Fujia, the Song minister Hua Du killed him and then Duke Shang, installing Duke Zhuang and bribing the neighboring lords.
summary_zh: 宋太宰华督见孔父嘉之妻而杀孔父，又弑宋殇公，迎立公子冯，并贿赂诸侯。

title: Battle of Xuge: Zheng defeats the king
summary: King Huan of Zhou attacks the state of Zheng and is beaten; an arrow wounds him in the shoulder. Royal prestige never recovers.
summary_zh: 周桓王讨伐郑国，结果大败，肩膀还中了一箭。周王室的威信从此一蹶不振。

title: Xiong Tong of Chu declares himself king
summary: Rebuffed when he asked Zhou for a higher rank, Xiong Tong of Chu proclaimed himself King Wu, the first southern ruler to claim parity with Zhou.
summary_zh: 熊通求周室尊其号被拒，遂自立为楚武王，楚国公开与周王室分庭抗礼。

title: Etruscan city-states flourish
place_zh: 塔尔奎尼亚（今意大利拉齐奥）
summary: Etruscan cities in central Italy grew rich from metals and trade, built painted tombs, and passed much of their culture on to Rome.
summary_zh: 意大利中部的伊特鲁里亚城邦靠金属和贸易致富，修建彩绘墓室，并把许多文化传给了罗马。

title: Deioces founds the Median kingdom
place_zh: 埃克巴坦那（今伊朗哈马丹）
summary: According to Herodotus, Deioces united the Median tribes and built Ecbatana as his capital, founding the first Iranian kingdom.
summary_zh: 据希罗多德记载，戴奥凯斯统一米底诸部落，修建都城埃克巴坦那，建立了第一个伊朗人王国。

title: Founding of Samarkand
place_zh: 阿夫拉西阿卜（今乌兹别克斯坦撒马尔罕）
summary: Maracanda, later Samarkand, was founded on the Afrasiyab hill and grew into the chief city of Sogdia.
summary_zh: 马拉坎达城（后来的撒马尔罕）在阿夫拉西阿卜高地建立，逐渐成为粟特地区的中心城市。

title: Kingdom of Văn Lang
place_zh: 峰州（今越南富寿省越池）
summary: Vietnamese tradition names Văn Lang, ruled by the Hùng kings, as the first Vietnamese state; historians link it to the Đông Sơn culture.
summary_zh: 越南传统认为雄王建立的文郎国是越南第一个国家，史学界一般将其与东山文化联系起来。

title: Duke Huan of Lu killed in Qi
summary: Visiting Qi with his wife Wen Jiang, who had an affair with her brother Duke Xiang, Duke Huan of Lu was murdered by Qi's strongman Pengsheng.
summary_zh: 鲁桓公与夫人文姜赴齐，文姜与其兄齐襄公私通，襄公使公子彭生拉杀鲁桓公。

title: King Wen of Chu moves to Ying
summary: Chu moved its capital to Ying near the Yangtze, which remained the political center of the southern power for four centuries.
summary_zh: 楚文王定都于郢（纪南城），此后四百余年郢为楚国政治中心。

title: Qin establishes the first counties
summary: After conquering Rong tribes, Duke Wu of Qin set up Gui and Ji as counties governed directly by appointees, an early step toward centralized administration.
summary_zh: 秦武公伐邽、冀戎，初置邽、冀二县，开郡县制先河。

title: Duke Xiang of Qi assassinated
summary: Disgruntled officers killed Duke Xiang and enthroned Gongsun Wuzhi; his own death soon after triggered the race between princes Xiaobai and Jiu.
summary_zh: 齐襄公被连称、管至父所杀，公孙无知自立，旋被杀，公子小白与公子纠争位。

title: Guan Zhong's reforms in Qi
summary: Guan Zhong becomes chief minister of Qi and reorganises its people, taxes and army, and by tradition puts salt and iron under state control.
summary_zh: 管仲出任齐国国相，整顿户籍、赋税和军制，相传还把盐、铁收归官府经营。

title: Battle of Changshao
summary: Advised by Cao Gui, the small state of Lu waits until the Qi army has drummed three times, then charges and wins.
summary_zh: 在曹刿的谋划下，弱小的鲁国等齐军擂过三通鼓后才发起冲锋，结果大获全胜。

title: Cao Mo seizes Duke Huan at Ke
summary: At a covenant with Lu, the Lu officer Cao Mo held Duke Huan at dagger-point to demand return of land; Huan honored the forced promise, earning trust.
summary_zh: 齐鲁柯之盟，曹沫持匕首劫齐桓公索还侵地，桓公守信归地，诸侯由此信服。

title: Duke Huan of Qi becomes the first hegemon
summary: Advised by Guan Zhong, Qi leads the states in defending the Zhou king, a model later hegemons follow.
summary_zh: 在管仲辅佐下，齐国率领诸侯尊奉周王、抵御外敌，成为后来霸主效仿的榜样。

title: Quwo branch seizes the Jin throne
summary: After 67 years of civil war, the cadet branch of Quwo destroyed the senior Jin line at Yi and bribed the Zhou king to recognize Duke Wu.
summary_zh: 晋国小宗曲沃经六十余年征战，终灭大宗翼，曲沃武公以宝器贿周王，获封晋君。

title: Chen Wan flees to Qi
summary: Prince Wan of Chen fled to Qi and took the surname Tian; his descendants would eventually usurp the Qi state.
summary_zh: 陈国公子完避乱奔齐，改姓田，为田氏代齐之始祖。

title: Assyrian conquest of Egypt
summary: Esarhaddon of Assyria took Memphis from the Kushite king Taharqa, and Assyrian armies sacked Thebes in 663 BC.
summary_zh: 亚述国王阿萨尔哈东从库施法老塔哈尔卡手中夺取孟菲斯，公元前663年亚述军洗劫底比斯。

title: Megarians found Byzantium
place_zh: 拜占庭（今土耳其伊斯坦布尔）
summary: Greek colonists from Megara founded Byzantium on the Bosporus, the city later rebuilt by Constantine as Constantinople.
summary_zh: 墨伽拉的希腊移民在博斯普鲁斯海峡畔建立拜占庭，此城后来被君士坦丁重建为君士坦丁堡。

title: Duke Huan rescues Yan from the Shanrong
summary: Answering Yan's call, Duke Huan of Qi marched north and broke the Shanrong and Guzhu, embodying the hegemon's slogan 'honor the king, expel the barbarians'.
summary_zh: 山戎病燕，齐桓公北伐山戎，破令支、孤竹而还，践行“尊王攘夷”。

title: Psamtik I founds the Saite Dynasty
title_zh: 普萨美提克一世建立赛斯王朝
place_zh: 赛斯（今埃及西部省萨哈杰尔）
summary: Psamtik I threw off Assyrian control, reunited Egypt and began a revival that used Greek mercenaries and traders.
summary_zh: 普萨美提克一世摆脱亚述控制，重新统一埃及，借助希腊雇佣兵和商人开启复兴。

title: The Di overrun Wey
summary: Duke Yi of Wey, who gave his cranes carriages of officials, was killed when the Di stormed the capital; Qi later rebuilt Wey at Chuqiu.
summary_zh: 卫懿公好鹤，狄人来攻，国人不战，懿公被杀卫亡；齐桓公后助卫复国于楚丘。

title: Qi and Chu make peace at Zhaoling
summary: Duke Huan led eight states against Chu, faulting it for unpaid tribute; facing Chu's stout defense, both sides swore a covenant at Zhaoling.
summary_zh: 齐桓公率八国之师伐楚，责其“包茅不入”，楚屈完应对不屈，双方订立召陵之盟。

title: Lady Li drives Prince Shensheng to suicide
summary: Duke Xian's consort Lady Li framed Crown Prince Shensheng with poisoned meat; he hanged himself while princes Chong'er and Yiwu fled abroad.
summary_zh: 骊姬以毒胙诬陷太子申生，申生自缢，公子重耳、夷吾出奔，晋国内乱。

title: Jin borrows a road to conquer Guo
summary: Duke Xian of Jin marches through Yu to destroy Guo, then takes Yu on the way back. The origin of the idiom 唇亡齿寒.
summary_zh: 晋献公向虞国借道灭了虢国，回师途中又顺手灭了虞国。成语“唇亡齿寒”就出自这里。

title: Covenant of Kuiqiu
summary: Duke Huan of Qi holds his greatest assembly of the lords. The Zhou king sends him an honour, and the lords swear to common rules.
summary_zh: 齐桓公召集规模最大的一次诸侯会盟，周王派人赐予他特殊的礼遇，诸侯共同订立盟约。

title: Library of Ashurbanipal
place_zh: 尼尼微（今伊拉克摩苏尔）
summary: Ashurbanipal collected tens of thousands of tablets at Nineveh, preserving the Epic of Gilgamesh and much Mesopotamian learning.
summary_zh: 亚述巴尼拔在尼尼微收藏数万块泥板，《吉尔伽美什史诗》和大量两河流域知识因此得以保存。

title: Qin ships grain to famine-hit Jin
summary: Despite Jin's ingratitude, Duke Mu of Qin sent a long convoy of grain boats from Yong to Jiang along the Wei and Fen rivers to relieve Jin's famine.
summary_zh: 晋国饥荒，秦穆公不计前嫌，以船队自雍至绛运粮济晋，史称“泛舟之役”。

title: Ashurbanipal sacks Susa
place_zh: 苏萨（今伊朗胡齐斯坦省）
summary: The Assyrian king Ashurbanipal destroyed Susa, looted its temples and royal tombs, and ended Elam as a major power.
summary_zh: 亚述国王亚述巴尼拔摧毁苏萨，洗劫神庙和王陵，埃兰从此不再是强国。

title: Qin captures Duke Hui at Hanyuan
summary: When Jin refused grain to famine-stricken Qin, Duke Mu attacked and captured Duke Hui of Jin, releasing him in exchange for the lands west of the Yellow River.
summary_zh: 晋惠公背信，秦穆公伐晋，于韩原俘获晋惠公，后释之，晋献河西之地。

title: Duke Huan dies amid succession chaos
summary: After Guan Zhong's death Huan trusted favorites; when he died his five sons fought, and his corpse lay unburied for 67 days until worms crawled out.
summary_zh: 管仲死后桓公任用竖刁、易牙，桓公卒，五公子争立，尸身停放六十七日，虫出于户。

title: Battle of the Hong River
summary: Duke Xiang of Song refuses to attack the Chu army while it is crossing the river and is badly defeated.
summary_zh: 宋襄公不肯趁楚军渡河时进攻，结果大败。

title: Chong'er returns to rule Jin
summary: After nineteen years in exile, Prince Chong'er returns to Jin with Qin's army and becomes Duke Wen.
summary_zh: 流亡十九年后，公子重耳在秦军护送下回到晋国即位，就是晋文公。

title: Battle of Chengpu
summary: Jin defeats the southern state of Chu, and Duke Wen of Jin becomes hegemon.
summary_zh: 晋国打败南方的楚国，晋文公由此成为霸主。

title: Duke Wen of Jin named hegemon at Jiantu
