summary_zh: 第一次北伐前，诸葛亮上表劝勉后主刘禅，即著名的《出师表》。

title: Battle of Shiting
summary: Lured by Zhou Fang's feigned defection letters, Cao Xiu marched south and was routed by Lu Xun.
summary_zh: 曹休中周鲂诈降之计，深入皖地，被陆逊大败于石亭。

title: Battle of Jieting
summary: Ma Su ignores orders and camps on a hill; Zhang He cuts off his water and routs him, ending the first northern campaign.
summary_zh: 马谡违背调度，舍水上山扎营，被张郃断绝水源击溃，第一次北伐因此失败。

title: Sima Yi crushes Meng Da's defection
summary: Meng Da plotted to return to Shu; Sima Yi marched 1,200 li in eight days, took Xincheng and beheaded him.
summary_zh: 孟达谋叛魏归蜀，司马懿倍道兼行，八日至新城，旬余破城斩孟达。

title: Siege of Chencang
summary: In Zhuge Liang's second northern expedition, Hao Zhao held Chencang with a thousand men for over twenty days until Shu supplies ran out.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮二次北伐围陈仓，郝昭以千余人坚守二十余日，蜀军粮尽退兵。

title: Sun Quan declares himself emperor of Wu
summary: Sun Quan takes the imperial title and soon moves his capital to Jianye, today's Nanjing.
summary_zh: 孙权称帝，不久迁都建业，即今天的南京。

title: Sun Quan moves capital to Jianye
summary: After proclaiming himself emperor, Sun Quan moved from Wuchang to Jianye, making Nanjing a capital for the first time.
summary_zh: 孙权称帝后自武昌迁都建业，南京自此首次成为王朝都城。

title: Shu takes Wudu and Yinping
summary: In his third expedition Zhuge Liang sent Chen Shi to seize Wudu and Yinping, driving back Guo Huai; Zhuge was restored as Chancellor.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮第三次北伐，遣陈式攻取武都、阴平二郡，郭淮退走，亮复丞相职。

title: Wu fleet sails to Yizhou
summary: Sun Quan sent Wei Wen and Zhuge Zhi with 10,000 men across the sea to Yizhou, widely identified with Taiwan; they returned with several thousand people.
summary_zh: 孙权遣卫温、诸葛直率甲士万人浮海求夷洲，得数千人而还，一般认为夷洲即台湾。

title: Cao Zhen's rain-ruined invasion of Shu
summary: Cao Zhen led Wei's largest offensive against Shu through the Ziwu and other valleys, but a month of rain washed out the roads and the campaign was called off.
summary_zh: 曹真率军由子午谷等道伐蜀，遇大雨三十余日，栈道断绝，诏令班师。

title: Battle of Mount Qi; Zhang He killed
summary: Zhuge Liang besieged Mount Qi and beat Sima Yi in the field; withdrawing for lack of grain, he ambushed and killed Zhang He at Mumen.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮围祁山，败司马懿，因粮尽退军，于木门道伏杀追将张郃。

title: Zhuge Liang's wooden oxen supply carts
summary: To move grain over the Qinling passes, Zhuge Liang devised the 'wooden ox' and 'gliding horse', probably improved wheelbarrows.
summary_zh: 为解决秦岭运粮难题，诸葛亮创制木牛流马，可能是改良的独轮车。

title: Death of the poet Cao Zhi
summary: Cao Zhi, the most celebrated poet of the Jian'an era and author of the Rhapsody on the Luo River Goddess, died sidelined as Prince of Chen.
summary_zh: 建安文学代表、《洛神赋》作者曹植郁郁而终，时为陈王。

title: Gongsun Yuan beheads Wu's envoys
summary: Sun Quan made Gongsun Yuan King of Yan against his ministers' advice; Gongsun killed the envoys and sent their heads to Wei.
summary_zh: 孙权不听群臣劝阻，遣使封公孙渊为燕王，公孙渊斩吴使，传首于魏。

title: Zhuge Liang dies at Wuzhang Plains
summary: On his last northern campaign against Wei, the Shu chancellor dies in camp.
summary_zh: 蜀汉丞相诸葛亮在最后一次北伐曹魏途中病逝军中。

title: Sun Quan fails at Hefei New City
summary: Coordinating with Zhuge Liang's last expedition, Sun Quan besieged Hefei New City but withdrew when Cao Rui led a relief army.
summary_zh: 孙权配合诸葛亮北伐围攻合肥新城，魏明帝亲征，吴军撤退。

title: Death of the last Han emperor
summary: Liu Xie, the deposed Emperor Xian, died as Duke of Shanyang and was buried with imperial honors.
summary_zh: 退位的汉献帝刘协以山阳公身份去世，魏以天子礼葬之。

title: Wei Yan killed after Zhuge Liang's death
summary: Feuding with Yang Yi over the retreat, Wei Yan burned the plank roads and was killed by Ma Dai.
summary_zh: 诸葛亮死后，魏延与杨仪争权，烧绝栈道，兵败被马岱斩杀。

title: Ma Jun builds the south-pointing chariot
summary: The engineer Ma Jun reconstructed the south-pointing chariot with differential gearing and improved the silk loom and chain pump.
summary_zh: 机械家马钧复原指南车，并改进绫机和翻车，被称为“天下之名巧”。

title: Crisis of the Third Century
place_zh: 莫贡提亚库姆（今德国美因茨）
summary: The murder of Severus Alexander at Mainz began fifty years of civil wars, invasions, plague and inflation, with dozens of short-lived emperors.
summary_zh: 塞维鲁·亚历山大在美因茨被杀，此后五十年内战、外族入侵、瘟疫和通货膨胀交织，皇帝更替频繁。

title: Sima Yi conquers Liaodong
summary: Sima Yi besieges and takes Xiangping, ending the Gongsun family's semi-independent state in the northeast.
summary_zh: 司马懿围攻并攻克襄平，消灭了割据辽东半个世纪的公孙氏。

title: Queen Himiko of Wa sends envoys to Wei
title_zh: 倭女王卑弥呼遣使朝魏
summary: Wei names the Japanese queen "Ruler of Wa, Friend of Wei" and sends her gifts including bronze mirrors.
summary_zh: 魏朝封日本女王卑弥呼为“亲魏倭王”，赐给她铜镜等礼物。

title: Cao Fang enthroned under two regents
summary: Cao Rui died young; the boy Cao Fang succeeded with Cao Shuang and Sima Yi as co-regents, a rivalry that ended at Gaopingling.
summary_zh: 魏明帝崩，幼主曹芳即位，曹爽与司马懿共同辅政，埋下争权伏笔。

title: Mani founds Manichaeism
summary: Mani preached a new religion mixing Zoroastrian, Christian and Buddhist ideas. Manichaeism later spread west to Rome and east to China.
summary_zh: 摩尼宣讲融合琐罗亚斯德教、基督教和佛教思想的新宗教，摩尼教后来西传罗马，东传中国。

title: Sasanians conquer Bactria
summary: The Sasanians took Bactria from the Kushans and ruled it through princes called Kushanshahs.
summary_zh: 萨珊波斯从贵霜手中夺取巴克特里亚，由称为“贵霜沙”的王子统治，贵霜帝国走向衰落。

title: Deng Ai's military farms in the Huai
summary: On Deng Ai's plan, Wei dug canals and set up soldier-farmer colonies along the Huai, storing grain for war against Wu.
summary_zh: 魏用邓艾之策，于淮南淮北广开漕渠，大兴屯田，积谷以备伐吴。

title: Wu's offensive defeated at Quebei
summary: Wu attacked Wei on several fronts; Quan Cong's force was beaten at the Quebei reservoir and the offensive failed.
summary_zh: 吴分兵数路攻魏，全琮于芍陂与魏军激战失利，北伐无功。

title: Wu's succession struggle of the Two Palaces
summary: Factions backing heir Sun He and his brother Sun Ba split Wu's court; in 250 Sun Quan deposed Sun He and forced Sun Ba to suicide.
summary_zh: 太子孙和与鲁王孙霸争位，朝臣分党；250年孙权废和赐霸死，吴政渐衰。

title: Wu expedition to Hainan
summary: Sun Quan sent Nie You and Lu Kai with 30,000 troops to Zhuya and Dan'er on Hainan Island.
summary_zh: 孙权遣聂友、陆凯率兵三万讨珠崖、儋耳，经略海南岛。

title: Wei invades Goguryeo
summary: The Wei general Guanqiu Jian sacks the Goguryeo capital at Hwando and chases its king to the far northeast.
summary_zh: 魏将毌丘俭攻破高句丽都城丸都，一路追击高句丽王。

title: Battle of Xingshi
summary: Cao Shuang invaded Hanzhong to win prestige, but Wang Ping held the Xingshi passes and Fei Yi's relief forced a costly retreat.
summary_zh: 曹爽伐蜀以立威名，王平据守兴势，费祎率援军至，魏军狼狈退还。

title: He Yan and Wang Bi found Xuanxue
summary: During the Zhengshi era He Yan and Wang Bi reinterpreted the Laozi and Yijing around 'nothingness', founding Neo-Daoist Xuanxue and the fashion for Pure Talk.
summary_zh: 正始年间何晏、王弼以“贵无”注《老子》《周易》，开创魏晋玄学与清谈风气。

title: Zhu Ying and Kang Tai visit Funan
place_zh: 扶南（今柬埔寨吴哥波雷）
summary: Wu envoys Zhu Ying and Kang Tai travelled to Funan and beyond; their records are the earliest Chinese accounts of mainland Southeast Asia.
summary_zh: 吴遣朱应、康泰出使扶南等国，所著记录为中国关于东南亚最早的详细记载。

title: Eunuch Huang Hao gains power in Shu
summary: After Jiang Wan and Dong Yun died, the eunuch Huang Hao won Liu Shan's trust and gradually dominated Shu's court.
summary_zh: 蒋琬、董允相继去世，宦官黄皓得刘禅宠信，逐渐操弄蜀汉朝政。

title: Kang Senghui founds Jianchu Temple
summary: The Sogdian monk Kang Senghui reached Jianye; Sun Quan built Jianchu Temple for him, the first Buddhist temple in the Yangtze delta.
summary_zh: 康居僧人康僧会至建业传法，孙权为之建建初寺，为江南佛寺之始。

title: Lady Triệu's revolt against Wu
summary: Triệu Thị Trinh led a rising in Jiuzhen against Wu rule; it was suppressed by Lu Yin.
summary_zh: 九真赵氏贞起兵反吴，交州骚动，陆胤率军讨平。

title: Incident at the Gaoping Tombs
summary: While the regent Cao Shuang is away at an imperial tomb, Sima Yi seizes Luoyang. The Sima family now controls Wei.
summary_zh: 趁辅政大臣曹爽随皇帝出城祭扫高平陵，司马懿发动政变控制洛阳，从此司马氏掌握魏国大权。

title: Tomb of the Lord of Sipán
place_zh: 西潘（今秘鲁兰巴耶克大区）
summary: A Moche ruler was buried at Sipán with gold, silver and turquoise ornaments; the untouched tomb was found in 1987.
summary_zh: 一位莫切统治者葬于西潘，随葬大量金银和绿松石饰品，1987年发现时墓葬完好未被盗掘。

title: Hashihaka Kofun built
place_zh: 箸墓古坟（今日本奈良县樱井市）
summary: One of the earliest great keyhole-shaped tombs was raised at Makimuku, marking the start of the Kofun period and the Yamato kingship.
summary_zh: 缠向地区建成最早的大型前方后圆坟之一，标志着古坟时代和大和王权的开始。

title: Wang Ling's plot at Shouchun
summary: Wang Ling plotted to replace Cao Fang; Sima Yi struck first, and Wang took poison—the first of three Huainan rebellions.
summary_zh: 王凌谋立楚王曹彪，司马懿率军突至，王凌服毒自尽，为“淮南三叛”之首。

title: Death of Sima Yi
summary: Sima Yi died after crushing Wang Ling; his son Sima Shi took over as regent of Wei.
summary_zh: 司马懿平王凌后病卒，长子司马师继掌魏国大权。

title: Battle of Dongxing
summary: Zhuge Ke routed a Wei army attacking the Dongxing dykes in a snowstorm, Wu's greatest victory over Wei.
summary_zh: 魏军进攻东兴堤，诸葛恪冒雪迎击，大破魏军，为吴对魏最大胜利。

title: Sun Quan dies; Zhuge Ke regent
summary: Sun Quan died after a 50-year rule; nine-year-old Sun Liang succeeded with Zhuge Ke as regent.
summary_zh: 孙权在位多年后病逝，幼子孙亮即位，诸葛恪辅政。

title: Zhuge Ke killed by Sun Jun
summary: After a disastrous siege of Hefei New City, Zhuge Ke was assassinated at a banquet by Sun Jun, who took power.
summary_zh: 诸葛恪围合肥新城大败，回朝后被孙峻于宴席上刺杀，孙峻专权。

title: Fei Yi assassinated by a Wei defector
summary: Shu's chief minister Fei Yi was stabbed at a New Year banquet by Guo Xun, a captured Wei officer; Jiang Wei then gained a free hand.
summary_zh: 蜀汉大将军费祎在岁首宴会上被魏降人郭循刺杀，此后姜维得以频繁北伐。

title: Sima Shi deposes Cao Fang
summary: After a plot by Li Feng and Xiahou Xuan was crushed, Sima Shi deposed Cao Fang and enthroned Cao Mao.
summary_zh: 李丰、夏侯玄谋诛司马师事泄被杀，司马师随即废魏帝曹芳，立曹髦。

title: Guanqiu Jian and Wen Qin rebel
summary: The Huainan commanders rose against Sima Shi; Guanqiu Jian was killed and Wen Qin fled to Wu, and Sima Shi died soon after.
summary_zh: 毌丘俭、文钦起兵讨司马师，兵败，毌丘俭被杀，文钦奔吴，司马师不久病死。

title: Jiang Wei's victory at Taoxi
summary: Jiang Wei crushed Wang Jing west of the Tao River, killing tens of thousands, then besieged Didao.
summary_zh: 姜维于洮水西大破魏雍州刺史王经，魏军死者数万，进围狄道。

title: Jiang Wei defeated at Duangu
summary: Deng Ai routed Jiang Wei at Duangu, inflicting heavy losses that drained Shu's strength.
summary_zh: 姜维在段谷被邓艾击败，士卒星散，死者甚众，蜀国元气大伤。

title: Zhuge Dan's rebellion at Shouchun
summary: Zhuge Dan rebelled with Wu support; Sima Zhao besieged Shouchun for nearly a year and took it, ending Huainan resistance.
summary_zh: 诸葛诞联吴起兵，司马昭围寿春近一年攻破，“淮南三叛”终结。

title: Sun Xiu kills the regent Sun Chen
summary: Sun Chen deposed Sun Liang and enthroned Sun Xiu, who soon had him seized and executed at a winter court assembly.
summary_zh: 权臣孙綝废孙亮立孙休，孙休于腊会上擒杀孙綝，夺回大权。

title: Emperor Cao Mao is killed
summary: The young Wei emperor leads his palace servants against Sima Zhao and is killed in the street.
summary_zh: 魏帝曹髦率宫中侍从讨伐司马昭，在宫外被杀。

title: Gallic Empire breaks away
place_zh: 特里尔（今德国莱茵兰-普法尔茨）
summary: The general Postumus set up a separate Gallic Empire in Gaul, Britain and Spain, which Aurelian took back in 274.
summary_zh: 将领波斯图穆斯在高卢、不列颠和西班牙另立高卢帝国，274年被奥勒良收复。

title: Battle of Edessa, Valerian captured
title_zh: 埃德萨战役（瓦勒良被俘）
place_zh: 埃德萨（今土耳其尚勒乌尔法）
summary: The Sasanian king Shapur I defeated and captured the Roman emperor Valerian, the only Roman emperor taken prisoner by a foreign enemy.
summary_zh: 萨珊国王沙普尔一世击败并俘虏罗马皇帝瓦勒良，他是唯一被外敌俘虏的罗马皇帝。

title: King Goi organizes Baekje's government
summary: King Goi is credited with creating six chief ministers and sixteen official ranks, turning Baekje into a centralized kingdom.
summary_zh: 古尔王设立六佐平和十六官等，确立官服制度，百济由此发展为中央集权国家。

title: Ji Kang is executed; the Seven Sages of the Bamboo Grove
summary: The poet and musician Ji Kang, leader of a circle of free-spirited scholars, is executed by the Sima regime.
summary_zh: 竹林七贤的核心人物、诗人兼音乐家嵇康被司马氏处死。

title: Jiang Wei withdraws to farm at Tazhong
summary: Fearing Huang Hao and failing at Taoyang, Jiang Wei withdrew to Tazhong to farm, leaving Hanzhong's defenses thin.
summary_zh: 姜维伐魏败于侯和，又惧黄皓谗害，退往沓中屯田避祸，汉中防务空虚。

title: Wei conquers Shu
summary: Deng Ai crosses the mountains by a secret route and Liu Shan surrenders.
summary_zh: 邓艾偷渡阴平小道，直逼成都，后主刘禅出城投降。

title: Liu Hui's commentary on the Nine Chapters
summary: The mathematician explains the classic problem book with proofs and calculates pi to about 3.14.
summary_zh: 数学家刘徽为《九章算术》作注，给出证明，并用割圆术把圆周率算到约3.14。

title: Jiaozhi defects from Wu to Wei
summary: Lü Xing killed Wu's governor in Jiaozhi and submitted to Wei, igniting a long struggle over the far south.
summary_zh: 交趾郡吏吕兴杀吴太守孙谞，举郡附魏，吴、晋长期争夺交州。

title: Zhong Hui's revolt in Chengdu
summary: After the fall of Shu, the Wei general Zhong Hui and the Shu general Jiang Wei plot a revolt. Their own soldiers kill them.
summary_zh: 蜀亡后，魏将钟会与蜀将姜维密谋反叛，结果被乱兵所杀。

title: Liu Shan 'too happy to miss Shu'
summary: Taken to Luoyang as Duke of Anle, Liu Shan told Sima Zhao he was too happy to miss Shu, earning safety and lasting ridicule.
summary_zh: 刘禅迁洛阳封安乐公，司马昭问其是否思蜀，答“此间乐，不思蜀”。

title: Sun Hao becomes emperor of Wu
summary: After Sun Xiu's death, ministers chose Sun Hao, who soon became notorious for cruelty and extravagance.
summary_zh: 孙休死，群臣迎立孙皓，不久即以残暴奢侈著称，吴政日坏。

title: Sima Zhao restores the five noble ranks
summary: Newly King of Jin, Sima Zhao revived the Zhou five ranks of nobility and ordered new codes of rites and law.
summary_zh: 司马昭进爵晋王，奏复五等爵制，命贾充等议定礼仪律令。

title: Sun Hao moves capital to Wuchang
summary: Sun Hao moved the Wu capital upriver to Wuchang; the costly move was resented—'rather drink Jianye water than eat Wuchang fish'.
summary_zh: 孙皓迁都武昌，扬州百姓溯流供给，怨声载道，民谣“宁饮建业水，不食武昌鱼”。

title: Sima Yan founds the Jin
summary: The Sima family, real rulers of Wei, take the throne.
summary_zh: 早已掌握魏国实权的司马氏正式登上皇位。

title: Pei Xiu's grid-based maps
summary: Minister of Works Pei Xiu compiled an 18-sheet historical atlas and set out six principles of cartography, including scale and grids.
summary_zh: 司空裴秀编制《禹贡地域图》十八篇，提出“制图六体”，奠定中国传统地图学。

title: Promulgation of the Taishi Code
summary: Jin issued the Taishi Code drafted by Jia Chong and others, the first comprehensive code to blend Confucian ritual norms into law.
summary_zh: 晋颁行贾充等修订的《泰始律》，首次将儒家礼制系统纳入律令，影响后世。

title: Yang Hu prepares conquest at Xiangyang
summary: Yang Hu governed the Jing frontier with benevolence, built up grain reserves and urged the conquest of Wu, while keeping courteous relations with Lu Kang.
summary_zh: 羊祜坐镇襄阳，屯田积谷，以德怀柔，与吴将陆抗互相敬重，力主伐吴。

title: Tufa Shujineng's Xianbei revolt
summary: The Xianbei chief Tufa Shujineng killed several Jin governors and held Liangzhou for a decade until Ma Long defeated him.
summary_zh: 鲜卑首领秃发树机能起兵，连杀晋数任刺史，据凉州近十年，后为马隆讨平。

title: Anthony the Great begins desert monasticism
place_zh: 东部沙漠（今埃及红海省圣安东尼修道院）
summary: Anthony withdrew into the Egyptian desert to live as a hermit, and his followers made Egypt the birthplace of Christian monasticism.
summary_zh: 安东尼隐居埃及沙漠修行，追随者众多，埃及由此成为基督教修道制度的发源地。

title: Zenobia's Palmyrene Empire
title_zh: 芝诺比娅建立帕尔米拉帝国
place_zh: 帕尔米拉（今叙利亚霍姆斯省）
summary: Queen Zenobia of Palmyra broke from Rome and seized Syria, Egypt and much of Anatolia until Aurelian defeated her.
summary_zh: 帕尔米拉女王芝诺比娅脱离罗马，夺取叙利亚、埃及和安纳托利亚大部，最终被奥勒良击败。

title: Aksum issues its own coins
place_zh: 阿克苏姆（今埃塞俄比亚）
summary: Aksum began minting gold, silver and bronze coins, one of the few ancient states anywhere to issue its own gold coinage.
summary_zh: 阿克苏姆开始铸造金、银、铜币，是古代少数自行发行金币的国家之一。

title: Aurelian Walls of Rome
summary: Facing barbarian raids, Aurelian ringed Rome with a new 19 km wall, a sign that even the capital was no longer safe.
summary_zh: 面对蛮族侵袭，奥勒良为罗马修建长约19公里的新城墙，表明连首都也不再安全。

title: Lu Kang retakes Xiling
summary: Wu commander Bu Chan defected to Jin; Lu Kang besieged Xiling, repelled Yang Hu's relief and executed Bu Chan.
summary_zh: 吴西陵督步阐降晋，陆抗围西陵，击退羊祜援军，斩步阐。

title: Wang Jun builds a war fleet in Shu
summary: Ordered to prepare for the conquest of Wu, Wang Jun built great towered warships in Shu; wood shavings floating downstream alarmed Wu.
summary_zh: 王濬在蜀大造楼船，木屑蔽江而下，吴建平太守吾彦请增兵防备未果。

title: Discovery of the Bamboo Annals
summary: A tomb robber opened a Wei royal tomb at Ji, revealing bamboo-slip texts including the Bamboo Annals and the Tale of King Mu.
summary_zh: 盗墓者发掘汲郡战国魏王墓，出土大批竹简，包括《竹书纪年》《穆天子传》。

title: Jin conquers Wu and reunifies China
summary: A fleet sails down the Yangtze from Sichuan and Wu surrenders.
summary_zh: 晋军舰队从蜀地顺长江而下，东吴投降。

title: Land allotment and tax system
summary: After reunification Jin set land quotas by household and rank and a household tax in silk and grain, limiting aristocrats' holdings on paper.
summary_zh: 灭吴后西晋颁行占田、课田与户调制，按丁口和品级规定占田限额和赋税。

title: Jin disbands provincial armies
summary: Emperor Wu disbanded provincial and commandery troops after reunification, leaving the realm reliant on princes' armies—later blamed for Jin's collapse.
summary_zh: 晋武帝统一后罢州郡兵备，地方无兵，宗王坐拥重兵，埋下祸乱隐患。

title: Liu Yi denounces the nine-rank system
summary: Liu Yi memorialized that the nine-rank system meant 'no humble families in the upper grades, no great clans in the lower', but nothing changed.
summary_zh: 刘毅上疏陈九品中正八损，指出“上品无寒门，下品无势族”，未被采纳。

title: Shi Chong and Wang Kai's wealth contest
summary: The magnates Shi Chong and Wang Kai competed in extravagance, smashing coral trees and lining roads with silk screens—emblems of Western Jin decadence.
summary_zh: 石崇与王恺竞相斗富，以锦步障、珊瑚树相夸，为西晋奢靡之风的写照。

title: Murong Hui sacks Buyeo
summary: The Xianbei chief Murong Hui sacked the Buyeo capital; its king killed himself, and Jin later helped restore the kingdom.
summary_zh: 鲜卑慕容廆攻破夫余，夫余王依虑自杀，晋后助其复国。

title: Chen Shou writes the Records of the Three Kingdoms
summary: A former Shu official writes the official history of Wei, Shu and Wu, the base of all later Three Kingdoms stories.
summary_zh: 出身蜀汉的史官陈寿撰写魏、蜀、吴三国的历史，后世三国故事都以它为本。

title: Emperor Wu dies; Yang Jun regent
summary: Emperor Wu died; the developmentally disabled Emperor Hui took the throne with the empress dowager's father Yang Jun as sole regent.
summary_zh: 晋武帝崩，惠帝即位，外戚杨骏独揽辅政大权，与贾后矛盾激化。

title: War of the Eight Princes
summary: Princes of the Sima clan fight for control of the court, wrecking the empire.
summary_zh: 司马氏诸王为争夺朝政大权相互攻杀，使国家元气大伤。

title: Diocletian sets up the Tetrarchy
title_zh: 戴克里先改革与四帝共治
place_zh: 尼科米底亚（今土耳其伊兹米特）
summary: Diocletian split rule among two senior and two junior emperors, multiplied provinces and enlarged the army and bureaucracy.
summary_zh: 戴克里先实行两位正帝、两位副帝共治，增设行省，扩充军队和官僚机构，帝国暂时恢复稳定。

title: Qi Wannian's Di-Qiang uprising
summary: Di and Qiang peoples of Guanzhong rose under Qi Wannian, defeating Jin armies until Meng Guan captured him; famine drove refugees into Shu.
summary_zh: 关中氐羌推齐万年为帝起兵，屡败晋军，后为孟观所擒，流民大批入蜀。

title: Jiang Tong urges resettling the Rong
summary: Jiang Tong warned that non-Han peoples settled inside the frontier would rebel and urged their removal; the court ignored him.
summary_zh: 江统作《徙戎论》，主张将内迁的少数民族迁回故地，朝廷未能采纳。

title: Empress Jia frames the crown prince
summary: Empress Jia Nanfeng tricked heir Sima Yu into writing a treasonous text, deposed him and had him murdered in 300.
summary_zh: 贾后诱太子司马遹醉书逆文，废为庶人，次年遣人将其杀害。

title: Ghana Empire rises
place_zh: 昆比萨利赫（今毛里塔尼亚）
summary: The Soninke kingdom of Wagadu, known to Arab writers as Ghana, rose in the western Sahel by controlling the gold trade.
summary_zh: 索宁克人的瓦加杜王国在西部萨赫勒兴起，因控制黄金贸易而强盛，阿拉伯作家称之为加纳。

title: Sima Lun deposes Empress Jia
summary: The Prince of Zhao kills the scheming Empress Jia Nanfeng and the minister Zhang Hua, and soon seizes the throne.
summary_zh: 赵王司马伦杀死专权的贾南风和大臣张华，不久又篡夺帝位。

title: Panchatantra
summary: A collection of animal fables teaching statecraft, the Panchatantra was translated into Persian and Arabic and spread across the world.
summary_zh: 以动物寓言讲述治国处世之道的《五卷书》被译成波斯文、阿拉伯文，流传世界各地。

title: Obelisks of Aksum
place_zh: 阿克苏姆（今埃塞俄比亚）
summary: Aksum's kings raised giant carved granite stelae over royal tombs, the tallest over 30 metres, among the largest single stones ever erected.
summary_zh: 阿克苏姆国王在王陵上竖立雕刻精美的巨型花岗岩石碑，最高者超过30米，是古代最大的整块立石之一。

title: Hohokam irrigation canals
place_zh: 盐河河谷（今美国亚利桑那州菲尼克斯）
summary: The Hohokam dug hundreds of kilometers of canals to farm maize and cotton in the Sonoran Desert.
summary_zh: 霍霍坎人开挖数百公里水渠，在索诺兰沙漠中种植玉米和棉花。

title: Li Te leads refugees' rising in Shu
summary: Refugees from Guanzhong, ordered home by the governor of Yizhou, rebelled under the Di chief Li Te; he died in 303 but his son took Chengdu.
summary_zh: 入蜀流民被逼遣返，推氐人李特起兵，李特303年战死，其子李雄继续作战。

title: Zhang Gui takes charge of Liangzhou
summary: Zhang Gui became governor of Liangzhou and kept it orderly and loyal to Jin; his family's rule became the Former Liang.
summary_zh: 张轨出任凉州刺史，保境安民，奉晋正朔，其家族世守凉州，是为前凉。

title: Three princes overthrow usurper Sima Lun
summary: Sima Lun usurped the throne; the princes of Qi, Chengdu and Hejian raised armies, killed him and restored Emperor Hui after 60 days of fighting.
summary_zh: 赵王伦篡位，齐王冏、成都王颖、河间王颙起兵讨伐，战六十余日，诛伦复惠帝位。

title: Edict on Maximum Prices
place_zh: 尼科米底亚（今土耳其伊兹米特）
summary: Diocletian fixed maximum prices for over a thousand goods and wages to fight inflation; it largely failed.
summary_zh: 戴克里先为一千多种商品和工资规定最高价格以遏制通货膨胀，但基本未能奏效。

title: Zhang Chang's rising in Jing province
summary: Conscripts resisting service in Shu rose under Zhang Chang, overrunning much of Jing, Jiang and Yang provinces before Tao Kan's forces crushed them.
summary_zh: 不愿应征入蜀的民众随张昌起事，席卷荆、江、扬诸州，后被刘弘、陶侃镇压。

title: Poet Lu Ji executed after defeat
summary: Leading Sima Ying's army against Luoyang, the Wu-born poet Lu Ji was defeated and executed, lamenting the cranes' cries of Huating.
summary_zh: 陆机为成都王颖统兵攻洛阳兵败，被谗遇害，临刑叹“华亭鹤唳，岂可复闻乎”。

title: Diocletianic Persecution
place_zh: 尼科米底亚（今土耳其伊兹米特）
summary: Diocletian ordered churches destroyed and Christians stripped of rights, the last and harshest Roman persecution of Christianity.
summary_zh: 戴克里先下令拆毁教堂、剥夺基督徒权利，这是罗马对基督教最后也最严酷的一次迫害。

title: Liu Yuan founds Han Zhao; the Sixteen Kingdoms begin
summary: A Xiongnu noble declares himself king of Han. The same year Li Xiong sets up the Cheng state in Sichuan.
summary_zh: 匈奴贵族刘渊自立为汉王；同年李雄在蜀地建立成国。

title: Li Xiong founds Cheng in Sichuan
summary: Li Xiong declared himself King of Chengdu in 304 and emperor of Cheng in 306, ruling Sichuan with light taxes for three decades.
summary_zh: 李雄据成都称王，306年称帝，国号大成，轻徭薄赋，蜀中安定三十年。

title: Battle of Dangyin; Emperor Hui captured
summary: Sima Yue led Emperor Hui against Sima Ying; the imperial army was routed and the emperor, his face wounded, was taken to Ye.
summary_zh: 东海王越挟惠帝攻成都王颖，于荡阴大败，惠帝面伤，被掳至邺。

title: Sima Rui and Wang Dao move to Jianye
summary: A minor prince and his adviser Wang Dao set up a base south of the Yangtze and win over the local gentry.
summary_zh: 琅琊王司马睿与谋士王导南下建邺，争取江南士族的支持，建立根据地。

title: Fotudeng arrives in Luoyang
summary: The Kuchean monk Fotudeng arrived and later won the trust of Shi Le and Shi Hu, spreading Buddhism widely in the north.
summary_zh: 西域高僧佛图澄至洛阳，后得石勒、石虎崇信，大力推动佛教在北方传播。

title: Disaster of Yongjia
summary: Xiongnu forces of Han Zhao sack Luoyang and capture the emperor. Many northern families flee south.
summary_zh: 匈奴人建立的汉赵军队攻破洛阳，俘虏晋怀帝。大批北方士族百姓南逃。

title: Battle of Ningping
summary: Shi Le's cavalry surrounded the army escorting Sima Yue's coffin and massacred over 100,000; Wang Yan was captured and killed.
summary_zh: 石勒追及护送司马越灵柩的晋军，于宁平城围歼十余万人，俘杀王衍。

title: Battle of the Milvian Bridge
place_zh: 米尔维安大桥（今意大利罗马）
summary: Constantine defeated his rival Maxentius outside Rome after, by tradition, seeing a Christian sign in the sky.
summary_zh: 君士坦丁在罗马城外击败对手马克森提乌斯，相传他战前看到天空中的基督教标记。

title: Edict of Milan
summary: Constantine and Licinius granted freedom of worship to Christians and all others, ending the persecutions.
summary_zh: 君士坦丁和李锡尼宣布宗教宽容，基督徒获得信仰自由，对基督教的迫害结束。

title: Goguryeo conquers Lelang
summary: King Micheon of Goguryeo took Lelang Commandery, ending four centuries of Chinese rule in the northwest of the peninsula.
summary_zh: 高句丽美川王攻占乐浪郡，结束了中原王朝在半岛西北部约四百年的统治。

title: Zu Ti's northern expedition
summary: With little help from the court, Zu Ti crosses the Yangtze and retakes most land south of the Yellow River.
summary_zh: 祖逖几乎没有得到朝廷支持，渡江北伐，收复了黄河以南的大片土地。

title: Sogdian merchants' Ancient Letters
summary: Letters by Sogdian traders, found near Dunhuang, describe the fall of Luoyang and their commercial network across northern China.
summary_zh: 敦煌附近发现的粟特商人书信，记述洛阳陷落及其遍布中国北方的贸易网络。

title: Shi Le seizes Wang Jun at Jicheng
summary: Feigning submission, Shi Le entered Jicheng and seized Wang Jun, the Jin warlord of the northeast.
summary_zh: 石勒伪称归附，进入蓟城擒获割据幽州的王浚，尽并其众。

title: Tuoba Yilu made Prince of Dai
summary: In return for aiding Liu Kun, Jin made the Tuoba chief Yilu Prince of Dai, the origin of the later Northern Wei state.
summary_zh: 拓跋猗卢助刘琨抗汉赵，晋封其为代王，为后来北魏之源。

title: Fall of Chang'an; Western Jin ends
summary: Han Zhao besieges Chang'an until Emperor Min surrenders. He is killed the following year.
summary_zh: 汉赵军围困长安，晋愍帝出城投降，次年遇害。

title: Jin court re-established at Jiankang
summary: Sima Rui rules the south from Jiankang, while the north fragments into the Sixteen Kingdoms.
summary_zh: 司马睿在建康主政南方，北方则分裂为十六国。

title: Ge Hong's Baopuzi
summary: A Daoist scholar writes on alchemy, medicine and long life. His works record early chemistry and herbal cures.
summary_zh: 道教学者葛洪论述炼丹、医药和养生，书中保存了早期化学和草药疗法的记录。

title: Liu Kun killed by Duan Pidi
summary: Driven from Bingzhou, the loyalist Liu Kun took refuge with Duan Pidi, who strangled him on suspicion of plotting.
summary_zh: 刘琨失并州后投奔鲜卑段匹磾，遭猜忌被缢杀，北方晋军抵抗瓦解。

title: Jin Zhun massacres the Liu clan
summary: Jin Zhun killed Han emperor Liu Can and slaughtered the imperial clan; Liu Yao and Shi Le crushed him and split the Han state.
summary_zh: 靳准杀汉主刘粲，屠刘氏宗族，刘曜、石勒合讨平之，汉赵从此分裂。

title: Arian controversy begins in Alexandria
summary: The priest Arius taught that Christ was created by the Father; the dispute led to the Council of Nicaea in 325.
summary_zh: 亚历山大的司铎阿里乌主张基督为圣父所造，争论引发了325年的尼西亚会议。

title: Shi Le founds Later Zhao
summary: Liu Yao renamed his state Zhao at Chang'an, and Shi Le declared himself King of Zhao at Xiangguo, founding Later Zhao.
summary_zh: 刘曜在长安改国号为赵，石勒在襄国自称赵王，建立后赵，二赵对峙。

title: Chandragupta I founds the Gupta Empire
summary: Chandragupta I, allied by marriage to the Licchavis, took the title Maharajadhiraja and began the Gupta era.
summary_zh: 旃陀罗笈多一世与离车族联姻，自称“众王之王”，开创笈多王朝。

title: Death of Zu Ti
summary: Zu Ti, who had recovered land south of the Yellow River, died in despair as the court sent Dai Yuan to supervise him; his gains were soon lost.
summary_zh: 祖逖收复黄河以南，因朝廷派戴渊节制且内乱将起，忧愤病卒，失地复陷。

title: Wang Dun's rebellion
summary: The powerful general marches on the capital and takes control. He dies during a second revolt in 324.
summary_zh: 手握重兵的王敦起兵攻入建康，控制朝政；324年再次起兵时病死。

title: First Council of Nicaea
place_zh: 尼西亚（今土耳其伊兹尼克）
summary: Constantine called the first general council of the church, which condemned Arianism and issued the Nicene Creed.
summary_zh: 君士坦丁召开第一次基督教大公会议，谴责阿里乌派，制定《尼西亚信经》。

title: Su Jun's rebellion sacks Jiankang
summary: Provoked by Yu Liang, Su Jun and Zu Yue took Jiankang and held the child emperor; Tao Kan and Wen Jiao's coalition crushed them.
summary_zh: 庾亮激变，苏峻、祖约攻入建康，挟持成帝，陶侃、温峤联军讨平。

title: Shi Le defeats Liu Yao at Luoyang
summary: Later Zhao captures the Former Zhao emperor in battle and soon takes all of his lands.
summary_zh: 后赵石勒在洛阳生擒前赵皇帝刘曜，随后吞并前赵全境。

title: Later Zhao destroys Former Zhao
summary: After Liu Yao's capture, Shi Hu took Shanggui and killed the Former Zhao heir, leaving Later Zhao master of the north.
summary_zh: 刘曜被俘后，石虎攻破上邽，杀前赵太子刘熙等，后赵统一北方大部。

title: Constantinople dedicated
place_zh: 君士坦丁堡（今土耳其伊斯坦布尔）
summary: Constantine rebuilt Byzantium as a new capital named Constantinople, which became the center of the eastern empire for over a thousand years.
summary_zh: 君士坦丁将拜占庭重建为新都君士坦丁堡，此后一千多年这里都是东部帝国的中心。

title: Ezana adopts Christianity
place_zh: 阿克苏姆（今埃塞俄比亚）
summary: King Ezana of Aksum, taught by the Syrian Frumentius, made Christianity the state religion, the beginning of the Ethiopian Orthodox Church.
summary_zh: 阿克苏姆国王埃扎纳受叙利亚人弗鲁门修斯影响，定基督教为国教，埃塞俄比亚正教会由此开始。

title: Conquests of Samudragupta
place_zh: 普拉亚格拉杰（今印度北方邦）
summary: Samudragupta conquered the north and made southern kings tributaries, as praised on the Allahabad pillar.
summary_zh: 沙摩陀罗笈多征服北印度并使南方诸王称臣纳贡，事迹刻于阿拉哈巴德石柱。

title: Shi Hu moves capital to Ye
summary: Shi Hu, who had usurped the throne, moved the Later Zhao capital to Ye and embarked on vast palace and hunting projects.
summary_zh: 石虎篡位后迁都邺城，大兴宫殿园囿，役使无度。

title: Murong Huang founds Former Yan
summary: Murong Huang proclaimed himself King of Yan, founding the Former Yan state of the Murong Xianbei in Liaoxi.
summary_zh: 慕容皝自称燕王，建立前燕，鲜卑慕容部崛起于辽西。

title: Tuoba Shiyijian rebuilds Dai
summary: Returning from hostage at Later Zhao, Tuoba Shiyijian became Prince of Dai, set up offices and laws and built Shengle.
summary_zh: 拓跋什翼犍自后赵归国即代王位，设置百官，制定法令，筑盛乐城。

title: Former Yan sacks the Goguryeo capital
summary: Murong Huang took Hwando, dug up the king's father's tomb and carried off the queen mother, forcing Goguryeo to submit.
summary_zh: 慕容皝攻破高句丽丸都，掘王父墓，掳王母，高句丽被迫称臣。

title: Huan Wen conquers Cheng Han
summary: The Eastern Jin general takes Sichuan, which becomes the base of his power.
summary_zh: 东晋将领桓温攻取蜀地，成为他权势的根基。

title: Aksum overruns Meroe
summary: An Aksumite campaign recorded on Ezana's inscriptions reached the Nile as the Kingdom of Kush, already in decline, came to an end.
summary_zh: 埃扎纳碑文记载阿克苏姆军队远征至尼罗河，此时已经衰落的库施王国随之灭亡。

title: Ran Min overthrows Later Zhao
summary: A Han Chinese general seizes power in Ye, orders a massacre of the Jie, and founds the short-lived Ran Wei.
summary_zh: 汉人将领冉闵在邺城夺权，下令屠杀羯人，建立短命的冉魏政权。

title: Fu Jiàn founds Former Qin
summary: The Di leader Fu Jiàn occupied Chang'an and proclaimed himself Heavenly King of Great Qin, founding the Former Qin.
summary_zh: 氐人苻健入据长安，自称天王、大单于，国号大秦，史称前秦。

title: Murong Ke captures Ran Min
summary: Former Yan general Murong Ke defeated Ran Min with chained cavalry at Liantai; Ran was executed and Murong Jun declared himself emperor.
summary_zh: 慕容恪以连环马阵大破冉闵于廉台，冉闵被杀，慕容儁称帝。

title: Wang Xizhi writes the Orchid Pavilion Preface
summary: Written at a poetry gathering, it became the most admired work of Chinese calligraphy.
summary_zh: 王羲之在一次修禊雅集上写下此序，成为最受推崇的书法作品。

title: Huan Wen's first northern expedition
summary: Huan Wen advanced to Bashang outside Chang'an, where locals welcomed him and Wang Meng famously chatted while picking lice, but lack of grain forced retreat.
summary_zh: 桓温北伐前秦至灞上，关中父老牵牛持酒迎接，王猛扪虱而谈，终因缺粮而退。

title: Huan Wen recovers Luoyang
summary: Huan Wen defeated Yao Xiang on the Yi River and retook Luoyang, repairing the Jin imperial tombs.
summary_zh: 桓温第二次北伐，于伊水大败姚襄，收复洛阳，修复西晋诸陵。

title: Fu Jian and Wang Meng reform Former Qin
summary: The Di ruler Fu Jian takes power and makes the Han Chinese scholar Wang Meng his chief minister.
summary_zh: 氐族君主苻坚即位，任用汉人谋士王猛主持国政。

title: Kidarites take Bactria
title_zh: 寄多罗人占领巴克特里亚
summary: The Kidarites, first of the Hunnic groups, seized Bactria from the Sasanians and later pushed into Gandhara.
summary_zh: 寄多罗人是最早进入中亚南部的匈人部族之一，他们从萨珊手中夺取巴克特里亚，后又进入犍陀罗。

title: Gengxu tuduan household registration
summary: Huan Wen enforced the 'Gengxu' registration, enrolling northern émigrés in local registers so they paid tax and served in the army.
summary_zh: 桓温主持庚戌土断，将侨人编入所在郡县户籍，增加国家赋役来源。

title: First caves cut at Mogao
summary: A monk begins the cave temples that grow over a thousand years into a library of Buddhist art.
summary_zh: 一位僧人在此开凿石窟，此后千年间逐渐形成佛教艺术宝库。

title: Battle of Fangtou
summary: Huan Wen's last northern expedition is beaten by Murong Chui of Former Yan, ending his hopes of the throne.
summary_zh: 桓温最后一次北伐被前燕慕容垂击败，他借北伐威望篡位的打算随之落空。

title: Former Qin conquers Former Yan
summary: Wang Meng defeated Murong Ping's huge army at Lushan and took Ye, capturing Emperor Murong Wei.
summary_zh: 王猛于潞川大破慕容评，攻克邺城，俘燕主慕容暐，前燕灭亡。

title: Huan Wen deposes Emperor Fei
summary: To restore prestige after Fangtou, Huan Wen deposed Sima Yi on fabricated charges and enthroned Emperor Jianwen.
summary_zh: 桓温枋头败后为立威，诬废晋帝司马奕为海西公，立简文帝。

title: Baekje attacks Pyongyang
summary: King Geunchogo of Baekje attacked Pyongyang fortress and killed King Gogugwon of Goguryeo, bringing Baekje to its height.
summary_zh: 百济近肖古王进攻平壤城，射杀高句丽故国原王，百济国力达到鼎盛。

title: Buddhism reaches Goguryeo
place_zh: 国内城（今中国吉林集安）
summary: The monk Sundo brought Buddhist images and scriptures from Former Qin, and King Sosurim accepted the faith, the first in Korea.
summary_zh: 前秦僧人顺道携佛像和经文来到高句丽，小兽林王接受佛教，这是佛教传入朝鲜半岛之始。

title: Former Qin seizes Hanzhong and Shu
summary: Former Qin overran Jin's Liang and Yi provinces, taking Hanzhong and Chengdu.
summary_zh: 前秦攻取东晋梁、益二州，占领汉中、成都。

title: Former Qin unites the north
summary: Fu Jian conquers Former Liang and Dai. Every state in the north is now under Former Qin.
summary_zh: 苻坚灭前凉和代国，北方全部归于前秦。

title: Xie Xuan creates the Beifu Army
summary: Xie Xuan recruited hardy northern refugees into the Beifu Army, the force that would win at Fei River and later carry Liu Yu to power.
summary_zh: 谢玄招募北方流民中的勇健者组成北府兵，后取得淝水大捷，并成为刘裕崛起的基础。

title: Battle of Adrianople
place_zh: 阿德里安堡（今土耳其埃迪尔内）
summary: Goths who had crossed the Danube fleeing the Huns destroyed a Roman army and killed Emperor Valens, a turning point in the barbarian invasions.
summary_zh: 为躲避匈人而渡过多瑙河的哥特人大败罗马军队，皇帝瓦伦斯阵亡，成为蛮族入侵的转折点。

title: Teotihuacan's arrival at Tikal
title_zh: 特奥蒂瓦坎干预蒂卡尔
place_zh: 蒂卡尔（今危地马拉佩滕省）
summary: Siyaj K'ak', linked to Teotihuacan, arrived at Tikal the day its king died and installed a new ruling line.
summary_zh: 与特奥蒂瓦坎有关的将领西亚赫·卡克抵达蒂卡尔，当天蒂卡尔国王死去，他扶植了新王系。

title: Former Qin takes Xiangyang
summary: Fu Pi besieged Xiangyang for a year; despite the defence led by Zhu Xu and his mother, the city fell and Zhu Xu was captured.
summary_zh: 苻丕围攻襄阳近一年，朱序及其母韩夫人筑“夫人城”坚守，终城破被俘。

title: Christianity becomes the state religion
place_zh: 帖撒罗尼迦（今希腊塞萨洛尼基）
summary: Theodosius I made Nicene Christianity the official religion of the empire; pagan sacrifices were banned in the following years.
summary_zh: 狄奥多西一世宣布尼西亚派基督教为帝国国教，此后数年又禁止异教祭祀。

title: Gu Kaizhi and figure painting
summary: Gu Kaizhi, painter of the Admonitions Scroll and the Nymph of the Luo River, emphasized conveying the spirit of his subjects.
summary_zh: 顾恺之作《女史箴图》《洛神赋图》，主张“以形写神”，为中国人物画奠基者。

title: Lü Guang's expedition to the Western Regions
summary: Fu Jiān sent Lü Guang with 70,000 troops to the Western Regions; he took Kucha and brought Kumarajiva back east.
summary_zh: 苻坚遣吕光率七万兵西征，攻破龟兹，西域诸国归附，并得鸠摩罗什东归。

title: Jerome begins the Vulgate
title_zh: 哲罗姆翻译武加大译本
summary: Pope Damasus asked Jerome to revise the Latin Bible; his translation, the Vulgate, became the standard Bible of the Western Church.
summary_zh: 教宗达马苏一世委托哲罗姆修订拉丁文圣经，他的译本即武加大译本，成为西方教会的标准圣经。

title: Battle of Fei River
summary: A small Eastern Jin army defeats the Former Qin, keeping the south independent.
summary_zh: 东晋以少量兵力大败前秦，保住了南方的独立。

title: Murong Chui founds Later Yan
summary: After Fei River, Murong Chui broke with Former Qin and restored the Yan state, later making Zhongshan his capital.
summary_zh: 淝水战后慕容垂叛秦复国，建立后燕，后定都中山。

title: Fu Jiān killed by Yao Chang
summary: Fleeing Chang'an, Fu Jiān was captured by the Qiang leader Yao Chang, founder of Later Qin, and strangled in a Buddhist temple.
summary_zh: 苻坚出奔被后秦姚苌所俘，拒绝禅让，被缢杀于新平佛寺。

title: Tuoba Gui founds the Northern Wei
place_zh: 盛乐（今内蒙古和林格尔）
summary: A Xianbei chief restores his people's state of Dai and renames it Wei. It will unite the north in 439.
summary_zh: 鲜卑首领拓跋珪复兴代国，改国号为魏，北魏将在439年统一北方。

title: Lü Guang founds Later Liang
summary: Returning from Kucha, Lü Guang seized Guzang and founded the Later Liang, holding Kumarajiva there for 17 years.
summary_zh: 吕光自西域东归，据姑臧建立后凉，鸠摩罗什被留凉州十七年。

title: Gwanggaeto the Great takes the throne
place_zh: 国内城（今中国吉林集安）
summary: Gwanggaeto expanded Goguryeo across Manchuria and south to the Han River, making it the leading power of Northeast Asia.
summary_zh: 广开土王即位后四处征伐，疆域扩展到辽东和汉江流域，高句丽成为东北亚强国。

title: Last known hieroglyphic inscription
summary: The Graffito of Esmet-Akhom at Philae is the last dated text in Egyptian hieroglyphs, after which knowledge of the script faded.
summary_zh: 菲莱岛上的埃斯梅特-阿霍姆题刻是最后一件有纪年的象形文字铭文，此后这种文字失传。

title: Division of the Roman Empire
summary: At the death of Theodosius I the empire was divided for good between his sons, Arcadius in the East and Honorius in the West.
summary_zh: 狄奥多西一世去世，帝国由两个儿子分治，阿卡狄乌斯统治东部，霍诺里乌斯统治西部，此后再未统一。

title: Battle of Canhe Slope
summary: Tuoba Gui surprised the retreating Later Yan army at Canhe and buried tens of thousands of prisoners, breaking Later Yan's power.
summary_zh: 拓跋珪于参合陂袭破后燕军，坑杀降卒数万，后燕由此衰落。

title: Chandragupta II defeats the Western Satraps
title_zh: 旃陀罗笈多二世灭西部总督
summary: Chandragupta II (Vikramaditya) conquered the Saka Western Satraps, gaining the rich ports of western India.
summary_zh: 旃陀罗笈多二世（超日王）消灭塞种人的西部总督政权，获得西印度富庶的港口。

title: Augustine becomes bishop of Hippo
place_zh: 希波（今阿尔及利亚安纳巴）
summary: Augustine of Hippo wrote the Confessions and The City of God, shaping Western Christian theology for over a thousand years.
summary_zh: 奥古斯丁任希波主教，著有《忏悔录》和《上帝之城》，深刻影响了此后一千多年的西方神学。

title: Northern Liang founded in the Hexi corridor
summary: Juqu Mengxun and his cousin rebelled against Later Liang and installed Duan Ye; Mengxun later killed Duan and ruled Northern Liang.
summary_zh: 沮渠蒙逊兄弟起兵反后凉，推段业为主建北凉，蒙逊后杀段业自立。

title: Wang Gong's revolts
summary: Wang Gong twice raised troops against the court of Sima Daozi; in 398 his general Liu Laozhi defected and Wang was executed.
summary_zh: 王恭两度起兵讨司马道子，398年部将刘牢之倒戈，王恭兵败被杀。

title: Tuoba Gui makes Pingcheng capital
summary: Tuoba Gui moved his capital to Pingcheng, proclaimed himself emperor and began building palaces and settling conquered peoples there.
summary_zh: 拓跋珪迁都平城，即皇帝位，营建宫室，徙民充实京畿。

title: Faxian travels to India
summary: The monk walks across Central Asia to India and returns by sea via Sri Lanka with Buddhist texts.
summary_zh: 僧人法显徒步经中亚到达天竺，又经狮子国（斯里兰卡）走海路带回佛经。

title: Sun En and Lu Xun rebellion
summary: A Daoist sect leader raises peasants along the coast. After his death his brother-in-law Lu Xun fights on.
summary_zh: 五斗米道首领孙恩在沿海发动农民起义，他死后妹夫卢循继续作战。

title: Kalidasa writes Shakuntala
summary: Kalidasa, the greatest Sanskrit poet and dramatist, wrote the play Shakuntala and the poem Meghaduta.
summary_zh: 梵语最伟大的诗人和剧作家迦梨陀娑创作了戏剧《沙恭达罗》和抒情诗《云使》。

title: Camel caravans open the trans-Saharan trade
place_zh: 奥达戈斯特（今毛里塔尼亚）
summary: The spread of the camel let caravans cross the Sahara regularly, carrying salt south and gold north and binding West Africa to the Mediterranean.
summary_zh: 骆驼的普及使商队能定期穿越撒哈拉，向南运盐、向北运金，把西非与地中海世界联系起来。

title: Tiwanaku grows into a city
place_zh: 蒂瓦纳库（今玻利维亚拉巴斯省）
summary: Near Lake Titicaca, Tiwanaku became a large city fed by raised field farming, with stone temples such as the Kalasasaya.
summary_zh: 的的喀喀湖畔的蒂瓦纳库依靠台田农业发展成大城市，建有卡拉萨萨亚等石砌神庙。

title: Li Gao founds Western Liang
summary: Li Gao, a Han official, founded Western Liang at Dunhuang, encouraging learning and farming at the western edge of China.
summary_zh: 李暠在敦煌建立西凉，兴学劝农，保存中原文化于河西。

title: Iron pillar of Delhi
summary: A seven-metre pillar of wrought iron, raised under Chandragupta II, has barely rusted in sixteen centuries.
summary_zh: 旃陀罗笈多二世时期竖立的七米高熟铁柱，历经一千六百年几乎没有锈蚀。

title: Kutai inscriptions
place_zh: 穆阿拉卡曼（今印度尼西亚东加里曼丹）
summary: Seven stone pillars of King Mulavarman, written in Sanskrit, are the oldest known inscriptions in Indonesia.
summary_zh: 古泰国王牟罗跋摩留下七根梵文石柱，是印度尼西亚已知最早的文字记录，反映了印度文化的传入。

title: Kumarajiva arrives in Chang'an
summary: The Kuchean monk leads a huge translation team. His versions of key sutras are still the ones most read.
summary_zh: 龟兹高僧鸠摩罗什主持大规模译经，他译出的许多佛经至今仍是最通行的版本。

title: Huiyuan's vow at Mount Lu
summary: Huiyuan and 123 followers vowed rebirth in Amitabha's Pure Land at Donglin Temple, regarded as the origin of Pure Land Buddhism.
summary_zh: 慧远与刘遗民等百余人于庐山东林寺立誓往生西方，被尊为净土宗初祖。

title: Huan Xuan usurps the Jin throne
summary: Huan Wen's son Huan Xuan took Jiankang in 402 and next year deposed Emperor An, proclaiming the state of Chu.
summary_zh: 桓玄402年攻入建康，次年废晋安帝，自立为帝，国号楚。

title: Liu Yu rises against Huan Xuan
summary: Liu Yu and Beifu officers rose at Jingkou, routed Huan Xuan and restored Jin, beginning Liu Yu's ascent.
summary_zh: 刘裕联络北府旧将在京口起兵，击败桓玄，恢复晋室，开始掌握朝政。

title: Tao Yuanming quits office to farm
summary: The poet resigns as magistrate of Pengze after 80 days and goes home to farm and write.
summary_zh: 诗人陶渊明做了八十多天彭泽县令后辞官回乡，躬耕田园，写诗为生。

title: Wani brings Chinese classics
summary: According to the Kojiki and Nihon Shoki, the scholar Wani came from Baekje with the Analects and the Thousand Character Classic.
summary_zh: 据《古事记》《日本书纪》记载，学者王仁从百济带来《论语》和《千字文》，汉字和儒学由此传入。

title: Crossing of the Rhine
place_zh: 莫贡提亚库姆（今德国美因茨）
summary: Vandals, Alans and Suebi crossed the Rhine into Gaul, and the western frontier never recovered.
summary_zh: 汪达尔人、阿兰人和苏维汇人越过莱茵河进入高卢，西部边防从此崩溃。

title: Helian Bobo founds Xia
summary: The Xiongnu chief Helian Bobo broke with Later Qin and founded Xia; in 413 he built the white-walled capital Tongwancheng.
summary_zh: 匈奴赫连勃勃叛后秦，自称大夏天王，413年筑统万城为都。

title: Visigoths sack Rome
summary: Alaric's Visigoths sacked Rome, the first fall of the city to a foreign enemy in 800 years, shocking the Roman world.
summary_zh: 阿拉里克率西哥特人洗劫罗马，这是八百年来罗马城首次被外敌攻破，震动了整个罗马世界。

title: Liu Yu conquers Southern Yan
summary: After a long siege Liu Yu takes Guanggu and brings Shandong back under Jin.
summary_zh: 刘裕围攻广固多时后破城，使山东重归东晋。

title: End of Roman rule in Britain
place_zh: 伦迪尼乌姆（今英国伦敦）
summary: With the legions gone, Emperor Honorius told the British cities to see to their own defense, ending Roman rule in Britain.
summary_zh: 罗马军团撤离后，皇帝霍诺里乌斯让不列颠各城自行防卫，罗马对不列颠的统治结束。

title: Faxian returns by sea
summary: After 13 years abroad, Faxian sailed home from Sri Lanka and landed at Laoshan with Sanskrit texts, then wrote his Record of Buddhist Kingdoms.
summary_zh: 法显历十余年自狮子国浮海东归，于牢山登岸，携回梵本，撰《佛国记》。

title: Augustine writes The City of God
place_zh: 希波（今阿尔及利亚安纳巴）
summary: Answering pagans who blamed Christianity for the sack of Rome, Augustine wrote The City of God, a foundation of medieval Christian thought.
summary_zh: 为回应异教徒把罗马陷落归咎于基督教，奥古斯丁写作《上帝之城》，成为中世纪基督教思想的基石。

title: Yixi tuduan registration
summary: Liu Yu carried out another household-registration drive, executing the magnate Yu Hu for concealing households.
summary_zh: 刘裕主持义熙土断，严厉检括隐户，诛隐匿人口的豪强虞亮以立威。

title: Zhu Lingshi conquers Western Shu
summary: Liu Yu's general Zhu Lingshi took Chengdu, ending Qiao Zong's breakaway Western Shu.
summary_zh: 刘裕遣朱龄石伐蜀，攻克成都，谯纵自杀，西蜀灭亡。

title: Gwanggaeto Stele erected
summary: Goguryeo's King Jangsu erected a six-metre stele recording the conquests of his father Gwanggaeto, a key source for Northeast Asian history.
summary_zh: 高句丽长寿王立碑颂其父好太王功业，为研究东北亚古史的重要史料。

title: Murder of Hypatia
summary: The mathematician and philosopher Hypatia was killed by a Christian mob, often seen as marking the end of classical Alexandria.
summary_zh: 女数学家、哲学家希帕提娅被基督徒暴民杀害，常被视为古典亚历山大学术终结的标志。

title: Liu Yu takes Chang'an
summary: The Eastern Jin general destroys Later Qin and briefly retakes the old capital, the high point of southern power.
summary_zh: 东晋大将刘裕消灭后秦，一度收复故都长安，这是南方军事力量的顶峰。

title: Liu Yu's crescent formation
summary: Advancing up the Yellow River against Later Qin, Liu Yu used a crescent formation of wagons and crossbows to rout Northern Wei cavalry.
summary_zh: 刘裕北伐沿黄河西进，以车阵弩兵布“却月阵”，大破北魏骑兵。

title: Helian Bobo captures Chang'an
summary: After Liu Yu left for the south, Jin's commanders feuded; Helian Bobo crushed them and took Chang'an, undoing the northern conquest.
summary_zh: 刘裕南归后关中晋将内讧，赫连勃勃大败晋军，攻占长安，北伐成果丧失。

title: Liu Yu founds the Song
summary: The general ends the Jin. Four short southern dynasties follow at Jiankang: Song, Qi, Liang and Chen.
summary_zh: 刘裕结束东晋统治。此后建康相继出现宋、齐、梁、陈四个短命的南方王朝。

title: Xie Lingyun founds landscape poetry
summary: Demoted to Yongjia, the aristocrat Xie Lingyun wandered its mountains and wrote the poems that founded the Chinese landscape (shanshui) genre.
summary_zh: 谢灵运出任永嘉太守，遍游山水，所作诗开创中国山水诗派。

title: Northern Wei takes Hulao and Luoyang
summary: After Liu Yu's death, Northern Wei invaded and took Luoyang and, after a 200-day siege, Hulao; Song lost most land south of the Yellow River.
summary_zh: 刘裕死后北魏南侵，攻占洛阳，围虎牢二百余日破之，宋失河南大片土地。

title: Regents depose and kill Emperor Shao
summary: Regents Xu Xianzhi, Fu Liang and Xie Hui deposed the frivolous Emperor Shao, had him killed and enthroned Liu Yilong as Emperor Wen.
summary_zh: 顾命大臣徐羡之、傅亮、谢晦废杀荒嬉的少帝，迎立宜都王刘义隆，是为宋文帝。

title: K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo' founds the Copán dynasty
summary: K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo' founded a dynasty that ruled Copán for about 400 years, making it a great Maya art centre.
summary_zh: 基尼奇·亚克斯·库克·莫建立的王朝统治科潘约四百年，使其成为玛雅艺术重镇。

title: Nalanda founded
place_zh: 那烂陀（今印度比哈尔邦）
summary: Gupta kings founded the monastery at Nalanda, which grew into the greatest Buddhist university in Asia.
summary_zh: 笈多诸王创建那烂陀寺，后发展为亚洲最大的佛教学术中心。

title: Northern Wei captures Tongwancheng
summary: Emperor Taiwu feigned retreat to lure out the Xia army, then stormed its white-walled capital Tongwancheng.
summary_zh: 魏太武帝诱夏军出城决战，大破之，攻克夏都统万城。

title: Jangsu moves the capital to Pyongyang
summary: King Jangsu moved the Goguryeo capital from Gungnae to Pyongyang, showing its turn toward expansion in the south.
summary_zh: 长寿王将都城从国内城迁到平壤，表明高句丽将扩张重心转向半岛南部。

title: Emperor Taiwu routs the Rouran
summary: Taiwu struck deep into the steppe, scattering the Rouran and taking hundreds of thousands of captives and livestock.
summary_zh: 魏太武帝亲率大军深入漠北，大破柔然，降附及俘获人畜以数十万计。

title: Shishuo Xinyu compiled
summary: Liu Yiqing, Prince of Linchuan, compiled anecdotes of Wei–Jin gentry wit and Pure Talk into the Shishuo Xinyu.
summary_zh: 临川王刘义庆组织文士编撰《世说新语》，记录魏晋名士言行与清谈风尚。

title: Song's failed Yuanjia expedition of 430
summary: Song retook land south of the Yellow River unopposed, but Wei counterattacked; Huatai fell and Tan Daoji's 'counting sand' ruse saved the retreat.
summary_zh: 宋遣到彦之北伐，先收复河南，旋遭魏反击，滑台失守，檀道济“唱筹量沙”全军而还。

title: Xia destroyed by Tuyuhun
summary: Helian Ding, having destroyed Western Qin, was ambushed by the Tuyuhun while crossing the Yellow River and handed to Northern Wei.
summary_zh: 夏主赫连定灭西秦后西渡黄河，被吐谷浑截击生擒，送交北魏，夏亡。

title: Northern Wei destroys Northern Yan
summary: Wei forces took Longcheng; Feng Hong burned his palace and fled to Goguryeo, where he was later killed.
summary_zh: 魏军攻龙城，燕主冯弘焚宫东奔高句丽，后被杀，北燕亡。

title: Tan Daoji executed
summary: Fearing the veteran general, Liu Yikang had Tan Daoji killed; Tan cried that they were destroying their own Great Wall.
summary_zh: 刘义康忌檀道济威名，矫诏杀之，道济怒斥“乃坏汝万里长城”。北魏闻之称快。

title: Song founds four academies
summary: Emperor Wen set up separate schools for Confucianism, Xuanxue, history and literature at Jiankang, recognizing literature and history as distinct fields.
summary_zh: 宋文帝于建康分立儒学、玄学、史学、文学四馆，学术分科自此显明。

title: Theodosian Code
place_zh: 君士坦丁堡（今土耳其伊斯坦布尔）
summary: Theodosius II issued an official collection of imperial laws since Constantine, used in both halves of the empire.
summary_zh: 狄奥多西二世颁布汇编君士坦丁以来皇帝敕令的官方法典，在帝国东西两部通行。

title: Northern Wei unifies the north
summary: The Xianbei Tuoba conquer Northern Liang, ending the Sixteen Kingdoms.
summary_zh: 鲜卑拓跋氏灭北凉，十六国时代结束。

title: Vandals capture Carthage
summary: Gaiseric's Vandals seized Carthage and founded a kingdom in North Africa, cutting the Western Roman Empire off from its grain.
summary_zh: 盖萨里克率汪达尔人攻占迦太基，在北非建立王国，切断了西罗马帝国的粮食来源。

title: Taoism becomes Wei's state religion
summary: Backed by Cui Hao, Kou Qianzhi's reformed Celestial Masters Taoism won Emperor Taiwu, who adopted the era name Taiping Zhenjun and received Taoist registers.
summary_zh: 在崔浩支持下，寇谦之改革的新天师道受太武帝尊崇，改元太平真君，帝亲受符箓。

title: Northern Liang remnant seizes Gaochang
summary: Survivors of Northern Liang under Juqu Wuhui and Anzhou took Gaochang, beginning centuries of Han-ruled states in Turpan.
summary_zh: 北凉余部沮渠无讳、安周西走占据高昌，此后吐鲁番长期由汉人政权统治。

title: He Chengtian's Yuanjia calendar
summary: He Chengtian proposed the Yuanjia calendar, adopted in 445, introducing improved lunar month calculations.
summary_zh: 何承天制《元嘉历》，445年颁行，改进朔望月推算方法。

title: Fan Ye's Book of the Later Han
summary: A Liu Song official writes the standard history of the Eastern Han. He is executed for treason in 445.
summary_zh: 刘宋官员范晔撰写东汉一代的正史，445年因谋反罪被处死。

title: Gai Wu's uprising in Guanzhong
summary: The Lushui Hu leader Gai Wu raised over 100,000 against Northern Wei; Taiwu found weapons in a Chang'an monastery, triggering the persecution of Buddhism.
summary_zh: 卢水胡盖吴起义，众至十余万，太武帝平乱时于长安佛寺发现兵器，引发灭佛。

title: Emperor Taiwu persecutes Buddhism
summary: Northern Wei orders monks killed or returned to lay life and temples and images destroyed.
summary_zh: 北魏下令诛杀或勒令僧人还俗，并焚毁寺庙和佛像。

title: Anglo-Saxons settle in Britain
title_zh: 盎格鲁-撒克逊人入侵不列颠
place_zh: 埃布斯弗利特（今英国肯特）
summary: By tradition Hengist and Horsa landed in Kent in 449; Angles, Saxons and Jutes then settled much of what became England.
summary_zh: 相传亨吉斯特和霍萨于449年在肯特登陆，此后盎格鲁人、撒克逊人和朱特人在后来的英格兰大片定居。

title: Song's northern campaign fails; Wei reaches the Yangtze
summary: Emperor Wen of Song attacks Northern Wei and is routed. Wei cavalry ride all the way to the Yangtze opposite Jiankang.
summary_zh: 宋文帝北伐北魏大败，北魏骑兵一路南下，直抵建康对岸的长江边。

title: Daisen Kofun built
place_zh: 大仙陵古坟（今日本大阪府堺市）
summary: The largest keyhole tomb in Japan, traditionally that of Emperor Nintoku, showed the huge labour the Yamato kings could command.
summary_zh: 日本最大的前方后圆坟，传为仁德天皇陵，显示了大和王权调动大量人力的能力。

title: Rise of the Hephthalites
place_zh: 吐火罗斯坦（今阿富汗北部与乌兹别克斯坦南部）
summary: The Hephthalites, the White Huns, built an empire over Bactria, Sogdia and the Tarim cities.
summary_zh: 嚈哒人（白匈奴）兴起，建立起统治巴克特里亚、粟特和塔里木诸城的大国。

title: Cui Hao is executed over the state history
summary: The leading Han Chinese minister of Northern Wei is killed with his whole clan after his history offends the Xianbei nobles.
summary_zh: 北魏重臣崔浩因修国史触怒鲜卑贵族，被灭族。

title: Battle of the Catalaunian Plains
place_zh: 卡塔隆平原（今法国香槟）
summary: The Roman general Aetius with Visigoth allies stopped Attila the Hun's invasion of Gaul.
summary_zh: 罗马将领埃提乌斯联合西哥特人，在高卢挡住了匈人首领阿提拉的进攻。

title: Council of Chalcedon and the Coptic split
title_zh: 卡尔西顿会议与科普特教会分立
place_zh: 卡尔西顿（今土耳其伊斯坦布尔卡德柯伊）
summary: The council deposed Dioscorus of Alexandria; most Egyptian Christians rejected its creed and formed the Coptic Church.
summary_zh: 卡尔西顿会议罢黜亚历山大主教狄奥斯库若，多数埃及基督徒拒绝其信条，形成科普特教会。

title: Council of Chalcedon
place_zh: 卡尔西顿（今土耳其伊斯坦布尔卡德柯伊）
summary: The council defined Christ as one person in two natures; Syrian, Armenian and Egyptian churches that rejected it split away.
summary_zh: 会议确定基督是一个位格兼具两种本性，拒绝接受的叙利亚、亚美尼亚和埃及教会从此分裂出去。

title: Defense of Xuyi
summary: After reaching Guabu on the Yangtze, Taiwu's withdrawing army besieged Xuyi for a month; Zang Zhi's stubborn defense inflicted heavy losses.
summary_zh: 魏太武帝饮马长江于瓜步后北撤，围攻盱眙月余，臧质坚守，魏军死伤惨重。

title: Eunuch Zong Ai murders Emperor Taiwu
summary: Fearing punishment, the eunuch Zong Ai killed Emperor Taiwu and then the successor he installed; officials soon killed Zong and enthroned Emperor Wencheng.
summary_zh: 宦官宗爱弑太武帝，又杀所立南安王，群臣诛宗爱，立文成帝。

title: Wencheng restores Buddhism
summary: Emperor Wencheng lifted the ban on Buddhism, rebuilt temples and later made Tanyao head of the sangha.
summary_zh: 文成帝即位后下诏复兴佛法，重建寺塔，后以昙曜为沙门统。

title: Liu Shao murders Emperor Wen
summary: Exposed for witchcraft against his father, crown prince Liu Shao stormed the palace and killed Emperor Wen; his brother Liu Jun overthrew him within months.
summary_zh: 太子刘劭巫蛊事泄，率兵入宫弑杀宋文帝，不久被其弟刘骏起兵诛灭。

title: Liu Yixuan's revolt at Jiangling
summary: Emperor Xiaowu's uncle Liu Yixuan rebelled at Jiangling with Zang Zhi but was defeated at Liangshan; Jing province was then split up.
summary_zh: 荆州刺史刘义宣联合臧质起兵反宋孝武帝，于梁山战败被杀，朝廷遂分割荆州。

title: Vandals sack Rome
summary: Gaiseric's Vandals sailed from Carthage and plundered Rome for two weeks; the word vandalism comes from this event.
summary_zh: 盖萨里克率汪达尔人从迦太基渡海劫掠罗马两周，英语中“破坏公物”一词即由此而来。

title: Sasanian Persia sends envoys to Wei
summary: The first of several Sasanian embassies reached Pingcheng, reflecting Silk Road links that also brought Persian silver to Wei tombs.
summary_zh: 波斯萨珊王朝首次遣使至平城，此后屡有往来，北魏墓葬中多见波斯银器。

title: Skandagupta repels the Huns
title_zh: 塞建陀笈多击退白匈奴
summary: Skandagupta drove back the Huna (Hephthalite) invaders, but the wars drained the Gupta treasury.
summary_zh: 塞建陀笈多击退嚈哒（白匈奴）入侵，但战争耗尽了笈多王朝的国库。

title: Yungang Grottoes begun
summary: Northern Wei emperors sponsor giant Buddha figures carved into the cliffs near their capital.
summary_zh: 北魏皇帝出资在都城附近的山崖上开凿巨大佛像。

title: Ajanta cave paintings
place_zh: 阿旃陀（今印度马哈拉施特拉邦）
summary: Under the Vakataka king Harishena, Buddhist caves at Ajanta were carved and painted with murals of the Buddha's lives.
summary_zh: 伐卡塔卡国王诃利犀那时期开凿阿旃陀佛教石窟，绘有佛本生故事壁画，是印度艺术瑰宝。

title: Zu Chongzhi's Daming calendar and pi
summary: The mathematician presents a more accurate calendar. He also calculates pi to between 3.1415926 and 3.1415927.
summary_zh: 祖冲之献上更精确的《大明历》，他还把圆周率推算到3.1415926与3.1415927之间。

title: Empress Dowager Feng's first regency
summary: Empress Dowager Feng killed the regent Yifu Hun and took control of the Wei government, later guiding Xiaowen's reforms.
summary_zh: 冯太后诛权臣乙浑，临朝听政，后主导孝文帝初年改革。

title: Succession war of Taishi
summary: After the tyrant Liu Ziye was murdered, Emperor Ming faced a rival claimant Liu Zixun backed by most provinces; Ming won but killed many princes.
summary_zh: 前废帝被杀后，宋明帝即位，各地拥立晋安王刘子勋于寻阳，明帝平之，大杀宗室。

title: Northern Wei seizes Huaibei and Qingqi
summary: Exploiting Song's civil war, Northern Wei annexed the Huaibei region and Shandong, taking Dongyang in 469; Song was confined south of the Huai.
summary_zh: 北魏乘宋内乱，夺取淮北四州及青齐之地，469年攻克东阳，宋退守淮河。

title: Emperor Xianwen abdicates to his son
summary: At 17, Xianwen yielded the throne to his four-year-old son Xiaowen, becoming retired emperor; he died in 476, reputedly poisoned by Empress Dowager Feng.
summary_zh: 献文帝禅位于年仅五岁的太子拓跋宏，自称太上皇，476年暴卒，传为冯太后所害。

title: Fall of Hanseong, Baekje moves to Ungjin
title_zh: 汉城陷落，百济迁都熊津
place_zh: 熊津（今韩国忠清南道公州）
summary: Goguryeo captured Baekje's capital Hanseong and killed King Gaero. Baekje moved south to Ungjin and lost the Han River basin.
summary_zh: 高句丽攻陷百济都城汉城，杀盖卤王，百济被迫南迁熊津，失去汉江流域。

title: Romulus Augustulus made emperor
title_zh: 罗慕路斯·奥古斯都路斯即位
place_zh: 拉文纳（今意大利艾米利亚-罗马涅）
summary: The general Orestes put his young son Romulus Augustulus on the western throne at Ravenna; he would be the last western emperor.
summary_zh: 将领欧瑞斯特斯在拉文纳拥立年幼的儿子罗慕路斯·奥古斯都路斯为西罗马皇帝，他是西罗马的末代皇帝。

title: Fall of the Western Roman Empire
place_zh: 拉文纳（今意大利拉文纳）
summary: The Germanic general Odoacer deposed Romulus Augustulus, the last Western emperor. The date is used to mark the end of antiquity in Europe.
summary_zh: 日耳曼将领奥多亚克废黜西罗马末代皇帝罗慕路斯·奥古斯都，西罗马帝国灭亡，通常被视为欧洲古代史的结束。

title: Xiao Daocheng has Emperor Houfei killed
summary: Xiao Daocheng arranged the murder of the violent boy-emperor Liu Yu and enthroned Emperor Shun, taking control of the Song court.
summary_zh: 萧道成使人杀暴虐的少主刘昱（苍梧王），立顺帝，独揽宋政。

title: Sigiriya rock fortress
summary: King Kashyapa built a palace on top of a 180-metre rock, with gardens and painted maidens on its walls.
summary_zh: 迦叶波一世在一百八十米高的巨岩顶上修建宫殿，岩壁上绘有仕女壁画。

title: King Bu of Wa petitions Song
summary: King Bu of Wa (Yūryaku) sent a memorial recounting his ancestors' conquests and received the title General Pacifying the East.
summary_zh: 倭王武（雄略天皇）遣使上表，述其祖先征服四方，宋授以安东大将军。

title: Xiao Daocheng founds the Southern Qi
summary: The general Xiao Daocheng forced the last Liu Song emperor to abdicate. The south changed dynasty but kept the same capital and lands.
summary_zh: 将领萧道成逼迫刘宋末帝禅位。南方虽改朝换代，都城和疆域却没有变化。

title: Yongming peace of Southern Qi
summary: Emperor Wu of Qi's Yongming reign brought a decade of stability, frugality and literary flourishing in the south.
summary_zh: 齐武帝永明年间政局安定，崇尚节俭，文学繁荣，史称永明之治。

title: Northern Wei pays official salaries
summary: Northern Wei began paying officials fixed salaries and punished corruption severely, replacing reliance on plunder and extortion.
summary_zh: 北魏颁行俸禄制，官吏按品给禄，贪赃满一匹者处死。

title: Hephthalites defeat and kill Peroz I
place_zh: 巴尔赫附近（今阿富汗北部）
summary: The Sasanian king Peroz I was killed with much of his army in a Hephthalite ambush, and Persia paid tribute for decades.
summary_zh: 萨珊国王卑路斯一世中伏战死，大军覆没，此后波斯长期向嚈哒纳贡。

title: Northern Wei's equal-field system
summary: The state hands out farmland to households by the number of adults, to bring land back into use and secure taxes.
summary_zh: 国家按人口授田给农户，使荒地重新耕种，保证赋税来源。

title: Tang Yuzhi's rebellion against registers
summary: Resentment at Southern Qi's harsh household-register audits fuelled Tang Yuzhi's rising in Zhejiang, which briefly took Qiantang.
summary_zh: 南齐检籍苛急，唐寓之聚众起事，一度攻占钱唐，称帝，旋被镇压。

title: Three Elders system
summary: On Li Chong's proposal, Wei organized villages into neighborhood, village and ward heads to register households and enforce the equal-field system.
summary_zh: 采纳李冲建议，北魏设邻、里、党三长，检括户口，配合均田制征收租调。

title: Eight Friends of Jingling
summary: Prince Xiao Ziliang's salon on Jiming Hill gathered Shen Yue, Xie Tiao, Xiao Yan and others, shaping Yongming literature and Buddhist debate.
summary_zh: 竟陵王萧子良开西邸于鸡笼山，聚沈约、谢朓、萧衍等八友，文学与佛学兴盛。

title: Shen Yue's four tones and Yongming style
summary: Shen Yue and Zhou Yong formalized the four tones of Chinese and tonal rules for verse, laying foundations for Tang regulated poetry.
summary_zh: 沈约、周颙等提出四声八病之说，创永明体，为唐代格律诗奠基。

title: Fan Zhen argues the soul perishes
summary: Fan Zhen debated Xiao Ziliang and later Emperor Wu of Liang, arguing that spirit is to body as sharpness is to a blade, denying karma's afterlife.
summary_zh: 范缜与萧子良辩论因果，后著《神灭论》，以“形神相即”批驳佛教神不灭说。

title: Longmen Grottoes begun
summary: As the capital moved to Luoyang, carving began at Longmen with the Guyang Cave; work continued for four centuries.
summary_zh: 北魏迁洛前后开凿龙门古阳洞，此后历朝续凿四百余年。

title: Emperor Xiaowen moves the capital to Luoyang
summary: The Xianbei court adopts Chinese dress, language and surnames. The Longmen Grottoes are begun nearby.
summary_zh: 鲜卑朝廷改穿汉服、说汉语、改汉姓。附近的龙门石窟也开始开凿。

title: Xiao Luan seizes the Qi throne
summary: Xiao Luan murdered two young emperors in succession, took the throne as Emperor Ming of Qi and killed most of Xiao Daocheng's descendants.
summary_zh: 萧鸾连废杀二帝，自立为齐明帝，并大肆诛杀高帝、武帝子孙。

title: Mazdakite movement
summary: The preacher Mazdak called for sharing property, and King Kavad I at first backed him. The movement was crushed in 528.
summary_zh: 马兹达克宣扬财产共有，国王卡瓦德一世一度支持他。528年运动被镇压。

title: Ban on Xianbei dress and language
summary: Xiaowen ordered officials to wear Han-style clothing and banned Xianbei speech at court for those under 30.
summary_zh: 孝文帝诏令禁止胡服，朝廷之上三十岁以下者禁用鲜卑语，改说汉语。

title: Shaolin Temple founded
summary: Emperor Xiaowen built the Shaolin Temple on Mount Song for the Indian monk Batuo.
summary_zh: 孝文帝为天竺僧人跋陀在嵩山少室山下建少林寺。

title: Taihe wuzhu coins minted
summary: Northern Wei minted its first official coinage, the Taihe wuzhu, to replace barter in silk and grain.
summary_zh: 北魏铸行太和五铢钱，改变以绢帛实物交易的状况。

title: Xianbei surnames changed to Han ones
summary: Xiaowen changed the imperial surname Tuoba to Yuan and Xianbei clans' names to Han forms, ranking them with leading Han families.
summary_zh: 孝文帝改拓跋氏为元氏，鲜卑诸姓改为汉姓，并定士族门第，鼓励鲜汉通婚。

title: Baptism of Clovis
summary: Clovis I, king of the Franks, converted to Catholic Christianity, winning the support of the Gallo-Roman church for the Frankish kingdom.
summary_zh: 法兰克国王克洛维皈依天主教，使法兰克王国获得高卢罗马教会和居民的支持，为法兰克人称霸西欧奠定基础。

title: Aryabhata's Aryabhatiya
title_zh: 阿耶波多著《阿耶波多历书》
summary: Aryabhata used place-value numbers, gave a value of pi near 3.1416 and argued that the Earth rotates.
summary_zh: 阿耶波多运用位值记数法，求得圆周率约3.1416，并提出地球自转的观点。

title: Xiaowen dies on campaign
summary: Emperor Xiaowen died aged 32 while campaigning against Southern Qi; Emperor Xuanwu succeeded.
summary_zh: 孝文帝南伐齐，病逝于谷塘原军中，年三十三，宣武帝即位。

title: Tao Hongjing's annotated pharmacopoeia
summary: The Daoist recluse Tao Hongjing, 'prime minister in the mountains', doubled the Shennong herbal to 730 drugs and classified them by type.
summary_zh: “山中宰相”陶弘景整理《神农本草经》，著《本草经集注》，收药七百三十种并按自然属性分类。

title: Babylonian Talmud completed
place_zh: 庞贝迪塔（今伊拉克费卢杰）
summary: Rabbis in the academies of Sura and Pumbedita finished the Babylonian Talmud, the main text of Jewish law and learning.
summary_zh: 苏拉和庞贝迪塔经学院的拉比编成《巴比伦塔木德》，它成为犹太律法和学术最主要的典籍。

title: Puquios of Nazca
place_zh: 坎塔洛克（今秘鲁伊卡大区纳斯卡）
summary: The Nazca dug underground channels with spiral wells to bring groundwater to their fields in one of the driest places on Earth.
summary_zh: 纳斯卡人在极度干旱的沙漠中开凿地下水渠，修建螺旋形通风井，把地下水引入农田。

title: Liu Xie's The Literary Mind and the Carving of Dragons
summary: The first systematic book of Chinese literary criticism, covering genres, style and the craft of writing.
summary_zh: 中国第一部系统的文学理论著作，论述文体、风格和写作技巧。

title: Xiao Yan founds the Liang
summary: Xiao Yan, Emperor Wu of Liang, ruled for 48 years. His reign was the high point of southern Buddhism and court culture.
summary_zh: 萧衍即梁武帝，在位四十八年，是南朝佛教和宫廷文化的鼎盛时期。

title: Zu Geng's principle and the sphere
summary: Zu Geng, son of Zu Chongzhi, stated that solids with equal cross-sections have equal volumes and derived the sphere's volume.
summary_zh: 祖冲之之子祖暅提出“幂势既同，则积不容异”，求得球体积公式。

title: Xiao Hong's failed northern expedition
summary: Liang massed a huge army under Xiao Hong, but the timid prince fled one stormy night and the force disintegrated.
summary_zh: 梁武帝遣临川王萧宏大举北伐，萧宏怯战，夜遇风雨弃军逃归，大军溃散。

title: Battle of Zhongli
summary: Liang forces destroyed a huge Northern Wei army besieging Zhongli on the Huai, which stopped the northern advance south.
summary_zh: 梁军在淮河边的钟离大败围城的北魏大军，阻止了北方继续南进。

title: Empress Dowager Hu takes power
summary: After Xuanwu's death, Empress Dowager Hu became regent for her young son; lavish Buddhist building and misrule followed.
summary_zh: 宣武帝死，胡太后临朝称制，崇佛奢靡，政治日益腐败。

title: Li Daoyuan's Commentary on the Water Classic
summary: A Northern Wei official describes more than a thousand rivers and the towns, sites and legends along them.
summary_zh: 北魏官员郦道元记述一千多条河流及沿岸城邑、古迹和传说。

title: Monk Faqing's Mahayana rebellion
summary: The monk Faqing led a millenarian rising in Jizhou, burning temples and proclaiming that 'a new Buddha has appeared'.
summary_zh: 沙门法庆在冀州聚众起事，号“大乘”，称“新佛出世，除去旧魔”，焚寺杀僧。

title: Fushan Dam collapses
summary: Liang dammed the Huai to flood Wei-held Shouyang; after two years of labor the dam burst, drowning over 100,000 people downstream.
summary_zh: 梁武帝筑浮山堰欲以淮水灌寿阳，役工二十万，堰成数月即溃，下游溺死十余万人。

title: Yongning Temple pagoda
summary: Empress Dowager Hu built the Yongning Temple and its wooden pagoda, about 136 m tall and seen from 100 li away; it burned in 534.
summary_zh: 胡太后兴建永宁寺，木塔高九层，百里外可见，534年焚毁。

title: Song Yun and Huisheng travel to India
summary: Sent by Empress Dowager Hu, Song Yun and Huisheng crossed the Pamirs to Udyana and Gandhara and brought back 170 Buddhist texts.
summary_zh: 宋云、惠生奉胡太后命西行，越葱岭至乌苌、乾陀罗，取回佛经一百七十部。

title: Bodhidharma brings Chan to China
summary: According to tradition the Indian monk Bodhidharma met Emperor Wu of Liang, then meditated at Shaolin, becoming the first patriarch of Chan.
summary_zh: 相传天竺僧菩提达摩见梁武帝不契，渡江北上，于嵩山面壁，被尊为禅宗初祖。

title: Yuan Cha confines Empress Dowager Hu
summary: Yuan Cha and the eunuch Liu Teng killed Prince Yuan Yi and confined the empress dowager, ruling until 525.
summary_zh: 元叉与宦官刘腾杀清河王元怿，幽禁胡太后，专权五年。

title: Silla issues a law code
summary: King Beopheung issued a law code and set official ranks and robes, laying the base of a centralized Silla state.
summary_zh: 新罗法兴王颁布律令，制定百官公服和官等，奠定了中央集权国家的基础。

title: Liang casts iron coins
summary: Liang replaced copper with iron coinage; mass minting caused inflation so severe that coins were counted by the cartload.
summary_zh: 梁武帝废铜钱改铸铁钱，私铸泛滥，物价腾贵，交易以车载钱。

title: Tomb of King Muryeong
summary: King Muryeong of Baekje was buried in a brick tomb in Southern Dynasties style. Found intact in 1971, it shows Baekje's close ties with Liang.
summary_zh: 百济武宁王葬于南朝式砖室墓中，该墓1971年完整出土，反映了百济与南朝梁的密切交往。

title: Revolt of the Six Garrisons
summary: Frontier soldiers on the northern border rose against the Luoyang court. The revolt broke Northern Wei apart within ten years.
summary_zh: 北方边境的戍卒起兵反抗洛阳朝廷，十年之内北魏便因此分崩离析。

title: Kaleb of Aksum invades Himyar
summary: King Kaleb crossed the Red Sea to overthrow the Jewish king of Himyar after his persecution of Christians, putting southern Arabia under Aksumite control.
summary_zh: 阿克苏姆国王卡莱布渡过红海，推翻迫害基督徒的希木叶尔犹太教国王，使阿拉伯半岛南部归阿克苏姆控制。

title: Martyrdom of Ichadon
summary: The court official Ichadon gave his life to win acceptance for Buddhism, and Silla officially adopted the faith.
summary_zh: 朝臣异次顿为推行佛教而殉身，此后新罗正式承认佛教，佛教成为国家宗教。

title: Emperor Wu of Liang gives himself to Tongtai Temple
summary: The emperor takes vows at a temple he built; ministers pay a huge ransom to buy him back. He does this four times.
summary_zh: 梁武帝到自己修建的同泰寺出家，群臣花巨款把他“赎”回。他先后这样做了四次。

title: Iwai Rebellion
place_zh: 八女（今日本福冈县八女市）
summary: Iwai, a powerful chief in Kyushu, rose against Yamato when it sent troops to Korea, and was crushed the next year.
summary_zh: 九州豪族筑紫君磐井在大和出兵朝鲜半岛时起兵反抗，次年被镇压，大和对九州的控制加强。

title: Heyin massacre
summary: The warlord Erzhu Rong drowns the Empress Dowager Hu and kills some two thousand court officials.
summary_zh: 军阀尔朱荣把胡太后沉入黄河，屠杀朝臣两千余人。

title: Erzhu Rong crushes Ge Rong
summary: With only 7,000 cavalry Erzhu Rong routed Ge Rong's vast rebel army near Ye and captured him, ending the Hebei rising.
summary_zh: 尔朱荣率精骑七千于滏口大破号称百万的葛荣军，生擒葛荣，河北义军瓦解。

title: Code of Justinian
place_zh: 君士坦丁堡（今土耳其伊斯坦布尔）
summary: Emperor Justinian I had Roman law collected and codified. The Corpus Juris Civilis became the basis of civil law across Europe.
summary_zh: 东罗马皇帝查士丁尼一世下令汇编罗马法，形成《民法大全》，成为后世欧洲大陆法系的重要基础。

title: Chen Qingzhi marches to Luoyang
summary: A Liang general with 7,000 men in white robes escorts a Wei prince to Luoyang, winning dozens of battles.
summary_zh: 梁将陈庆之率七千白袍军护送北魏宗室北上，连战连捷，攻入洛阳。

title: Xiao Tong compiles the Selections of Refined Literature
summary: The Liang crown prince collects the best poetry and prose of eight centuries. It becomes a standard textbook for later writers.
summary_zh: 梁朝太子萧统选编八百年间的优秀诗文，此书成为后世文人的必读范本。

title: Emperor Xiaozhuang kills Erzhu Rong
summary: Emperor Xiaozhuang lured Erzhu Rong into the palace and killed him; the Erzhu clan retaliated, capturing and killing the emperor.
summary_zh: 孝庄帝诱尔朱荣入宫手刃之，尔朱兆等攻入洛阳，俘杀孝庄帝。

title: Reforms of Khosrow I
summary: Khosrow I introduced a fixed land tax, rebuilt the army under four generals and made the Sasanian state its strongest.
summary_zh: 库思老一世推行固定土地税，把军队分归四大将领统辖，萨珊王朝达到鼎盛。

title: Battle of Hanling
summary: Gao Huan, with under 30,000 men, defeated the combined Erzhu forces at Hanling and took control of the Wei court.
summary_zh: 高欢以不足三万之众于韩陵大破尔朱氏联军二十万，掌控北魏朝政。

title: Xie He's Six Principles of Painting
summary: In his Record of Classifying Old Painters, Xie He set out six principles, led by 'spirit resonance', that guided Chinese art criticism.
summary_zh: 谢赫著《古画品录》，提出以“气韵生动”为首的绘画六法。

title: Belisarius reconquers Africa
place_zh: 阿德底改姆（今突尼斯迦太基附近）
summary: Justinian's general Belisarius destroyed the Vandal kingdom and restored Roman rule in North Africa.
summary_zh: 查士丁尼的大将贝利萨留消灭汪达尔王国，恢复罗马对北非的统治。

title: Northern Wei splits in two
summary: Rival generals set up Eastern Wei at Ye and Western Wei at Chang'an.
summary_zh: 两位权臣分别在邺城建立东魏、在长安建立西魏。

title: Yuwen Tai poisons Emperor Xiaowu
summary: Emperor Xiaowu, who fled Gao Huan to Chang'an, quarrelled with Yuwen Tai and was poisoned; Yuwen enthroned Emperor Wen of Western Wei.
summary_zh: 西奔长安的魏孝武帝与宇文泰不和，被鸩杀，宇文泰立文帝，西魏建立。

title: Hagia Sophia completed
place_zh: 君士坦丁堡（今土耳其伊斯坦布尔）
summary: Justinian rebuilt the great church with a vast dome. It remained the largest church in the world for nearly a thousand years.
summary_zh: 查士丁尼重建圣索菲亚大教堂，巨大的穹顶是拜占庭建筑的杰作，此后近千年是世界最大的教堂。

title: Battle of Shayuan
summary: Yuwen Tai of Western Wei ambushes and routs Gao Huan's much larger Eastern Wei army.
summary_zh: 西魏宇文泰设伏，以少胜多大败高欢率领的东魏大军。

title: Battle of Xiaoguan
summary: Yuwen Tai made a surprise attack on Dou Tai's Eastern Wei column at Xiaoguan; Dou killed himself and Gao Huan withdrew.
summary_zh: 宇文泰奇袭东魏窦泰于小关，窦泰兵败自杀，高欢撤军。

title: Buddhism introduced to Japan
place_zh: 飞鸟（今日本奈良县明日香村）
summary: King Seong of Baekje sent a Buddha image and sutras to the Yamato court, starting a debate between the Soga and the Mononobe.
summary_zh: 百济圣王向大和朝廷赠送佛像和经卷，佛教正式传入日本，引发苏我氏与物部氏的争论。

title: Battle of Heqiao and Mangshan
summary: Western Wei and Eastern Wei clashed around Luoyang's Yellow River bridge; both sides suffered heavy losses and Luoyang was left in ruins.
summary_zh: 东西魏于洛阳河桥、邙山一带激战，双方伤亡惨重，洛阳遭严重破坏。

title: Baekje moves its capital to Sabi
place_zh: 泗沘（今韩国忠清南道扶余）
summary: King Seong moved the Baekje capital to Sabi and renamed the state Nambuyeo, and sent Buddhist envoys to Japan.
summary_zh: 百济圣王迁都泗沘，改国号为南扶余，并向日本传播佛教。

title: Su Chuo's Six Edicts
summary: Su Chuo drafted six edicts for Yuwen Tai on governing the people, appointing the worthy and equalizing taxes, which officials had to memorize.
summary_zh: 苏绰为宇文泰制定六条诏书，倡清心、敷教化、尽地利、擢贤良、恤狱讼、均赋役。

title: Plague of Justinian
place_zh: 君士坦丁堡（今土耳其伊斯坦布尔）
summary: The first recorded pandemic of bubonic plague struck the Mediterranean, killing a large share of the population and weakening the empire.
summary_zh: 史上第一次有记载的鼠疫大流行席卷地中海世界，人口大量死亡，削弱了东罗马帝国的复兴努力。

title: First Battle of Mangshan
summary: Western Wei backed the defector Gao Zhongmi; Gao Huan routed Yuwen Tai at Mangshan, after which Western Wei recruited Han local militias.
summary_zh: 西魏接应高仲密，宇文泰于邙山大败于高欢，此后广募关陇豪右乡兵。

title: Gu Yewang compiles the Yupian
summary: Gu Yewang completed the Yupian, a dictionary of over 16,000 characters arranged by radical, the oldest surviving regular-script dictionary.
summary_zh: 顾野王撰成《玉篇》，按部首收字一万六千余，为现存最早的楷书字典。

title: Lý Bí founds Van Xuan
summary: Lý Bí drove out the Liang governor of Jiaozhou and declared the kingdom of Van Xuan, the Early Lý dynasty.
summary_zh: 李贲赶走梁朝的交州刺史，建立万春国，史称前李朝。

title: Jia Sixie's Qimin Yaoshu
summary: A detailed farming manual covering crops, trees, animals and food processing, including early recipes for brewing.
summary_zh: 一部详尽的农书，内容涵盖作物、林木、畜牧和食品加工，包括早期的酿造方法。

title: New Songs from a Jade Terrace
summary: Xu Ling compiled the Yutai Xinyong, an anthology of love poetry that preserved 'Southeast Fly the Peacocks'.
summary_zh: 徐陵编《玉台新咏》，收汉至梁艳情诗，保存了《孔雀东南飞》等名篇。

title: Paramartha arrives in Guangzhou
summary: The Indian monk Paramartha reached Guangzhou and became one of the great translators, rendering Yogacara texts amid the chaos of Hou Jing's revolt.
summary_zh: 天竺高僧真谛抵广州，后历经战乱辗转译经，为四大译经家之一，传瑜伽行派学说。

title: Siege of Yubi
summary: Wei Xiaokuan holds the fortress of Yubi for fifty days against Gao Huan, who falls ill and dies soon after.
summary_zh: 韦孝宽坚守玉璧五十天，高欢久攻不下，忧愤成疾，不久去世。

title: Record of the Buddhist Monasteries of Luoyang
summary: Revisiting the ruined city, Yang Xuanzhi describes the great temples of Northern Wei Luoyang as they once were.
summary_zh: 杨衒之重游残破的洛阳，追记北魏洛阳城中寺院的昔日盛况。

title: Battle of Hanshan
summary: Liang sent Xiao Yuanming to support Hou Jing's defection, damming the Si to flood Pengcheng, but Murong Shaozong routed and captured him.
summary_zh: 梁武帝遣萧渊明接应侯景，于寒山筑堰灌彭城，被慕容绍宗大败，萧渊明被俘。

title: Hou Jing defects to Liang
summary: On Gao Huan's death, Hou Jing, master of thirteen provinces south of the Yellow River, offered them to Liang; Emperor Wu accepted despite warnings.
summary_zh: 高欢死，拥河南十三州的侯景叛东魏，请降于梁，梁武帝不顾劝阻纳之。

title: Hou Jing rebellion
summary: A defecting general besieges and ruins Jiankang, and Emperor Wu of Liang starves to death.
summary_zh: 降将侯景围攻并摧毁建康，梁武帝被困饿死。

title: Gao Yang founds the Northern Qi
summary: The Gao family, who already ran Eastern Wei, took the throne for themselves.
summary_zh: 早已掌控东魏的高氏家族自立为帝。

title: Yuwen Tai's fubing militia system
summary: Western Wei organizes soldier-farmer families into twenty-four armies under eight great generals.
summary_zh: 西魏把兵农合一的军户编为二十四军，由八柱国统领。

title: Chenla conquers Funan
place: Sambor Prei Kuk, Kampong Thom, Cambodia
place_zh: 三坡布雷库（今柬埔寨磅同省）
summary: Chenla, once a vassal of Funan, rose up under Bhavavarman and Mahendravarman and absorbed Funan.
summary_zh: 原为扶南属国的真腊在拔婆跋摩和摩诃因陀罗跋摩时崛起，吞并扶南，成为高棉人的主要国家。

title: Burning and decline of Teotihuacan
place_zh: 特奥蒂瓦坎（今墨西哥州）
summary: The temples and palaces along the Avenue of the Dead were burned, and the great city slowly lost its people and power.
summary_zh: 亡者大道两旁的神庙和宫殿被焚毁，这座大城此后人口和势力逐渐衰退。

title: Academy of Gondishapur
place_zh: 贡德沙普尔（今伊朗胡齐斯坦省）
summary: Under Khosrow I, scholars at Gondishapur translated Greek and Indian works and taught medicine, a tradition later passed to Baghdad.
summary_zh: 库思老一世时，贡德沙普尔的学者翻译希腊和印度著作并传授医学，这一传统后来传入巴格达。

title: Wang Sengbian holds Baling
summary: Hou Jing's advance upriver stalled at Baling, where Wang Sengbian held out; the turn of the tide led to Hou Jing's destruction.
summary_zh: 侯景西进被王僧辩阻于巴陵，久攻不下，败退，梁军转入反攻。

title: Bumin founds the Turkic Khaganate
summary: The Turks overthrow their Rouran overlords. Both Northern Qi and Northern Zhou pay them silk to stay friendly.
summary_zh: 突厥推翻柔然的统治。北齐、北周都争相向突厥送去丝绸，以求结好。

title: Western Wei conquers Sichuan
summary: Yuchi Jiong led Western Wei into Sichuan while Liang princes fought each other, taking Chengdu and shifting the balance decisively northwards.
summary_zh: 梁宗室内争，西魏遣尉迟迥入蜀，攻克成都，益州归西魏，南北实力对比大变。

title: Silla seizes the Han River basin
summary: King Jinheung broke the alliance with Baekje and took the lower Han River, gaining a direct sea route to China.
summary_zh: 新罗真兴王撕毁与百济的同盟，夺取汉江下游，获得了直通中国的海路。

title: Western Wei sacks Jiangling
summary: Western Wei took the Liang capital at Jiangling and carried tens of thousands of people north. Emperor Yuan of Liang burned his library of 140,000 scrolls before he surrendered.
summary_zh: 西魏攻陷梁朝都城江陵，把数万百姓掳往北方。梁元帝投降前焚毁了十四万卷藏书。

title: Wei Shou completes the Book of Wei
summary: Wei Shou completed the official history of Northern Wei; accused of bias, it was nicknamed the 'filthy history'.
summary_zh: 魏收撰成《魏书》，因褒贬不公被讥为“秽史”，仍为研究北魏的基本史料。

title: Western Liang puppet state
summary: After sacking Jiangling, Western Wei installed Xiao Cha as emperor of a small Liang rump state there.
summary_zh: 西魏破江陵后立萧詧为梁帝，据江陵一隅，为附庸政权，史称西梁（后梁）。

title: Chen Baxian kills Wang Sengbian
summary: Wang Sengbian accepted Northern Qi's candidate Xiao Yuanming as Liang emperor; Chen Baxian attacked from Jingkou and killed him.
summary_zh: 王僧辩迎立北齐所送萧渊明，陈霸先自京口袭石头城杀之。

title: Northern Qi builds the Great Wall
summary: Northern Qi conscripted 1.8 million men to build a long wall from Juyong Pass to Datong against Turks and Khitan.
summary_zh: 北齐征发民夫一百八十万筑长城，自幽州夏口至恒州九百余里。

title: Chen Baxian routs Northern Qi at Jiankang
summary: A Northern Qi army crossed the Yangtze to Jiankang; Chen Baxian's starving troops routed it beneath Mount Mufu, securing the south.
summary_zh: 北齐大军渡江逼建康，陈霸先于幕府山南大破之，江南得保。

title: Chen Baxian founds the Chen
summary: The general who had defeated Hou Jing took the throne. Chen was the smallest of the southern dynasties.
summary_zh: 平定侯景之乱的将领陈霸先登上帝位。陈是南朝中疆域最小的王朝。

title: Northern Zhou replaces Western Wei
summary: The Yuwen family, who already ran Western Wei, took the throne. Their state would conquer the north, and its successor Sui would unite China.
summary_zh: 早已掌控西魏的宇文氏称帝。北周后来统一北方，继承它的隋朝则统一了全国。

title: Yuwen Hu kills Emperor Xiaomin
summary: Regent Yuwen Hu deposed and killed Yuwen Jue within a year of the Zhou founding; he later poisoned Emperor Ming too.
summary_zh: 北周建立当年，宇文护废杀孝闵帝宇文觉，560年又毒杀明帝。

title: Turks and Sasanians destroy the Hephthalites
summary: The Western Turks under Istämi and the Sasanians under Khosrow I crushed the Hephthalites and divided their lands at the Amu Darya.
summary_zh: 西突厥室点密与萨珊库思老一世联手击溃嚈哒，以阿姆河为界瓜分其领土。

title: Gao Yang massacres the Yuan clan
summary: Emperor Wenxuan of Northern Qi had over 700 members of the Northern Wei imperial clan killed and their bodies thrown into the Zhang River.
summary_zh: 北齐文宣帝高洋大杀北魏宗室元氏七百余人，尸投漳水。

title: Silla conquers Daegaya
summary: Silla general Isabu destroyed Daegaya, ending the Gaya league and leaving three kingdoms on the peninsula.
summary_zh: 新罗将军异斯夫攻灭大伽倻，伽倻联盟终结，半岛形成高句丽、百济、新罗三国鼎立。

title: Caracol and Calakmul defeat Tikal
title_zh: 卡拉科尔与卡拉克穆尔击败蒂卡尔
place_zh: 卡拉科尔（今伯利兹卡约区）
summary: Caracol, allied with Calakmul, defeated Tikal, starting a long Tikal hiatus and making Calakmul the strongest Maya kingdom.
summary_zh: 卡拉科尔联合卡拉克穆尔击败蒂卡尔，蒂卡尔陷入长期沉寂，卡拉克穆尔成为最强大的玛雅王国。

title: Zhou and Turks attack Jinyang
summary: Northern Zhou and Göktürk armies attacked Northern Qi's Jinyang in deep winter but were repulsed.
summary_zh: 北周联合突厥冒雪进攻北齐晋阳，被齐军击退。

title: Northern Qi Code promulgated
summary: The Northern Qi Code fixed twelve chapters and the 'ten abominations', providing the model for Sui and Tang law.
summary_zh: 北齐颁布《北齐律》十二篇，首列“重罪十条”，为隋唐律所本。

title: Prince of Lanling at Mangshan
summary: Gao Changgong of Northern Qi breaks through the Northern Zhou siege of Luoyang with 500 cavalry.
summary_zh: 北齐兰陵王高长恭率五百骑兵冲破北周对洛阳的包围。

title: Hua Jiao's revolt against Chen
summary: Hua Jiao, governor of Xiangzhou, rebelled and called in Northern Zhou and Western Liang; Chen forces defeated them on the Yangtze.
summary_zh: 湘州刺史华皎叛陈，引北周、后梁军，陈将吴明彻、淳于量击败之。

title: Turkic princess weds Emperor Wu of Zhou
summary: After years of negotiation, the daughter of Mukan Khagan married Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou, sealing a Zhou–Turkic alliance.
summary_zh: 木杆可汗之女阿史那氏嫁北周武帝，周与突厥结盟。

title: Turks and Byzantium exchange embassies
summary: The Sogdian Maniakh led a Turkic embassy to Constantinople, and Zemarchus returned to Istämi's court, to trade silk around Persia.
summary_zh: 粟特人马尼亚克率突厥使团前往君士坦丁堡，拜占庭随后派蔡马库斯回访，双方谋求绕过波斯贩运丝绸。

title: Buddhas of Bamiyan carved
summary: Two giant standing Buddhas, 55 and 38 metres tall, were carved into the cliffs of Bamiyan, a Buddhist centre on the Silk Road.
summary_zh: 丝绸之路上的佛教中心巴米扬的崖壁上凿出两尊高55米和38米的立佛。

title: Birth of Muhammad
summary: Muhammad was born in Mecca into the Quraysh tribe, in the year Muslim tradition calls the Year of the Elephant.
summary_zh: 穆罕默德出生于麦加古莱什部落，伊斯兰传统称这一年为“象年”。

title: Emperor Wu of Zhou kills Yuwen Hu
summary: Emperor Wu struck down the overbearing regent Yuwen Hu with a jade tablet in the palace, taking personal rule.
summary_zh: 周武帝于宫中以玉笏击杀专权十余年的宇文护，开始亲政。

title: Wu Mingche's northern expedition
summary: Chen general Wu Mingche took Northern Qi's lands between the Huai and Yangtze, capturing Shouyang by damming the Fei River.
summary_zh: 陈将吴明彻北伐，堰肥水灌寿阳，尽复淮南之地。

title: Prince of Lanling forced to suicide
summary: Gao Changgong, hero of Mangshan, was sent poisoned wine by the suspicious Gao Wei.
summary_zh: 邙山之战英雄兰陵王高长恭遭后主高纬猜忌，被赐毒酒而死。

title: Emperor Wu of Zhou bans Buddhism and Daoism
summary: Northern Zhou closes monasteries, returns monks and nuns to lay life and takes temple wealth for the state.
summary_zh: 北周关闭寺观，令僧尼道士还俗，没收寺院财产充实国库。

title: Zhiyi enters Mount Tiantai
summary: Zhiyi withdrew to Mount Tiantai to meditate and systematize doctrine, founding the Tiantai school, the first indigenous Chinese Buddhist school.
summary_zh: 智顗入天台山修禅讲学，创立天台宗，为中国最早创立的佛教宗派。

title: Battle of Pingyang
summary: Emperor Wu of Zhou took Pingyang and defeated Gao Wei's relief army, opening the way to Jinyang and Ye.
summary_zh: 周武帝攻克平阳，大败北齐后主援军，进而攻取晋阳、邺城。
