summary: A judge writes the world's first systematic book on examining bodies to find the cause of death.
summary_zh: 宋慈写成世界上第一部系统的法医学著作，教官员如何验尸断案。

title: Li Ye's Sea Mirror of Circle Measurements
summary: Li Ye systematized the 'tian yuan' method of setting up polynomial equations with one unknown, a milestone of Chinese algebra.
summary_zh: 李冶著《测圆海镜》，系统阐述天元术，为中国代数学里程碑。

title: Seventh Crusade defeated at Mansurah
place_zh: 曼苏拉（今埃及达卡赫利亚省）
summary: Mamluk troops under Baybars routed the crusaders and captured Louis IX of France; the Mamluks then seized power.
summary_zh: 拜伯尔斯率马穆鲁克军击溃十字军，俘获法王路易九世，马穆鲁克随即夺取政权。

title: Konark Sun Temple
place_zh: 科纳克（今印度奥里萨邦）
summary: King Narasimhadeva I of the Eastern Gangas built a temple to the sun god shaped as a giant stone chariot.
summary_zh: 东恒伽王朝那罗辛哈一世修建太阳神庙，整体造型为一辆巨大的石雕战车。

title: Mexica arrive in the Valley of Mexico
title_zh: 墨西加人迁入墨西哥谷地
place_zh: 查普特佩克（今墨西哥城）
summary: The Mexica, migrants from Aztlan in the north, settled at Chapultepec as mercenaries and vassals of local cities.
summary_zh: 来自北方阿兹特兰的墨西加人定居查普特佩克，为当地城邦充当雇佣兵和附庸。

title: Kublai conquers the Dali Kingdom
summary: Kublai crossed the Jinsha River on inflated hides and took Dali, outflanking the Song from the southwest; Yunnan came under Mongol rule.
summary_zh: 忽必烈“革囊渡江”攻灭大理国，从西南包抄南宋，云南归入版图。

title: Hulagu founds the Ilkhanate
place_zh: 马拉盖（今伊朗东阿塞拜疆省）
summary: Hulagu, sent west by Mongke, destroyed the Ismaili castles including Alamut, took Baghdad in 1258 and founded the Ilkhanate.
summary_zh: 受蒙哥派遣西征的旭烈兀攻灭阿拉穆特等伊斯玛仪派城堡，1258年攻陷巴格达，建立伊儿汗国。

title: Kaiping (Shangdu) founded
summary: Liu Bingzhong designed the city of Kaiping for Kublai; it became the Yuan summer capital Shangdu, the Xanadu of Western legend.
summary_zh: 刘秉忠为忽必烈营建开平城，后为元上都。

title: Mongols sack Baghdad
summary: Hulagu's Mongols took Baghdad, killed the last Abbasid caliph and many inhabitants, ending the Islamic golden age in Iraq.
summary_zh: 旭烈兀率蒙古军攻陷巴格达，杀死末代阿拔斯哈里发和大批居民，伊拉克的伊斯兰黄金时代结束。

title: Saadi writes the Gulistan
place_zh: 设拉子（今伊朗法尔斯省）
summary: Saadi of Shiraz wrote the Gulistan, stories and moral lessons in prose and verse that became a classic of Persian literature.
summary_zh: 设拉子的萨迪写成散文夹诗的故事集《蔷薇园》，成为波斯文学经典。

title: First Mongol invasion of Đại Việt
summary: Uriyangkhadai invaded from Yunnan and briefly took Thăng Long, but the Trần forced the Mongols out within weeks.
summary_zh: 兀良合台自云南攻入陈朝，一度攻占升龙，旋即撤兵。

title: Siege of Diaoyu Fortress
summary: A Song mountain fortress holds out, and the Great Khan Möngke dies during the siege.
summary_zh: 南宋的钓鱼城坚守不降，蒙古大汗蒙哥死于围城期间。

title: Kublai besieges Ezhou
summary: Kublai besieged Ezhou until news of Möngke's death sent him north; Jia Sidao secretly offered terms but claimed a great victory.
summary_zh: 忽必烈围鄂州，闻蒙哥死讯北还，贾似道私下议和却诈称大捷。

title: Maragheh observatory
place_zh: 马拉盖（今伊朗东阿塞拜疆省）
summary: Nasir al-Din Tusi built an observatory for Hulagu and compiled new astronomical tables. Its methods later reached China.
summary_zh: 纳西尔丁·图西为旭烈兀建造天文台，编制新的天文表，其方法后来传到中国。

title: Bamboo 'fire-spurting lance' invented
summary: Song forces at Shouchun made a bamboo-tube weapon firing a projectile with gunpowder, considered an early ancestor of the gun.
summary_zh: 寿春府造突火枪，以巨竹为筒，内装子窠，为管形射击火器之先声。

title: Kublai becomes Great Khan
summary: Kublai claims the throne at Kaiping and fights his brother Ariq Böke for it for four years.
summary_zh: 忽必烈在开平即大汗位，此后与弟弟阿里不哥争位四年。

title: Kublai–Ariq Böke succession war
title_zh: 忽必烈与阿里不哥争位
place_zh: 哈拉和林（今蒙古国哈尔和林）
summary: Ariq Böke was proclaimed khan at Karakorum against Kublai; cut off from Chinese grain, he surrendered in 1264, but the empire fragmented.
summary_zh: 阿里不哥在和林称汗，与忽必烈争位，粮道被断，1264年投降，蒙古帝国分裂。

title: Battle of Ain Jalut
place_zh: 艾因贾鲁（今以色列耶斯列谷）
summary: The Mamluks of Egypt under Qutuz and Baybars defeated the Mongols, halting their advance into Syria and Egypt.
summary_zh: 埃及马穆鲁克军队在古突兹和拜巴尔斯率领下击败蒙古军，阻止了蒙古人向叙利亚和埃及推进。

title: Envoy Hao Jing detained by Song
summary: Kublai's envoy Hao Jing came to confirm the Ezhou terms; Jia Sidao held him for 16 years to hide the deal, later a pretext for war.
summary_zh: 忽必烈遣郝经使宋，贾似道恐私和事泄，拘之真州十六年。

title: Li Tan's rebellion
summary: The Shandong warlord Li Tan defected to Song and rose against Kublai; his defeat at Jinan led Kublai to curb the power of Han hereditary lords.
summary_zh: 山东世侯李璮叛蒙降宋，兵败济南被杀，忽必烈遂削汉人世侯兵权。

title: Jia Sidao's Public Fields Law
summary: To feed the army and curb inflation, Jia Sidao forced landowners in the lower Yangtze to sell excess land to the state, alienating the gentry.
summary_zh: 贾似道在浙西等地强买官户逾限之田为公田，以供军饷，大失士大夫之心。

title: Kublai sets up a bureau to govern Tibet
summary: The office later called the Xuanzheng Yuan runs Tibetan affairs and Buddhism, with the lama Phagpa as Imperial Preceptor.
summary_zh: 忽必烈设立管理吐蕃事务和佛教的机构，即后来的宣政院，由帝师八思巴主持。

title: Aquinas writes the Summa Theologica
title_zh: 托马斯·阿奎那《神学大全》
summary: Thomas Aquinas began his great synthesis of Christian theology and Aristotle, the summit of scholasticism.
summary_zh: 托马斯·阿奎那开始撰写《神学大全》，用亚里士多德哲学论证基督教神学，是经院哲学的高峰。

title: Construction of Dadu begins
summary: Kublai ordered a new capital built northeast of the old Jin Zhongdu, planned by Liu Bingzhong on classical principles; it became today's Beijing.
summary_zh: 忽必烈命刘秉忠在金中都东北营建新城，即大都，奠定北京城格局。

title: Mongols begin the siege of Xiangyang
summary: On the advice of Song defector Liu Zheng, Aju began encircling Xiangyang and Fancheng with forts and a new navy.
summary_zh: 蒙古采纳降将刘整之策，阿术筑堡围困襄樊，并编练水军。

title: 'Phags-pa script promulgated
summary: Kublai decreed the 'Phags-pa script, devised by the Tibetan lama 'Phags-pa, as the official alphabet for writing all languages of the empire.
summary_zh: 忽必烈颁行帝师八思巴所创新蒙古字，用以译写帝国各种语言。

title: Kurultai of Talas
place_zh: 塔剌思（今哈萨克斯坦塔拉兹）
summary: Kaidu and the Chagatayid princes met at Talas, divided Transoxiana and joined against Kublai, deepening the split of the Mongol empire.
summary_zh: 海都与察合台系诸王在塔剌思会盟，瓜分河中利益并共同对抗忽必烈，蒙古帝国分裂加深。

title: Sambyeolcho Rebellion
summary: When the court made peace with the Mongols, the Sambyeolcho troops refused and fought on from Jindo and Jeju until 1273.
summary_zh: 高丽朝廷与蒙古议和后，三别抄拒绝投降，转战珍岛和济州岛继续抗蒙，至1273年失败。

title: Solomonic dynasty founded
place_zh: 特古莱特（今埃塞俄比亚绍阿）
summary: Yekuno Amlak overthrew the Zagwe and founded the Solomonic dynasty, which claimed descent from Solomon and the Queen of Sheba and ruled Ethiopia until 1974.
summary_zh: 耶库诺·阿姆拉克推翻扎格维王朝，建立自称所罗门王与示巴女王后裔的所罗门王朝，统治埃塞俄比亚至1974年。

title: Kublai Khan proclaims the Yuan
summary: Kublai takes a Chinese dynastic name and builds a new capital at Dadu.
summary_zh: 忽必烈采用中原王朝的国号，并在大都营建新都城。

title: Mas'ud Beg's currency reform
summary: Mas'ud Beg, governor of Transoxiana, introduced a uniform silver coinage that helped the ruined oases recover.
summary_zh: 河中长官马思忽惕推行统一的银币，帮助遭战乱破坏的绿洲城市恢复商业。

title: Zhongdu renamed Dadu as capital
summary: Kublai renamed his new capital Dadu (Khanbaliq), making it the main seat of Yuan government while Shangdu served as the summer capital.
summary_zh: 忽必烈改中都为大都，定为首都，上都为夏都，实行两都巡幸。

title: Fall of Xiangyang
summary: After a six-year siege broken with counterweight trebuchets, the key Song fortress surrenders.
summary_zh: 元军围城六年，最后用配重式投石机（回回炮）打开局面，这座南宋要塞终于投降。

title: First invasion of Japan
summary: A Yuan and Korean fleet lands at Hakata Bay, fights for a day, then withdraws and is hit by a storm.
summary_zh: 元朝与高丽联军在博多湾登陆，激战一天后撤退，途中遭遇风暴。

title: Marco Polo reaches Kublai's court
summary: The Venetian's account of Yuan China shapes European ideas of Asia for centuries.
summary_zh: 这位威尼斯人对元代中国的描述，影响了此后几百年欧洲人对亚洲的想象。

title: Battle of Dingjiazhou
summary: Bayan's Yuan army routed the main Song fleet and army led by Jia Sidao on the Yangtze, after which Song resistance collapsed along the river.
summary_zh: 伯颜在丁家洲大败贾似道所率宋军主力，沿江州郡纷纷降元。

title: Jia Sidao dismissed and killed
place_zh: 漳州木绵庵（今福建漳州）
summary: Disgraced after Dingjiazhou, Jia Sidao was banished south and murdered on the road by his escort Zheng Huchen.
summary_zh: 丁家洲败后贾似道被贬，途中为押送官郑虎臣所杀于木绵庵。

title: Battle of Jiaoshan
summary: Song commanders chained their warships together at Jiaoshan; Yuan forces attacked with fire arrows and destroyed the last major Song fleet on the Yangtze.
summary_zh: 宋将张世杰等以铁索连舟于焦山，元军火攻，宋水军覆灭。

title: Yuan armies take Lin'an
summary: The Song court surrenders its capital to Bayan, and the boy emperor is taken north.
summary_zh: 南宋朝廷向元军统帅伯颜献城投降，年幼的宋恭帝被押往北方。

title: Song loyalists crown Zhao Shi at Fuzhou
summary: After Lin'an surrendered, Chen Yizhong, Zhang Shijie and Lu Xiufu enthroned the young prince Zhao Shi at Fuzhou to continue resistance.
summary_zh: 临安降元后，陈宜中、张世杰、陆秀夫等在福州拥立赵昰为帝，继续抗元。

title: Pu Shougeng surrenders Quanzhou
summary: The powerful Arab-descended trade commissioner Pu Shougeng refused the Song court refuge, massacred Song clansmen and handed Quanzhou's fleet to the Yuan.
summary_zh: 泉州提举市舶蒲寿庚拒纳宋帝，屠宋宗室，以泉州降元。

title: Yuan maritime trade offices
summary: Yuan set up maritime trade offices at Quanzhou, Qingyuan, Shanghai and Ganpu; Quanzhou (Zaitun) became one of the world's largest ports.
summary_zh: 元于泉州、庆元、上海、澉浦设市舶司，泉州“刺桐港”跻身世界大港。

title: Battle of Yamen
summary: The last Song fleet is destroyed and the boy emperor drowns. Mongol rule covers all of China.
summary_zh: 南宋最后的船队覆没，幼帝投海而死，蒙古统治了整个中国。

title: Survey of the Four Seas and Gaocheng observatory
summary: Guo Shoujing organized astronomical measurements at 27 stations from the South China Sea to Siberia and built the gnomon tower at Gaocheng.
summary_zh: 郭守敬主持四海测验，设二十七处观测点，建登封观星台。

title: Guo Shoujing's Shoushi calendar
summary: New instruments and observations across the empire produce a calendar with a year of 365.2425 days.
summary_zh: 郭守敬等人用新仪器在全国各地观测，编成以365.2425日为一年的新历法。

title: Golden age of Yuan drama
summary: Playwrights such as Guan Hanqing make zaju, a sung drama in four acts, the great art form of the age.
summary_zh: 关汉卿等剧作家使杂剧成为元代最有代表性的艺术形式。

title: Second invasion of Japan
summary: A typhoon, later called kamikaze, wrecks the Yuan fleet.
summary_zh: 一场台风摧毁了元军船队，日本人后来称之为"神风"。

title: Samguk yusa compiled
place_zh: 麟角寺（今韩国大邱军威郡）
summary: The monk Iryeon collected legends and Buddhist tales of the Three Kingdoms, including the oldest record of the Dangun myth.
summary_zh: 僧人一然编撰《三国遗事》，收录三国时期的传说和佛教故事，最早记载了檀君神话。

title: Sea transport of tax grain begins
summary: Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan first shipped southern tax grain by sea around Shandong to Zhigu near Dadu; sea transport became the lifeline of the capital.
summary_zh: 朱清、张瑄始由海道运江南漕粮至直沽，海运成为大都命脉。

title: Finance minister Ahmad assassinated
summary: Officers Wang Zhu and Gao He killed the extortionate Central Asian finance minister Ahmad Fanākatī; Kublai later posthumously condemned him.
summary_zh: 王著等刺杀专权敛财的回回大臣阿合马，忽必烈后追治其罪。

title: Wen Tianxiang is executed
summary: The captured Song chief minister refuses to serve the Yuan and is put to death in Dadu.
summary_zh: 被俘的南宋丞相文天祥拒绝投降元朝，在大都被处死。

title: Yuan invasion of Champa
summary: Sogetu's seaborne expedition took the Cham capital, but the king fled to the hills and guerrilla resistance forced the Yuan to withdraw.
summary_zh: 唆都率舟师攻占城，国王退入山中抗击，元军无功而还。

title: Second Yuan invasion of Đại Việt
summary: Prince Toghan took Thăng Long, but Trần Hưng Đạo's scorched-earth tactics and counterattacks drove the Yuan out, killing Sogetu.
summary_zh: 脱欢攻占升龙，陈兴道坚壁清野后反击，元军败退，唆都战死。

title: Branch Secretariats become provinces
summary: Yuan branch secretariats (xingsheng), first military-administrative offices, became permanent regional governments, the origin of China's provinces.
summary_zh: 元设行中书省分治各地，行省成为常设地方机构，为后世省制之源。

title: Nayan's rebellion
place_zh: 辽河流域（今内蒙古通辽）
summary: The Genghisid prince Nayan rebelled in Manchuria in league with Qaidu; the aged Kublai led the campaign himself and had Nayan executed.
summary_zh: 东道诸王乃颜联合海都反叛，忽必烈亲征平定。

title: Zhiyuan paper currency issued
summary: To combat inflation of the earlier Zhongtong notes, Sangha issued the Zhiyuan banknote at five times their value, one of history's first fiat-currency systems.
summary_zh: 为应对中统钞贬值，桑哥发行至元宝钞，一贯当中统钞五贯。

title: Mongol invasion of Burma
summary: Yuan armies advanced into Burma and the Pagan Empire collapsed into rival states.
summary_zh: 元军进入缅甸，蒲甘王朝随之瓦解，缅甸陷入长期分裂。

title: Battle of Bạch Đằng (1288)
summary: Trần Hưng Đạo planted iron-tipped stakes in the river bed and trapped the retreating Yuan fleet at low tide, ending the third Yuan invasion.
summary_zh: 陈兴道在白藤江底植木桩，乘退潮围歼元军水师，第三次征安南失败。

title: Huitong Canal links the Grand Canal north
summary: The Huitong Canal cut through western Shandong allowed boats to travel directly from Hangzhou to Dadu, creating the north-south Grand Canal used ever since.
summary_zh: 开凿会通河，使大运河由杭州直通大都，奠定京杭运河格局。

title: Guan Hanqing's Injustice to Dou E
summary: Guan Hanqing, the greatest Yuan playwright, wrote 'The Injustice to Dou E', a tragedy of a wrongly executed widow condemning corrupt officials.
summary_zh: 元曲大家关汉卿作《窦娥冤》，控诉官府黑暗，为中国古典悲剧名作。

title: Fall of Acre
summary: The Mamluks took Acre, the last major crusader city, ending the crusader states in the Holy Land.
summary_zh: 马穆鲁克攻占十字军最后一座重要城市阿卡，十字军在圣地的统治宣告结束。

title: Finance minister Sangha executed
summary: Sangha, the Tibetan-Uighur minister who had raised taxes and looted Song tombs through his ally, was executed for corruption.
summary_zh: 敛财专权、纵容杨琏真加盗掘宋陵的桑哥以贪腐被诛。

title: Federal Charter of 1291
summary: Uri, Schwyz and Unterwalden swore a pact of mutual defence, the traditional founding of Switzerland.
summary_zh: 乌里、施维茨和下瓦尔登三州结盟互助，传统上被视为瑞士联邦的建立。

title: Ramkhamhaeng Inscription
place_zh: 素可泰（今泰国素可泰府）
summary: This stone inscription praises King Ramkhamhaeng's rule and is traditionally the earliest text in the Thai script.
summary_zh: 兰甘亨碑颂扬兰甘亨国王的统治，传统上被视为最早的泰文文献，相传泰文即由他创制。

title: Founding of Majapahit
place_zh: 特罗武兰（今印度尼西亚东爪哇）
summary: Raden Wijaya used a Yuan expedition against Java to defeat his rivals, then drove the Yuan army out and founded Majapahit.
summary_zh: 罗登·威查亚借元军之力击败对手，又驱逐元军，建立满者伯夷王国。

title: Grand Canal reaches Dadu
summary: Guo Shoujing's new canal lets grain ships from the south sail right into the capital.
summary_zh: 郭守敬主持开凿的通惠河完工，南方的漕船可以直接驶入大都城内。

title: Death of Kublai Khan
summary: Kublai died aged 79; his grandson Temür (Chengzong) succeeded and ended further overseas wars against Japan and Annam.
summary_zh: 元世祖忽必烈病逝，孙铁穆耳即位为成宗，停止对日本、安南用兵。

title: Huang Daopo brings new cotton skills
summary: A woman returns from Hainan and teaches better ways to gin, spin and weave cotton, making Songjiang a textile center.
summary_zh: 黄道婆从海南回到家乡，传授先进的轧棉、纺纱、织布技术，松江由此成为棉纺织中心。

title: Model Parliament
place_zh: 威斯敏斯特（今英国伦敦）
summary: Edward I summoned nobles, clergy and representatives of counties and towns, the pattern for later English parliaments.
summary_zh: 爱德华一世召集贵族、教士以及各郡和城市代表开会，成为后来英国议会的范本。

title: Zhao Mengfu's Autumn Colors
summary: Back in his hometown, Zhao Mengfu painted the Jinan landscape for Zhou Mi in a deliberately archaic style that renewed Chinese literati painting.
summary_zh: 赵孟頫归湖州，为周密作《鹊华秋色图》，倡古意，开元代文人画风。

title: Ghazan converts to Islam
place_zh: 大不里士（今伊朗东阿塞拜疆省）
summary: Ghazan Khan made Islam the Ilkhanate's religion and, with his vizier Rashid al-Din, reformed taxes and ruled from Tabriz.
summary_zh: 合赞汗将伊斯兰教定为伊儿汗国国教，并与宰相拉施特一起改革税制，以大不里士为都。

title: Zhou Daguan visits Angkor
summary: The Yuan envoy Zhou Daguan stayed a year at Angkor and wrote A Record of Cambodia, the only eyewitness account of Angkor life.
summary_zh: 元朝使者周达观在吴哥居留一年，撰《真腊风土记》，是唯一记录吴哥社会的亲历文献。

title: Samudera Pasai adopts Islam
place_zh: 洛克肖马韦（今印度尼西亚亚齐）
summary: The tomb of Sultan Malik al-Salih marks Samudera Pasai as the first Muslim kingdom in Southeast Asia.
summary_zh: 苏丹马利克·萨利赫的墓碑表明须文答剌-巴塞是东南亚最早的伊斯兰王国。

title: Osman I founds the Ottoman state
place_zh: 瑟于特（今土耳其比莱吉克省）
summary: Osman, a Turkish chief in northwest Anatolia, began raiding Byzantine lands, founding the dynasty that would rule for six centuries.
summary_zh: 安纳托利亚西北的突厥首领奥斯曼开始攻掠拜占庭领土，开创了延续六百年的王朝。

title: Founding of the Tarascan state
place_zh: 钦聪灿（今墨西哥米却肯州）
summary: Tariácuri united the Purépecha around Lake Pátzcuaro; the Tarascan state later became the Aztecs' strongest rival.
summary_zh: 塔里亚库里统一了帕茨夸罗湖周围的普雷佩查人，塔拉斯坎国后来成为阿兹特克最强的对手。

title: Muisca gold offerings and the El Dorado ceremony
title_zh: 穆伊斯卡人与黄金国传说
place_zh: 瓜塔维塔湖（今哥伦比亚昆迪纳马卡省）
summary: The Muisca of the Colombian highlands threw gold offerings into Lake Guatavita when a new ruler took office, the origin of the El Dorado legend.
summary_zh: 哥伦比亚高原的穆伊斯卡人在新首领即位时向瓜塔维塔湖投入金器祭祀，这就是黄金国传说的由来。

title: Wang Shifu's Romance of the West Chamber
summary: Wang Shifu's five-part zaju about the lovers Zhang Sheng and Cui Yingying became the most popular love drama in Chinese theatre.
summary_zh: 王实甫作杂剧《西厢记》，歌颂自由爱情，传唱不衰。

title: Ma Zhiyuan's 'Autumn Thoughts' sanqu
summary: Ma Zhiyuan, author of 'Autumn in the Han Palace', wrote the short lyric 'Autumn Thoughts', hailed as the finest of all Yuan sanqu.
summary_zh: 马致远作《汉宫秋》及小令《天净沙·秋思》，被誉为“秋思之祖”。

title: First Estates General
summary: Philip IV summoned clergy, nobles and townsmen to back him against the pope, founding the French Estates General.
summary_zh: 法王腓力四世为对抗教皇召集教士、贵族和市民代表开会，法国三级会议由此诞生。

title: Zhu Shijie's Jade Mirror of Four Unknowns
summary: Zhu Shijie extended the tian yuan method to systems of equations in up to four unknowns and summed higher-order series, the peak of Chinese algebra.
summary_zh: 朱世杰著《四元玉鉴》，创四元术解多元高次方程组，达古代代数巅峰。

title: Alauddin Khalji's market reforms
title_zh: 阿拉丁·卡尔吉的市场改革
summary: To pay a large army against the Mongols, Alauddin fixed grain prices, raised land tax and controlled the markets of Delhi.
summary_zh: 为供养抵御蒙古的大军，阿拉丁规定粮价，提高田赋，严格管制德里市场。

title: Ma Duanlin's Wenxian Tongkao
summary: Ma Duanlin completed a 348-scroll encyclopedic history of institutions from antiquity to Song, one of the 'Three Comprehensive' works.
summary_zh: 马端临撰成三百四十八卷《文献通考》，为“三通”之一。

title: First Catholic archbishop of Khanbaliq
summary: Pope Clement V named the Franciscan John of Montecorvino archbishop of Khanbaliq, where he had built churches and baptized thousands.
summary_zh: 教皇任命方济各会士孟高维诺为汗八里大主教，他在大都建堂传教。

title: Avignon Papacy
place_zh: 阿维尼翁（今法国阿维尼翁）
summary: The popes lived at Avignon under French influence for nearly 70 years, a blow to papal prestige.
summary_zh: 教廷迁至阿维尼翁近七十年，受法国国王控制，史称“阿维尼翁之囚”，教皇威望大为下降。

title: Yuan restores the civil service exams
summary: Emperor Renzong revives the exams with Zhu Xi's commentaries as the standard; the first are held in 1315.
summary_zh: 元仁宗下诏恢复科举，以朱熹的注释为标准，1315年举行第一次考试。

title: Wang Zhen's Treatise on Agriculture
summary: Wang Zhen's Nongshu illustrated hundreds of farm tools and described his invention of rotating wooden movable type.
summary_zh: 王祯《农书》图绘农具数百种，并记其木活字与转轮排字法。

title: Dante completes the Divine Comedy
place_zh: 拉文纳（今意大利拉文纳）
summary: Dante finished his epic journey through Hell, Purgatory and Paradise, written in Italian rather than Latin.
summary_zh: 但丁完成用意大利语写成的长诗《神曲》，描写地狱、炼狱和天堂之旅，被视为文艺复兴的先声。

title: Nanpo coup kills Emperor Gegeen
summary: Conservative Mongol nobles led by Tegshi murdered the reforming emperor Shidebala and his minister Baiju near Shangdu.
summary_zh: 铁失等守旧贵族在上都附近南坡刺杀推行改革的英宗及丞相拜住。

title: Da Yuan Tongzhi law code issued
summary: Under Emperor Yingzong, Yuan compiled its laws and precedents into the Da Yuan Tongzhi, its first comprehensive legal code.
summary_zh: 英宗时编成《大元通制》颁行，为元代较完整的法典。

title: Mansa Musa's pilgrimage to Mecca
summary: Mansa Musa of Mali crossed the Sahara to Mecca with a vast retinue and so much gold that its price fell in Cairo, making Mali famous in the Islamic world and Europe.
summary_zh: 马里国王曼萨·穆萨率庞大队伍穿越撒哈拉前往麦加朝觐，携带黄金之多使开罗金价下跌，马里由此闻名伊斯兰世界和欧洲。

title: Mansa Musa passes through Cairo
title_zh: 曼萨·穆萨朝觐途经开罗
summary: The king of Mali spent so much gold in Cairo on his pilgrimage to Mecca that its value there fell for years.
summary_zh: 马里国王曼萨·穆萨朝觐途经开罗时大量花费黄金，致使当地金价多年低落。

title: Founding of Tenochtitlan
place_zh: 特诺奇蒂特兰（今墨西哥城）
summary: By tradition the Mexica saw an eagle on a cactus on an island in Lake Texcoco and founded Tenochtitlan there.
summary_zh: 据传墨西加人在特斯科科湖的小岛上看到老鹰立于仙人掌上，便在此建立特诺奇蒂特兰。

title: Ibn Battuta sets out from Tangier
summary: The Moroccan traveller began nearly thirty years of journeys across Africa and Asia as far as China.
summary_zh: 摩洛哥旅行家伊本·白图泰从丹吉尔出发，此后近三十年游历亚非，远至中国。

title: Crow Creek massacre
place_zh: 克罗溪（今美国南达科他州）
summary: Nearly 500 villagers were killed at a fortified village on the Missouri River, evidence of violent warfare before Europeans came.
summary_zh: 密苏里河畔一座设防村落近五百名居民遇害，是欧洲人到来前存在激烈战争的证据。

title: Tughlaq moves the capital to Daulatabad
title_zh: 图格鲁克迁都道拉塔巴德
place_zh: 道拉塔巴德（今印度马哈拉施特拉邦）
summary: Muhammad bin Tughluq forced Delhi's people to move to Daulatabad in the Deccan; the plan failed and was reversed.
summary_zh: 穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克强令德里居民迁往德干的道拉塔巴德，计划失败后又迁回。

title: Djinguereber Mosque built
summary: Returning from Mecca, Mansa Musa had the poet-architect al-Sahili build the great mud mosque of Timbuktu, which helped make the city a centre of learning.
summary_zh: 曼萨·穆萨朝觐归来后，命诗人兼建筑师萨赫利在廷巴克图修建大型泥砖清真寺，推动该城成为学术中心。

title: War of the Two Capitals
summary: Rival courts at Dadu and Shangdu fight over the throne. Dadu wins, and strongmen dominate the court afterwards.
summary_zh: 大都和上都两个朝廷为争夺皇位开战，大都一方获胜，此后权臣把持朝政。

title: Tughlaq's token currency
summary: Muhammad bin Tughluq issued copper and brass coins at the value of silver; forgery spread and the scheme collapsed.
summary_zh: 穆罕默德·本·图格鲁克发行与银币等值的铜币，因伪币泛滥而失败。

title: Genkō War
place_zh: 笠置山（今日本京都府笠置町）
summary: Emperor Go-Daigo plotted to overthrow the Hōjō; though exiled, his supporters fought on and brought down the shogunate.
summary_zh: 后醍醐天皇密谋倒幕，失败后被流放，但各地武士继续响应，最终推翻了镰仓幕府。

title: Fall of the Kamakura shogunate
place_zh: 镰仓（今日本神奈川县镰仓市）
summary: Nitta Yoshisada stormed Kamakura and the Hōjō leaders killed themselves, while Ashikaga Takauji took Kyoto.
summary_zh: 新田义贞攻入镰仓，北条氏一族自尽，足利尊氏攻占京都，镰仓幕府灭亡。

title: Kenmu Restoration
summary: Go-Daigo tried to restore direct imperial rule, but neglected warrior rewards and lost power to Ashikaga Takauji within three years.
summary_zh: 后醍醐天皇试图恢复天皇亲政，但忽视武士利益，不到三年即被足利尊氏推翻。

title: Bayan abolishes the civil examinations
summary: Chancellor Bayan of the Merkid, hostile to Han Chinese, suspended the civil service exams and imposed discriminatory measures.
summary_zh: 权相伯颜排斥汉人，罢废科举。

title: Death of Abu Said and break-up of the Ilkhanate
title_zh: 不赛因去世，伊儿汗国瓦解
place_zh: 苏丹尼耶（今伊朗赞詹省）
summary: Abu Said died without an heir, and the Ilkhanate split among the Jalayirids, Muzaffarids, Sarbadars and other local rulers.
summary_zh: 不赛因死后无嗣，伊儿汗国被札剌亦儿、穆扎法尔、萨尔巴达尔等地方政权瓜分。

title: Vijayanagara Empire founded
title_zh: 维查耶那加尔帝国建立
place_zh: 亨比（今印度卡纳塔克邦）
summary: The brothers Harihara and Bukka founded a Hindu empire at Vijayanagara that dominated the south for two centuries.
summary_zh: 诃里诃罗和布卡兄弟在维查耶那加尔建立印度教帝国，称雄南印度两百年。

title: Northern and Southern Courts
place_zh: 吉野（今日本奈良县吉野町）
summary: Go-Daigo fled to Yoshino and set up a rival Southern Court; two imperial lines fought until they were reunited in 1392.
summary_zh: 后醍醐天皇逃往吉野另立南朝，与京都的北朝对立近六十年，1392年南北朝统一。

title: Gajah Mada's Palapa oath
place_zh: 特罗武兰（今印度尼西亚东爪哇）
summary: The Majapahit minister Gajah Mada vowed to unite the archipelago, and Majapahit's power spread across the islands.
summary_zh: 满者伯夷宰相加查·马达立誓统一群岛，此后满者伯夷势力扩展到东南亚海岛大部分地区。

title: Hundred Years' War
summary: England and France fought over the French crown. English longbows won at Crecy (1346), but France won in the end.
summary_zh: 英法两国为争夺法国王位断续交战一百多年，英军在克雷西战役中大胜，但最终法国获胜。

title: Ashikaga Takauji founds the Muromachi shogunate
title_zh: 足利尊氏建立室町幕府
summary: Takauji was named shogun by the Northern Court; the shogunate later took its name from the Muromachi district of Kyoto.
summary_zh: 足利尊氏被北朝任命为征夷大将军，建立幕府，因后来设于京都室町而称室町幕府。

title: Plague near Lake Issyk-Kul
place_zh: 楚河流域（今吉尔吉斯斯坦）
summary: Gravestones of a Christian community in the Chu valley record deaths from pestilence in 1338-1339, an early trace of the Black Death.
summary_zh: 楚河流域景教徒墓碑记载了1338至1339年的瘟疫死亡，被认为是黑死病的早期踪迹。

title: Toghto's reforms
summary: Toghto ousted his uncle Bayan, restored the examinations, eased penalties and sponsored the official histories, a brief revival of Yuan government.
summary_zh: 脱脱逐伯颜，恢复科举，宽刑减赋，主持修史，史称“脱脱更化”。

title: Yellow River breaches at Baimao
summary: The Yellow River burst its dikes at Baimao, flooding much of Shandong and Henan for years and damaging the Grand Canal and salt works.
summary_zh: 黄河在白茅堤决口，山东、河南大片泛滥数年，运河盐场受损。

title: Histories of Liao, Jin and Song completed
summary: Under chief minister Toghto, official histories of all three earlier dynasties are finished in two years.
summary_zh: 在丞相脱脱主持下，辽、金、宋三朝正史用两年多时间全部修成。

title: Ibn Battuta visits Zaitun
summary: The Moroccan traveller Ibn Battuta landed at Zaitun (Quanzhou), describing it as one of the greatest ports in the world, before travelling north.
summary_zh: 摩洛哥旅行家伊本·白图泰抵泉州，称其为世界最大港口之一。

title: Black Death
place_zh: 墨西拿（今意大利西西里）
summary: Plague arrived by ship in Sicily and swept Europe, killing perhaps a third or more of its people.
summary_zh: 鼠疫经商船传入西西里，随后席卷欧洲，约三分之一以上的人口死亡，深刻改变了欧洲社会。

title: Bahmani Sultanate founded
place_zh: 古尔伯加（今印度卡纳塔克邦）
summary: Alauddin Bahman Shah revolted against Delhi and founded a Muslim sultanate in the Deccan, a rival of Vijayanagara.
summary_zh: 阿拉丁·巴赫曼沙反叛德里，在德干建立穆斯林苏丹国，与维查耶那加尔长期对抗。

title: Black Death strikes Egypt
summary: The plague killed perhaps a third of Egypt's people and returned many times, weakening the Mamluk economy.
summary_zh: 黑死病可能夺去埃及三分之一人口，此后多次复发，削弱了马穆鲁克王朝的经济。

title: Fang Guozhen's revolt at sea
summary: The salt trader Fang Guozhen took to the sea with a fleet, raiding the coast and disrupting the grain shipments vital to Dadu.
summary_zh: 盐贩方国珍聚众入海起事，劫掠海运漕粮，威胁大都供给。

title: Wang Dayuan's Daoyi Zhilüe
summary: After two voyages across the Indian Ocean, Wang Dayuan described about 100 foreign lands, a key source on Asian maritime trade.
summary_zh: 汪大渊两次远航后著《岛夷志略》，记海外近百国地理风物。

title: Huang Gongwang paints Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains
place_zh: 富春江（今浙江杭州富阳）
summary: The old painter finishes a long handscroll of the river landscape, one of the most admired works of Chinese art.
summary_zh: 年迈的黄公望画成描绘富春江山水的长卷，这是中国最受推崇的画作之一。

title: Zhizheng paper money reform
summary: Toghto's issue of new Zhizheng notes caused runaway inflation; paper money soon became nearly worthless and markets reverted to barter.
summary_zh: 脱脱发行至正交钞，滥发致物价飞涨，钞法崩溃。

title: Red Turban Rebellion
summary: Forced labour on the Yellow River dikes sparks a millenarian revolt across the north.
summary_zh: 朝廷征发民夫修治黄河堤防，引发了席卷北方的宗教性起义。

title: Founding of Ayutthaya
place_zh: 阿瑜陀耶（今泰国大城府）
summary: King Uthong founded Ayutthaya on an island in the Chao Phraya River; it would dominate Siam for four centuries.
summary_zh: 乌通王在湄南河的河心岛建立阿瑜陀耶城，此后四百年间称雄暹罗。

title: Jia Lu's Yellow River works
summary: Jia Lu mobilized 170,000 labourers to close the Baimao breach and restore the river; the discontented workforce helped spark the Red Turban uprising.
summary_zh: 贾鲁征发民夫十七万治河，堵塞决口；民夫聚集，成为红巾起义导火索。

title: Xu Shouhui founds Tianwan
summary: Southern Red Turbans led by Xu Shouhui and Peng Yingyu proclaimed the Tianwan state, spreading across the middle Yangtze.
summary_zh: 南方红巾军徐寿辉、彭莹玉起兵，建天完国，势及长江中游。

title: Ibn Battuta visits Mali
summary: Ibn Battuta crossed the Sahara and spent months at the court of Mansa Suleyman, leaving the best eyewitness description of the Mali Empire.
summary_zh: 伊本·白图泰穿越撒哈拉，在马里国王苏莱曼的宫廷停留数月，留下对马里帝国最详细的亲历记述。

title: Zhu Yuanzhang joins the rebels
summary: A poor former monk joins Guo Zixing's Red Turban force and soon marries his adopted daughter, the future Empress Ma.
summary_zh: 出身贫苦的游方僧朱元璋投奔郭子兴的红巾军，不久娶了郭的养女，也就是后来的马皇后。

title: Fa Ngum founds Lan Xang
summary: Fa Ngum united the Lao principalities into the kingdom of Lan Xang, the 'land of a million elephants'.
summary_zh: 法昂统一老挝各部建立澜沧王国，意为“万象之邦”，并引入上座部佛教，是老挝历史的开端。

title: Zhang Shicheng's salt workers' revolt
summary: The salt boatman Zhang Shicheng led salt workers in revolt, took Gaoyou and proclaimed the state of Great Zhou.
summary_zh: 盐贩张士诚率盐丁起事，占高邮，建大周。

title: Siege of Gaoyou
summary: Toghto's huge army was on the verge of taking Gaoyou when court intrigue had him dismissed; the army dissolved, and Yuan never recovered the initiative.
summary_zh: 脱脱率大军围高邮，垂克之际被罢，大军溃散，元朝从此无力平乱。

title: Han Lin'er proclaimed Song emperor
summary: Liu Futong enthroned Han Lin'er as 'Little Prince of Radiance' of a restored Song dynasty, rallying the northern Red Turbans.
summary_zh: 刘福通拥立韩林儿为帝，号小明王，国号宋，北方红巾军奉其正朔。

title: Hanseatic League
summary: Merchant towns led by Lubeck held their first general diet, forming a league that dominated Baltic and North Sea trade.
summary_zh: 以吕贝克为首的北德商业城市召开首次大会，汉萨同盟垄断波罗的海和北海贸易数百年。

title: King Gongmin's anti-Yuan reforms
summary: Gongmin purged pro-Yuan families, abolished the Yuan office in Korea and retook the northeast from Mongol control.
summary_zh: 恭愍王清除亲元势力，撤销征东行省理问所，收复双城总管府，摆脱元朝控制。

title: Zhu Yuanzhang takes Nanjing
summary: Zhu captures the city, renames it Yingtian and makes it his base.
summary_zh: 朱元璋攻下集庆，改名应天府，以此为根据地。

title: Golden Bull of 1356
summary: Charles IV fixed the rules for electing the emperor by seven prince-electors, confirming the empire's decentralised form.
summary_zh: 查理四世颁布金玺诏书，规定由七大选帝侯选举皇帝，确认了神圣罗马帝国诸侯分立的格局。

title: Red Turbans burn Shangdu
summary: A column of the Red Turban northern expedition captured and burned the summer capital Shangdu, then raided into Liaodong and Korea.
summary_zh: 红巾军北伐中路攻克上都，焚毁宫阙，转战辽东、高丽。

title: Poetry of Hafez
place_zh: 设拉子（今伊朗法尔斯省）
summary: Hafez of Shiraz wrote ghazals of love and wine that made him Iran's best-loved poet. His Divan is still used for fortune telling.
summary_zh: 设拉子的哈菲兹创作吟咏爱情与美酒的抒情诗，成为伊朗人最喜爱的诗人，其诗集至今仍被用来占卜。

title: Battle of Longwan
summary: Zhu Yuanzhang lured Chen Youliang's fleet into an ambush at Longwan outside Nanjing, defeating the newly proclaimed emperor of Han.
summary_zh: 朱元璋诱陈友谅至龙湾设伏，大败之。

title: Gao Ming's The Lute
summary: Gao Ming's southern drama The Lute, about the loyal wife Zhao Wuniang, was later called the ancestor of chuanqi drama.
summary_zh: 高明作南戏《琵琶记》，被誉为“南戏之祖”“传奇之祖”。

title: Yuan general Chaghan Temür assassinated
summary: The ablest Yuan commander was murdered by surrendered rebels while besieging Yidu, removing the main threat to Zhu Yuanzhang.
summary_zh: 元军统帅察罕帖木儿围益都时被降将刺杀，元廷失柱石。

title: Battle of Lake Poyang
summary: Zhu Yuanzhang defeats Chen Youliang in one of the largest naval battles in history.
summary_zh: 朱元璋在鄱阳湖击败陈友谅，这是历史上规模最大的水战之一。

title: Mun Ik-jeom brings cotton
summary: Returning from Yuan, the envoy Mun Ik-jeom brought cotton seeds home, and cotton cloth soon became common in Korea.
summary_zh: 使臣文益渐从元朝带回棉花种子，在山清试种成功，棉布从此在朝鲜半岛普及。

title: Zhu Yuanzhang proclaims himself Prince of Wu
summary: After destroying Chen Youliang, Zhu Yuanzhang took the title Prince of Wu at Yingtian, setting up a full administration.
summary_zh: 朱元璋灭陈友谅后于应天称吴王，建百官。

title: Nagarakretagama
place_zh: 特罗武兰（今印度尼西亚东爪哇）
summary: The court poet Prapanca wrote this Old Javanese poem praising King Hayam Wuruk and listing Majapahit's dependencies.
summary_zh: 宫廷诗人普腊班扎用古爪哇语写成长诗，歌颂哈奄·武禄国王，记述满者伯夷的属地。

title: Han Lin'er drowns at Guabu
summary: Being escorted to Yingtian, the Red Turban emperor Han Lin'er drowned when his boat capsized, almost certainly on Zhu Yuanzhang's orders.
summary_zh: 小明王韩林儿被迎往应天，途中于瓜步沉舟溺死。

check.n: Wikipedia says Han Lin'er died in 1367, not 1366.
check.n_zh: 维基百科称韩林儿死于1367年，而非1366年。

title: Xu Da's northern expedition
summary: Zhu Yuanzhang sent Xu Da and Chang Yuchun north with the call to 'expel the barbarians and restore China'; they took Dadu the following year.
summary_zh: 朱元璋命徐达、常遇春北伐，檄文号召“驱逐胡虏，恢复中华”，次年攻克大都。

title: Fall of Zhang Shicheng at Suzhou
summary: After a ten-month siege Zhu's army takes Suzhou and captures his last major rival in the south.
summary_zh: 经过十个月围城，朱元璋的军队攻下平江，俘获了南方最后一个强敌张士诚。

title: Zhu Yuanzhang founds the Ming
summary: The former monk becomes the Hongwu Emperor. His army takes Dadu and the Yuan court flees north.
summary_zh: 出身僧人的朱元璋登基称帝，年号洪武。明军攻占大都，元朝宫廷北逃。

title: Xu Da captures Yuan capital Dadu
summary: Ming general Xu Da took Dadu as the Yuan emperor Toghon Temür fled north, ending Mongol rule over China proper.
summary_zh: 明将徐达北伐攻入大都，元顺帝北逃，元朝在中原的统治结束。

title: Imperial kilns at Jingdezhen
summary: The early Ming set up an imperial porcelain factory at Jingdezhen, making blue-and-white ware for the court and export.
summary_zh: 明初于景德镇设御器厂，烧造宫廷与外销青花瓷。

title: Timur founds his empire
summary: Timur took power in Transoxiana at Balkh and made Samarkand the capital of an empire built by campaigns from Delhi to Anatolia.
summary_zh: 帖木儿在巴尔赫掌握河中政权，以撒马尔罕为都城，此后连年征战，建立从德里到安纳托利亚的大帝国。

title: Ming victory at Yingchang
place_zh: 应昌（今内蒙古克什克腾旗）
summary: Li Wenzhong raided Yingchang, capturing the Yuan heir's son and many nobles shortly after Toghon Temür's death.
summary_zh: 李文忠奇袭应昌，俘获元嗣君之子买的里八剌及大批宗室官员。

title: Hongwu enfeoffs his sons as princes
summary: Hongwu made his sons princes with troops in strategic cities, a system meant to guard the dynasty that later fuelled the Jingnan war.
summary_zh: 朱元璋分封诸子为王，镇守要地、掌握兵权，为日后靖难之役埋下伏笔。

title: Hongwu imposes the maritime ban
summary: The Hongwu Emperor forbade private overseas trade, restricting foreign commerce to official tribute missions; the ban shaped coastal society for two centuries.
summary_zh: 洪武帝下令片板不许入海，禁止私人出海贸易，对外交往限于朝贡，影响沿海二百年。

title: Ming conquers the Xia regime in Sichuan
summary: Tang He and Fu Youde advanced up the Yangtze and from Shaanxi, forcing Ming Sheng of the Xia regime to surrender and bringing Sichuan under Ming rule.
summary_zh: 汤和、傅友德两路入川，大夏明昇出降，四川归入明朝版图。

title: Xu Da defeated in the steppe at Lingbei
place_zh: 岭北（今蒙古国哈拉和林一带）
summary: Xu Da's deep thrust into Mongolia was routed by Köke Temür, persuading Hongwu to adopt a defensive frontier policy.
summary_zh: 徐达深入漠北，被扩廓帖木儿击败，明朝此后对北元转取守势。

title: Ryukyu begins tribute to the Ming
summary: After a Ming envoy's visit, King Satto of Chūzan sent tribute, beginning a tributary tie that lasted five centuries.
summary_zh: 明使杨载出使琉球，中山王察度遣使入贡，开启延续五百年的宗藩关系。

title: Ibn Khaldun writes the Muqaddimah
title_zh: 伊本·赫勒敦著《历史绪论》
place_zh: 伊本·萨拉马堡（今阿尔及利亚弗兰达附近）
summary: The Tunis-born scholar explained the rise and fall of dynasties through group solidarity, a founding work of sociology and history.
summary_zh: 生于突尼斯的伊本·赫勒敦以群体凝聚力解释王朝兴衰，被视为社会学和历史哲学的奠基之作。

title: Jikji printed
place_zh: 兴德寺（今韩国忠清北道清州）
summary: Heungdeoksa temple printed the Buddhist text Jikji with metal type, the oldest surviving book printed with movable metal type.
summary_zh: 清州兴德寺用金属活字印行《白云和尚抄录佛祖直指心体要节》，是现存最早的金属活字印本。

title: Hu Weiyong purge; chancellor abolished
summary: The Hongwu Emperor executes his chancellor for treason and abolishes the post, ruling the ministries directly.
summary_zh: 明太祖以谋反罪处死丞相胡惟庸，随后废除丞相制度，由皇帝直接统领六部。

title: Battle of Kulikovo
place_zh: 库利科沃原野（今俄罗斯图拉州）
summary: Dmitry Donskoy of Moscow defeated a Golden Horde army, raising Moscow's standing among the Russian lands.
summary_zh: 莫斯科大公德米特里·顿斯科伊击败金帐汗国军队，提高了莫斯科在罗斯诸公国中的地位。

title: Ming conquest of Yunnan
summary: Fu Youde, Lan Yu and Mu Ying destroyed the Yuan prince of Liang's forces; the Mu family then governed Yunnan hereditarily.
summary_zh: 傅友德、蓝玉、沐英击灭元梁王，云南归附，沐氏世镇云南。

title: Yellow Registers compiled
summary: A nationwide household census organized households into lijia units and recorded labour and tax duties, renewed every ten years.
summary_zh: 全国编造赋役黄册，推行里甲制，十年一造，登记户口与赋役。

title: Peasants' Revolt
summary: Angered by a poll tax, peasants led by Wat Tyler marched on London. The revolt failed but serfdom faded afterwards.
summary_zh: 英国农民因人头税在瓦特·泰勒率领下进军伦敦，起义失败，但农奴制此后逐渐瓦解。

title: Timur takes Herat
summary: Timur began his conquest of Iran by taking Herat. Within a few years he had subdued the whole plateau, massacring cities such as Isfahan.
summary_zh: 帖木儿攻占赫拉特，开始征服伊朗，数年内平定整个高原，伊斯法罕等城遭到屠城。

title: Embroidered Uniform Guard established
summary: Hongwu created the Jinyiwei, an imperial guard with powers to investigate, arrest and torture officials outside normal courts.
summary_zh: 朱元璋设立锦衣卫，掌侍卫、缉捕、刑狱，可直接奉旨办案。

title: Guo Huan embezzlement case
summary: A vice minister of revenue was accused of embezzling grain; tens of thousands of officials and landlords were killed in the fallout.
summary_zh: 户部侍郎郭桓被控贪污官粮，牵连处死者数万人。

title: Lan Yu's victory at Buir Lake
summary: Lan Yu surprised the Northern Yuan camp, capturing tens of thousands and breaking the power of Tögüs Temür.
summary_zh: 蓝玉率军奔袭捕鱼儿海，大破北元脱古思帖木儿，俘获数万人。

title: Wihwado Retreat
place_zh: 威化岛（今朝鲜平安北道鸭绿江中）
summary: Ordered to attack Ming Liaodong, Yi Seong-gye turned his army back at Wihwa Island and seized power in Gaegyeong.
summary_zh: 李成桂奉命进攻明朝辽东，行至威化岛时回师开京，夺取了高丽政权。

title: Battle of Kosovo
place_zh: 科索沃原野（今科索沃普里什蒂纳附近）
summary: Ottoman and Serbian armies fought a bloody battle in which both rulers died. Serbia soon became an Ottoman vassal.
summary_zh: 奥斯曼军与塞尔维亚军血战，双方君主都战死，塞尔维亚此后沦为奥斯曼附庸。

title: Kingdom of Kongo founded
summary: Lukeni lua Nimi conquered the lands south of the Congo River and founded the Kingdom of Kongo with its capital at Mbanza Kongo.
summary_zh: 卢凯尼·卢阿·尼米征服刚果河以南地区，建立刚果王国，定都姆班扎刚果。

title: Gwajeon land law
summary: Yi Seong-gye's faction burned the old land registers and gave officials rights to land tax around the capital, breaking the old aristocracy.
summary_zh: 李成桂一派焚毁旧田籍，实行科田法，按官品分给京畿土地的收租权，摧毁了旧贵族的经济基础。

title: Founding of Joseon
summary: Yi Seong-gye took the throne, and the next year Ming approved the name Joseon. The dynasty lasted over five centuries.
summary_zh: 李成桂即位，次年经明朝认可定国号为朝鲜，朝鲜王朝延续五百余年。

title: Lan Yu purge
summary: General Lan Yu was executed for alleged treason; some 15,000 people died, eliminating most surviving founding generals.
summary_zh: 大将蓝玉以谋反罪被杀，株连一万五千余人，开国功臣几被诛尽。

title: Capital moves to Hanyang
summary: Taejo moved the capital to Hanyang (Seoul) and built Gyeongbokgung palace, planned by Jeong Do-jeon.
summary_zh: 太祖迁都汉阳（今首尔），由郑道传规划修建景福宫和都城。

title: Timur defeats Tokhtamysh
place_zh: 捷列克河（今俄罗斯北高加索）
summary: Timur routed the Golden Horde khan Tokhtamysh on the Terek and then sacked Sarai, a blow the Horde never recovered from.
summary_zh: 帖木儿在捷列克河大败金帐汗脱脱迷失，随后洗劫萨莱，金帐汗国从此一蹶不振。

title: Great Ming Code promulgated
summary: After thirty years of revision, the final Great Ming Code was issued, becoming the model for Qing law.
summary_zh: 历经三十年修订，《大明律》正式颁行，后为清律所本。

title: Kinkaku-ji built
place_zh: 金阁寺（今日本京都市北区）
summary: Ashikaga Yoshimitsu built the gold-leaf Golden Pavilion in his Kitayama villa, the symbol of Kitayama culture.
summary_zh: 足利义满在北山山庄建造贴满金箔的金阁，是北山文化的代表。

title: Northern and Southern examination lists case
summary: When all successful candidates were southerners, Hongwu executed examiners and passed only northerners, leading to regional quotas.
summary_zh: 会试录取者全为南人，朱元璋杀考官、另录北士，后形成南北分卷取士。

title: Jianwen Emperor curtails the princes
summary: Advised by Qi Tai and Huang Zicheng, the new emperor stripped several uncles of their fiefs, provoking Zhu Di's revolt.
summary_zh: 建文帝用齐泰、黄子澄之策削夺诸王，激起燕王朱棣起兵。

title: Timur sacks Delhi
summary: Timur defeated the Tughluq sultan and sacked Delhi, killing many thousands and shattering the sultanate.
summary_zh: 帖木儿击败图格鲁克王朝苏丹，洗劫德里并大肆屠杀，德里苏丹国从此一蹶不振。

title: Bibi-Khanym Mosque
summary: With spoils from India, Timur began one of the largest mosques of the Islamic world in Samarkand.
summary_zh: 帖木儿用征服印度的战利品在撒马尔罕修建比比哈努姆清真寺，是当时伊斯兰世界最大的清真寺之一。

title: Founding of Malacca
place_zh: 马六甲（今马来西亚马六甲州）
summary: Parameswara, a prince from Palembang, founded Malacca, which grew into the great trading port of the straits.
summary_zh: 巨港王子拜里米苏拉建立马六甲，凭借海峡要冲成为东南亚最大的贸易港。

title: Battle of Dongchang
summary: Imperial general Sheng Yong inflicted the heaviest defeat on Zhu Di's army during the Jingnan campaign.
summary_zh: 盛庸在东昌大败燕军，燕将张玉战死，为靖难中燕军最大挫败。

title: Zeami writes on Noh theatre
summary: Under Yoshimitsu's patronage Zeami perfected Noh drama and wrote Fūshikaden, setting out its ideal of yūgen.
summary_zh: 在足利义满的扶持下，世阿弥完善了能乐，著《风姿花传》阐述以“幽玄”为核心的艺术理论。

title: Hồ Quý Ly founds the Hồ dynasty
summary: Hồ Quý Ly seized the Trần throne and carried out reforms, issuing paper money and limiting land holdings.
summary_zh: 胡季犛篡夺陈朝建立胡朝，推行发行纸币、限田限奴等改革。

title: K'iche' kingdom of Q'umarkaj
place_zh: 库马尔卡赫（今危地马拉基切省）
summary: The K'iche' Maya ruled much of highland Guatemala from Q'umarkaj; their myths were later written down in the Popol Vuh.
summary_zh: 基切玛雅人以库马尔卡赫为都，统治危地马拉高原大部，其神话后来记入《波波尔乌》。

title: Timur sacks Damascus and Baghdad
title_zh: 帖木儿洗劫大马士革和巴格达
summary: Timur took Damascus and then razed Baghdad, building towers of skulls; the region took long to recover.
summary_zh: 帖木儿攻占大马士革，又摧毁巴格达，用人头垒成高塔，这一地区很久才恢复元气。

title: Prince of Yan takes Nanjing
summary: After a three-year civil war Zhu Di overthrows his nephew and becomes the Yongle Emperor.
summary_zh: 经过三年内战，燕王朱棣推翻侄子建文帝，登基为永乐帝。

title: Grand Secretariat formed
summary: Yongle had Hanlin scholars such as Xie Jin and Yang Shiqi assist in drafting decisions, the origin of the Ming Grand Secretariat.
summary_zh: 永乐帝命解缙、杨士奇等入直文渊阁参预机务，内阁制度由此形成。

title: Battle of Ankara
summary: Timur defeated and captured Sultan Bayezid I, plunging the Ottoman state into a decade of civil war.
summary_zh: 帖木儿击败并俘虏奥斯曼苏丹巴耶济德一世，奥斯曼国家陷入长达十年的内战。

title: Execution of Fang Xiaoru
summary: The Confucian scholar refused to draft Yongle's accession edict and was executed with his kin and followers.
summary_zh: 方孝孺拒为朱棣草拟即位诏书，被杀，亲族门生遭株连。

title: Kangnido world map
title_zh: 混一疆理历代国都之图
summary: Joseon scholars made a world map covering Asia, Europe and Africa, one of the oldest surviving East Asian world maps.
summary_zh: 朝鲜学者绘制《混一疆理历代国都之图》，描绘亚洲、欧洲和非洲，是东亚现存最早的世界地图之一。

title: Tally trade with Ashikaga Japan
summary: Ashikaga Yoshimitsu accepted investiture as 'King of Japan', opening licensed tribute trade through Ningbo.
summary_zh: 足利义满受封日本国王，中日以勘合符为凭开展朝贡贸易，经宁波入贡。

title: Zheng He's first voyage
summary: The first of seven treasure fleet voyages that reach India, Arabia and East Africa.
summary_zh: 郑和率宝船队第一次出海，此后七下西洋，到达印度、阿拉伯和东非。

title: Zheng He at Calicut
summary: Zheng He's treasure fleet reached Calicut on its first voyage and returned there on every later voyage.
summary_zh: 郑和第一次下西洋即抵达古里，此后每次远航都到访此地，郑和据传也卒于古里附近。

title: Death of Timur
summary: Timur died at Otrar while setting out to invade Ming China, and was buried in the Gur-e-Amir in Samarkand.
summary_zh: 帖木儿在出征明朝途中病逝于讹答剌，葬于撒马尔罕的古尔-艾米尔陵，东征计划随之中止。

title: Construction of the Forbidden City
summary: Yongle ordered the building of a new palace complex in Beijing; finished in 1420, it housed 24 Ming and Qing emperors.
summary_zh: 永乐帝下令营建北京宫殿，1420年建成，此后为明清两代皇宫。

title: Ming conquest of Đại Ngu (Vietnam)
summary: Ming armies under Zhang Fu overthrew the Hồ dynasty and annexed Vietnam as Jiaozhi province.
summary_zh: 张辅等率军攻灭胡朝，在安南设交趾布政使司。

title: Yongle Encyclopedia completed
summary: More than 2,000 scholars compile a huge encyclopedia of over 11,000 volumes, the largest in the world for 600 years.
summary_zh: 两千多名学者编成一万一千多册的大型类书，此后六百年间一直是世界上规模最大的百科全书。

title: Nurgan Regional Commission set up
summary: Ming established a regional military commission near the Amur estuary; the eunuch Yishiha later erected the Yongning Temple steles there.
summary_zh: 明在黑龙江下游设奴儿干都司，亦失哈多次巡视并立永宁寺碑。

title: Shah Rukh rules from Herat
summary: Timur's son Shah Rukh made Herat his capital, and under him and his wife Goharshad it became a centre of Persian art and learning.
summary_zh: 帖木儿之子沙哈鲁定都赫拉特，他与王后高哈尔·沙德使赫拉特成为波斯艺术和学术中心。

title: Zheng He's fleet at Malacca
place_zh: 满剌加（今马来西亚马六甲）
summary: Zheng He's treasure fleets used Malacca as a base and the Ming recognized its ruler, protecting it from Siam.
summary_zh: 郑和船队以满剌加为中转基地，明朝册封其国王，使其摆脱暹罗控制。

title: Yongle's first Mongolian campaign
summary: Yongle personally led a huge army into Mongolia, defeating Bunyashiri on the Onon and Arughtai soon after.
summary_zh: 永乐帝亲征漠北，于斡难河击败本雅失里，继破阿鲁台。

title: Battle of Grunwald
summary: Poland and Lithuania crushed the Teutonic Knights in one of the largest battles of medieval Europe.
summary_zh: 波兰立陶宛联军大败条顿骑士团，是中世纪欧洲规模最大的会战之一，条顿骑士团从此衰落。

title: Huitong Canal reopened
summary: Song Li restored the Huitong section of the Grand Canal, after which grain went to Beijing by canal and sea transport ended.
summary_zh: 工部尚书宋礼重浚会通河，漕运全由运河北上，海运罢废。

title: Guizhou made a province
summary: After suppressing the Sizhou chieftains, Ming created Guizhou province, extending direct rule into the southwest.
summary_zh: 废思州、思南宣慰司，设贵州布政使司，贵州正式建省。

title: Chen Cheng's embassy to Herat
summary: The Ming envoy Chen Cheng reached Shah Rukh's court at Herat and wrote an account of the western lands. Herat sent embassies to Beijing in return.
summary_zh: 明朝使臣陈诚到达沙哈鲁的都城哈烈，写下《西域行程记》等书，哈烈也遣使到北京回访。

title: Malacca adopts Islam
place_zh: 马六甲（今马来西亚马六甲州）
summary: Malacca's rulers became Muslim, and the port helped spread Islam across the Malay world.
summary_zh: 马六甲统治者改信伊斯兰教，借助贸易网络使伊斯兰教传遍马来群岛。

title: Portugal captures Ceuta
summary: Portugal seized the Moroccan port of Ceuta, the first step of European overseas expansion into Africa.
summary_zh: 葡萄牙攻占摩洛哥港口休达，这是欧洲向非洲海外扩张的第一步。

title: Ulugh Beg Madrasa
place_zh: 雷吉斯坦广场（今乌兹别克斯坦撒马尔罕）
summary: Ulugh Beg built a madrasa on the Registan where astronomy and mathematics were taught alongside religion.
summary_zh: 兀鲁伯在雷吉斯坦广场建立经学院，除宗教外还讲授天文和数学，奠定了雷吉斯坦建筑群的格局。

title: Goharshad Mosque
place_zh: 马什哈德（今伊朗礼萨呼罗珊省）
summary: Queen Goharshad built a great tiled mosque beside the shrine of Imam Reza, a masterpiece of Timurid architecture.
summary_zh: 王后高哈尔·沙德在伊玛目礼萨陵旁修建大型彩砖清真寺，是帖木儿时期建筑的杰作。

title: Zheng He's fleet visits East Africa
summary: On its fifth voyage the Ming treasure fleet reached Mogadishu, Brava and Malindi, whose envoys had earlier brought a giraffe to the Chinese court.
summary_zh: 明朝郑和船队第五次下西洋时到达木骨都束、不剌哇和麻林，此前麻林使者曾向明廷进献长颈鹿。

title: Hussite Wars
summary: After Jan Hus was burned at Constance, his Czech followers rose and repeatedly defeated crusades sent against them.
summary_zh: 胡斯在康斯坦茨被处以火刑后，捷克胡斯派起义，多次击败教皇和皇帝组织的十字军。

title: Eastern Depot founded
summary: Yongle creates a secret police office run by eunuchs to spy on officials.
summary_zh: 永乐帝设立由宦官掌管的东厂，专门侦察臣民。

title: Tang Sai'er uprising
summary: A woman leader of the White Lotus rose in Shandong against heavy corvée; the revolt was crushed but she was never caught.
summary_zh: 山东女子唐赛儿以白莲教聚众起事，被镇压后不知所终。

title: Beijing becomes the capital
summary: Yongle moves the court north to his new Forbidden City.
summary_zh: 永乐帝把朝廷迁到北方，入居新建的紫禁城。

title: Yongle dies returning from campaign
summary: The emperor died on the way back from his fifth campaign against the Mongols, ending Ming offensives on the steppe.
summary_zh: 永乐帝第五次北征回师途中病逝榆木川，明朝对漠北的大规模出击告终。

title: Ming abandons Vietnam
summary: After Liu Sheng was killed in ambush by Lê Lợi's forces, Xuande withdrew Ming troops and recognized Vietnamese independence.
summary_zh: 柳升援军在支棱关中伏败死，宣德帝撤军，安南复国。

title: Ulugh Beg Observatory
summary: Ulugh Beg's observatory, with a giant meridian arc, produced the Zij-i Sultani, the most accurate star catalogue of its age.
summary_zh: 兀鲁伯建造带有巨型子午仪的天文台，编成《兀鲁伯天文表》，是当时最精确的星表。

title: Aztec Triple Alliance formed
place_zh: 特诺奇蒂特兰（今墨西哥城）
summary: Tenochtitlan, Texcoco and Tlacopan overthrew Azcapotzalco and formed the alliance that built the Aztec Empire.
summary_zh: 特诺奇蒂特兰、特斯科科和特拉科潘推翻阿斯卡波察尔科，结成三城同盟，奠定阿兹特克帝国。

title: Lê Lợi founds the Later Lê dynasty
summary: Lê Lợi became emperor and founded the Later Lê dynasty; Nguyễn Trãi's proclamation of victory became a national text.
summary_zh: 黎利称帝建立后黎朝，阮廌所作《平吴大诰》被视为越南的独立宣言。

title: Joan of Arc relieves Orleans
summary: The peasant girl Joan of Arc led French troops to lift the English siege, turning the tide of the Hundred Years' War.
summary_zh: 农家少女贞德率法军解除英军对奥尔良的围困，扭转了百年战争的局势。

title: Ryukyu Kingdom unified
place_zh: 首里（今日本冲绳县那霸市）
summary: Shō Hashi united the three kingdoms of Okinawa; the Ryukyu Kingdom grew rich as a trading hub between China, Japan and Southeast Asia.
summary_zh: 尚巴志统一冲绳三山，建立琉球王国，琉球作为中国、日本和东南亚之间的转口贸易中心而繁荣。

title: Mutapa Empire founded
place_zh: 福拉山（今津巴布韦北部）
summary: Nyatsimba Mutota moved north from the Great Zimbabwe area and founded the Mutapa state, which took over the gold trade as Great Zimbabwe declined.
summary_zh: 尼亚钦巴·穆托塔从大津巴布韦一带北迁，建立穆塔帕王国，在大津巴布韦衰落后接管黄金贸易。

title: Ayutthaya sacks Angkor
summary: Ayutthaya captured Angkor, and the Khmer court later moved south toward Phnom Penh, ending the Angkor era.
summary_zh: 阿瑜陀耶攻陷吴哥，高棉王廷随后南迁金边一带，吴哥时代结束。

title: Zheng He dies on final voyage
summary: Zheng He died during the seventh expedition; the treasure fleet returned and Ming ocean voyages ceased.
summary_zh: 郑和第七次下西洋途中卒于古里，此后明朝不再远航。

title: Brunelleschi's dome
title_zh: 佛罗伦萨大教堂穹顶落成
place_zh: 佛罗伦萨（今意大利佛罗伦萨）
summary: Filippo Brunelleschi completed the great dome of Florence Cathedral, a landmark of Renaissance engineering.
summary_zh: 布鲁内莱斯基设计的佛罗伦萨大教堂穹顶完工，是文艺复兴建筑与工程的标志。

title: Pachacuti defeats the Chanka and builds the Inca Empire
title_zh: 帕查库特克建立印加帝国
summary: After driving off a Chanka attack on Cusco, Pachacuti took the throne, rebuilt the city and began the conquests that made the Inca Empire.
summary_zh: 帕查库特克击退昌卡人对库斯科的进攻后即位，重建都城并开始扩张，建立起印加帝国。

title: Luchuan campaigns
summary: Wang Ji led repeated expeditions against the Shan state of Luchuan-Pingmian, at great cost to the treasury.
summary_zh: 王骥三征麓川思任发父子，耗费巨大。

title: Gutenberg's printing press
summary: Johannes Gutenberg developed movable metal type and the printing press, making books cheap and spreading ideas fast.
summary_zh: 古腾堡发明金属活字印刷机，书籍变得廉价，知识和思想迅速传播，推动了文艺复兴和宗教改革。

title: Ewuare the Great of Benin
summary: Oba Ewuare rebuilt Benin City with great walls and moats, reorganised its government and turned Benin into a powerful empire.
summary_zh: 贝宁国王埃瓦雷以宏大城墙和壕沟重建贝宁城，整顿政府机构，使贝宁成为强大的帝国。

title: Moctezuma I becomes emperor
place_zh: 特诺奇蒂特兰（今墨西哥城）
summary: Moctezuma I expanded the empire to the Gulf coast and Oaxaca and set up its tribute system.
summary_zh: 蒙特祖马一世把帝国扩展到墨西哥湾沿岸和瓦哈卡，建立了纳贡体系。

title: Rain gauge
summary: Under Sejong, Joseon made standard rain gauges and sent them to every province to measure rainfall.
summary_zh: 世宗时期制作测雨器并分发各地测量降雨量，建立了全国性的雨量观测制度。

title: Eunuch Wang Zhen dominates court
summary: After Grand Empress Dowager Zhang died, the eunuch Wang Zhen took control of Yingzong's court, beginning eunuch dominance.
summary_zh: 太皇太后张氏死后，宦官王振专擅朝政，开明代宦官专权之端。

title: Hunminjeongeum proclaimed
summary: King Sejong published a new alphabet, now called Hangul, so that ordinary people could read and write their own language.
summary_zh: 世宗颁布《训民正音》，创制朝鲜文字（今称韩文），使普通百姓也能读写本民族语言。

title: Deng Maoqi tenant uprising
summary: Tenant farmers and miners in Fujian rose against rent burdens and corrupt officials; the revolt spread widely before suppression.
summary_zh: 福建佃农邓茂七抗租起事，矿工叶宗留等响应，声势浩大。

title: Tumu Crisis
summary: The Oirat Mongols capture the Zhengtong Emperor. Yu Qian defends Beijing.
summary_zh: 瓦剌蒙古俘虏了明英宗，于谦率军民保卫北京。

title: Yu Qian defends Beijing
summary: After Tumu, Yu Qian enthroned the Jingtai Emperor and repelled Esen's Oirat army at the gates of Beijing.
summary_zh: 土木之变后，于谦拥立景泰帝，击退也先瓦剌军，保住京师。

title: Machu Picchu built
place_zh: 马丘比丘（今秘鲁库斯科大区）
summary: Pachacuti had an estate of fine stone temples and terraces built on a mountain ridge above the Urubamba river.
summary_zh: 帕查库特克在乌鲁班巴河上方的山脊上修建了由精美石砌神庙和梯田组成的王室庄园马丘比丘。

title: Founding of the Iroquois Confederacy
place_zh: 奥奈达加（今美国纽约州）
summary: Five nations of the Haudenosaunee joined under the Great Law of Peace, a lasting league with a shared council.
summary_zh: 豪德诺索尼五个民族依《大和平法》结盟，设立共同议事会，形成长期稳定的联盟。

title: Inca road system
summary: The Incas linked their empire with about 40,000 km of roads, rope bridges and waystations, used by runners and armies.
summary_zh: 印加人修建了约四万公里的道路网，配有吊桥和驿站，供信使和军队往来，把整个帝国连成一体。

title: Quipu record keeping
summary: Without writing, Inca officials recorded census, tribute and storehouse data on knotted cords called quipus.
summary_zh: 印加没有文字，官员用称为基普的结绳记录人口、贡赋和仓储等数字。

title: Captive Yingzong released by Oirats
summary: Esen freed the captured emperor, who returned to be confined in the Southern Palace by his brother Jingtai.
summary_zh: 瓦剌放还英宗，景泰帝尊其为太上皇，幽居南宫。

title: Kabir's poetry
place_zh: 瓦拉纳西（今印度北方邦）
summary: The weaver-poet Kabir sang of one God beyond Hindu and Muslim forms, a key voice of the Bhakti movement.
summary_zh: 织工诗人迦比尔歌颂超越印度教和伊斯兰教形式的唯一神，是虔信运动的代表人物。

title: Flower wars begin
place_zh: 特拉斯卡拉（今墨西哥特拉斯卡拉州）
summary: The Aztecs fought ritual wars with Tlaxcala and its neighbours to take captives for sacrifice, leaving Tlaxcala a bitter enemy.
summary_zh: 阿兹特克与特拉斯卡拉等邦进行仪式性战争以俘获祭品，使特拉斯卡拉成为其死敌。

title: Fall of Constantinople
place_zh: 君士坦丁堡（今土耳其伊斯坦布尔）
summary: Mehmed II's Ottoman army took the city with great cannon, ending the Byzantine Empire.
summary_zh: 奥斯曼苏丹穆罕默德二世用巨炮攻破君士坦丁堡，拜占庭帝国灭亡，城市成为奥斯曼新都。

title: Wars of the Roses
place_zh: 圣奥尔本斯（今英国赫特福德郡）
summary: The houses of Lancaster and York fought for the English throne until Henry VII founded the Tudor dynasty.
summary_zh: 兰开斯特家族与约克家族争夺英国王位，内战延续三十年，最终亨利七世建立都铎王朝。

title: Trailokanat's reforms
place_zh: 阿瑜陀耶（今泰国大城府）
summary: King Trailokanat organized Ayutthaya's government into civil and military ministries and ranked all subjects by the sakdina system.
summary_zh: 戴莱洛迦纳王将政府分为文武两部，并推行萨迪纳制度按等级分配田地，奠定暹罗行政体制。

title: Yingzong retakes the throne
summary: Generals and officials free the former captive emperor from house arrest and restore him; Yu Qian is executed.
summary_zh: 一批将领和官员把被软禁的明英宗拥上皇位，于谦随后被冤杀。

title: Sonni Ali founds the Songhai Empire
summary: Sonni Ali of Gao conquered Timbuktu and Djenne and built the Songhai Empire, the largest state in West African history.
summary_zh: 加奥的桑尼·阿里攻取廷巴克图和杰内，建立桑海帝国，这是西非历史上疆域最大的国家。

title: Founding of the Kazakh Khanate
place_zh: 楚河流域（今哈萨克斯坦）
summary: Kerei and Janibek led their followers away from Abu'l-Khayr Khan to the Chu valley, founding the Kazakh Khanate.
summary_zh: 克烈汗和贾尼别克汗率部众脱离阿布海尔汗，迁到楚河流域，建立哈萨克汗国。

title: Battle of Big Rattan Gorge
summary: Han Yong led a large army against Yao and Zhuang rebels in Guangxi's Big Rattan Gorge, killing thousands.
summary_zh: 韩雍率军进剿大藤峡瑶、壮起义，斩杀数千。

title: Ōnin War
summary: A succession dispute split the great lords into two camps; ten years of fighting burned Kyoto and began the Sengoku period.
summary_zh: 将军继嗣之争使各大名分成东西两军，混战十年，京都化为焦土，日本进入战国时代。

title: Uzun Hasan defeats the Black Sheep
title_zh: 乌尊·哈桑击败黑羊王朝
place_zh: 大不里士（今伊朗东阿塞拜疆省）
summary: Uzun Hasan of the White Sheep Turkmen killed Jahan Shah of the Black Sheep and became master of western Iran, ruling from Tabriz.
summary_zh: 白羊王朝的乌尊·哈桑击杀黑羊王朝的贾汉·沙，成为伊朗西部的主人，定都大不里士。

title: Marriage of Ferdinand and Isabella
title_zh: 斐迪南与伊莎贝拉联姻
place_zh: 巴利亚多利德（今西班牙）
summary: The marriage of the heirs of Aragon and Castile united the two crowns and created the core of Spain.
summary_zh: 阿拉贡王子斐迪南与卡斯蒂利亚公主伊莎贝拉结婚，两国此后联合，形成西班牙的核心。

title: Inca conquest of Chimor
summary: Inca armies under Topa Inca conquered the Chimú kingdom and took its metalworkers to Cusco.
summary_zh: 图帕克·印卡率印加军队征服奇穆王国，并把奇穆的金属工匠迁往库斯科。

title: Đại Việt conquers Vijaya
summary: Lê Thánh Tông took the Cham capital of Vijaya, and Champa never recovered as a major power.
summary_zh: 黎圣宗攻破占城都城阇槃，占城从此衰落，越南加快南进。

title: Rise of Demak
place_zh: 淡目（今印度尼西亚中爪哇）
summary: Demak became the first Muslim sultanate on Java and helped bring down Hindu Majapahit.
summary_zh: 淡目成为爪哇第一个伊斯兰苏丹国，推动了印度教的满者伯夷的灭亡。

title: Western Depot established
summary: Chenghua created a second secret-police agency under eunuch Wang Zhi, abolished in 1482 after protests.
summary_zh: 成化帝设西厂，由太监汪直掌管，侦缉横行，1482年撤销。

title: Great Stand on the Ugra River
place_zh: 乌格拉河（今俄罗斯卡卢加州）
summary: Ivan III's army faced down the Great Horde, which withdrew without battle, ending Mongol-Tatar rule over Russia.
summary_zh: 伊凡三世的军队与大帐汗国隔河对峙，对方不战而退，蒙古鞑靼对罗斯的统治宣告结束。

title: Inca expansion into Chile
summary: Topa Inca pushed the empire south into central Chile, where Mapuche resistance stopped it near the Maule River.
summary_zh: 图帕克·印卡把帝国疆域向南推进到智利中部，在马乌莱河一带遭到马普切人抵抗而止步。

title: Elmina Castle built
summary: The Portuguese built São Jorge da Mina on the Gold Coast to buy gold, the first European fort in sub-Saharan Africa and later a slave-trading post.
summary_zh: 葡萄牙人在黄金海岸修建圣乔治城堡收购黄金，这是撒哈拉以南第一座欧洲城堡，后来成为奴隶贸易据点。

title: Ginkaku-ji begun
place_zh: 银阁寺（今日本京都市左京区）
summary: Ashikaga Yoshimasa built his Higashiyama villa with the Silver Pavilion, centre of a culture of tea, ink painting and gardens.
summary_zh: 足利义政修建东山山庄及银阁，以茶道、水墨画、园林为代表的东山文化由此兴盛。

title: Hồng Đức Code
summary: Lê Thánh Tông's law code combined Chinese law with Vietnamese custom and gave women notable property rights.
summary_zh: 黎圣宗颁布《国朝刑律》，即洪德法典，融合中国法律与越南习俗，保障妇女财产权。

title: Navoi's Khamsa
summary: Ali-Shir Navai wrote his Khamsa in Chagatai Turkic, proving the Turkic language could rival Persian in literature.
summary_zh: 纳沃伊用察合台突厥语写成《五卷诗》，证明突厥语可以与波斯语媲美，被尊为乌兹别克文学之父。

title: Gyeongguk daejeon
summary: The Gyeongguk daejeon, Joseon's national law code, took effect and set the framework of government for four centuries.
summary_zh: 《经国大典》正式施行，成为朝鲜王朝的基本法典，奠定了此后四百年的统治体制。

title: Eight-legged essay standardised
summary: By the Chenghua reign the rigid eight-part essay format became mandatory in civil examinations.
summary_zh: 成化年间八股文格式定型，成为科举考试固定文体。

title: Templo Mayor rededicated
summary: Ahuitzotl rededicated the enlarged Great Temple to Huitzilopochtli and Tlaloc with mass sacrifices.
summary_zh: 阿维索特尔为维齐洛波奇特利和特拉洛克重新落成扩建后的大神庙，举行了大规模献祭。

title: Bartolomeu Dias rounds the Cape of Good Hope
place: Cape of Good Hope, South Africa
summary: Bartolomeu Dias sailed round the southern tip of Africa, proving that the Atlantic joined the Indian Ocean and opening the sea route to Asia.
summary_zh: 迪亚士绕过非洲南端，证明大西洋与印度洋相通，打开了通往亚洲的海路。

title: Behzad and the Herat school of painting
summary: At the court of Sultan Husayn Bayqara, the painter Behzad brought Persian miniature painting to its height.
summary_zh: 在苏丹侯赛因·拜哈拉的宫廷中，画家毕扎德把波斯细密画推向顶峰。

title: Hongzhi Restoration
summary: The Hongzhi Emperor curbed eunuchs and trusted able ministers such as Liu Jian and Li Dongyang, a period remembered as good government.
summary_zh: 弘治帝勤政节俭，任用刘健、李东阳等贤臣，史称弘治中兴。

title: Kaga Ikkō-ikki
place_zh: 加贺（今日本石川县金泽市）
summary: True Pure Land believers overthrew the governor of Kaga and ruled the province themselves for nearly a century.
summary_zh: 净土真宗信徒推翻加贺守护富樫政亲，此后由信徒自治加贺国近百年。

title: Columbus sails west
place_zh: 帕洛斯（今西班牙韦尔瓦省）
summary: Sponsored by Spain, Christopher Columbus sailed across the Atlantic and reached the Caribbean, linking Europe and the Americas.
summary_zh: 哥伦布在西班牙资助下从帕洛斯出发横渡大西洋到达加勒比海，开启了欧洲与美洲的联系。

title: Fall of Granada
place_zh: 格拉纳达（今西班牙格拉纳达）
summary: The last Muslim kingdom in Iberia surrendered to Ferdinand and Isabella, completing the Reconquista.
summary_zh: 伊比利亚最后的穆斯林政权格拉纳达向天主教双王投降，收复失地运动结束。

title: Askia Muhammad takes power in Songhai
title_zh: 阿斯基亚·穆罕默德掌权
summary: Askia Muhammad seized the Songhai throne, reorganised the empire into provinces, supported Islamic scholars and made a famous pilgrimage to Mecca.
summary_zh: 阿斯基亚·穆罕默德夺取桑海王位，把帝国划分为行省，扶持伊斯兰学者，并以朝觐麦加著称。

title: Treaty of Tordesillas
place_zh: 托德西利亚斯（今西班牙）
summary: Spain and Portugal divided newly found lands outside Europe along a line west of the Cape Verde Islands.
summary_zh: 西班牙与葡萄牙以佛得角群岛以西的一条经线划分海外势力范围，瓜分新发现的土地。

title: Italian Wars
place_zh: 那不勒斯（今意大利那不勒斯）
summary: Charles VIII of France invaded Italy to claim Naples, starting decades of war between France and the Habsburgs over Italy.
summary_zh: 法王查理八世入侵意大利争夺那不勒斯，引发法国与哈布斯堡家族争夺意大利的长期战争。

title: Vasco da Gama sails to India
summary: Da Gama left Lisbon, rounded Africa and reached India in 1498, opening a sea route for the spice trade.
summary_zh: 达·伽马从里斯本出发绕过非洲，1498年抵达印度，开辟了欧洲通往亚洲的海上香料贸易航线。

title: John Cabot reaches North America
place_zh: 博纳维斯塔（今加拿大纽芬兰）
summary: Sailing for England, John Cabot reached Newfoundland, which later gave England its claim to North America.
summary_zh: 约翰·卡伯特为英格兰航行到达纽芬兰，此后成为英国宣称拥有北美的依据。

title: Vasco da Gama reaches Calicut
place_zh: 卡帕德（今印度喀拉拉邦）
summary: The Portuguese navigator Vasco da Gama sailed around Africa to Calicut, opening the sea route from Europe to India.
summary_zh: 葡萄牙航海家达·伽马绕过非洲抵达卡利卡特，开辟了从欧洲到印度的新航路。

title: Leonardo's Last Supper
summary: Leonardo da Vinci finished his mural in a Milan convent, a masterpiece of High Renaissance composition.
summary_zh: 达·芬奇在米兰圣玛利亚感恩修道院完成壁画《最后的晚餐》，是文艺复兴盛期的杰作。

title: Vasco da Gama at Malindi
summary: Da Gama's fleet sailed up the Swahili coast, and at Malindi found a pilot who guided it across the Indian Ocean to India.
summary_zh: 达·伽马船队沿斯瓦希里海岸北上，在马林迪找到领航员，引导船队横渡印度洋抵达印度。

title: Columbus reaches the South American mainland
summary: On his third voyage Columbus sailed along the Paria peninsula and the Orinoco delta, the first European landing on the continent.
summary_zh: 哥伦布第三次航行时沿帕里亚半岛和奥里诺科河口航行，是欧洲人首次登上南美大陆。

title: Guru Nanak founds Sikhism
place_zh: 苏丹普尔洛迪（今印度旁遮普邦）
summary: After a spiritual experience, Guru Nanak began preaching one God and equality, founding Sikhism.
summary_zh: 那纳克在宗教体验后开始宣扬一神信仰和人人平等，创立锡克教。

title: Cabral reaches Brazil
place_zh: 塞古罗港（今巴西巴伊亚州）
summary: A Portuguese fleet bound for India under Pedro Álvares Cabral landed in Brazil and claimed it for Portugal.
summary_zh: 葡萄牙航海家卡布拉尔率船队前往印度途中在巴西登陆，宣布此地归葡萄牙所有。

title: Muhammad Shaybani takes Samarkand
title_zh: 昔班尼汗攻占撒马尔罕
summary: The Uzbek leader Muhammad Shaybani took Samarkand, and after defeating Babur in 1501 ended Timurid rule in Transoxiana.
summary_zh: 乌兹别克首领昔班尼汗攻占撒马尔罕，次年击败巴布尔，帖木儿王朝在河中的统治结束。

title: Benin Bronzes
summary: Guild craftsmen of the Oba cast thousands of brass plaques and heads recording court life, including the newly arrived Portuguese.
summary_zh: 贝宁国王的工匠行会铸造了数千件黄铜浮雕和头像，记录宫廷生活，其中也描绘了新到来的葡萄牙人。

title: Wu School of painting flourishes
summary: Shen Zhou, Wen Zhengming, Tang Yin and Qiu Ying made Suzhou the centre of literati painting.
summary_zh: 沈周、文徵明、唐寅、仇英等名家辈出，吴门画派兴盛。

title: Ismail I founds the Safavid dynasty
title_zh: 伊斯玛仪一世建立萨法维王朝
place_zh: 大不里士（今伊朗东阿塞拜疆省）
summary: Ismail took Tabriz, crowned himself shah and made Twelver Shia Islam the state religion, shaping Iran's identity to this day.
summary_zh: 伊斯玛仪攻占大不里士称沙，把十二伊玛目什叶派定为国教，奠定了伊朗至今的宗教特征。

title: Moctezuma II becomes emperor
place_zh: 特诺奇蒂特兰（今墨西哥城）
summary: Moctezuma II took the throne when the empire was at its largest and centralised power in the court.
summary_zh: 蒙特祖马二世在帝国疆域最大时即位，加强了宫廷集权。

title: Aztec Sun Stone carved
place_zh: 特诺奇蒂特兰（今墨西哥城）
summary: Sculptors carved the great basalt Sun Stone showing the Aztec ages of the world and the calendar signs.
summary_zh: 工匠雕刻巨大的玄武岩太阳石，刻画阿兹特克的世界纪元和历法符号。

title: Babur takes Kabul
summary: Driven from Central Asia, the Timurid prince Babur seized Kabul, the base from which he later conquered India and founded the Mughal Empire.
summary_zh: 被逐出中亚的帖木儿后裔巴布尔夺取喀布尔，后以此为基地征服印度，建立莫卧儿帝国。

title: Portuguese sack Kilwa and Mombasa
title_zh: 葡萄牙洗劫基尔瓦和蒙巴萨
summary: Francisco de Almeida's fleet attacked Kilwa and burned Mombasa to seize control of the Indian Ocean trade, starting the decline of the Swahili cities.
summary_zh: 阿尔梅达率葡萄牙舰队攻打基尔瓦、焚烧蒙巴萨，企图控制印度洋贸易，斯瓦希里城邦由此衰落。

title: Wang Yangming's enlightenment at Longchang
summary: In exile in Guizhou, Wang Yangming realizes that moral principle is found in one's own mind.
summary_zh: 被贬到贵州龙场的王阳明领悟到：道理不必向外求，就在自己心中。

title: Sistine Chapel ceiling
summary: Michelangelo painted the ceiling of the pope's chapel with scenes from Genesis over four years.
summary_zh: 米开朗琪罗用四年时间为西斯廷礼拜堂绘制以《创世记》为题材的天顶画。

title: Krishnadevaraya of Vijayanagara
title_zh: 克里希纳德瓦拉亚即位
place_zh: 亨比（今印度卡纳塔克邦）
summary: Krishnadevaraya led Vijayanagara to its height, defeating the Deccan sultans and patronising Telugu and Kannada poets.
summary_zh: 克里希纳德瓦拉亚使维查耶那加尔帝国达到鼎盛，击败德干诸苏丹，资助泰卢固语和卡纳达语诗人。

title: Afonso I of Kongo
summary: The Christian king Afonso I made Catholicism Kongo's state religion and later wrote to the king of Portugal protesting the slave trade.
summary_zh: 信奉基督教的阿方索一世定天主教为刚果国教，后来致信葡萄牙国王抗议奴隶贸易。

title: Battle of Marv
place_zh: 梅尔夫（今土库曼斯坦马雷附近）
summary: Shah Ismail I defeated and killed Muhammad Shaybani, fixing the Amu Darya as the frontier between Safavid Iran and the Uzbeks.
summary_zh: 萨法维王朝伊斯玛仪一世击杀昔班尼汗，此后阿姆河成为萨法维伊朗与乌兹别克人的大致边界。

title: Eunuch Liu Jin executed
summary: The powerful eunuch Liu Jin, leader of the 'Eight Tigers', was convicted of treason and executed by slicing.
summary_zh: 八虎之首刘瑾专权数年，以谋反罪被凌迟处死。

title: Portuguese capture Goa
summary: Afonso de Albuquerque took Goa from the Bijapur Sultanate, making it the capital of Portuguese Asia for 450 years.
summary_zh: 阿尔布克尔克从比贾布尔苏丹国手中夺取果阿，此后四百五十年为葡属亚洲首府。

title: Portuguese capture Malacca
place_zh: 马六甲（今马来西亚马六甲州）
summary: Afonso de Albuquerque took Malacca, the first European conquest in Southeast Asia, and gained control of the spice route.
summary_zh: 葡萄牙人阿尔布克尔克攻占马六甲，这是欧洲人在东南亚的第一次征服，控制了香料贸易要道。

title: Founding of the Khanate of Khiva
summary: Uzbek princes of the Arabshahid line took Khwarezm, founding the khanate later ruled from Khiva.
summary_zh: 乌兹别克阿拉布沙赫家族占领花剌子模，建立汗国，后来以希瓦为都，称希瓦汗国。

title: Machiavelli writes The Prince
place_zh: 佛罗伦萨（今意大利佛罗伦萨）
summary: Niccolo Machiavelli described how rulers gain and keep power, founding modern political thought.
summary_zh: 马基雅维利撰写《君主论》，论述君主如何获取和保持权力，开创了近代政治学。

title: Ponce de León reaches Florida
title_zh: 庞塞·德莱昂到达佛罗里达
place_zh: 佛罗里达东海岸（今美国）
summary: The Spanish explorer Juan Ponce de León landed on the coast he named La Florida, starting Spanish claims north of the Gulf.
summary_zh: 西班牙探险家庞塞·德莱昂登陆并命名佛罗里达，开启西班牙对墨西哥湾以北地区的宣称。

title: Battle of Chaldiran
place_zh: 查尔迪兰（今伊朗西阿塞拜疆省）
summary: Ottoman guns and Janissaries crushed Ismail's cavalry, fixing a long Ottoman-Safavid frontier and a Sunni-Shia divide.
summary_zh: 奥斯曼帝国的火炮和禁卫军击溃伊斯玛仪的骑兵，奥斯曼与萨法维的长期边界和逊尼派、什叶派的分野由此形成。

title: Battle of Marj Dabiq
place_zh: 达比格（今叙利亚阿勒颇省）
summary: Selim I defeated the Mamluks north of Aleppo and took Syria; the next year he conquered Egypt and won the guardianship of Mecca and Medina.
summary_zh: 塞利姆一世在阿勒颇以北击败马穆鲁克，夺取叙利亚，次年征服埃及，并成为麦加和麦地那的保护者。

title: Luther's Ninety-five Theses
title_zh: 马丁·路德发表《九十五条论纲》
summary: Martin Luther attacked the sale of indulgences, starting the Protestant Reformation.
summary_zh: 马丁·路德发表《九十五条论纲》，抨击教会出售赎罪券，揭开宗教改革的序幕。

title: Ottoman conquest of Egypt
summary: Selim I defeated the last Mamluk sultan Tuman Bay outside Cairo, and Egypt became an Ottoman province.
summary_zh: 塞利姆一世在开罗城外击败马穆鲁克末代苏丹图曼贝伊，埃及成为奥斯曼帝国的行省。

title: Portuguese embassy of Tomé Pires
summary: The first Portuguese embassy reached Guangzhou and travelled to Beijing but was rejected after Zhengde's death.
summary_zh: 葡萄牙使节皮莱资抵广州并北上，正德帝死后遭驱逐。

title: Magellan's circumnavigation
place_zh: 桑卢卡尔（今西班牙加的斯省）
summary: Magellan's Spanish fleet sailed west around the world. Magellan died on the way but one ship returned in 1522.
summary_zh: 麦哲伦率西班牙船队西行，完成人类首次环球航行。麦哲伦死于途中，1522年仅一艘船返回。

title: Cortés lands at Veracruz
title_zh: 科尔特斯登陆韦拉克鲁斯
place_zh: 韦拉克鲁斯（今墨西哥韦拉克鲁斯州）
summary: Hernán Cortés landed with about 500 men, founded Veracruz and marched inland, gaining Tlaxcala as an ally.
summary_zh: 科尔特斯率约五百人登陆，建立韦拉克鲁斯并向内陆进军，与特拉斯卡拉结盟。

title: Prince of Ning rebellion
summary: Zhu Chenhao rebelled in Jiangxi; Wang Yangming defeated him at Poyang Lake within about forty days.
summary_zh: 宁王朱宸濠在南昌起兵，王守仁四十余日即平定。

title: La Noche Triste
place_zh: 特诺奇蒂特兰（今墨西哥城）
summary: After Moctezuma's death the Aztecs drove the Spanish out of Tenochtitlan by night, killing many on the causeways.
summary_zh: 蒙特祖马死后，阿兹特克人连夜把西班牙人赶出特诺奇蒂特兰，许多人死在湖上堤道。

title: Smallpox epidemic in Mexico
place_zh: 特诺奇蒂特兰（今墨西哥城）
summary: Smallpox brought by the Spanish killed a large part of Tenochtitlan's people, including the emperor Cuitláhuac.
summary_zh: 西班牙人带来的天花夺去了特诺奇蒂特兰大批居民的生命，皇帝奎特拉瓦克也染病而死。

title: Magellan passes the Strait of Magellan
summary: Magellan's fleet found the passage at the tip of South America and sailed through it into the Pacific.
summary_zh: 麦哲伦船队在南美洲南端找到连接两大洋的海峡，穿过后进入太平洋。

title: Fall of Tenochtitlan
place_zh: 特诺奇蒂特兰（今墨西哥城）
summary: After a long siege, Cortés and his native allies took Tenochtitlan and captured Cuauhtémoc, ending the Aztec Empire.
summary_zh: 经过长期围城，科尔特斯与原住民盟军攻占特诺奇蒂特兰，俘虏夸乌特莫克，阿兹特克帝国灭亡。

title: Battle of Mactan
place_zh: 麦克坦岛（今菲律宾宿务）
summary: Magellan reached the Philippines but was killed on Mactan by the forces of the local chief Lapulapu.
summary_zh: 麦哲伦船队抵达菲律宾，在麦克坦岛被当地首领拉普拉普的部众击杀。

title: Great Rites Controversy
summary: The new Jiajing Emperor fights his officials over how to honor his own father, and has protesters flogged.
summary_zh: 嘉靖帝即位后，为如何尊奉生父与群臣激烈争执，最后下令廷杖抗议的官员。

title: Ming expels the Portuguese at Tunmen
summary: Ming naval forces drove off Portuguese ships at Tunmen, the first armed clash between China and a European power.
summary_zh: 明水师在屯门击退葡萄牙船队，为中欧首次武装冲突。

title: Romance of the Three Kingdoms printed
summary: The earliest surviving edition of Luo Guanzhong's novel, the Jiajing edition, appeared with a 1522 preface.
summary_zh: 现存最早的嘉靖本《三国志通俗演义》刊行，序署嘉靖壬午。

title: Ningbo tribute dispute
summary: Rival Japanese tribute missions fought in Ningbo, leading Ming to close the maritime trade office and fuelling piracy.
summary_zh: 日本两派贡使在宁波相互仇杀，明廷罢市舶司，倭患渐起。

title: German Peasants' War
place_zh: 米尔豪森（今德国图林根）
summary: Peasants in southern and central Germany rose against their lords, inspired in part by Thomas Muntzer. They were crushed.
summary_zh: 德意志中南部农民在闵采尔等人领导下起义反抗封建领主，最终被诸侯镇压。

title: Spanish conquest of Guatemala
place_zh: 伊希姆切（今危地马拉奇马尔特南戈省）
summary: Pedro de Alvarado defeated the K'iche' and other Maya kingdoms and began Spanish rule in Guatemala.
summary_zh: 佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多击败基切等玛雅王国，开始西班牙对危地马拉的统治。

title: First Battle of Panipat
place_zh: 帕尼帕特（今印度哈里亚纳邦）
summary: Babur used field guns and cavalry to defeat Ibrahim Lodi, ending the Delhi Sultanate and founding the Mughal Empire.
summary_zh: 巴布尔以火炮和骑兵击败易卜拉欣·洛迪，结束德里苏丹国，建立莫卧儿帝国。

title: Atlantic slave trade grows
summary: Ships began carrying captives directly from Africa to the Americas. Over three and a half centuries some 12.5 million Africans were shipped across the Atlantic.
summary_zh: 运奴船开始从非洲直接驶往美洲。此后三个半世纪中，约1250万非洲人被贩运过大西洋。

title: Iwami Ginzan silver mine developed
place_zh: 石见银山（今日本岛根县大田市）
summary: The merchant Kamiya Jutei opened Iwami Ginzan and brought in new smelting methods; Japanese silver soon flowed into China and world trade.
summary_zh: 商人神谷寿祯开发石见银山并引进灰吹法炼银，日本白银大量流入中国和世界贸易。

title: Battle of Mohacs
summary: Suleiman the Magnificent destroyed the Hungarian army and killed its king, leading to the partition of Hungary.
summary_zh: 苏莱曼大帝大败匈牙利军队，匈牙利国王战死，匈牙利此后被奥斯曼与哈布斯堡瓜分。

title: Mạc Đăng Dung seizes the throne
summary: The general Mạc Đăng Dung took the Lê throne and founded the Mạc dynasty, starting decades of civil war.
summary_zh: 权臣莫登庸篡夺黎朝皇位建立莫朝，越南陷入南北朝长期内战。

title: Smallpox kills Huayna Capac
title_zh: 瓦伊纳·卡帕克死于天花
summary: Smallpox spread from the Spanish ahead of their arrival and killed the emperor Huayna Capac and his heir, leaving the succession open.
summary_zh: 天花先于西班牙人传入，皇帝瓦伊纳·卡帕克和他指定的继承人相继病死，王位继承出现危机。

title: Ethiopian-Adal war
title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚-阿达尔战争
place_zh: 希姆布拉库雷（今埃塞俄比亚）
summary: Imam Ahmad Gragn of Adal crushed the Ethiopian army and overran the highlands, until Ethiopia with Portuguese musketeers killed him at Wayna Daga in 1543.
summary_zh: 阿达尔的伊玛目艾哈迈德·格兰击败埃塞俄比亚军队并占领高原，1543年埃塞俄比亚在葡萄牙火枪手援助下于瓦伊纳达加将其击毙。

title: Inca Civil War
summary: The half-brothers Huáscar and Atahualpa fought for the throne; Atahualpa won just as the Spanish arrived.
summary_zh: 瓦斯卡尔和阿塔瓦尔帕兄弟争夺王位，阿塔瓦尔帕获胜之时，西班牙人恰好到来。

title: Barbarossa makes Algiers an Ottoman base
place_zh: 阿尔及尔（今阿尔及利亚）
summary: Hayreddin Barbarossa took the Spanish fort of the Peñón, making Algiers the corsair capital of the Ottoman west.
summary_zh: 海雷丁·巴巴罗萨夺取西班牙控制的佩尼翁要塞，使阿尔及尔成为奥斯曼帝国西部的海盗中心。

title: Our Lady of Guadalupe
summary: Tradition holds that the Virgin Mary appeared to Juan Diego at Tepeyac; she became the patron of Mexico.
summary_zh: 据传圣母在特佩亚克向原住民胡安·迭戈显现，后来成为墨西哥的主保圣人。

title: Battle of Cajamarca
summary: Francisco Pizarro's small force ambushed Atahualpa's retinue in the plaza of Cajamarca and took the emperor prisoner.
summary_zh: 皮萨罗率少量西班牙士兵在卡哈马卡广场伏击阿塔瓦尔帕的随从，俘虏了印加皇帝。

title: Execution of Atahualpa
summary: After collecting a room full of gold and silver as ransom, Pizarro had Atahualpa executed and marched on Cusco.
summary_zh: 皮萨罗收下装满一屋的金银赎金后仍处死阿塔瓦尔帕，随后进军库斯科，印加帝国覆灭。

title: Act of Supremacy
summary: Henry VIII broke with Rome and made himself head of the Church of England.
summary_zh: 亨利八世与罗马教廷决裂，议会通过《至尊法案》，国王成为英国国教会的最高首脑。

title: Jacques Cartier explores the St. Lawrence
title_zh: 卡蒂埃探索圣劳伦斯河
place_zh: 加斯佩（今加拿大魁北克省）
summary: Jacques Cartier claimed the Gaspé for France and sailed up the St. Lawrence; the name Canada comes from the Iroquoian word he recorded.
summary_zh: 雅克·卡蒂埃在加斯佩为法国宣示主权并溯圣劳伦斯河而上，“加拿大”一名即源于他记录的易洛魁语词。

title: Suleiman takes Baghdad
title_zh: 苏莱曼一世攻占巴格达
summary: Suleiman the Magnificent took Baghdad from the Safavids, bringing Iraq under Ottoman rule.
summary_zh: 苏莱曼大帝从萨法维王朝手中夺取巴格达，伊拉克归入奥斯曼统治。

title: Viceroyalty of New Spain established
title_zh: 新西班牙总督辖区建立
summary: Spain sent Antonio de Mendoza as first viceroy, ruling Mexico, Central America and later the Philippines from Mexico City.
summary_zh: 西班牙派门多萨任首任总督，从墨西哥城统治墨西哥、中美洲，后来还包括菲律宾。

title: Founding of Lima
summary: Pizarro founded Lima on the coast as the City of Kings, which became the capital of Spanish South America.
summary_zh: 皮萨罗在沿海建立利马城，称为“诸王之城”，后来成为西属南美的统治中心。

title: Charles V captures Tunis
summary: Emperor Charles V drove Barbarossa from Tunis and restored a Hafsid client, part of the Habsburg-Ottoman struggle for the Mediterranean.
summary_zh: 查理五世把巴巴罗萨逐出突尼斯，扶立哈夫斯附庸，这是哈布斯堡与奥斯曼争夺地中海的一部分。

title: Calvin's Institutes
summary: John Calvin published his Institutes and later led Geneva, spreading Reformed Protestantism to France, the Netherlands and Scotland.
summary_zh: 加尔文发表《基督教要义》，后主持日内瓦的宗教改革，加尔文宗传播到法国、尼德兰和苏格兰。

title: Manco Inca besieges Cusco
summary: The puppet emperor Manco Inca rose against the Spanish and besieged Cusco for months, then founded a rebel state at Vilcabamba.
summary_zh: 傀儡皇帝曼科·印卡起兵反抗西班牙人，围攻库斯科数月，失败后退到比尔卡班巴建立抵抗政权。

title: Quesada conquers the Muisca and founds Bogotá
summary: Gonzalo Jiménez de Quesada conquered the Muisca highlands and founded Santa Fe de Bogotá.
summary_zh: 希门内斯·德克萨达征服穆伊斯卡人所在的高原，建立圣菲波哥大城。

title: Hernando de Soto expedition
place_zh: 马比拉（今美国亚拉巴马州）
summary: De Soto's army marched through the Southeast looking for gold, fought chiefdoms such as at Mabila, and spread disease.
summary_zh: 德索托的军队在东南部寻找黄金，在马比拉等地与当地酋邦交战，并传播了疾病。

title: First printing press in the Americas
summary: Juan Pablos set up the first printing press in the Americas in Mexico City, printing religious books in Spanish and Nahuatl.
summary_zh: 胡安·帕布洛斯在墨西哥城建立美洲第一家印刷所，用西班牙语和纳瓦特尔语印刷宗教书籍。

title: Water Margin circulates in print
summary: Printed editions of the outlaw saga attributed to Shi Nai'an circulated widely in the mid-sixteenth century.
summary_zh: 题为施耐庵所著的《水浒传》在嘉靖年间刊印流行。

title: Sher Shah Suri's reforms
place_zh: 萨萨拉姆（今印度比哈尔邦）
summary: Sher Shah drove out Humayun and reformed land revenue, built the Grand Trunk Road and issued the silver rupiya.
summary_zh: 舍尔沙驱逐胡马雍，改革田赋，修建大干道，发行银币卢比。

title: Coronado expedition
place_zh: 哈维库（今美国新墨西哥州）
summary: Francisco Vázquez de Coronado searched the Southwest and Great Plains for the fabled Seven Cities of Gold and found none.
summary_zh: 科罗纳多在西南部和大平原寻找传说中的“七座黄金城”，一无所获。

title: Valdivia founds Santiago
summary: Pedro de Valdivia founded Santiago in the central valley of Chile and began the Spanish conquest of Chile.
summary_zh: 瓦尔迪维亚在智利中部谷地建立圣地亚哥城，开始了西班牙对智利的征服。

title: Viceroyalty of Peru established
summary: Spain set up the Viceroyalty of Peru, ruled from Lima, to govern almost all of its South American lands.
summary_zh: 西班牙设立以利马为首府的秘鲁总督区，统辖几乎全部西属南美领土。

title: Orellana sails down the Amazon
title_zh: 奥雷亚纳首航亚马孙河
summary: Francisco de Orellana and his men floated the length of the Amazon to the Atlantic, the first Europeans to do so.
summary_zh: 奥雷亚纳率部顺亚马孙河而下直达大西洋，是第一批走完这条大河全程的欧洲人。

title: Copernicus publishes heliocentrism
summary: Nicolaus Copernicus argued that the Earth goes around the Sun, beginning the Scientific Revolution.
summary_zh: 哥白尼出版《天体运行论》，提出日心说，开启了近代科学革命。

title: Firearms reach Japan at Tanegashima
place_zh: 种子岛（今日本鹿儿岛县）
summary: Portuguese traders on a Chinese junk landed at Tanegashima with matchlock guns, which Japanese smiths soon copied in large numbers.
summary_zh: 搭乘中国商船的葡萄牙人漂流到种子岛，带来火绳枪，日本工匠很快仿制并大量生产，改变了战争方式。

title: Silver found at Potosí
summary: A huge silver mountain was found at Potosí; worked by forced Indian labour, it supplied much of the world's silver, much of which reached China.
summary_zh: 波托西发现巨大银矿，靠强迫印第安人劳动开采，产出的白银流向世界，其中大量流入中国。

title: Council of Trent
place_zh: 特伦托（今意大利特伦托）
summary: The Catholic Church defined its doctrine against Protestantism and reformed its clergy, the heart of the Counter-Reformation.
summary_zh: 天主教会召开特伦托会议，重申教义、整顿教士，是反宗教改革运动的核心。

title: Silver found at Zacatecas
place_zh: 萨卡特卡斯（今墨西哥萨卡特卡斯州）
summary: Rich silver lodes at Zacatecas made New Spain one of the world's largest silver producers.
summary_zh: 萨卡特卡斯发现丰富银矿，使新西班牙成为世界上最大的白银产地之一。

title: Ivan IV crowned tsar
place_zh: 莫斯科（今俄罗斯莫斯科）
summary: Ivan IV was crowned the first Tsar of All Russia and later conquered Kazan and Astrakhan.
summary_zh: 伊凡四世加冕为全俄罗斯第一位沙皇，此后征服喀山和阿斯特拉罕汗国，强化专制统治。

title: Zhu Wan destroys Shuangyu smuggling port
summary: Zhu Wan razed the smuggling base at Shuangyu used by Portuguese and Chinese traders, intensifying wokou raids.
summary_zh: 朱纨攻毁中葡走私据点双屿港，倭寇活动随之加剧。

title: Francis Xavier arrives in Japan
place_zh: 鹿儿岛（今日本鹿儿岛市）
summary: The Jesuit Francis Xavier landed at Kagoshima and began the Christian mission; within decades Japan had over 100,000 converts.
summary_zh: 耶稣会士沙勿略在鹿儿岛登陆，开始在日本传播天主教，数十年间信徒达十余万人。

title: Salvador becomes the capital of Brazil
place_zh: 萨尔瓦多（今巴西巴伊亚州）
summary: Portugal sent a governor-general and Jesuit missionaries to found Salvador as the capital of a royal colony in Brazil.
summary_zh: 葡萄牙派总督和耶稣会传教士到巴西，建立萨尔瓦多城作为殖民地首府。

title: Sugar plantations and African slavery in Brazil
title_zh: 巴西甘蔗种植园与黑奴贸易
place_zh: 奥林达（今巴西伯南布哥州）
summary: Plantations in Pernambuco and Bahia made Brazil the world's largest sugar producer, worked by millions of enslaved Africans.
summary_zh: 伯南布哥和巴伊亚的种植园使巴西成为世界最大的产糖地，依靠数百万非洲奴隶劳动。

title: Altan Khan raids the outskirts of Beijing
summary: Mongol horsemen break through the Great Wall and loot the Beijing suburbs for days while Ming troops stay inside.
summary_zh: 蒙古骑兵突破长城，在北京郊外劫掠多日，明军却闭城不战。

title: Lautaro and the Arauco War
place_zh: 图卡佩尔（今智利比奥比奥大区）
summary: The Mapuche leader Lautaro defeated and killed Pedro de Valdivia at Tucapel, starting a long war that kept southern Chile free of Spanish rule.
summary_zh: 马普切首领劳塔罗在图卡佩尔击败并杀死瓦尔迪维亚，开启了长期的阿劳科战争，智利南部长期未被西班牙控制。

title: Peace of Augsburg
place_zh: 奥格斯堡（今德国奥格斯堡）
summary: German princes won the right to choose Lutheranism or Catholicism for their lands, under the rule 'whose realm, his religion'.
summary_zh: 和约确认“教随国定”原则，德意志诸侯可自行决定领地信奉路德宗或天主教。

title: Akbar becomes emperor
place_zh: 卡拉瑙尔（今印度旁遮普邦）
summary: Akbar, aged 13, began a reign that expanded the empire and built a tolerant administration with the mansabdari system.
summary_zh: 十三岁的阿克巴即位，扩张帝国，推行曼萨布达尔制度，奉行宗教宽容政策。

title: Shaanxi earthquake
place_zh: 华州（今陕西渭南华州区）
