summary: The deadliest earthquake in recorded history kills about 830,000 people.
summary_zh: 有记载以来死亡人数最多的地震，约八十三万人遇难。

title: Portuguese settle at Macau
summary: Ming lets Portuguese traders stay, opening a door for European trade and missionaries.
summary_zh: 明朝允许葡萄牙商人在澳门居留，为欧洲贸易和传教士打开了一扇门。

title: Pirate leader Wang Zhi executed
summary: Lured by Hu Zongxian's promises, the merchant-pirate Wang Zhi surrendered and was executed.
summary_zh: 胡宗宪诱降海商首领汪直，后汪直被处斩。

check.n: Wikipedia gives Wang Zhi's death as 22 January 1560, not 1559.
check.n_zh: 维基百科称汪直死于1560年1月22日，而非1559年。

title: Battle of Okehazama
place_zh: 桶狭间（今日本爱知县名古屋市）
summary: Oda Nobunaga's small army surprised and killed Imagawa Yoshimoto, launching Nobunaga's rise.
summary_zh: 织田信长以少数兵力奇袭今川义元本阵并将其击杀，从此崛起。

title: Qi Jiguang defeats the pirates at Taizhou
summary: Qi Jiguang's newly trained army wins a string of battles against the wokou pirates raiding the coast.
summary_zh: 戚继光率领新练成的戚家军连战连捷，大败侵扰沿海的倭寇。

title: Fall of Grand Secretary Yan Song
summary: After two decades dominating Jiajing's court, Yan Song was dismissed and his son Yan Shifan later executed.
summary_zh: 专权二十年的首辅严嵩被罢，其子严世蕃后被处斩。

title: Diego de Landa burns Maya books at Maní
place_zh: 马尼（今墨西哥尤卡坦州）
summary: Friar Diego de Landa burned Maya codices and idols at Maní, destroying much of Maya written knowledge.
summary_zh: 修士迭戈·德·兰达在马尼焚烧玛雅抄本和神像，大量玛雅文字典籍因此毁灭。

title: Founding of St. Augustine
place_zh: 圣奥古斯丁（今美国佛罗里达州）
summary: Spain founded St. Augustine, the oldest continuously inhabited European town in the present United States.
summary_zh: 西班牙建立圣奥古斯丁，这是今美国境内有人连续居住的最古老欧洲人城镇。

title: Battle of Talikota
place_zh: 塔利科塔（今印度卡纳塔克邦）
summary: An alliance of Deccan sultanates crushed Vijayanagara, whose capital Hampi was sacked and abandoned.
summary_zh: 德干诸苏丹国联军大败维查耶那加尔，其都城亨比遭洗劫后被废弃。

title: Hai Rui's memorial rebukes Jiajing
summary: Hai Rui bought a coffin and submitted a memorial denouncing the emperor's neglect, and was jailed until Jiajing's death.
summary_zh: 海瑞备棺上疏直斥嘉靖帝，被下狱，嘉靖死后获释。

title: Ming lifts the ban on private sea trade
summary: Private merchants may now sail abroad from Yuegang, and silver from the Americas begins to pour in.
summary_zh: 朝廷允许私人商船从月港出海贸易，美洲白银随之大量流入。

title: Qi Jiguang rebuilds the Great Wall near Beijing
summary: Qi Jiguang takes command north of Beijing and builds over a thousand brick watchtowers on the wall.
summary_zh: 戚继光镇守蓟州，在北京以北的长城上修建了一千多座砖砌空心敌台。

title: Dutch Revolt
place_zh: 海利赫莱（今荷兰格罗宁根省）
summary: The Netherlands rose against Spanish rule under William of Orange. The Dutch Republic won independence in 1648.
summary_zh: 尼德兰在奥兰治亲王威廉领导下反抗西班牙统治，经八十年战争建立荷兰共和国，1648年获承认。

title: Oda Nobunaga enters Kyoto
summary: Nobunaga marched into Kyoto and installed Ashikaga Yoshiaki as shogun, beginning his drive to unify Japan.
summary_zh: 织田信长拥立足利义昭进入京都就任将军，开始了统一天下的进程。

title: Yi Hwang's Ten Diagrams
place_zh: 陶山书院（今韩国庆尚北道安东）
summary: The leading Neo-Confucian Yi Hwang presented the young King Seonjo with the Ten Diagrams on Sage Learning.
summary_zh: 朝鲜理学大家李滉向宣祖进献《圣学十图》，阐述朱子学思想，影响深远。

title: Toungoo captures Ayutthaya
place_zh: 阿瑜陀耶（今泰国大城府）
summary: King Bayinnaung of Toungoo, ruler of the largest empire in Southeast Asian history, captured Ayutthaya and made Siam a vassal.
summary_zh: 东吁王朝莽应龙建立东南亚史上最大的帝国，攻陷阿瑜陀耶，使暹罗沦为属国。

title: Spanish found Manila
summary: Miguel López de Legazpi made Manila the capital of the Spanish Philippines, which Spain would rule for over three centuries.
summary_zh: 黎牙实比在马尼拉建立西属菲律宾首府，西班牙此后统治菲律宾三百多年。

title: Peace and trade with Altan Khan
summary: The Ming names Altan Khan a prince and opens border markets, ending decades of raids.
summary_zh: 明朝封俺答汗为顺义王，开放边境互市，结束了数十年的战乱。

title: Battle of Lepanto
summary: The fleet of the Holy League defeated the Ottoman navy in the largest galley battle in history.
summary_zh: 西班牙、威尼斯等组成的神圣同盟舰队大败奥斯曼海军，是历史上规模最大的桨帆船海战。

title: Nagasaki opened to Portuguese trade
summary: The Christian lord Ōmura Sumitada opened Nagasaki to Portuguese ships; it became Japan's main port for foreign trade.
summary_zh: 信奉天主教的大名大村纯忠向葡萄牙商船开放长崎，长崎成为日本对外贸易的主要港口。

title: Toledo's reforms and the end of Vilcabamba
summary: Viceroy Francisco de Toledo executed the last Inca Túpac Amaru, resettled Indians into towns and organised the mita forced labour for Potosí.
summary_zh: 总督托莱多处死最后一位印加君主图帕克·阿马鲁，把印第安人集中到新建村镇，并把米塔强制劳役制度化。

title: Zhang Juzheng's reforms
summary: As senior grand secretary for the young Wanli Emperor, Zhang Juzheng enforced official accountability, restored finances and strengthened frontiers.
summary_zh: 张居正辅佐幼年万历帝，推行考成法、整顿财政、巩固边防。

title: Manila galleons bring American silver
summary: Spanish galleons began shipping Mexican silver to Manila to buy Chinese silk and porcelain, making China the sink of world silver.
summary_zh: 西班牙大帆船将美洲白银运至马尼拉换取中国丝瓷，白银大量流入中国。

title: Fall of the Muromachi shogunate
summary: Nobunaga drove the last Ashikaga shogun, Yoshiaki, out of Kyoto, ending the Muromachi shogunate.
summary_zh: 织田信长将末代将军足利义昭逐出京都，室町幕府灭亡。

title: Tulsidas writes the Ramcharitmanas
title_zh: 杜勒西达斯著《罗摩功行之湖》
place_zh: 瓦拉纳西（今印度北方邦）
summary: Tulsidas retold the Ramayana in Awadhi Hindi, making it the most beloved devotional book of northern India.
summary_zh: 杜勒西达斯用阿瓦德印地语重述《罗摩衍那》，成为北印度最受喜爱的宗教文学。

title: Battle of Nagashino
place_zh: 长篠（今日本爱知县新城市）
summary: Massed Oda and Tokugawa musketeers behind fences shattered the cavalry of Takeda Katsuyori.
summary_zh: 织田、德川联军在栅栏后集中使用火枪，大败武田胜赖的骑兵，显示了火器的威力。

title: Li Shizhen completes the Compendium of Materia Medica
summary: After 27 years of work, a doctor finishes a book describing about 1,900 medicines.
summary_zh: 医生李时珍历时二十七年，写成记载约一千九百种药物的巨著。

title: Pan Jixun controls the Yellow River
summary: Pan Jixun applied 'confining the river to scour the silt', rebuilding dikes at the Yellow-Huai confluence.
summary_zh: 潘季驯以束水攻沙之法治理黄淮，修筑大堤。

title: Battle of Alcacer Quibir
summary: The Saadians crushed a Portuguese invasion; King Sebastian died, leading to Portugal's union with Spain.
summary_zh: 萨阿德王朝击败葡萄牙入侵，葡王塞巴斯蒂昂阵亡，葡萄牙随后与西班牙合并。

title: Nationwide land survey
summary: Zhang Juzheng ordered a re-measurement of all taxable land, uncovering large hidden holdings.
summary_zh: 张居正下令全国清丈田亩，查出大量隐匿田地。

title: Single Whip tax reform
summary: Zhang Juzheng extends a reform that merges land tax and labor service into one payment in silver.
summary_zh: 张居正在全国推行一条鞭法，把田赋和徭役合并，折成白银征收。

title: Honnō-ji Incident
summary: Nobunaga's general Akechi Mitsuhide attacked him at Honnō-ji, where Nobunaga died; Toyotomi Hideyoshi defeated Akechi days later.
summary_zh: 织田信长的部将明智光秀在本能寺发动兵变，信长自尽，丰臣秀吉随即击败明智光秀。

title: Taikō land survey
summary: Hideyoshi surveyed all farmland in standard units and recorded who farmed it, fixing taxes in rice for centuries.
summary_zh: 丰臣秀吉以统一标准丈量全国耕地，登记耕作者，以石高确定年贡，奠定了近世的土地和税收制度。

title: Zhang Juzheng dies; reforms reversed
summary: After his death Zhang was posthumously disgraced and his family property confiscated, and many reforms lapsed.
summary_zh: 张居正死后被抄家夺谥，新政多被废止。

title: Akbar's Din-i Ilahi
place_zh: 法特普尔西克里（今印度北方邦）
summary: After debates among scholars of many faiths, Akbar promoted a syncretic creed of his own, which faded after his death.
summary_zh: 阿克巴在召集各宗教学者辩论后倡导融合各教的“神圣宗教”，他死后即消失。

title: Zhu Zaiyu defines equal temperament
summary: The Ming prince Zhu Zaiyu calculated twelve-tone equal temperament with high precision.
summary_zh: 明宗室朱载堉精确计算出十二平均律。

title: Dispute over the heir
summary: Officials fought Wanli for fifteen years over naming his eldest son heir; the emperor retreated from court business.
summary_zh: 群臣与万历帝围绕立太子争执十五年，万历帝怠政不朝。

title: Roanoke Colony
place_zh: 罗阿诺克岛（今美国北卡罗来纳州）
summary: England's first attempt at a colony in America vanished by 1590, leaving only the word Croatoan carved on a post.
summary_zh: 英格兰在美洲的首次殖民尝试到1590年时已人去屋空，只在木桩上留下“克罗阿通”一词。

title: Defeat of the Spanish Armada
place_zh: 格拉沃利讷（今法国北部）
summary: England defeated Philip II's great fleet, and storms wrecked much of the rest. English sea power rose.
summary_zh: 英国海军在格拉沃利讷海战中击败西班牙无敌舰队，残余舰船又遇风暴，英国海上力量崛起。

title: Sword hunt
summary: Hideyoshi ordered farmers to hand over their weapons, separating warriors from peasants.
summary_zh: 丰臣秀吉下令收缴农民的刀枪等武器，使兵农分离，身份制度固定下来。

title: Siege of Odawara and unification of Japan
place_zh: 小田原（今日本神奈川县小田原市）
summary: Hideyoshi took Odawara from the Hōjō and the northern lords submitted, completing the unification of Japan.
summary_zh: 丰臣秀吉攻陷北条氏的小田原城，东北大名相继臣服，日本重归统一。

title: Battle of Tondibi
place_zh: 通迪比（今马里加奥附近）
summary: A Moroccan army with firearms crossed the Sahara and routed the Songhai, ending the last great Sahelian empire.
summary_zh: 摩洛哥军队携火器穿越撒哈拉，击溃桑海军队，萨赫勒最后一个大帝国就此瓦解。

title: Fakhr al-Din II of Mount Lebanon
title_zh: 法赫尔丁二世统治黎巴嫩山
summary: The Druze emir Fakhr al-Din II built a near-independent principality in Lebanon and traded with Tuscany until the Ottomans crushed him.
summary_zh: 德鲁兹派埃米尔法赫尔丁二世在黎巴嫩建立近乎独立的公国，并与托斯卡纳通商，最终被奥斯曼镇压。

title: Death of Sen no Rikyū
summary: Sen no Rikyū, who perfected the wabi style of tea ceremony, was ordered by Hideyoshi to kill himself.
summary_zh: 完善了“侘茶”茶道的千利休被丰臣秀吉命令切腹，其茶道思想由后人传承。

title: Japanese invasions of Korea
place_zh: 名护屋城（今日本佐贺县唐津市）
summary: Hideyoshi sent armies from Nagoya Castle to conquer Korea and Ming; Korean and Ming forces resisted and Japan withdrew after his death.
summary_zh: 丰臣秀吉从名护屋城出兵侵略朝鲜，企图进攻明朝，朝鲜与明朝联军抵抗，秀吉死后日军撤退。

title: Journey to the West published
summary: A Nanjing printer publishes the novel about the monk Xuanzang and the Monkey King.
summary_zh: 南京书坊刊行了讲述唐僧和孙悟空取经故事的小说《西游记》。

title: Ningxia campaign against Bobai
summary: Li Rusong and others besieged and flooded Ningxia to crush the mutiny of Bobai, first of Wanli's three great campaigns.
summary_zh: 李如松等水灌宁夏城，平定哱拜叛乱，为万历三大征之一。

title: Battle of Hansan Island
place_zh: 闲山岛（今韩国庆尚南道统营）
summary: Admiral Yi Sun-sin's fleet, with turtle ships, destroyed a Japanese fleet off Hansan Island and cut Japanese supply lines by sea.
summary_zh: 李舜臣率领包括龟船在内的水军在闲山岛大败日本水军，切断了日军的海上补给线。

title: Ming relieves Pyongyang
summary: Ming armies join Korea against Hideyoshi's invasion of Joseon.
summary_zh: 明军入朝，与朝鲜一道抗击丰臣秀吉的侵略。

title: Naresuan's elephant duel
place_zh: 农沙莱（今泰国素攀武里府）
summary: King Naresuan killed the Burmese crown prince in an elephant duel, securing Siam's independence from Burma.
summary_zh: 纳黎萱王在象战中击杀缅甸王储，使暹罗摆脱缅甸控制，被泰国尊为大帝。

title: Wanli's mining and commercial tax eunuchs
summary: Wanli sent eunuchs to collect mining and commercial taxes across the provinces, provoking urban riots.
summary_zh: 万历帝派宦官四出征收矿税商税，激起各地民变。

title: Battle of Myeongnyang
place_zh: 鸣梁海峡（今韩国全罗南道珍岛）
summary: With only thirteen ships, Yi Sun-sin used the strong currents of the Myeongnyang Strait to defeat a far larger Japanese fleet.
summary_zh: 李舜臣仅率十三艘战船，利用鸣梁海峡的急流击败数量远超己方的日本水军。

title: Shah Abbas moves the capital to Isfahan
title_zh: 阿拔斯一世迁都伊斯法罕
summary: Abbas I made Isfahan his capital and built the vast Naqsh-e Jahan Square with its mosques and palace. Persians said Isfahan was half the world.
summary_zh: 阿拔斯一世迁都伊斯法罕，修建宏大的伊玛目广场及清真寺和宫殿，波斯人称“伊斯法罕半天下”。

title: Battle of Noryang
summary: The Ming-Korean fleet destroyed withdrawing Japanese ships; Yi Sun-sin and Ming commander Deng Zilong were both killed.
summary_zh: 中朝水师在露梁海截击撤退日军，李舜臣、邓子龙战死。

title: Edict of Nantes
summary: Henry IV granted the Protestant Huguenots freedom of worship, ending the French Wars of Religion.
summary_zh: 法王亨利四世颁布南特敕令，给予胡格诺派信仰自由，结束了法国宗教战争。

title: Tang Xianzu's The Peony Pavilion
summary: A playwright finishes a romantic drama about a girl who dies of love and comes back to life.
summary_zh: 汤显祖写成《牡丹亭》，讲述少女杜丽娘因情而死、又为情复生的故事。

title: Bozhou campaign against Yang Yinglong
summary: Li Hualong led 240,000 men to destroy the hereditary chieftain Yang Yinglong, ending 700 years of Yang rule.
summary_zh: 李化龙统兵二十余万平定播州杨应龙，结束杨氏七百年统治。

title: Battle of Sekigahara
place_zh: 关原（今日本岐阜县关原町）
summary: Tokugawa Ieyasu's Eastern Army defeated the Western Army of Ishida Mitsunari, giving Ieyasu control of Japan.
summary_zh: 德川家康率领的东军击败石田三成的西军，德川家康掌握了天下大权。

title: Shakespeare's Hamlet
summary: William Shakespeare wrote Hamlet for the Globe Theatre, the best-known tragedy in the English language.
summary_zh: 莎士比亚为环球剧场创作悲剧《哈姆雷特》，是英语文学中最著名的戏剧之一。

title: Mocha and the coffee trade
summary: Coffee grown in Yemen's highlands was shipped from Mocha, which held a world monopoly on coffee for over a century.
summary_zh: 也门山区种植的咖啡从摩卡港运出，此港垄断世界咖啡贸易达一百多年。

title: Matteo Ricci reaches Beijing
summary: The Jesuit brings clocks, maps and mathematics to the Wanli court.
summary_zh: 这位耶稣会士把自鸣钟、世界地图和数学知识带到了万历朝廷。

title: Ricci's world map printed
summary: Matteo Ricci and Li Zhizao printed a large world map introducing China to the Americas and modern geography.
summary_zh: 利玛窦与李之藻刊印《坤舆万国全图》，介绍五大洲知识。

title: Dutch East India Company founded
place_zh: 阿姆斯特丹（今荷兰阿姆斯特丹）
summary: The VOC, the first company to issue tradable shares, dominated the Asian spice trade for two centuries.
summary_zh: 荷兰东印度公司成立，最早公开发行可交易股票，此后两百年主导亚洲香料贸易。

title: Li Zhi dies in prison
summary: The iconoclastic thinker Li Zhi, accused of heresy, took his own life in jail.
summary_zh: 异端思想家李贽被以惑世诬民下狱，自刎而死。

title: Tokugawa Ieyasu founds the Edo shogunate
title_zh: 德川家康建立江户幕府
summary: Ieyasu was named shogun and ruled from Edo; the Tokugawa shogunate kept peace in Japan for over 260 years.
summary_zh: 德川家康就任征夷大将军，在江户开设幕府，此后德川氏统治日本260多年。

title: Donglin Academy revived
summary: Gu Xiancheng and Gao Panlong reopened the Donglin Academy, whose members criticised court politics and formed the Donglin faction.
summary_zh: 顾宪成、高攀龙重修东林书院讲学议政，形成东林党。

title: Adi Granth compiled
place_zh: 阿姆利则（今印度旁遮普邦）
summary: Guru Arjan compiled the hymns of the Sikh Gurus and installed the book in the Harmandir Sahib (Golden Temple).
summary_zh: 古鲁阿尔琼汇编锡克教历代古鲁的颂诗，供奉于哈尔曼迪尔寺（金庙）。

title: Cervantes's Don Quixote
place_zh: 马德里（今西班牙马德里）
summary: Miguel de Cervantes published his comic novel about a would-be knight, often called the first modern novel.
summary_zh: 塞万提斯出版《堂吉诃德》，讽刺骑士小说，常被称为第一部现代小说。

title: Quilombo of Palmares
title_zh: 帕尔马雷斯黑人逃奴王国
place_zh: 巴里加山（今巴西阿拉戈斯州）
summary: Escaped slaves built Palmares, a large free community that held out for most of a century until its leader Zumbi was killed.
summary_zh: 逃亡奴隶在巴西东北山区建立帕尔马雷斯，坚持近一个世纪，直到首领尊比被杀才被摧毁。

title: Armenians settled at New Julfa
title_zh: 亚美尼亚人迁居新朱利法
place_zh: 新朱利法（今伊朗伊斯法罕）
summary: Shah Abbas moved Armenians from Julfa to a new quarter of Isfahan, where their merchants ran Iran's silk trade with Europe and Asia.
summary_zh: 阿拔斯一世把朱利法的亚美尼亚人迁到伊斯法罕新区，他们的商人经营伊朗与欧亚之间的丝绸贸易。

title: Founding of Jamestown
place_zh: 詹姆斯敦（今美国弗吉尼亚州）
summary: The Virginia Company founded Jamestown, the first permanent English settlement in North America, which survived on tobacco.
summary_zh: 弗吉尼亚公司建立詹姆斯敦，这是英国在北美第一个永久定居点，靠种植烟草维持下来。

title: Euclid translated into Chinese
summary: Xu Guangqi and Matteo Ricci translate the first six books of Euclid's Elements.
summary_zh: 徐光启与利玛窦合译欧几里得《几何原本》前六卷。

title: Daedong tax law
summary: Joseon began replacing tribute in local goods with a tax paid in rice, first in Gyeonggi and later nationwide.
summary_zh: 朝鲜开始在京畿道实行大同法，以米代替各地土产贡物，后逐步推行到全国。

title: Champlain founds Quebec
place_zh: 魁北克城（今加拿大魁北克省）
summary: Samuel de Champlain founded Quebec as a fur-trading post, the heart of New France.
summary_zh: 萨米埃尔·德尚普兰建立魁北克作为毛皮贸易站，此地成为新法兰西的中心。

title: Jesuit reductions in Paraguay
place_zh: 圣伊格纳西奥米尼（今阿根廷米西奥内斯省）
summary: Jesuits gathered Guaraní people into mission towns with churches, workshops and common fields, shielding them from slave raiders.
summary_zh: 耶稣会把瓜拉尼人集中到传教村镇，建有教堂、作坊和公田，使他们免遭奴隶贩子掳掠。

title: Satsuma invades Ryukyu
summary: Japan's Satsuma domain subjugated Ryukyu, which thereafter paid tribute to both Ming and Japan.
summary_zh: 日本萨摩藩攻占琉球，此后琉球两属于中日。

title: Garcilaso de la Vega publishes the Royal Commentaries
summary: The mestizo writer Garcilaso de la Vega, son of an Inca princess, published a history of the Incas that shaped later views of them.
summary_zh: 印加公主之子、混血作家加西拉索·德拉维加出版印加历史著作，深刻影响了后人对印加的认识。

title: Galileo's telescope discoveries
place_zh: 帕多瓦（今意大利帕多瓦）
summary: Galileo turned a telescope to the sky and reported Jupiter's moons and mountains on the Moon, supporting Copernicus.
summary_zh: 伽利略用望远镜观测天空，发现木星卫星和月球山脉，出版《星际信使》，支持日心说。

title: English factory at Surat
title_zh: 英国在苏拉特设立商馆
place_zh: 苏拉特（今印度古吉拉特邦）
summary: After beating the Portuguese at Swally, the East India Company won Mughal leave to trade at Surat, its first base in India.
summary_zh: 东印度公司在斯瓦利海战击败葡萄牙后，获准在苏拉特经商，建立在印度的第一个据点。

title: Dongui bogam published
summary: The royal physician Heo Jun's encyclopedia of medicine was published and remains a classic of East Asian medicine.
summary_zh: 御医许浚编撰的医学百科《东医宝鉴》刊行，成为东亚传统医学的经典著作。

title: Siege of Osaka
summary: Ieyasu besieged Osaka Castle in two campaigns and destroyed the Toyotomi family in 1615.
summary_zh: 德川家康两次围攻大坂城，1615年丰臣氏灭亡，德川统治彻底稳固。

title: Laws for the Military Houses
summary: The shogunate issued rules for daimyo, limiting castle building and marriages between lords without permission.
summary_zh: 幕府颁布武家诸法度，限制大名修筑城池和私下联姻，加强对大名的控制。

title: Case of the Attack with the Club
summary: A man armed with a club broke into the heir apparent's palace, first of the three great cases of the late Ming.
summary_zh: 男子张差持梃闯入太子宫，为明末三大案之一。

title: Nurhaci founds the Later Jin
summary: The Jurchen leader unites his people under the Eight Banners.
summary_zh: 女真首领努尔哈赤以八旗制度统一部众，建立后金。

title: Thirty Years' War
summary: The Defenestration of Prague set off a war that drew in most of Europe and devastated Germany.
summary_zh: 布拉格掷出窗外事件引发三十年战争，欧洲多数国家卷入，德意志地区遭到严重破坏。

title: Nurhaci's Seven Grievances; Fushun falls
summary: Nurhaci declared war on the Ming with his Seven Grievances and captured Fushun, opening the Ming-Jurchen war.
summary_zh: 努尔哈赤以七大恨告天，攻陷抚顺，明金战争开始。

title: Jin Ping Mei printed
summary: The realist novel by 'Lanling Xiaoxiao Sheng' appeared in print, its frank portrayal of merchant life causing scandal.
summary_zh: 兰陵笑笑生所著《金瓶梅词话》刊行，描写市井生活。

title: Battle of Sarhu
summary: Nurhaci destroys a much larger Ming army.
summary_zh: 努尔哈赤击溃了兵力远胜于己的明军。

title: Dutch found Batavia
place_zh: 巴达维亚（今印度尼西亚雅加达）
summary: Jan Pieterszoon Coen took Jayakarta and built Batavia, headquarters of the Dutch East India Company in Asia.
summary_zh: 荷兰东印度公司总督科恩攻占雅加达，建立巴达维亚城作为公司在亚洲的总部。

title: Sher-Dor Madrasa
place_zh: 雷吉斯坦广场（今乌兹别克斯坦撒马尔罕）
summary: The Sher-Dor Madrasa, with its tiger and sun mosaics, completed the Registan ensemble opposite Ulugh Beg's college.
summary_zh: 希尔多尔经学院与兀鲁伯经学院隔广场相对，门楣上饰有老虎和太阳图案，雷吉斯坦建筑群由此成形。

title: First enslaved Africans in Virginia
title_zh: 首批非洲人抵达弗吉尼亚
place_zh: 康福特角（今美国弗吉尼亚州汉普顿）
summary: About twenty Africans were brought to Point Comfort, the start of African slavery in the English colonies.
summary_zh: 约二十名非洲人被运到康福特角，标志英属殖民地非洲奴隶制的开端。

title: Virginia House of Burgesses
place_zh: 詹姆斯敦（今美国弗吉尼亚州）
summary: The first elected assembly in English America met at Jamestown, starting colonial self-government.
summary_zh: 英属美洲第一个民选议会在詹姆斯敦召开，开启殖民地自治的传统。

title: Mayflower Compact and Plymouth Colony
place_zh: 普利茅斯（今美国马萨诸塞州）
summary: Pilgrims on the Mayflower agreed to govern themselves by majority rule and founded Plymouth Colony.
summary_zh: 五月花号上的清教徒约定按多数原则自我管理，随后建立普利茅斯殖民地。

title: Feng Menglong's Three Words collections
summary: Feng Menglong published three collections of vernacular short stories, landmarks of Ming popular fiction.
summary_zh: 冯梦龙编成《喻世明言》《警世通言》《醒世恒言》。

title: Red Pill case
summary: The Taichang Emperor died a month after accession after taking red pills, fuelling factional accusations.
summary_zh: 泰昌帝服红丸后暴毙，在位仅一月，引发党争。

title: Palace Removal case
summary: Officials forced Consort Li out of the Palace of Heavenly Purity so the young Tianqi Emperor could take the throne.
summary_zh: 东林官员迫使李选侍移出乾清宫，天启帝即位。

title: Shenyang and Liaoyang fall to Later Jin
summary: Nurhaci captured Shenyang and Liaoyang, seizing the Ming heartland east of the Liao River.
summary_zh: 后金攻陷沈阳、辽阳，辽河以东尽失。

title: She-An Rebellion
summary: Yi chieftains She Chongming and An Bangyan revolted in Sichuan and Guizhou, besieging Chengdu and Guiyang.
summary_zh: 彝族土司奢崇明、安邦彦起兵，围攻成都、贵阳，历时九年。

title: Battle of Guangning
summary: Feuding commanders Wang Huazhen and Xiong Tingbi lost Guangning, and Ming fell back behind Shanhai Pass.
summary_zh: 王化贞、熊廷弼不和，广宁失守，明军退守山海关。

title: Sino-Dutch conflict in Penghu
summary: The Dutch East India Company occupied Penghu; Ming forces besieged them until they withdrew to Taiwan.
summary_zh: 荷兰东印度公司占据澎湖，明军围攻，荷人退往台湾。

title: Capture of Hormuz
place_zh: 霍尔木兹岛（今伊朗霍尔木兹甘省）
summary: With help from English East India Company ships, Safavid forces drove the Portuguese out of Hormuz, and trade moved to Bandar Abbas.
summary_zh: 萨法维军队在英国东印度公司船只协助下把葡萄牙人逐出霍尔木兹，贸易转移到阿巴斯港。

title: Dutch establish Fort Zeelandia in Taiwan
summary: After leaving Penghu, the Dutch built Fort Zeelandia and began colonial rule over southwestern Taiwan.
summary_zh: 荷兰人退出澎湖后在大员筑热兰遮城，殖民台湾南部。

title: Queen Nzinga of Ndongo and Matamba
summary: Nzinga became ruler of Ndongo and for four decades resisted Portuguese expansion in Angola through war and diplomacy.
summary_zh: 恩津加成为恩东戈统治者，此后四十年以战争与外交抵抗葡萄牙在安哥拉的扩张。

title: Wei Zhongxian purges the Donglin faction
summary: The eunuch dictator has leading critics tortured to death in prison.
summary_zh: 权宦魏忠贤将东林党的主要人物下狱，酷刑致死。

title: Battle of Ningyuan
summary: Yuan Chonghuan's European-style cannon beat off Nurhaci, his first major defeat.
summary_zh: 袁崇焕用西洋大炮击退努尔哈赤，这是努尔哈赤第一次遭到重大失败。

title: Wanggongchang explosion
summary: A massive blast at a gunpowder factory in Beijing destroyed thousands of houses and killed some 20,000 people.
summary_zh: 北京王恭厂火药局发生大爆炸，毁屋万间，死伤约两万。

title: Chongzhen purges Wei Zhongxian
summary: The new Chongzhen Emperor banished the eunuch dictator, who hanged himself en route; his faction was purged.
summary_zh: 崇祯帝即位后贬斥魏忠贤，魏在阜城自缢，阉党被清算。

title: Trịnh-Nguyễn War
summary: The Trịnh lords in the north and the Nguyễn lords in the south fought seven wars, splitting Vietnam for over a century.
summary_zh: 北方郑主与南方阮主以灵江为界多次交战，越南南北分治一百多年。

title: Battle of Ning-Jin
summary: Yuan Chonghuan's defences at Ningyuan and Jinzhou repulsed Hong Taiji's attack.
summary_zh: 袁崇焕守宁远、锦州，击退皇太极进攻。

title: Peasant revolts break out in Shaanxi
summary: Famine and unpaid soldiers spark uprisings that grow into the armies of Li Zicheng and Zhang Xianzhong.
summary_zh: 饥荒和欠饷引发民变，后来发展成李自成、张献忠的大军。

title: Courier stations cut back
summary: To save money Chongzhen slashed the postal relay system, throwing many men, including Li Zicheng, out of work.
summary_zh: 崇祯帝为节省开支裁撤驿站，李自成等驿卒失业。

title: Hong Taiji raids to Beijing
summary: Later Jin troops bypassed Shanhai Pass via Inner Mongolia and reached Beijing's walls.
summary_zh: 皇太极绕道蒙古破关入塞，兵临北京城下。

title: Yuan Chonghuan is executed
summary: The Chongzhen Emperor executes his best frontier general on charges of treason.
summary_zh: 崇祯帝以通敌罪名处死了最得力的边关将领袁崇焕。

title: Mulla Sadra's philosophy
place_zh: 设拉子（今伊朗法尔斯省）
summary: Mulla Sadra joined philosophy, mysticism and theology in his Transcendent Theosophy, still taught in Iran's seminaries.
summary_zh: 毛拉·萨德拉把哲学、神秘主义和神学融为一体，创立“超验智慧”学说，至今仍在伊朗宗教学校讲授。

title: Massachusetts Bay Colony
place_zh: 波士顿（今美国马萨诸塞州）
summary: Thousands of Puritans led by John Winthrop founded Boston, hoping to build a model Christian community.
summary_zh: 约翰·温斯罗普率领数千清教徒建立波士顿，希望建成模范基督教社会。

title: Taj Mahal built
summary: Shah Jahan began a white marble tomb for his wife Mumtaz Mahal, the masterpiece of Mughal architecture.
summary_zh: 沙贾汗为亡妻穆塔兹·玛哈尔修建白色大理石陵墓，是莫卧儿建筑的巅峰之作。

title: Battle of Liaoluo Bay
summary: Zheng Zhilong's fleet defeated the Dutch East India Company, securing dominance over the Taiwan Strait.
summary_zh: 郑芝龙率明水师在料罗湾击败荷兰舰队。

title: Chongzhen calendar completed
summary: Xu Guangqi, Adam Schall and others completed a calendar compendium based on Western astronomy.
summary_zh: 徐光启、汤若望等依西法编成《崇祯历书》。

title: Alternate attendance system
summary: Iemitsu required daimyo to live in Edo every other year and leave their families there, draining their wealth and boosting roads and towns.
summary_zh: 德川家光规定大名隔年到江户居住，妻子常住江户，既控制了大名，也促进了交通和城市发展。

title: Rebels burn imperial tombs at Fengyang
summary: Peasant rebel armies took Fengyang and burned the Ming founder's ancestral tombs.
summary_zh: 农民军攻破凤阳，焚毁明皇陵。

title: Hong Taiji proclaims the Qing
summary: Hong Taiji declared himself emperor and renamed the Later Jin state as the Great Qing.
summary_zh: 皇太极称帝，改国号为大清。

title: Qing invasion of Joseon
summary: Qing forces besieged King Injo at Namhansanseong, forcing Joseon to break with the Ming.
summary_zh: 清军围困朝鲜仁祖于南汉山城，朝鲜被迫断绝与明朝关系。

title: Gondar founded
summary: Emperor Fasilides made Gondar the permanent capital of Ethiopia and built its castles, starting a flowering of church art and building.
summary_zh: 法西利达斯皇帝定贡德尔为埃塞俄比亚永久都城并修建城堡，开启宗教艺术和建筑的繁荣期。

title: Song Yingxing's Tiangong Kaiwu
summary: An illustrated encyclopedia describes Chinese farming and crafts, from rice and silk to iron and paper.
summary_zh: 这部图文并茂的百科全书记录了中国的农业和手工业技术，从稻米、丝绸到冶铁、造纸。

title: Shimabara Rebellion
place_zh: 原城（今日本长崎县南岛原市）
summary: Peasants, many of them Christians, rose against heavy taxes under the youth Amakusa Shirō and were massacred at Hara Castle.
summary_zh: 不堪重税的农民在天草四郎率领下起义，多数为天主教徒，坚守原城数月后被镇压屠杀。

title: Sakoku: Japan closes its ports
summary: The shogunate expelled the Portuguese and in 1641 confined Dutch traders to Dejima; only Dutch and Chinese ships could trade at Nagasaki.
summary_zh: 幕府驱逐葡萄牙人，1641年把荷兰商馆迁到出岛，此后只允许荷兰和中国商船在长崎贸易。

title: Complete Treatise on Agriculture
summary: Xu Guangqi's agricultural encyclopedia was edited by Chen Zilong and printed after his death.
summary_zh: 徐光启遗著《农政全书》经陈子龙整理刊行。

title: Treaty of Zuhab
place_zh: 席林堡（今伊朗克尔曼沙赫省）
summary: The Ottomans kept Baghdad and Iraq while Iran kept the Caucasus lands, setting a border close to today's Iran-Iraq border.
summary_zh: 奥斯曼帝国保有巴格达和伊拉克，伊朗保有高加索领土，确立的边界接近今天的伊朗与伊拉克边界。

title: Fort St George founded at Madras
title_zh: 马德拉斯圣乔治堡建立
place_zh: 金奈（今印度泰米尔纳德邦）
summary: The East India Company acquired land on the Coromandel coast and built Fort St George, the origin of Madras.
summary_zh: 东印度公司在科罗曼德尔海岸取得土地，修建圣乔治堡，马德拉斯城由此发展而来。

title: Battle of Song-Jin
summary: Qing forces destroyed Hong Chengchou's relief army of 130,000; Hong surrendered and Ming lost its last field army in Liaodong.
summary_zh: 清军大败洪承畴十三万援军，洪承畴降清，明关外精锐尽失。

title: Li Zicheng takes Luoyang
summary: Rebels kill the rich Prince of Fu and hand out his grain, winning huge popular support.
summary_zh: 起义军杀死富甲一方的福王朱常洵，开仓散粮，民心大附。

title: English Civil War
place_zh: 埃奇希尔（今英国沃里克郡）
summary: Parliament fought King Charles I. Oliver Cromwell's New Model Army won, and England became a republic.
summary_zh: 议会与国王查理一世爆发内战，克伦威尔领导的新模范军获胜，英国一度成为共和国。

title: Yellow River breached at Kaifeng
summary: During Li Zicheng's siege the Yellow River dikes were breached, drowning most of Kaifeng's population.
summary_zh: 李自成围开封期间黄河决口，城中军民大多溺死。

title: Sun Chuanting killed; Li takes Xi'an
summary: Li Zicheng crushed Sun Chuanting's last Ming field army, captured Xi'an and prepared to found the Shun dynasty.
summary_zh: 李自成破潼关，孙传庭战死，旋占西安。

title: Zhang Xianzhong takes Wuchang
summary: Zhang Xianzhong captured Wuchang, killed the Prince of Chu and styled himself King of the Great West.
summary_zh: 张献忠攻占武昌，杀楚王，自称大西王。

title: Battle of Shanhai Pass
summary: Li Zicheng has taken Beijing and the last Ming emperor has hanged himself. Wu Sangui opens the pass and the Qing take Beijing.
summary_zh: 李自成已攻占北京，崇祯帝自缢身亡。吴三桂打开山海关，清军随即进入北京。

title: Qing moves its capital to Beijing
summary: After Li Zicheng fled, Dorgon brought the young Shunzhi Emperor to Beijing, proclaiming Qing rule over all China.
summary_zh: 李自成撤离北京后，多尔衮迎顺治帝入关，定都北京。

title: Southern Ming Hongguang court in Nanjing
summary: Ming loyalists enthroned the Prince of Fu in Nanjing; factional strife left it unable to resist the Qing.
summary_zh: 明遗臣在南京拥立福王朱由崧，党争不断，次年覆灭。

title: Banner land enclosures
summary: The Qing seized farmland around Beijing for bannermen, dispossessing many Han farmers until enclosure was halted under Kangxi.
summary_zh: 清廷在京畿圈占民田分给旗人，至康熙时停止。

title: Fall of Yangzhou
summary: Qing troops storm the city defended by Shi Kefa and kill a great part of its people over ten days.
summary_zh: 清军攻破史可法据守的扬州，屠城十日，城中大批百姓遇害。

title: Queue Order
summary: All Han men must shave the front of the head and wear a Manchu braid, or die. Many towns resist.
summary_zh: 清廷下令汉族男子一律剃发留辫，违者处死，江南多地奋起反抗。

title: Li Zicheng dies at Jiugong Mountain
summary: Pursued by Qing armies, the Shun ruler Li Zicheng was killed by local militia in Hubei.
summary_zh: 李自成兵败南撤，在通山九宫山遇害。

title: Jiading massacres
summary: Resistance to the queue order in Jiading was crushed three times by Li Chengdong's troops, with heavy civilian deaths.
summary_zh: 嘉定民众抗拒剃发，清将李成栋三次屠城。

title: Peace of Westphalia
summary: The treaties ended the Thirty Years' War and the Eighty Years' War and set up a system of sovereign states.
summary_zh: 和约结束三十年战争和八十年战争，确立国家主权原则，奠定近代欧洲国际关系体系。

title: Execution of Charles I
summary: Parliament tried and beheaded the king, and England was declared a commonwealth without a monarch.
summary_zh: 英国议会审判并处死国王查理一世，宣布成立共和国，这在欧洲是史无前例的事件。

title: Oyo Empire at its height
summary: The Yoruba Oyo Empire built a powerful cavalry army and dominated the savanna and coast west of the Niger, growing rich on trade including slaves.
summary_zh: 约鲁巴人的奥约帝国建立强大的骑兵，控制尼日尔河以西的草原和海岸，依靠包括奴隶在内的贸易致富。

title: Rhodes's Vietnamese dictionary
summary: The Jesuit Alexandre de Rhodes published a Vietnamese dictionary in Latin letters, building on the script that became modern written Vietnamese.
summary_zh: 耶稣会士罗德在罗马出版越葡拉辞典，确立了拉丁字母拼写越南语的国语字，即今天的越南文。

title: Dutch found the Cape Colony
summary: Jan van Riebeeck set up a supply station for the Dutch East India Company at the Cape, the start of European settlement in South Africa.
summary_zh: 扬·范里贝克为荷兰东印度公司在开普建立补给站，欧洲人在南非的殖民定居由此开始。

title: Li Dingguo's victories at Guilin and Hengzhou
summary: Li Dingguo took Guilin, driving Kong Youde to suicide, then killed the Qing prince Nikan at Hengzhou.
summary_zh: 李定国攻克桂林，孔有德自焚，又于衡州斩杀尼堪。

title: Fifth Dalai Lama visits Beijing
summary: The Fifth Dalai Lama was received by Shunzhi and granted a title, establishing Qing patronage of the Gelug school.
summary_zh: 五世达赖入京觐见顺治帝，受册封，清与格鲁派关系确立。

title: Aurangzeb seizes the throne
summary: Aurangzeb defeated his brothers, imprisoned Shah Jahan in Agra Fort and ruled for nearly fifty years.
summary_zh: 奥朗则布击败诸兄弟，将父亲沙贾汗囚于阿格拉堡，统治近五十年。

title: Koxinga's assault on Nanjing
summary: Zheng Chenggong sailed up the Yangtze and besieged Nanjing but was routed, ending his northern offensive.
summary_zh: 郑成功率军溯江围攻南京，兵败退回厦门。

title: Coastal evacuation order
summary: To starve the Zheng regime, the Qing forced coastal residents inland from Shandong to Guangdong, devastating the coast.
summary_zh: 为困郑氏，清廷令沿海居民内迁数十里，沿海残破。

title: Lamentation at the Temple case
summary: Suzhou scholars protesting a corrupt magistrate were executed, among them critic Jin Shengtan, amid the Jiangnan tax arrears purge.
summary_zh: 苏州士子哭庙控告县令，金圣叹等被斩，同年江南奏销案株连甚众。

title: Koxinga takes Taiwan from the Dutch
summary: The Ming loyalist builds a base on Taiwan.
summary_zh: 这位忠于明朝的将领在台湾建立了抗清基地。

title: Yongli Emperor executed; Southern Ming ends
summary: Handed over by Burma, the last Southern Ming emperor was strangled in Kunming on Wu Sangui's orders.
summary_zh: 缅甸交出永历帝，吴三桂将其绞杀于昆明，南明灭亡。

title: Huang Zongxi writes Waiting for the Dawn
summary: Huang Zongxi's treatise attacked autocracy, arguing that rulers exist to serve the people rather than the reverse.
summary_zh: 黄宗羲著《明夷待访录》，批判君主专制，主张天下为主、君为客。

title: Calendar case against Adam Schall
summary: Yang Guangxian's accusations led to the imprisonment of Jesuit astronomer Schall; Kangxi later reinstated Western methods under Verbiest.
summary_zh: 杨光先控告汤若望，西洋历法被废，康熙亲政后由南怀仁恢复。

title: Alaouite dynasty takes power in Morocco
summary: Moulay al-Rashid took Fez and founded the Alaouite dynasty, which still rules Morocco today.
summary_zh: 穆莱·拉希德攻占非斯，建立阿拉维王朝，至今仍统治摩洛哥。

title: Kangxi arrests the regent Oboi
summary: The teenage emperor has young wrestlers seize his overbearing regent and takes power himself.
summary_zh: 少年康熙帝命一群习武少年擒拿专横的辅政大臣鳌拜，从此亲掌大权。

title: Shakushain's revolt
place_zh: 静内（今日本北海道新日高町）
summary: The Ainu leader Shakushain rose against the Matsumae domain's unfair trade; after his death Ainu came under tighter Japanese control.
summary_zh: 阿伊努首领沙牟奢允反抗松前藩的不公平贸易，失败被杀，阿伊努人受到更严密的控制。

title: Hudson's Bay Company chartered
place_zh: 约克工厂（今加拿大马尼托巴省）
summary: England chartered the Hudson's Bay Company with a fur-trade monopoly over the vast lands draining into Hudson Bay.
summary_zh: 英国特许成立哈德逊湾公司，垄断流入哈德逊湾的广大地区的毛皮贸易。

title: Revolt of the Three Feudatories
summary: Wu Sangui and two other southern lords rebel and the Kangxi Emperor crushes them.
summary_zh: 吴三桂等三位南方藩王起兵反清，被康熙帝平定。

title: Shivaji crowned Chhatrapati
place_zh: 赖加德（今印度马哈拉施特拉邦）
summary: The Maratha leader Shivaji, who had fought the Mughals and Bijapur, was crowned king at Raigad, founding the Maratha state.
summary_zh: 与莫卧儿和比贾布尔作战多年的马拉塔领袖西瓦吉在赖加德加冕，建立马拉塔国家。

title: King Philip's War
place_zh: 霍普山（今美国罗得岛州）
summary: The Wampanoag leader Metacom led a rising against New England colonists; its defeat broke Native power in the region.
summary_zh: 万帕诺亚格首领梅塔科姆领导反抗新英格兰殖民者的战争，失败后当地印第安人势力瓦解。

title: Sangpyeong tongbo coins
summary: Joseon issued the Sangpyeong tongbo copper coin across the country, and coins came into wide use in trade.
summary_zh: 朝鲜在全国发行常平通宝铜钱，货币开始在商业中广泛流通。

title: Pueblo Revolt
place_zh: 圣菲（今美国新墨西哥州）
summary: Led by Popé, the Pueblo peoples drove the Spanish out of New Mexico for twelve years.
summary_zh: 在波佩领导下，普韦布洛各族将西班牙人逐出新墨西哥长达十二年。

title: Tauke Khan's Zhety Zhargy
place_zh: 突厥斯坦城（今哈萨克斯坦）
summary: Tauke Khan issued the Zhety Zhargy, a customary law code for the Kazakhs covering land, feuds and family.
summary_zh: 头克汗颁布《七项法典》，以习惯法规范哈萨克人的土地、血仇和家庭事务。

title: Fall of Kunming ends the Three Feudatories
summary: Qing armies took Kunming; Wu Shifan killed himself, ending the eight-year revolt.
summary_zh: 清军攻克昆明，吴世璠自杀，三藩之乱平定。

title: Louis XIV moves to Versailles
title_zh: 路易十四迁居凡尔赛宫
summary: Louis XIV moved his court to the vast palace, where he kept the nobility under watch. It became the symbol of absolutism.
summary_zh: 路易十四把宫廷迁到凡尔赛宫，把贵族集中在身边控制，凡尔赛宫成为专制王权的象征。

title: Qing takes Taiwan
summary: Admiral Shi Lang defeats the Zheng fleet and Taiwan becomes part of the Qing.
summary_zh: 水师提督施琅击败郑氏水军，台湾归入清朝版图。

title: Battle of Vienna
place_zh: 卡伦山（今奥地利维也纳）
summary: Polish king Jan Sobieski led a relief army that broke the Ottoman siege, beginning the Ottoman retreat from Central Europe.
summary_zh: 波兰国王扬·索别斯基率援军击破奥斯曼军对维也纳的围攻，奥斯曼帝国从此在中欧节节退却。

title: Taiwan Prefecture established
summary: After the Zheng surrender, the Qing kept Taiwan, creating a prefecture under Fujian province.
summary_zh: 郑氏降清后，清廷设台湾府，隶属福建省。

title: Sea ban lifted; four customs houses
summary: Kangxi lifted the maritime ban and set up customs at Guangzhou, Xiamen, Ningbo and Shanghai.
summary_zh: 康熙开放海禁，设粤、闽、浙、江四海关。

title: Kangxi's first southern tour
summary: Kangxi inspected Yellow River works and visited the Ming founder's tomb, the first of six southern tours.
summary_zh: 康熙帝首次南巡，视察河工并祭明孝陵。

title: Sieges of Albazin
summary: Qing troops twice besiege a Russian fort on the Amur, leading to peace talks.
summary_zh: 清军两次围攻俄国人在黑龙江边修建的雅克萨城，促成了中俄谈判。

title: Newton's Principia
title_zh: 牛顿《自然哲学的数学原理》
summary: Isaac Newton set out the laws of motion and universal gravitation, the foundation of classical physics.
summary_zh: 牛顿出版《自然哲学的数学原理》，提出运动定律和万有引力定律，奠定经典力学基础。

title: Glorious Revolution
summary: James II was driven out and William of Orange and Mary took the throne without major bloodshed in England.
summary_zh: 英国议会迎立荷兰执政威廉和玛丽，詹姆斯二世出逃，政权更替基本未流血，史称光荣革命。

title: Treaty of Nerchinsk
place_zh: 尼布楚（今俄罗斯涅尔琴斯克）
summary: China's first treaty with a European power fixes the border with Russia.
summary_zh: 中国与欧洲国家签订的第一个条约，划定了中俄东段边界。

title: Bill of Rights 1689
place_zh: 威斯敏斯特（今英国伦敦）
summary: Parliament limited the powers of the Crown and secured its own rights, laying the base of constitutional monarchy.
summary_zh: 英国议会通过《权利法案》，限制王权、确立议会至上，奠定君主立宪制的基础。

title: Bashō's journey to the deep north
place_zh: 深川（今日本东京都江东区）
summary: Matsuo Bashō set out on a long walk through northern Honshu; his travel diary with haiku became a classic of Genroku culture.
summary_zh: 松尾芭蕉徒步游历本州东北，写成融合俳句的纪行文《奥之细道》，是元禄文化的代表作。

title: Battle of Ulan Butung
place_zh: 乌兰布通（今内蒙古克什克腾旗）
summary: Qing forces under Prince Fuquan defeated Galdan's Dzungar army at Ulan Butung, only about 350 km north of Beijing.
summary_zh: 裕亲王福全率清军在乌兰布通击败噶尔丹准噶尔军。

title: Sor Juana's Reply to Sister Philothea
title_zh: 胡安娜修女答菲洛特亚修女书
summary: The nun and poet Sor Juana Inés de la Cruz defended women's right to learning, the high point of colonial Mexican letters.
summary_zh: 修女诗人胡安娜·伊内斯·德·拉·克鲁斯为女性求知权利辩护，是殖民时期墨西哥文学的高峰。

title: Dolon Nor assembly
summary: Khalkha Mongol princes submitted to Kangxi, bringing Outer Mongolia into the Qing empire.
summary_zh: 喀尔喀蒙古王公在多伦会盟归附清朝。

title: Salem witch trials
place_zh: 塞勒姆（今美国马萨诸塞州）
summary: Accusations of witchcraft in Salem led to the execution of 20 people, later seen as a warning against mass hysteria.
summary_zh: 塞勒姆的巫术指控导致20人被处死，后来被视为集体歇斯底里的警示。

title: Brazilian gold rush
place_zh: 欧鲁普雷图（今巴西米纳斯吉拉斯州）
summary: Gold was found in Minas Gerais, drawing settlers and slaves inland and making Portugal rich in the 18th century.
summary_zh: 米纳斯吉拉斯发现金矿，大批移民和奴隶涌入内陆，使葡萄牙在18世纪获得巨额财富。

title: Battle of Jao Modo
place_zh: 昭莫多（今蒙古国土拉河畔）
summary: Kangxi's armies crush the Dzungar leader Galdan in Mongolia.
summary_zh: 康熙帝亲征漠北，清军在昭莫多大败准噶尔首领噶尔丹。

title: Fall of Nojpetén, last Maya kingdom
title_zh: 最后的玛雅王国诺赫佩滕陷落
place_zh: 弗洛雷斯（今危地马拉佩滕省）
summary: Spanish forces took the island capital of the Itza Maya, ending the last independent Maya kingdom.
summary_zh: 西班牙军队攻占伊察玛雅人的岛上都城，最后一个独立的玛雅王国灭亡。

title: Reforms of Peter the Great
place_zh: 莫斯科（今俄罗斯莫斯科）
summary: After touring Western Europe, Peter I remade Russia's army, navy, government and customs on Western models.
summary_zh: 彼得一世游历西欧归国后，仿效西方改革军队、海军、行政和社会风俗，使俄国成为欧洲强国。

title: Oman takes Mombasa
summary: After a long siege Omani Arabs captured Fort Jesus, ending Portuguese power north of Mozambique and beginning Omani dominance of the Swahili coast.
summary_zh: 经长期围攻，阿曼人攻占耶稣堡，结束葡萄牙在莫桑比克以北的势力，阿曼从此主导斯瓦希里海岸。

title: Founding of the Khalsa
place_zh: 阿南德普尔（今印度旁遮普邦）
summary: Guru Gobind Singh created the Khalsa, a community of initiated Sikhs pledged to defend their faith.
summary_zh: 古鲁戈宾德·辛格创立卡尔萨，组建受洗的锡克教徒团体以捍卫信仰。

title: Kong Shangren's Peach Blossom Fan
summary: Kong Shangren's drama on the fall of the Southern Ming became a classic of kunqu.
summary_zh: 孔尚任完成《桃花扇》，借离合之情写兴亡之感。

title: Great Northern War
summary: Russia and its allies fought Sweden. Peter's victory at Poltava in 1709 made Russia the dominant Baltic power.
summary_zh: 俄国联合多国与瑞典争夺波罗的海霸权，1709年波尔塔瓦战役获胜，俄国取得出海口。

title: Peak of the Middle Passage
place_zh: 邦尼（今尼日利亚尼日尔河三角洲）
summary: In the eighteenth century the slave trade reached its peak. Captives from ports like Bonny and Ouidah crossed the Atlantic in crowded ships, and many died on the way.
summary_zh: 十八世纪奴隶贸易达到顶峰，从邦尼、维达等港口被运出的俘虏挤在船舱里横渡大西洋，许多人死于途中。

title: Ashanti Empire founded
summary: Osei Tutu united the Akan states around Kumasi under the Golden Stool and defeated Denkyira, founding the Ashanti Empire.
summary_zh: 奥塞·图图以金凳为象征联合库马西周围的阿坎诸邦，击败登基拉，建立阿散蒂帝国。

title: Chengde Mountain Resort built
summary: Kangxi began a summer palace at Rehe used to host Mongol and Tibetan elites.
summary_zh: 康熙始建热河行宫，后成为接见蒙藏首领之地。

title: Death of Aurangzeb
place_zh: 艾哈迈德讷格尔（今印度马哈拉施特拉邦）
summary: Aurangzeb died after decades of war in the Deccan; succession fights followed and the empire broke into regional states.
summary_zh: 奥朗则布在德干征战数十年后去世，继承之争随之而来，帝国分裂为地方政权。

title: Crown Prince Yinreng deposed
summary: Kangxi deposed his heir twice, setting off a bitter struggle among his sons.
summary_zh: 康熙两废太子胤礽，诸皇子夺嫡愈烈。

title: Founding of the Kokand Khanate
summary: Shahrukh Bey of the Ming tribe broke away from Bukhara in the Ferghana valley, founding the Kokand Khanate.
summary_zh: 明格部的沙鲁克在费尔干纳盆地脱离布哈拉独立，建立浩罕汗国。

title: Poll tax quota frozen forever
summary: Kangxi fixed the poll tax at 1711 levels, paving the way for merging it into the land tax.
summary_zh: 康熙宣布以康熙五十年丁数为准，滋生人丁永不加赋。

title: Kangxi Dictionary completed
summary: A dictionary of about 47,000 characters, arranged by 214 radicals, becomes the standard for two centuries.
summary_zh: 收字约四万七千个、按214个部首编排的字典问世，此后二百年一直是标准字典。

title: Kyōho Reforms
summary: Shogun Yoshimune cut spending, encouraged new fields and relaxed the ban on Western books other than Christian ones.
summary_zh: 将军德川吉宗厉行节俭、鼓励开垦新田，并放宽对与天主教无关的西洋书籍的禁令。

title: Kangxi atlas completed
summary: Jesuits and Qing surveyors completed a triangulated map of the empire.
summary_zh: 传教士与清朝官员实地测绘，完成《皇舆全览图》。

title: Qing expedition to Tibet
summary: Qing armies drive the Dzungars out of Lhasa and install the Seventh Dalai Lama. From 1727 Qing residents (ambans) are stationed in Lhasa.
summary_zh: 清军把准噶尔军赶出拉萨，护送七世达赖喇嘛入藏坐床。1727年起，清朝在拉萨派驻驻藏大臣。

title: Kangxi bans Christian missions
summary: Angered by the papal ban on Chinese rites, Kangxi forbade missionary work.
summary_zh: 因罗马教廷禁止中国礼仪，康熙下令禁教。

title: Afghans take Isfahan
title_zh: 阿富汗人攻陷伊斯法罕
place_zh: 古尔纳巴德（今伊朗伊斯法罕附近）
summary: Ghilzai Afghans under Mahmud Hotak beat the Safavid army at Gulnabad and starved Isfahan into surrender, ending real Safavid rule.
summary_zh: 马哈茂德·霍塔克率吉尔查伊阿富汗人在古尔纳巴德击败萨法维军队，围困伊斯法罕迫其投降，萨法维王朝名存实亡。

title: Head tax merged into land tax
summary: Yongzheng folds the poll tax into the land tax, so taxes fall on land instead of people.
summary_zh: 雍正帝把丁银并入田赋征收，赋税从按人头改为按土地。

title: Years of Great Disaster
summary: A Dzungar invasion drove the Kazakhs from their pastures with terrible losses, the darkest years in Kazakh memory.
summary_zh: 准噶尔人大举入侵，哈萨克人被迫逃离牧场，死伤惨重，史称“大灾难年代”。

title: Nian Gengyao crushes Lobzang Danjin
summary: Nian Gengyao and Yue Zhongqi suppressed the Khoshut revolt, bringing Qinghai under direct control.
summary_zh: 年羹尧、岳钟琪平定罗卜藏丹津叛乱，青海直属清廷。

title: Meltage fees returned to public funds
summary: Yongzheng converted informal surcharges into regular revenue paying 'nourish-integrity' salaries.
summary_zh: 雍正将火耗归公，设养廉银。

title: Replacing native chieftains
summary: Ortai replaced hereditary tusi chiefs in Yunnan, Guizhou and Guangxi with regular officials.
summary_zh: 鄂尔泰在滇黔桂推行改土归流。

title: Treaty of Kyakhta
summary: Qing and Russia fixed the Mongolian border and regulated caravan trade.
summary_zh: 中俄签订条约，划定中段边界并规定贸易。

title: Ambans posted in Lhasa
summary: After civil war in Tibet, Yongzheng stationed imperial residents in Lhasa.
summary_zh: 雍正设驻藏大臣，监督西藏地方。

title: Dahomey conquers Ouidah
summary: King Agaja of Dahomey took the port of Ouidah, giving the kingdom direct control of one of the busiest slave markets on the Slave Coast.
summary_zh: 达荷美国王阿加贾攻占港口维达，直接控制奴隶海岸最繁忙的奴隶市场之一。

title: Grand Council created
summary: A small war office next to the emperor's quarters becomes the real center of government.
summary_zh: 雍正帝在宫中设立处理军务的小机构，后来成为实际上的最高决策中枢。

title: First edict against opium
summary: Yongzheng issued the first imperial edict banning the sale of opium and the running of opium dens, with harsh penalties.
summary_zh: 雍正帝颁布中国第一道禁烟令，严禁贩卖鸦片、开设烟馆。

title: Dōjima Rice Exchange recognised
place_zh: 堂岛（今日本大阪市北区）
summary: The shogunate approved the Osaka rice exchange, where futures were traded, showing Osaka's role as the 'kitchen of the realm'.
summary_zh: 幕府正式认可大阪堂岛米市场，这里进行大米期货交易，大阪成为“天下的厨房”。

title: Junior Zhuz accepts Russian protection
place_zh: 伊尔吉兹（今哈萨克斯坦阿克托别州）
summary: Abulkhair Khan of the Junior Zhuz swore allegiance to Empress Anna, opening the way for Russian expansion into the Kazakh steppe.
summary_zh: 小玉兹的阿布勒海尔汗宣誓效忠俄国女皇安娜，俄国势力由此进入哈萨克草原。

title: Nader Shah crowned
summary: After driving out the Afghans, Ottomans and Russians, the general Nader deposed the Safavids and was crowned shah, founding the Afsharid dynasty.
summary_zh: 将军纳迪尔驱逐阿富汗人、奥斯曼人和俄国人后废黜萨法维王朝，加冕称沙，建立阿夫沙尔王朝。

title: Nader Shah sacks Delhi
place_zh: 卡尔纳尔（今印度哈里亚纳邦）
summary: Nader Shah of Persia routed the Mughals at Karnal and plundered Delhi, carrying off the Peacock Throne.
summary_zh: 波斯的纳迪尔沙在卡尔纳尔击溃莫卧儿军，洗劫德里，掠走孔雀宝座。

title: Pact of Diriyah, first Saudi state
place_zh: 德拉伊耶（今沙特阿拉伯利雅得）
summary: Muhammad ibn Saud allied with the preacher Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab, joining Saudi power to Wahhabi reform.
summary_zh: 穆罕默德·本·沙特与宣教者穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜结盟，沙特家族政权与瓦哈比派从此结合。

title: Ahmad Shah Durrani founds Afghanistan
summary: After Nader Shah was murdered, the Pashtun chiefs chose Ahmad Shah Durrani as king at Kandahar, the start of the modern Afghan state.
summary_zh: 纳迪尔沙遇刺后，普什图部落首领在坎大哈推举艾哈迈德·沙·杜兰尼为王，这是近代阿富汗国家的开端。

title: Wu Jingzi's The Scholars
summary: Living in Nanjing, Wu Jingzi wrote a satirical novel exposing the hypocrisy of examination candidates and officials.
summary_zh: 吴敬梓寓居南京，著《儒林外史》，讽刺科举制度下的士林百态。

title: Diderot's Encyclopedie
summary: Diderot and d'Alembert began publishing an encyclopedia that spread Enlightenment ideas across Europe.
summary_zh: 狄德罗和达朗贝尔开始编纂出版《百科全书》，集中宣传启蒙思想，影响遍及欧洲。

title: Karim Khan Zand rules from Shiraz
title_zh: 卡里姆汗·赞德定都设拉子
place_zh: 设拉子（今伊朗法尔斯省）
summary: Karim Khan Zand won control of most of Iran and ruled it from Shiraz as regent, not shah, giving the country a calm period.
summary_zh: 卡里姆汗·赞德控制伊朗大部，以摄政而不称沙的身份在设拉子执政，伊朗获得一段安定时期。

title: Alaungpaya founds the Konbaung dynasty
summary: Alaungpaya rallied the Burmese against the Mon of Hanthawaddy and founded the last Burmese dynasty.
summary_zh: 雍籍牙起兵击败孟人的勃固王国，重新统一缅甸，建立贡榜王朝。

title: French and Indian War
place_zh: 尼塞瑟蒂堡（今美国宾夕法尼亚州）
summary: Britain and France fought for control of North America; Britain's victory in 1763 ended New France.
summary_zh: 英法两国争夺北美控制权，1763年英国获胜，新法兰西从此终结。

title: Seven Years' War
place_zh: 罗斯巴赫（今德国萨克森-安哈尔特）
summary: A global war between Britain and Prussia on one side and France, Austria and Russia on the other. Britain won a world empire.
summary_zh: 英普同盟与法奥俄同盟在欧洲和海外激战，英国夺得法国大片殖民地，普鲁士保住西里西亚。

title: Qing conquers the Dzungars
summary: Qianlong's campaigns destroy the Dzungar Khanate and bring Xinjiang under Qing rule.
summary_zh: 乾隆帝发兵消灭准噶尔汗国，把新疆纳入清朝统治。

title: Battle of Plassey
place_zh: 普拉西（今印度西孟加拉邦）
summary: Robert Clive defeated Siraj ud-Daulah, the Nawab of Bengal, with the help of defectors, starting British rule in India.
summary_zh: 克莱武借助孟加拉内部叛将击败纳瓦布西拉杰·乌德-达乌拉，英国在印度的统治由此开始。

title: Canton System
summary: Qianlong limits Western trade to Guangzhou, through licensed Chinese merchants.
summary_zh: 乾隆帝下令西洋商船只许在广州一口通商，并由特许的行商经营。

title: Qing defeats the Altishahr Khojas
summary: Zhaohui's armies took Kashgar and Yarkand, bringing the Tarim Basin under Qing rule; the region was named Xinjiang.
summary_zh: 兆惠等平定大小和卓叛乱，天山南路归入清朝，称新疆。

title: Battle of the Plains of Abraham
place_zh: 魁北克城（今加拿大魁北克省）
summary: British troops under James Wolfe defeated Montcalm outside Quebec, deciding the fate of New France.
summary_zh: 沃尔夫率领的英军在魁北克城外击败蒙卡尔姆，决定了新法兰西的命运。

title: Third Battle of Panipat
place_zh: 帕尼帕特（今印度哈里亚纳邦）
summary: Ahmad Shah Durrani crushed the Marathas in one of the bloodiest battles of the century, halting their advance north.
summary_zh: 艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼大败马拉塔军，是十八世纪最惨烈的战役之一，阻止了马拉塔北进。

title: Rousseau's The Social Contract
place_zh: 阿姆斯特丹（今荷兰阿姆斯特丹）
summary: Jean-Jacques Rousseau argued that sovereignty belongs to the people, an idea that inspired the French Revolution.
summary_zh: 卢梭出版《社会契约论》，提出人民主权学说，深刻影响了法国大革命。

title: Pontiac's War
place_zh: 底特律（今美国密歇根州）
summary: The Odawa leader Pontiac led Native nations against British forts; Britain then barred settlement west of the Appalachians.
summary_zh: 渥太华族首领庞蒂亚克率各族进攻英军要塞，英国随后禁止殖民者越过阿巴拉契亚山脉定居。

title: Battle of Buxar
place_zh: 布克萨尔（今印度比哈尔邦）
summary: The Company defeated the combined forces of the Mughal emperor and the Nawabs of Bengal and Awadh.
summary_zh: 东印度公司击败莫卧儿皇帝与孟加拉、奥德两位纳瓦布的联军。

title: Spinning jenny
place_zh: 斯坦希尔（今英国兰开夏郡）
summary: James Hargreaves's multi-spindle spinning frame raised textile output, often taken as the start of the Industrial Revolution.
summary_zh: 哈格里夫斯发明珍妮纺纱机，大大提高纺纱效率，通常被视为工业革命开始的标志。

title: Bourbon Reforms in New Spain
summary: José de Gálvez reorganised taxes, trade and government in New Spain to raise revenue and tighten royal control.
summary_zh: 何塞·德·加尔韦斯整顿新西班牙的税收、贸易和行政，以增加收入并加强王室控制。

title: Sino-Burmese War
summary: Four Qing invasions of Konbaung Burma failed with heavy losses; the war ended in an uneasy truce.
summary_zh: 清军四次征缅，损失惨重，最终议和。

title: Stamp Act
summary: Britain taxed printed papers in the colonies; protests under the slogan no taxation without representation forced its repeal.
summary_zh: 英国对殖民地印刷品征税，“无代表不纳税”的抗议迫使其废除。

title: Fall of Ayutthaya
place_zh: 阿瑜陀耶（今泰国大城府）
summary: A Burmese army destroyed Ayutthaya after a long siege; Taksin rallied the Siamese and founded the Thonburi kingdom.
summary_zh: 缅军长期围攻后攻陷并焚毁阿瑜陀耶，郑信随后收复失地，建立吞武里王朝。

title: Watt's steam engine
place_zh: 格拉斯哥（今英国格拉斯哥）
summary: James Watt patented a separate condenser that made steam engines far more efficient, powering the Industrial Revolution.
summary_zh: 瓦特取得分离式冷凝器专利，大幅提高蒸汽机效率，蒸汽动力推动工业革命进入新阶段。

title: Bengal famine of 1770
place_zh: 穆尔希达巴德（今印度西孟加拉邦）
summary: Drought and harsh Company tax collection caused a famine that killed millions in Bengal.
summary_zh: 干旱加上东印度公司的严苛征税酿成大饥荒，孟加拉数百万人丧生。

title: Tây Sơn rebellion
summary: Three brothers from Tây Sơn rose against the Nguyễn lords and went on to overthrow both the Nguyễn and the Trịnh.
summary_zh: 西山阮氏三兄弟起兵，先后推翻南方阮主和北方郑主，几乎统一越南。

title: Torghut Mongols return from the Volga
summary: Led by Ubashi Khan, the Torghuts left Russia and trekked to Ili, losing many people on the way, and were settled by Qianlong.
summary_zh: 渥巴锡率土尔扈特部摆脱沙俄，万里东归伊犁，受清廷安置。

title: Second Jinchuan campaign
summary: Agui subdued the Gyalrong chiefdoms after five years of mountain warfare costing over 60 million taels.
summary_zh: 阿桂历时五年平定大小金川，耗银六千余万两。

title: Partitions of Poland
summary: Russia, Prussia and Austria divided the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth in three partitions, erasing it by 1795.
summary_zh: 俄国、普鲁士、奥地利三次瓜分波兰立陶宛联邦，到1795年波兰从欧洲地图上消失。

title: Boston Tea Party
place_zh: 波士顿港（今美国马萨诸塞州）
summary: Colonists dumped East India Company tea into Boston Harbor to protest the Tea Act; Britain answered with harsh laws.
summary_zh: 殖民者把东印度公司的茶叶倒入波士顿港，抗议《茶税法》，英国随即颁布严厉法令报复。

title: Siku Quanshu compiled
summary: Qianlong's scholars copy about 3,500 works into a giant library, while also banning and destroying thousands of books.
summary_zh: 乾隆帝组织学者把约三千五百种书籍抄成一部巨型丛书，同时禁毁了数千种书。

title: Regulating Act and Warren Hastings
title_zh: 《调整法》与首任总督黑斯廷斯
place_zh: 加尔各答（今印度西孟加拉邦）
summary: Parliament began to supervise the Company, and Warren Hastings became the first Governor-General of Bengal.
summary_zh: 英国议会开始监管东印度公司，沃伦·黑斯廷斯成为首任孟加拉总督。

title: Kaitai Shinsho published
summary: Sugita Genpaku and others translated a Dutch anatomy book, launching Rangaku, the study of Western science.
summary_zh: 杉田玄白等人翻译荷兰解剖学著作出版《解体新书》，兰学由此兴起。

title: Wang Lun uprising
summary: Wang Lun's White Lotus offshoot sect rose in Shandong and besieged Linqing on the Grand Canal.
summary_zh: 清水教首王伦在山东起事，攻打运河重镇临清。

title: First Continental Congress
place_zh: 费城（今美国宾夕法尼亚州）
summary: Delegates from twelve colonies met in Philadelphia and agreed to boycott British goods.
summary_zh: 十二个殖民地的代表在费城集会，决定抵制英国商品。

title: Battles of Lexington and Concord
title_zh: 莱克星顿和康科德战役
place_zh: 莱克星顿（今美国马萨诸塞州）
summary: The first shots between colonial militia and British troops began the American Revolutionary War.
summary_zh: 殖民地民兵与英军的首次交火揭开了美国独立战争的序幕。

title: Declaration of Independence
place_zh: 独立厅（今美国宾夕法尼亚州费城）
summary: The Continental Congress adopted Thomas Jefferson's declaration that all men are created equal, founding the United States.
summary_zh: 大陆会议通过杰斐逊起草的宣言，宣布人人生而平等，美利坚合众国由此诞生。

title: Smith's Wealth of Nations
summary: Adam Smith argued for free markets and the division of labour, founding classical economics.
summary_zh: 亚当·斯密出版《国富论》，主张自由市场和分工，奠定古典政治经济学。

title: Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata
place_zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯（今阿根廷）
summary: Spain created a new viceroyalty at Buenos Aires, joining Potosí's silver to the Atlantic trade of the Río de la Plata.
summary_zh: 西班牙在布宜诺斯艾利斯设立新的总督区，把波托西白银与拉普拉塔河的大西洋贸易连在一起。

title: Common Sense published
place_zh: 费城（今美国宾夕法尼亚州）
summary: Thomas Paine's pamphlet argued plainly for independence and republican government and sold over 100,000 copies.
summary_zh: 托马斯·潘恩的小册子通俗地主张独立和共和，销量超过十万册。

title: Battles of Saratoga
place_zh: 萨拉托加（今美国纽约州）
summary: The surrender of a British army at Saratoga was the war's turning point and brought France into alliance with the Americans.
summary_zh: 英军一支部队在萨拉托加投降，成为战争转折点，并促使法国与美国结盟。

title: Yizhulou poetry case
summary: Xu Shukui's poems were deemed anti-Manchu; his corpse was mutilated and relatives punished, typifying Qianlong's literary inquisition.
summary_zh: 徐述夔诗集被指悖逆，剖棺戮尸，为乾隆文字狱典型。

title: Xhosa Wars begin
place: Fish River, Eastern Cape, South Africa
place_zh: 大鱼河（今南非东开普省）
summary: The first of nine wars between the Xhosa and Cape colonists broke out on the Fish River frontier, a century of conflict over land and cattle.
summary_zh: 科萨人与开普殖民者在大鱼河边界爆发第一场冲突，此后为争夺土地和牛群前后共九次战争，持续一百年。

title: Rebellion of Túpac Amaru II
title_zh: 图帕克·阿马鲁二世起义
place_zh: 廷塔（今秘鲁库斯科大区）
summary: José Gabriel Condorcanqui, calling himself Túpac Amaru II, led a huge Indian uprising against colonial abuses before he was captured and executed.
summary_zh: 自称图帕克·阿马鲁二世的孔多尔坎基领导大规模印第安人起义，反抗殖民压迫，最终被俘处死。

title: Reforms of Joseph II
place_zh: 维也纳（今奥地利维也纳）
summary: Emperor Joseph II abolished serfdom, granted religious toleration and centralised government, a model of enlightened absolutism.
summary_zh: 约瑟夫二世废除农奴制、实行宗教宽容、加强中央集权，是开明专制的典型。

title: Siege of Yorktown
place_zh: 约克镇（今美国弗吉尼亚州）
summary: American and French forces trapped Cornwallis at Yorktown; his surrender effectively ended the war.
summary_zh: 美法联军在约克镇围困康华里，其投降实际上结束了独立战争。

title: Kant's Critique of Pure Reason
place_zh: 柯尼斯堡（今俄罗斯加里宁格勒）
summary: Immanuel Kant examined the limits of human knowledge, a turning point in modern philosophy.
summary_zh: 康德出版《纯粹理性批判》，探讨人类认识的能力和界限，是近代哲学的转折点。

title: Founding of Bangkok and the Chakri dynasty
summary: Rama I founded the Chakri dynasty and moved the capital across the river to Bangkok, where it remains.
summary_zh: 拉玛一世建立却克里王朝，迁都湄南河东岸的曼谷，该王朝延续至今。

title: Treaty of Paris (1783)
summary: Britain recognized the independence of the United States, with borders reaching the Mississippi.
summary_zh: 英国承认美国独立，美国疆界西抵密西西比河。

title: Loyalists settle in Canada
place_zh: 圣约翰（今加拿大新不伦瑞克省）
summary: Tens of thousands of colonists loyal to Britain moved north to Nova Scotia and Quebec, shaping English Canada.
summary_zh: 数万名效忠英国的殖民者北迁新斯科舍和魁北克，塑造了英语加拿大。

title: Asiatic Society founded
place_zh: 加尔各答（今印度西孟加拉邦）
summary: William Jones founded the Asiatic Society, and soon showed that Sanskrit was related to Greek and Latin.
summary_zh: 威廉·琼斯创立亚洲学会，不久提出梵语与希腊语、拉丁语同源，开创比较语言学。

title: Manghit dynasty founds the Emirate of Bukhara
summary: Shah Murad of the Manghit tribe took the title of emir, turning the khanate into the Emirate of Bukhara.
summary_zh: 曼吉特部的沙·穆拉德自称埃米尔，布哈拉汗国从此称布哈拉埃米尔国。

title: Lin Shuangwen rebellion
summary: The Heaven and Earth Society uprising overran much of Taiwan until Fuk'anggan's expedition ended it.
summary_zh: 天地会林爽文在台起事，福康安率军渡海平定。

title: Constitutional Convention
place_zh: 独立厅（今美国宾夕法尼亚州费城）
summary: Delegates wrote the United States Constitution, with a federal system and separation of powers; it was ratified in 1788.
summary_zh: 代表们制定《美利坚合众国宪法》，确立联邦制和三权分立，1788年获批准。

title: Storming of the Bastille
summary: A Paris crowd seized the royal fortress and prison on 14 July, the symbolic start of the French Revolution.
summary_zh: 7月14日巴黎民众攻占象征专制的巴士底狱，法国大革命爆发，这一天后来成为法国国庆日。

title: Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen
summary: The National Assembly declared that men are born free and equal in rights, with sovereignty resting in the nation.
summary_zh: 国民议会通过《人权宣言》，宣布人生而自由、权利平等，主权属于国民。

title: Washington becomes president
place_zh: 联邦大厅（今美国纽约市）
summary: George Washington took office as the first President of the United States under the new Constitution.
summary_zh: 乔治·华盛顿依新宪法在纽约就任美国首任总统，开创两届任期的先例。

title: Battle of Ngọc Hồi-Đống Đa
summary: Nguyễn Huệ marched north at the Lunar New Year and routed the Qing army that had come to restore the Lê.
summary_zh: 阮惠在春节期间突袭，大败入越扶持黎朝的清军，随后与清朝议和受封。

title: Anhui opera troupes come to Beijing
summary: The Sanqing troupe performed for Qianlong's 80th birthday; Anhui troupes later blended with Hubei tunes into Peking opera.
summary_zh: 三庆班进京为乾隆祝寿，徽汉合流，孕育京剧。

title: Dream of the Red Chamber printed
summary: Cao Xueqin's novel of a great family's decline is published in 120 chapters.
summary_zh: 曹雪芹描写一个大家族盛衰的小说以一百二十回本刊行。

title: Bill of Rights
place_zh: 联邦大厅（今美国纽约市）
summary: The first ten amendments to the Constitution guaranteed freedom of speech, religion, the press and other rights.
summary_zh: 宪法前十条修正案生效，保障言论、宗教、新闻等自由。

title: Qing war with Gorkha Nepal
summary: After Gorkha raids on Tibet, Fuk'anggan drove them back to near Kathmandu and forced Nepal into tribute.
summary_zh: 廓尔喀侵藏，福康安率军反击直逼加德满都，廓尔喀请降。

title: Battle of Valmy
summary: French revolutionary troops halted the Prussian invasion. The next day the monarchy was abolished and the First Republic proclaimed.
summary_zh: 法国革命军在瓦尔密击退普鲁士军，次日国民公会废除君主制，宣布成立法兰西第一共和国。

title: Freetown founded
summary: Black Loyalists from Nova Scotia founded Freetown as a settlement for freed slaves, later the base for the suppression of the slave trade.
summary_zh: 来自新斯科舍的黑人效忠派在此建立获释奴隶定居点弗里敦，后来成为打击奴隶贸易的基地。

title: Macartney Embassy
summary: Britain asks for trade and an embassy. Qianlong refuses.
summary_zh: 英国要求通商并互派使节，被乾隆帝拒绝。

title: Reign of Terror
summary: Robespierre's Jacobins ruled by mass executions to defend the Revolution, until they were overthrown in Thermidor 1794.
summary_zh: 罗伯斯庇尔领导的雅各宾派实行恐怖统治，大批处决反对者，1794年热月政变后垮台。

title: Permanent Settlement
place_zh: 加尔各答（今印度西孟加拉邦）
summary: Cornwallis fixed Bengal's land revenue forever and made the zamindars owners of the land.
summary_zh: 康华里永久固定孟加拉田赋数额，并承认柴明达尔为土地所有者。

title: Invention of the cotton gin
place_zh: 萨凡纳（今美国佐治亚州）
summary: Eli Whitney's cotton gin made cotton growing very profitable and greatly expanded slavery in the South.
summary_zh: 伊莱·惠特尼发明轧棉机，使种植棉花获利丰厚，南方奴隶制随之大规模扩张。

title: Golden Urn regulations for Tibet
summary: The 29-article ordinance placed Tibetan affairs under the ambans and introduced a golden urn lottery to choose reincarnations.
summary_zh: 颁布《钦定藏内善后章程》，确立金瓶掣签制度。

title: Agha Mohammad Khan sacks Tbilisi
title_zh: 阿迦·穆罕默德汗洗劫第比利斯
summary: The Qajar chief beat the Georgians at Krtsanisi and sacked Tbilisi to punish Georgia for its alliance with Russia.
summary_zh: 恺加部首领在克尔察尼西击败格鲁吉亚军队，洗劫第比利斯，惩罚格鲁吉亚与俄国结盟。

title: White Lotus Rebellion
summary: A religious revolt in the mountains of Hubei, Sichuan and Shaanxi takes nine years and a fortune to put down.
summary_zh: 湖北、四川、陕西山区爆发白莲教起义，清廷花了九年时间和巨额军费才将其镇压。

title: Qajar dynasty established
summary: Agha Mohammad Khan was crowned shah, reunited Iran and kept Tehran as the capital, which it has remained ever since.
summary_zh: 阿迦·穆罕默德汗加冕称沙，重新统一伊朗，以德黑兰为都，德黑兰从此一直是首都。

title: Hwaseong Fortress completed
summary: Jeongjo built the fortress city of Hwaseong at Suwon, using new techniques such as Jeong Yak-yong's crane.
summary_zh: 正祖在水原修建华城，采用丁若镛设计的举重机等新技术，是朝鲜后期筑城的代表。

title: Napoleon's campaign in Egypt
summary: Bonaparte defeated the Mamluks at the Battle of the Pyramids, but Nelson destroyed his fleet at Aboukir Bay and the French left in 1801.
summary_zh: 拿破仑在金字塔战役击败马穆鲁克，但纳尔逊在阿布基尔湾摧毁法国舰队，法军于1801年撤离。

title: Fall of Heshen
summary: Days after Qianlong's death, Jiaqing arrested Heshen, ordered his suicide and confiscated a vast fortune.
summary_zh: 乾隆死后，嘉庆赐和珅自尽，抄没巨额家产。

title: Ranjit Singh takes Lahore
title_zh: 兰吉特·辛格夺取拉合尔
place_zh: 拉合尔（今巴基斯坦旁遮普省）
summary: Ranjit Singh captured Lahore and united the Sikh misls into the Sikh Empire, which he ruled until 1839.
summary_zh: 兰吉特·辛格攻占拉合尔，统一锡克各部建立锡克帝国，统治至1839年。

title: Coup of 18 Brumaire
place_zh: 圣克卢（今法国上塞纳省）
summary: Napoleon Bonaparte overthrew the Directory and made himself First Consul.
summary_zh: 拿破仑发动政变推翻督政府，建立执政府并出任第一执政，掌握法国大权。

title: Rosetta Stone discovered
place_zh: 拉希德（今埃及布海拉省）
summary: French soldiers found the trilingual stone, and the expedition's scholars produced the Description de l'Egypte.
summary_zh: 法国士兵发现刻有三种文字的石碑，远征军学者随后编成《埃及记述》。

title: Fall of Seringapatam
place_zh: 斯里兰加帕特纳（今印度卡纳塔克邦）
summary: British forces stormed the capital of Mysore and Tipu Sultan died defending it, ending the Anglo-Mysore wars.
summary_zh: 英军攻陷迈索尔都城，蒂普苏丹战死，英国-迈索尔战争结束。

title: Napoleon's siege of Acre
summary: Jezzar Pasha with British naval help held Acre against Napoleon, ending his advance into Syria.
summary_zh: 杰扎尔帕夏在英国海军协助下守住阿卡，拿破仑进军叙利亚的计划告终。

title: Volta's battery
place_zh: 帕维亚（今意大利帕维亚）
summary: Alessandro Volta built the first electric battery, giving scientists a steady electric current.
summary_zh: 伏打发明伏打电堆，这是第一个能产生持续电流的电池，开启了电学研究的新时代。

title: Founding of the Nguyễn dynasty
summary: Nguyễn Ánh defeated the Tây Sơn, united Vietnam and ruled from Huế as Emperor Gia Long.
summary_zh: 阮福映击败西山朝，统一越南，以顺化为都，年号嘉隆，是越南最后一个王朝。

title: Louisiana Purchase
place_zh: 新奥尔良（今美国路易斯安那州）
summary: The United States bought Louisiana from Napoleon's France for 15 million dollars, doubling its territory.
summary_zh: 美国以1500万美元从拿破仑统治的法国购得路易斯安那，领土扩大一倍。

title: Napoleonic Code
summary: Napoleon's civil code set out equality before the law and property rights, and was copied across Europe and beyond.
summary_zh: 拿破仑颁布《民法典》，确立法律面前人人平等和私有财产权，被欧洲及世界多国效仿。

title: Usman dan Fodio's jihad and the Sokoto Caliphate
summary: The Fulani scholar Usman dan Fodio overthrew the Hausa kings in a holy war and founded the Sokoto Caliphate, the largest state in nineteenth-century West Africa.
summary_zh: 富拉尼学者奥斯曼·丹·福迪奥发动圣战推翻豪萨诸王，建立索科托哈里发国，是十九世纪西非最大的国家。

title: Lewis and Clark Expedition
place_zh: 克拉特索普堡（今美国俄勒冈州）
summary: Meriwether Lewis and William Clark crossed the continent to the Pacific with help from Sacagawea, mapping the West.
summary_zh: 刘易斯和克拉克在萨卡加维亚协助下横越大陆抵达太平洋，考察绘制了西部地图。

title: Muhammad Ali becomes ruler of Egypt
summary: The Albanian officer Muhammad Ali was made governor of Egypt and began sweeping military, farming and industrial reforms.
summary_zh: 阿尔巴尼亚裔军官穆罕默德·阿里出任埃及总督，推行军事、农业和工业改革。

title: Battle of Trafalgar
place_zh: 特拉法尔加角（今西班牙加的斯省外海）
summary: Nelson's British fleet destroyed the French and Spanish fleets, ending Napoleon's hopes of invading Britain.
summary_zh: 纳尔逊率英国舰队歼灭法西联合舰队，纳尔逊阵亡，英国从此确立海上霸权。

title: Battle of Austerlitz
place_zh: 奥斯特里茨（今捷克斯拉夫科夫）
summary: Napoleon defeated the Russian and Austrian emperors in his most celebrated victory.
summary_zh: 拿破仑击败俄奥联军，又称“三皇会战”，是拿破仑最辉煌的胜利之一。

title: Dissolution of the Holy Roman Empire
place_zh: 维也纳（今奥地利维也纳）
summary: Under pressure from Napoleon, Francis II gave up the imperial title, ending an empire of nearly a thousand years.
summary_zh: 在拿破仑压力下，弗朗茨二世放弃神圣罗马皇帝称号，延续近千年的神圣罗马帝国解体。

title: Britain abolishes the slave trade
summary: Britain banned the Atlantic slave trade and its West Africa Squadron, based at Freetown, began to stop slave ships, though the trade went on for decades.
summary_zh: 英国立法禁止大西洋奴隶贸易，以弗里敦为基地的西非舰队开始拦截运奴船，但奴隶贸易仍持续数十年。

title: Portuguese court moves to Rio de Janeiro
summary: Fleeing Napoleon, the Portuguese royal family moved to Rio, opened Brazil's ports and made it the centre of the empire.
summary_zh: 为躲避拿破仑，葡萄牙王室迁到里约热内卢，开放巴西港口，巴西成为葡萄牙帝国的中心。

title: Cry of Dolores
place_zh: 多洛雷斯（今墨西哥瓜纳华托州）
summary: Priest Miguel Hidalgo rang his church bell and called people to rise against Spanish rule, starting the Mexican War of Independence.
summary_zh: 神父伊达尔戈敲响教堂钟声，号召民众反抗西班牙统治，墨西哥独立战争爆发。

title: May Revolution
place_zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯（今阿根廷）
summary: The people of Buenos Aires removed the Spanish viceroy and set up a ruling junta, starting Argentina's independence.
summary_zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯民众罢免西班牙总督，成立执政委员会，开启了阿根廷的独立进程。

title: Hong Gyeong-nae's Rebellion
summary: Hong Gyeong-nae led peasants and merchants of the northwest, who were discriminated against, in a revolt that held Jeongju for months.
summary_zh: 洪景来率领受歧视的西北地区农民和商人起义，占据定州城数月后失败。

title: Venezuelan Declaration of Independence
summary: Venezuela became the first Spanish colony in South America to declare full independence, though the first republic soon fell.
summary_zh: 委内瑞拉成为南美第一个宣布完全独立的西班牙殖民地，但第一共和国不久即告失败。

title: French invasion of Russia
place_zh: 博罗季诺（今俄罗斯莫斯科州）
summary: Napoleon's Grande Armee reached Moscow after Borodino but was destroyed during the winter retreat.
summary_zh: 拿破仑率大军入侵俄国，经博罗季诺战役攻入莫斯科，但在冬季撤退中几乎全军覆没。

title: War of 1812
place_zh: 昆斯顿高地（今加拿大安大略省）
summary: The United States fought Britain and invaded Canada; British troops burned Washington, and the war ended in a draw.
summary_zh: 美国对英国开战并入侵加拿大，英军焚烧华盛顿，战争以平局告终。

title: Eight Trigrams rebels attack the Forbidden City
summary: A sect helped by palace eunuchs breaks into the palace; a prince drives them off with a musket.
summary_zh: 天理教徒在太监接应下攻入紫禁城，皇子旻宁用鸟枪将其击退。

title: Congress of Vienna
place_zh: 维也纳（今奥地利维也纳）
summary: The great powers redrew the map of Europe after Napoleon, restoring monarchies and setting up a balance of power.
summary_zh: 拿破仑战败后，欧洲列强在维也纳重新划分版图，恢复旧王朝，建立维也纳体系。

title: Battle of Waterloo
summary: Wellington and Blucher defeated Napoleon after his return from Elba, ending the Napoleonic Wars.
summary_zh: 拿破仑从厄尔巴岛复辟后，在滑铁卢被威灵顿和布吕歇尔击败，拿破仑战争结束。

title: Eruption of Mount Tambora
place_zh: 坦博拉火山（今印度尼西亚松巴哇岛）
summary: The largest eruption in recorded history killed tens of thousands and caused the 'year without a summer' in 1816.
summary_zh: 有记录以来最大的火山喷发造成数万人死亡，并导致次年北半球出现“无夏之年”。

title: Shaka builds the Zulu Kingdom
place_zh: 夸布拉瓦约（今南非夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省）
summary: Shaka took the Zulu throne and, with new weapons and regiments, turned a small chiefdom into the most powerful kingdom of southeastern Africa.
summary_zh: 恰卡继任祖鲁首领，凭借新式武器和军团制度，把一个小部落变成东南非最强大的王国。

title: Treaty of Sugauli
place_zh: 塞格利（今印度比哈尔邦）
summary: After the Anglo-Nepalese War, Nepal gave up Sikkim, Kumaon and other lands and accepted a British resident.
summary_zh: 英尼战争后，尼泊尔割让锡金、库马盎等地，并接受英国驻扎官。

title: Argentine Declaration of Independence
place_zh: 圣米格尔-德图库曼（今阿根廷）
summary: The Congress of Tucumán declared the independence of the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata.
summary_zh: 图库曼议会宣布拉普拉塔联合省独立，即今天的阿根廷。

title: San Martín crosses the Andes
summary: José de San Martín led an army over the Andes and defeated the royalists at Chacabuco, freeing Chile.
summary_zh: 圣马丁率军翻越安第斯山，在查卡布科击败保王军，解放了智利。

title: End of the Maratha Confederacy
place_zh: 浦那（今印度马哈拉施特拉邦）
summary: The British defeated the Peshwa in the Third Anglo-Maratha War, becoming the paramount power in India.
summary_zh: 英国在第三次英国-马拉塔战争中击败佩什瓦，成为印度的最高主宰。

title: Mfecane
summary: Wars connected with the rise of the Zulu scattered peoples across southern Africa and led to new states such as Lesotho, Swaziland and the Ndebele kingdom.
summary_zh: 与祖鲁崛起相关的连年战乱使众多族群流散于南部非洲，并催生了莱索托、斯威士兰和恩德贝莱等新国家。

title: Raffles founds Singapore
summary: Stamford Raffles set up a British trading post on Singapore, which grew into the leading port of the region.
summary_zh: 莱佛士与柔佛达成协议，在新加坡建立英国贸易站，新加坡迅速发展为区域第一大港。

title: Battle of Boyacá
place_zh: 博亚卡桥（今哥伦比亚博亚卡省）
summary: Simón Bolívar crossed the Andes and defeated the Spanish at Boyacá, freeing New Granada.
summary_zh: 玻利瓦尔翻越安第斯山，在博亚卡击败西班牙军，解放了新格拉纳达。

title: Gran Colombia founded
title_zh: 大哥伦比亚共和国成立
place_zh: 安戈斯图拉（今委内瑞拉玻利瓦尔城）
summary: The Congress of Angostura united Venezuela and New Granada, later joined by Ecuador, into the Republic of Colombia under Bolívar.
summary_zh: 安戈斯图拉议会把委内瑞拉和新格拉纳达合并为共和国，后来厄瓜多尔加入，由玻利瓦尔任总统。

title: Muhammad Ali's modernising reforms
summary: He built a conscript army, state factories and cotton farming, and sent students to Europe, starting Egypt's modernisation.
summary_zh: 穆罕默德·阿里组建征兵制军队，兴办国营工厂，推广棉花种植，选派学生赴欧，开启埃及近代化。

title: The Tale of Kiều
summary: Nguyễn Du wrote this long poem in chữ Nôm about a woman's suffering; it is the classic of Vietnamese literature.
summary_zh: 阮攸用喃字写成长篇叙事诗《金云翘传》，讲述女子翠翘的坎坷命运，是越南文学的经典。

title: Missouri Compromise
place_zh: 华盛顿（今美国哥伦比亚特区）
summary: Congress admitted Missouri as a slave state and Maine as a free state and banned slavery north of 36°30' in the West.
summary_zh: 国会接纳密苏里为蓄奴州、缅因为自由州，并禁止西部北纬36度30分以北实行奴隶制。

title: Mexico wins independence
summary: Agustín de Iturbide joined the rebels under the Plan of Iguala, the Treaty of Córdoba was signed and the army entered Mexico City.
summary_zh: 伊图尔维德依据伊瓜拉计划与起义军联合，签订科尔多瓦条约，军队开进墨西哥城，墨西哥独立。

title: Central America declares independence
summary: Leaders in Guatemala City proclaimed the independence of Central America from Spain.
summary_zh: 危地马拉城的领袖宣布中美洲脱离西班牙独立。

title: Greek War of Independence
place_zh: 卡拉马塔（今希腊伯罗奔尼撒）
summary: The Greeks rose against Ottoman rule and, with British, French and Russian help, won independence.
summary_zh: 希腊人起义反抗奥斯曼统治，在英法俄干预下取得独立，建立希腊王国。

title: Peruvian Declaration of Independence
summary: San Martín entered Lima and proclaimed Peru's independence, though royalist armies still held the highlands.
summary_zh: 圣马丁进入利马宣布秘鲁独立，但保王军仍控制着高原地区。

title: Independence of Brazil
place_zh: 伊皮兰加（今巴西圣保罗）
summary: Prince Pedro refused to return to Portugal and declared Brazil independent at the Ipiranga, becoming Emperor Pedro I.
summary_zh: 佩德罗王子拒绝返回葡萄牙，在伊皮兰加河畔宣布巴西独立，成为巴西帝国皇帝佩德罗一世。

title: Champollion deciphers hieroglyphs
summary: Using the Rosetta Stone, Jean-Francois Champollion showed how hieroglyphs worked, founding modern Egyptology.
summary_zh: 商博良借助罗塞塔石碑破解了象形文字的原理，开创了现代埃及学。

title: Guayaquil Conference
summary: Bolívar and San Martín met in private at Guayaquil; afterwards San Martín withdrew and left the liberation of Peru to Bolívar.
summary_zh: 玻利瓦尔与圣马丁在瓜亚基尔秘密会谈，此后圣马丁引退，把解放秘鲁的任务交给玻利瓦尔。

title: Monroe Doctrine
place_zh: 华盛顿（今美国哥伦比亚特区）
summary: President Monroe warned Europe against new colonies in the Americas, a lasting basis of US foreign policy.
summary_zh: 门罗总统警告欧洲不得在美洲建立新殖民地，成为美国外交政策的长期基础。

title: Federal Republic of Central America
summary: Five provinces formed a federation, but civil wars broke it apart into separate republics by 1841.
summary_zh: 中美洲五省组成联邦，但内战不断，到1841年分裂为五个独立国家。

title: Battle of Ayacucho
place_zh: 基努阿（今秘鲁阿亚库乔大区）
summary: Antonio José de Sucre defeated the last large Spanish army at Ayacucho, ending Spanish rule in South America.
summary_zh: 苏克雷在阿亚库乔击败西班牙在南美的最后一支主力，西班牙在南美大陆的统治宣告结束。

title: First Anglo-Burmese War
summary: Britain defeated Burma and took Assam, Arakan and Tenasserim in the Treaty of Yandabo.
summary_zh: 英国击败缅甸，通过《杨达波条约》取得阿萨姆、若开和丹那沙林，开启缅甸的殖民化。

title: Java War
summary: Prince Diponegoro led a five-year war against Dutch rule in Java; its defeat left the Dutch in full control of the island.
summary_zh: 蒂博尼哥罗亲王领导爪哇人反抗荷兰统治五年，失败后荷兰完全控制了爪哇。

title: Stockton and Darlington Railway
title_zh: 斯托克顿至达灵顿铁路通车
place_zh: 达灵顿（今英国达勒姆郡）
summary: The first public railway to use steam locomotives opened, built by George Stephenson.
summary_zh: 斯蒂芬森主持修建的斯托克顿至达灵顿铁路通车，是世界上第一条使用蒸汽机车的公共铁路。

title: Erie Canal opens
place_zh: 奥尔巴尼（今美国纽约州）
summary: The canal linked the Great Lakes to the Hudson River and made New York City the nation's leading port.
summary_zh: 伊利运河连通五大湖与哈得孙河，使纽约成为全国首要港口。

title: Independence of Bolivia
summary: Upper Peru declared independence and named the new republic after Simón Bolívar.
summary_zh: 上秘鲁宣布独立，以玻利瓦尔的名字命名新国家为玻利维亚。

title: Jahangir Khoja's revolt
summary: Jahangir invaded from Kokand and seized Kashgar before Qing troops captured him.
summary_zh: 张格尔从浩罕入侵，占领喀什等城，后被擒。

title: Treaty of Turkmenchay
place_zh: 土库曼恰伊（今伊朗东阿塞拜疆省）
summary: After losing a second war, Iran ceded Erivan and Nakhchivan to Russia and granted extraterritorial rights, a model for later unequal treaties.
summary_zh: 伊朗在第二次俄波战争中失败，把埃里温和纳希切万割让给俄国并给予领事裁判权，成为后来不平等条约的范本。

title: Brahmo Samaj founded
place_zh: 加尔各答（今印度西孟加拉邦）
summary: Ram Mohan Roy founded the Brahmo Samaj to reform Hinduism, opposing idol worship and caste.
summary_zh: 罗姆·莫汉·罗伊创立梵社，主张改革印度教，反对偶像崇拜和种姓制度。

title: Uruguay gains independence
summary: After a war between Brazil and Argentina over the Banda Oriental, British mediation made Uruguay an independent buffer state.
summary_zh: 巴西与阿根廷为争夺东岸地区交战，在英国调停下，乌拉圭成为独立的缓冲国。

title: Sati abolished
place_zh: 加尔各答（今印度西孟加拉邦）
summary: Governor-General William Bentinck banned sati, the burning of widows on their husbands' funeral pyres.
summary_zh: 总督本廷克下令禁止寡妇殉夫自焚的萨蒂习俗。

title: French invasion of Algiers
place_zh: 西迪费鲁什（今阿尔及利亚）
summary: France landed at Sidi Fredj and took Algiers, beginning 132 years of colonial rule in Algeria.
summary_zh: 法军在西迪费鲁什登陆并攻占阿尔及尔，开始了对阿尔及利亚长达132年的殖民统治。

title: Cultivation System
place_zh: 巴达维亚（今印度尼西亚雅加达）
summary: The Dutch forced Javanese villages to grow export crops like coffee and sugar, enriching the Netherlands and causing famines.
summary_zh: 荷兰强迫爪哇农民种植咖啡、甘蔗等出口作物，荷兰获利巨大，爪哇却屡遭饥荒。

title: July Revolution
summary: Parisians overthrew Charles X and brought in the constitutional monarchy of Louis Philippe.
summary_zh: 巴黎人民推翻复辟的波旁王朝国王查理十世，建立以路易·菲利普为王的七月王朝。

title: Dissolution of Gran Colombia
summary: Venezuela and Ecuador broke away from Gran Colombia, and Bolívar died at Santa Marta the same year.
summary_zh: 委内瑞拉和厄瓜多尔脱离大哥伦比亚，玻利瓦尔同年在圣玛尔塔去世，他的统一梦想破灭。

title: Faraday discovers electromagnetic induction
place_zh: 皇家研究院（今英国伦敦）
summary: Michael Faraday showed that a moving magnet produces an electric current, the principle of the generator.
summary_zh: 法拉第发现电磁感应现象，揭示了发电机的原理，为电力时代奠定基础。

title: Hokusai's The Great Wave off Kanagawa
title_zh: 葛饰北斋《神奈川冲浪里》
summary: Hokusai's woodblock print of a giant wave before Mount Fuji became the best-known ukiyo-e and later influenced Western artists.
summary_zh: 葛饰北斋的浮世绘版画《神奈川冲浪里》描绘巨浪与富士山，后来深刻影响了西方印象派艺术。

title: Abd al-Qadir's resistance to France
place_zh: 马斯卡拉（今阿尔及利亚）
summary: Emir Abd al-Qadir united Algerian tribes and fought the French for fifteen years before surrendering in 1847.
summary_zh: 埃米尔阿卜杜·卡迪尔联合阿尔及利亚各部落抗击法军十五年，1847年投降。

title: German Customs Union
summary: Prussia led most German states into a customs union, preparing the way for political unification.
summary_zh: 普鲁士联合德意志大多数邦国成立关税同盟，为德意志统一奠定经济基础。

title: Great Trek
summary: Thousands of Boer settlers left British-ruled Cape Colony in ox wagons and moved inland, later founding the Transvaal and Orange Free State.
summary_zh: 数千名布尔人赶着牛车离开英属开普殖民地向内陆迁徙，后来建立了德兰士瓦和奥兰治自由邦。

title: Darwin visits the Galápagos
title_zh: 达尔文考察加拉帕戈斯群岛
place_zh: 加拉帕戈斯群岛（今厄瓜多尔）
summary: During the Beagle voyage around South America, Darwin studied the finches and tortoises of the Galápagos, which later helped shape his theory of evolution.
summary_zh: 达尔文随贝格尔号环绕南美考察，研究加拉帕戈斯群岛的雀鸟和巨龟，为日后提出进化论积累了证据。

title: Kenesary's revolt
summary: Kenesary Kasymov, grandson of Ablai Khan, led the last great Kazakh uprising against Russian rule.
summary_zh: 阿布赉汗之孙克涅萨热领导反抗俄国统治的起义，是哈萨克人最后一次大规模武装斗争。

title: Rebellions of 1837
place_zh: 圣但尼（今加拿大魁北克省）
summary: Reformers in Lower and Upper Canada rose against colonial oligarchies; the defeat still led to responsible government.
summary_zh: 上、下加拿大的改革派起兵反对殖民寡头统治，虽然失败，却推动了责任政府的建立。

title: Trail of Tears
place_zh: 新埃科塔（今美国佐治亚州）
summary: The US Army forced the Cherokee west to Indian Territory; thousands died on the march.
summary_zh: 美军强迫切罗基人西迁至印第安领地，数千人死于途中。

title: Lin Zexu destroys opium at Humen
summary: The commissioner destroys over 1,000 tonnes of British opium, triggering the First Opium War.
summary_zh: 钦差大臣林则徐销毁英国商人一千多吨鸦片，第一次鸦片战争随之爆发。

title: Tanzimat reforms
place_zh: 居尔哈内（今土耳其伊斯坦布尔）
summary: The Edict of Gülhane promised equal law, fair taxes and regular conscription, starting decades of Westernising reforms.
summary_zh: 《居尔哈内诏书》承诺法律平等、公平征税和规范征兵，开启了数十年的西化改革。

title: First Anglo-Afghan War
summary: Britain invaded Afghanistan to put Shah Shuja on the throne. In 1842 the retreating army from Kabul was almost wiped out.
summary_zh: 英国入侵阿富汗，扶植舒贾沙复位。1842年英军从喀布尔撤退时几乎全军覆没。

title: Sultan of Oman moves to Zanzibar
summary: Sultan Said bin Sultan moved his capital from Muscat to Zanzibar, which grew rich on cloves and the East African ivory and slave trade.
summary_zh: 赛义德苏丹把都城从马斯喀特迁到桑给巴尔，桑给巴尔依靠丁香和东非象牙、奴隶贸易而繁荣。

title: Sanyuanli resistance
summary: Villagers north of Guangzhou attacked British troops, an episode later celebrated as popular resistance.
summary_zh: 广州三元里民众围攻英军。

title: Battle of the Bogue
summary: British warships stormed the Humen forts; Admiral Guan Tianpei was killed.
summary_zh: 英军攻陷虎门炮台，关天培战死。

title: Treaty of Nanking
summary: The first of the unequal treaties: Hong Kong is ceded and five ports opened.
summary_zh: 第一个不平等条约：清朝割让香港岛，开放五个通商口岸。

title: Wei Yuan's Illustrated Treatise on Maritime Kingdoms
summary: Wei Yuan's survey of world geography urged 'learning foreign skills to control foreigners'.
summary_zh: 魏源编《海国图志》，提出师夷长技以制夷。

title: Battle of Zhenjiang
summary: Manchu garrison troops fought to the end; the British then cut the Grand Canal and forced peace.
summary_zh: 镇江八旗守军死战，英军切断漕运，清廷求和。

title: Shanghai opens as a treaty port
summary: Shanghai opened under the Treaty of Nanjing; the British settlement founded in 1845 grew into the International Settlement.
summary_zh: 上海开埠，1845年设英租界，渐成通商中心。

title: The Bab declares his mission
place_zh: 设拉子（今伊朗法尔斯省）
summary: A young merchant of Shiraz proclaimed himself the Bab, or Gate. His Babi movement was persecuted and later gave rise to the Baha'i Faith.
summary_zh: 设拉子的青年商人自称“巴孛”（意为门），巴孛运动遭到镇压，后来从中产生了巴哈伊教。

title: First telegraph line
place_zh: 华盛顿（今美国哥伦比亚特区）
summary: Samuel Morse sent the message What hath God wrought from Washington to Baltimore, opening the age of instant communication.
summary_zh: 塞缪尔·莫尔斯从华盛顿向巴尔的摩发出电报，开启即时通讯时代。

title: Great Famine in Ireland
place_zh: 都柏林（今爱尔兰都柏林）
summary: Potato blight caused mass starvation. About a million died and a million more emigrated.
summary_zh: 马铃薯枯萎病导致爱尔兰大饥荒，约百万人饿死，另有百万人移民海外。

title: Peru's guano boom
place_zh: 钦查群岛（今秘鲁伊卡大区）
summary: Peru grew rich exporting seabird guano as fertiliser, dug largely by Chinese contract labourers.
summary_zh: 秘鲁大量出口海鸟粪作肥料而致富，开采工作主要由华工承担。

title: Mexican-American War
summary: The United States invaded Mexico and took Mexico City; Mexico was forced to cede about half its territory.
summary_zh: 美国入侵墨西哥并攻占墨西哥城，墨西哥被迫割让约一半领土。

title: Caste War of Yucatán
place_zh: 巴利亚多利德（今墨西哥尤卡坦州）
summary: Maya peasants rose against white and mestizo landowners and held much of eastern Yucatán for decades.
summary_zh: 玛雅农民起义反抗白人和混血地主，数十年间控制尤卡坦东部大片地区。

title: Liberia declares independence
summary: The colony founded by the American Colonization Society for freed African Americans declared itself an independent republic, Africa's oldest modern republic.
summary_zh: 美国殖民协会为获释非裔美国人建立的殖民地宣布成为独立共和国，是非洲最早的现代共和国。

title: The Communist Manifesto
summary: Marx and Engels published the programme of the Communist League, calling on the workers of all countries to unite.
summary_zh: 马克思和恩格斯发表《共产党宣言》，号召“全世界无产者，联合起来！”，标志马克思主义诞生。

title: California Gold Rush
place_zh: 科洛马（今美国加利福尼亚州）
summary: Gold found at Sutter's Mill drew 300,000 people, including many Chinese, and made California a state by 1850.
summary_zh: 萨特磨坊发现黄金，吸引约三十万人前来，其中有许多华人，加利福尼亚于1850年建州。

title: Revolutions of 1848
