summary: Revolutions spread from Paris across Europe, demanding liberal reforms and national unity. Most were crushed.
summary_zh: 革命从巴黎蔓延到德意志、奥地利、意大利等地，要求自由改革和民族统一，多数最终失败。

title: Seneca Falls Convention
place_zh: 塞尼卡福尔斯（今美国纽约州）
summary: The first women's rights convention demanded equality and the right to vote for women.
summary_zh: 第一次妇女权利大会召开，要求男女平等和妇女选举权。

title: Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo
title_zh: 瓜达卢佩-伊达尔戈条约
place_zh: 瓜达卢佩镇（今墨西哥城）
summary: Mexico ceded California, New Mexico and more to the United States for 15 million dollars.
summary_zh: 墨西哥以1500万美元的代价把加利福尼亚、新墨西哥等地割让给美国。

title: Taiping Rebellion
summary: Hong Xiuquan, who believed he was Jesus's brother, leads a revolt that takes Nanjing and costs tens of millions of lives.
summary_zh: 自称耶稣之弟的洪秀全发动起义，攻占南京，战乱造成数千万人死亡。

title: Amir Kabir's reforms and the Dar ul-Funun
summary: The chief minister Amir Kabir cut court spending, built factories and opened the Dar ul-Funun, Iran's first modern college, before he was killed in 1852.
summary_zh: 首相阿米尔·卡比尔削减宫廷开支，兴办工厂，创办伊朗第一所现代学校达鲁弗农，1852年被处死。

title: Uncle Tom's Cabin published
place_zh: 不伦瑞克（今美国缅因州）
summary: Harriet Beecher Stowe's novel about slavery became a bestseller and strengthened the anti-slavery cause in the North.
summary_zh: 斯托夫人揭露奴隶制的小说成为畅销书，壮大了北方的废奴力量。

title: Arrival of Perry's Black Ships
place_zh: 浦贺（今日本神奈川县横须贺市）
summary: US Commodore Matthew Perry sailed into Edo Bay with steam warships and demanded that Japan open its ports.
summary_zh: 美国海军准将佩里率蒸汽军舰驶入江户湾，要求日本开国，锁国体制开始动摇。

title: Taipings take Nanjing as Tianjing
summary: Taiping armies took Nanjing, renamed it Tianjing and issued the Heavenly Land System.
summary_zh: 太平军攻克南京，定都天京，颁布《天朝田亩制度》。

title: Zeng Guofan forms the Xiang Army
summary: Zeng Guofan organised a personal militia army in Hunan that became the main force against the Taipings.
summary_zh: 曾国藩在湖南编练湘军，成为镇压太平天国主力。

title: Nian Rebellion
summary: Bandit groups in the Huaibei plain united under Zhang Lexing and raided north China for 15 years.
summary_zh: 张乐行在雉河集会盟，捻军纵横华北十余年。

title: Crimean War
place_zh: 塞瓦斯托波尔（今克里米亚）
summary: Britain, France and the Ottomans defeated Russia, exposing Russia's backwardness and prompting reform.
summary_zh: 英法联合奥斯曼帝国击败俄国，暴露了俄国的落后，促使其进行农奴制改革。

title: First passenger railway
place_zh: 孟买（今印度马哈拉施特拉邦）
summary: The first passenger train ran from Bombay to Thane; railways soon linked the subcontinent for trade and rule.
summary_zh: 第一列客运火车从孟买开往塔纳，铁路随后连通次大陆，服务于贸易和殖民统治。

title: Taiping Northern Expedition
summary: A Taiping force reached near Tianjin but was annihilated by Senggerinchin.
summary_zh: 太平军北伐逼近天津，被僧格林沁全歼。

title: Convention of Kanagawa
place_zh: 横滨（今日本神奈川县横滨市）
summary: Japan opened Shimoda and Hakodate to American ships, ending over two centuries of seclusion.
summary_zh: 日本向美国开放下田和箱馆两港，持续两百多年的锁国政策结束。

title: Founding of Verny (Almaty)
place_zh: 阿拉木图（今哈萨克斯坦）
summary: Russian troops built the fort of Verny below the Tian Shan, the origin of modern Almaty.
summary_zh: 俄军在天山北麓修建维尔内要塞，这是今天阿拉木图的起源。

title: Bowring Treaty
summary: Siam opened its economy to British trade with low tariffs, a step that helped it avoid colonization.
summary_zh: 暹罗与英国签约，开放贸易并实行低关税，以让步换取独立，开启泰国对外开放。

title: Livingstone reaches Victoria Falls
title_zh: 利文斯敦抵达维多利亚瀑布
place_zh: 维多利亚瀑布（今赞比亚与津巴布韦交界）
summary: On his crossing of Africa from coast to coast, David Livingstone became the first European to see the great falls of the Zambezi.
summary_zh: 戴维·利文斯敦在横穿非洲大陆途中到达赞比西河大瀑布，是第一个见到它的欧洲人。

title: Tianjing Incident
summary: Infighting killed Yang Xiuqing, Wei Changhui and thousands, crippling the Taipings.
summary_zh: 杨秀清、韦昌辉相继被杀，太平天国由盛转衰。

title: Panthay Rebellion
summary: Du Wenxiu led Hui and other peoples in Yunnan, ruling Dali for sixteen years.
summary_zh: 杜文秀在大理建政，抗清十六年。

title: William Walker in Nicaragua
summary: American adventurer William Walker made himself president of Nicaragua until Central American armies drove him out.
summary_zh: 美国冒险家威廉·沃克自封尼加拉瓜总统，后被中美洲各国联军驱逐。

title: Indian Rebellion of 1857
summary: Sepoys at Meerut mutinied over greased cartridges and marched to Delhi; the revolt spread across the north before being crushed.
summary_zh: 密拉特的印度兵因涂油子弹问题哗变并进军德里，起义席卷北印度，最终被镇压。

title: La Reforma and the Constitution of 1857
summary: Liberals led by Benito Juárez limited the power of the Church and army and wrote a liberal constitution.
summary_zh: 以华雷斯为首的自由派限制教会和军队的特权，制定了自由主义宪法。

title: Reform War
summary: Conservatives fought Liberals over the new constitution; Juárez's Liberals won and seized Church property.
summary_zh: 保守派与自由派围绕新宪法爆发内战，华雷斯领导的自由派获胜并没收教会财产。

title: Treaties of Tianjin
summary: After the Western powers take the Dagu forts, the Qing opens more ports and the Yangtze and accepts envoys in Beijing.
summary_zh: 英法联军攻占大沽炮台后，清朝被迫增开口岸、开放长江，并允许外国公使驻京。

title: Crown takes over India
title_zh: 英国王室直接统治印度
place_zh: 阿拉哈巴德（今印度普拉亚格拉杰）
summary: The Government of India Act ended Company rule and the last Mughal emperor was exiled; Queen Victoria's proclamation was read at Allahabad.
summary_zh: 《印度政府法》结束东印度公司统治，末代莫卧儿皇帝被流放，维多利亚女王的宣言在阿拉哈巴德宣读。

title: Treaty of Amity and Commerce with the United States
place_zh: 横滨（今日本神奈川县横滨市）
summary: Under pressure from Townsend Harris, Japan opened more ports and accepted extraterritoriality and fixed tariffs, an unequal treaty.
summary_zh: 在美国领事哈里斯的压力下，日本签约开放更多港口，承认领事裁判权和协定关税，是不平等条约。

title: French invasion of Vietnam
summary: France and Spain attacked Đà Nẵng and then Saigon; in 1862 Vietnam ceded three southern provinces to France.
summary_zh: 法国和西班牙联军进攻岘港和西贡，1862年阮朝被迫割让南圻东三省，越南开始沦为殖民地。

title: Treaty of Aigun
summary: Russia takes the land north of the Amur River.
summary_zh: 沙俄割占黑龙江以北的大片土地。

title: Battle of Sanhe
summary: Chen Yucheng and Li Xiucheng wiped out Li Xubin's elite Xiang Army brigade.
summary_zh: 陈玉成、李秀成歼灭湘军李续宾部。

title: Darwin's On the Origin of Species
summary: Charles Darwin set out the theory of evolution by natural selection, transforming biology.
summary_zh: 达尔文出版《物种起源》，提出以自然选择为核心的生物进化论，引起思想界巨大震动。

title: Hong Rengan's New Treatise
summary: Hong Rengan proposed railways, banks and Western-style reforms for the Taiping state.
summary_zh: 洪仁玕提出《资政新篇》，主张学习西方。

title: Burning of the Old Summer Palace
summary: British and French troops loot and burn the imperial gardens at the end of the Second Opium War.
summary_zh: 第二次鸦片战争末期，英法联军洗劫并焚毁了这座皇家园林。

title: Convention of Peking
summary: Britain, France and Russia extracted Kowloon, Tianjin's opening and the Ussuri territory.
summary_zh: 割九龙、开天津，沙俄割取乌苏里江以东。

title: Choe Je-u founds Donghak
summary: Choe Je-u founded Donghak, Eastern Learning, a new religion that mixed Korean beliefs with Confucian and Buddhist ideas against Western Learning.
summary_zh: 崔济愚创立东学，融合民间信仰和儒佛思想以对抗西学，迅速在农民中传播。

title: 1860 conflict in Lebanon and Damascus
summary: Fighting between Druze and Maronites and a massacre of Christians in Damascus led to French intervention and autonomy for Mount Lebanon.
summary_zh: 德鲁兹派与马龙派冲突，大马士革基督徒遭屠杀，法国出兵干预，黎巴嫩山获得自治。

title: Lincoln elected president
place_zh: 斯普林菲尔德（今美国伊利诺伊州）
summary: Abraham Lincoln of the anti-slavery Republican Party won the presidency, and Southern states began to secede.
summary_zh: 反对奴隶制扩张的共和党人林肯当选总统，南方各州开始脱离联邦。

title: Self-Strengthening Movement
summary: Officials like Zeng Guofan and Li Hongzhang build arsenals, shipyards and schools on Western models.
summary_zh: 曾国藩、李鸿章等官员仿照西方，兴办兵工厂、造船厂和新式学堂。

title: American Civil War
place_zh: 萨姆特堡（今美国南卡罗来纳州）
summary: War began when the Confederacy fired on Fort Sumter; four years of fighting killed over 600,000 and ended slavery.
summary_zh: 南部邦联炮击萨姆特堡引发内战，四年战争造成六十多万人死亡，终结了奴隶制。

title: Xinyou Coup: Cixi takes power
summary: Two empress dowagers and Prince Gong overthrow the regents, and Cixi begins to rule from behind the curtain.
summary_zh: 两宫太后联合恭亲王推翻顾命大臣，慈禧从此垂帘听政。

title: Zongli Yamen created
summary: Prince Gong set up the Zongli Yamen to handle relations with Western powers, China's first foreign-affairs office.
summary_zh: 奕䜣奏设总理各国事务衙门，为中国第一个专门外交机构。

title: Emancipation of the Russian serfs
place_zh: 圣彼得堡（今俄罗斯圣彼得堡）
summary: Alexander II freed some 23 million serfs, though they had to pay for their land.
summary_zh: 亚历山大二世宣布废除农奴制，两千多万农奴获得人身自由，但须赎买土地。

title: Kingdom of Italy proclaimed
summary: After Cavour's diplomacy and Garibaldi's campaigns, Victor Emmanuel II became king of a united Italy.
summary_zh: 经加富尔的外交和加里波第的远征，撒丁国王维克托·伊曼纽尔二世成为意大利国王，意大利基本统一。

title: Battle of Puebla
place_zh: 普埃布拉（今墨西哥普埃布拉州）
summary: On 5 May Mexican troops beat the invading French army at Puebla, the day celebrated as Cinco de Mayo.
summary_zh: 5月5日墨西哥军队在普埃布拉击败入侵法军，这一天后来成为五月五日节。

title: Tongwen Guan school opens
summary: The government's first school of foreign languages, later adding science.
summary_zh: 清朝第一所官办外语学校成立，后来又增设算学和科学课程。

title: Shaanxi-Gansu Hui uprising
summary: Hui-Han violence in Shaanxi grew into a revolt across the northwest, finally suppressed by Zuo Zongtang.
summary_zh: 陕西回汉冲突引发大规模回民起义，蔓延西北，后被左宗棠镇压。

title: Emancipation Proclamation
place_zh: 华盛顿（今美国哥伦比亚特区）
summary: Lincoln declared enslaved people in the rebel states free, making the war a fight against slavery.
summary_zh: 林肯宣布叛乱各州的奴隶获得自由，使内战成为废除奴隶制的战争。

title: Battle of Gettysburg
place_zh: 葛底斯堡（今美国宾夕法尼亚州）
summary: Union forces stopped Lee's invasion of the North in the war's bloodiest battle; Lincoln later gave the Gettysburg Address here.
summary_zh: 北方军在内战最惨烈的战役中阻止了李将军北侵，林肯随后在此发表葛底斯堡演说。

title: Heungseon Daewongun's regency
summary: When Gojong became king as a boy, his father the Daewongun ruled, rebuilt Gyeongbokgung and enforced a closed-door policy.
summary_zh: 高宗幼年即位，其父兴宣大院君摄政，重建景福宫，推行锁国政策。

title: Shi Dakai trapped at the Dadu River
summary: Shi Dakai's army was trapped by floods and Qing troops at the Dadu River; he surrendered and was executed in Chengdu.
summary_zh: 石达开部受阻大渡河，全军覆没，石达开在成都被杀。

title: Cambodia becomes a French protectorate
title_zh: 柬埔寨成为法国保护国
place_zh: 乌栋（今柬埔寨磅士卑省）
summary: King Norodom accepted French protection to escape pressure from Siam and Vietnam.
summary_zh: 诺罗敦国王为摆脱暹罗和越南的控制，接受法国保护，柬埔寨成为法国保护国。

title: Paraguayan War
summary: Paraguay fought Brazil, Argentina and Uruguay together and was crushed, losing a large share of its population.
summary_zh: 巴拉圭与巴西、阿根廷、乌拉圭三国同盟交战，惨败，人口大量减少。

title: Fall of Tianjing
summary: Zeng Guoquan's Xiang Army stormed Nanjing weeks after Hong Xiuquan's death, effectively ending the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom.
summary_zh: 洪秀全病逝后，曾国荃率湘军攻破天京，太平天国失败。

title: Second Mexican Empire
summary: France installed the Austrian archduke Maximilian as emperor of Mexico, while Juárez kept up the republic's resistance.
summary_zh: 法国扶植奥地利大公马克西米利安为墨西哥皇帝，华雷斯坚持共和国抵抗。

title: Russian capture of Tashkent
summary: General Chernyayev stormed Tashkent, the largest city of Central Asia, beginning the Russian conquest of the khanates.
summary_zh: 切尔尼亚耶夫将军攻占中亚最大城市塔什干，沙俄征服中亚各汗国由此开始。

title: Jiangnan Arsenal founded
summary: Zeng Guofan and Li Hongzhang founded the largest Self-Strengthening arsenal, which also translated Western science books.
summary_zh: 曾国藩、李鸿章创办江南制造总局，兼设翻译馆译介西书。

title: Assassination of Abraham Lincoln
place_zh: 福特剧院（今美国华盛顿）
summary: John Wilkes Booth shot Lincoln days after the war ended, leaving Reconstruction to Andrew Johnson.
summary_zh: 内战结束数日后林肯遭布思枪杀，重建工作落到安德鲁·约翰逊手中。

title: Thirteenth Amendment
title_zh: 美国宪法第十三修正案
place_zh: 华盛顿（今美国哥伦比亚特区）
summary: The amendment abolished slavery throughout the United States.
summary_zh: 第十三修正案获批准，在美国全境正式废除奴隶制和强迫劳役。

title: Mendel's laws of inheritance
summary: The monk Gregor Mendel reported his pea experiments, which later became the foundation of genetics.
summary_zh: 修道士孟德尔发表豌豆杂交实验结果，提出遗传规律，后来成为遗传学的基础。

title: Surrender at Appomattox
place_zh: 阿波马托克斯（今美国弗吉尼亚州）
summary: Robert E. Lee surrendered his army to Ulysses S. Grant, effectively ending the Civil War.
summary_zh: 南军统帅罗伯特·李向格兰特投降，南北战争实际宣告结束。

title: Satsuma-Chōshū Alliance
summary: Sakamoto Ryōma brokered an alliance between the rival Satsuma and Chōshū domains to overthrow the shogunate.
summary_zh: 在坂本龙马斡旋下，萨摩藩与长州藩结成同盟，共同推翻幕府。

title: French campaign against Korea
place_zh: 江华岛（今韩国仁川江华郡）
summary: After the execution of French missionaries, a French fleet attacked Ganghwa Island but withdrew after defeats.
summary_zh: 朝鲜处死法国传教士后，法国舰队进攻江华岛，受挫后撤退。

title: Canadian Confederation
place_zh: 渥太华（今加拿大安大略省）
summary: The British North America Act united Ontario, Quebec, Nova Scotia and New Brunswick into the self-governing Dominion of Canada.
summary_zh: 《英属北美法案》将安大略、魁北克、新斯科舍和新不伦瑞克合为自治的加拿大自治领。

title: Restoration of power to the emperor
summary: The last shogun, Tokugawa Yoshinobu, returned governing power to the emperor at Nijō Castle, ending the shogunate.
summary_zh: 末代将军德川庆喜在二条城宣布将政权奉还天皇，江户幕府结束。

title: Governorate-General of Turkestan
summary: Russia created the Governorate-General of Turkestan under Konstantin von Kaufman, with its seat at Tashkent.
summary_zh: 沙俄设立突厥斯坦总督区，以塔什干为首府，由考夫曼任总督，统治新征服的中亚地区。

title: Diamonds found at Kimberley
place_zh: 金伯利（今南非北开普省）
summary: The discovery of diamonds drew miners and capital to the interior and began South Africa's mining economy and its system of migrant black labour.
summary_zh: 钻石的发现吸引大批矿工和资本涌入内陆，开启南非的矿业经济和黑人流动劳工制度。

title: Alaska Purchase
place_zh: 锡特卡（今美国阿拉斯加州）
summary: The United States bought Alaska from Russia for 7.2 million dollars.
summary_zh: 美国以720万美元从俄国购得阿拉斯加，当时被讥为“西华德的蠢事”。

title: Austro-Hungarian Compromise
place_zh: 布达佩斯（今匈牙利布达佩斯）
summary: Austria and Hungary became a dual monarchy with one emperor-king and separate governments.
summary_zh: 奥地利与匈牙利达成妥协，组成奥匈帝国，共奉一个君主，各设政府和议会。

title: Meiji Restoration
summary: The new imperial government moved to Tokyo and set out to build a modern, centralised state with Western industry and an army.
summary_zh: 新政府以天皇名义执政，迁都东京，推行富国强兵、殖产兴业和文明开化，日本走上现代化道路。

title: Chulalongkorn's reforms
summary: King Chulalongkorn abolished slavery, set up ministries and modern schools, and kept Siam independent.
summary_zh: 拉玛五世朱拉隆功废除奴隶制，设立内阁各部和新式学校，推动暹罗现代化并保持独立。

title: Boshin War
place_zh: 鸟羽伏见（今日本京都市伏见区）
summary: Imperial forces defeated the shogun's army at Toba-Fushimi, took Edo without a fight and crushed the last resistance at Hakodate in 1869.
summary_zh: 新政府军在鸟羽伏见击败幕府军，和平接收江户，1869年攻克箱馆，内战结束。

title: Bukhara becomes a Russian protectorate
title_zh: 布哈拉沦为俄国保护国
summary: Russia took Samarkand and defeated the emir at Zerabulak, and Bukhara became a protectorate.
summary_zh: 俄军攻占撒马尔罕并在泽拉布拉克击败布哈拉军，布哈拉埃米尔国沦为俄国保护国。

title: Charter Oath
place_zh: 京都御所（今日本京都市）
summary: The young Emperor Meiji promised deliberative assemblies and to seek knowledge throughout the world.
summary_zh: 明治天皇发布五条誓文，宣布“广兴会议，万机决于公论”“求知识于世界”，确定新政方针。

title: British expedition to Abyssinia
place_zh: 马格达拉（今埃塞俄比亚）
summary: A British army stormed Tewodros II's fortress at Magdala to free captive envoys, and the emperor shot himself rather than surrender.
summary_zh: 英军攻破特沃德罗斯二世的马格达拉要塞以解救被扣使节，皇帝宁死不降，开枪自尽。

title: Suez Canal opens
summary: The canal built by Ferdinand de Lesseps's company linked the Mediterranean and Red Sea, cutting the sea route from Europe to Asia.
summary_zh: 由雷赛布的公司开凿的运河连通地中海和红海，大大缩短了欧洲到亚洲的航程。

title: First transcontinental railroad
place_zh: 普罗蒙特里峰（今美国犹他州）
summary: The Union Pacific and Central Pacific lines met at Promontory; thousands of Chinese workers built the western section.
summary_zh: 联合太平洋铁路与中央太平洋铁路在普罗蒙特里接轨，西段主要由数以万计的华工修建。

title: Mendeleev's periodic table
place_zh: 圣彼得堡（今俄罗斯圣彼得堡）
summary: Dmitri Mendeleev arranged the elements by atomic weight and predicted elements not yet found.
summary_zh: 门捷列夫按原子量排列化学元素，制成元素周期表，并预言了尚未发现的元素。

title: Red River Rebellion
place_zh: 温尼伯（今加拿大马尼托巴省）
summary: Louis Riel led the Métis in setting up a provisional government, which led to the creation of Manitoba in 1870.
summary_zh: 路易·瑞尔领导梅蒂人成立临时政府，促成1870年马尼托巴省的建立。

title: Franco-Prussian War
summary: Prussia and the German states crushed France and captured Napoleon III at Sedan.
summary_zh: 普鲁士联合德意志各邦击败法国，在色当俘虏拿破仑三世，法兰西第二帝国崩溃。

title: Tianjin Massacre
summary: Rumours about a French orphanage led a crowd to kill nuns, priests and the French consul; Zeng Guofan's settlement was widely condemned.
summary_zh: 民众因育婴堂传闻焚毁教堂、杀死法国领事等，曾国藩处理遭非议。

title: Arab Renaissance (Nahda)
summary: Writers in Beirut and Cairo such as Butrus al-Bustani revived Arabic literature through newspapers, dictionaries and an encyclopedia.
summary_zh: 布特鲁斯·布斯塔尼等贝鲁特和开罗文人创办报刊，编纂词典和百科全书，复兴阿拉伯语文学。

title: Proclamation of the German Empire
place_zh: 凡尔赛宫镜厅（今法国凡尔赛）
summary: Wilhelm I was proclaimed German Emperor at Versailles, completing Bismarck's unification of Germany.
summary_zh: 普鲁士国王威廉一世在凡尔赛宫镜厅加冕为德意志皇帝，俾斯麦主导的德意志统一完成。

title: Paris Commune
summary: Paris workers and the National Guard set up their own government for two months before it was crushed in Bloody Week.
summary_zh: 巴黎工人和国民自卫军建立巴黎公社，存在两个多月后在“五月流血周”中被镇压。

title: Abolition of the han system
summary: The government replaced the feudal domains with prefectures run by appointed governors, completing central control.
summary_zh: 政府废除各藩，改设由中央任命知事的府县，完成了中央集权。

title: Iwakura Mission
place_zh: 横滨（今日本神奈川县横滨市）
summary: Iwakura Tomomi led leaders such as Ōkubo Toshimichi on a two-year tour of the US and Europe to study modern states.
summary_zh: 岩仓具视率大久保利通、伊藤博文等出访欧美近两年，考察各国制度，回国后推动全面改革。

title: Chinese Educational Mission
summary: The first of 120 Chinese boys sail to study in New England.
summary_zh: 首批留美幼童从上海出发，前后共一百二十人赴美国新英格兰求学。

title: China Merchants' Steam Navigation Company
summary: Li Hongzhang founded a government-supervised, merchant-managed shipping company to compete with foreign lines.
summary_zh: 李鸿章创办轮船招商局，官督商办，与外商争利。

title: Russian conquest of Khiva
summary: A Russian expedition crossed the desert and took Khiva, which became a protectorate and freed its Persian slaves.
summary_zh: 俄军穿越沙漠攻占希瓦，希瓦汗国沦为保护国，被迫释放奴隶。

title: Land Tax Reform
summary: Taxes were now paid in money at 3 percent of assessed land value, giving the state a stable income.
summary_zh: 政府改为按地价的百分之三以货币征收地租，确立了稳定的国家财政收入。

title: Aceh War
place_zh: 班达亚齐（今印度尼西亚）
summary: The Dutch invaded the sultanate of Aceh and fought one of the longest colonial wars in history.
summary_zh: 荷兰入侵亚齐苏丹国，亚齐人长期抵抗，成为殖民史上历时最久的战争之一。

title: Japanese expedition to Taiwan
summary: Japan attacked Paiwan villages over the killing of Ryukyuan sailors; the Qing paid an indemnity, weakening its claim to Ryukyu.
summary_zh: 日本借琉球船民被杀出兵台湾，清廷赔款了事。

title: First Impressionist exhibition
summary: Monet, Renoir, Degas and others held their own exhibition. A critic mocked Monet's Impression, Sunrise, giving the movement its name.
summary_zh: 莫奈、雷诺阿、德加等人举办独立画展，评论家借莫奈《日出·印象》嘲讽他们，印象派由此得名。

title: Treaty of Ganghwa
place_zh: 江华岛（今韩国仁川江华郡）
summary: After the Unyo incident, Japan forced Joseon to sign an unequal treaty opening three ports, ending its isolation.
summary_zh: 云扬号事件后，日本迫使朝鲜签订不平等的《江华岛条约》，开放三个港口，朝鲜被迫开国。

title: Porfiriato
summary: Porfirio Díaz ruled Mexico for over 30 years, building railways and attracting foreign capital while peasants lost land.
summary_zh: 迪亚斯统治墨西哥三十多年，修铁路、引外资，但农民大量失去土地。

title: Great North China Famine
summary: Drought brings one of the worst famines in history; around 9 to 13 million people die.
summary_zh: 华北大旱引发历史上最严重的饥荒之一，约九百万至一千三百万人死亡。

title: Zuo Zongtang recovers Xinjiang
summary: Zuo Zongtang's army destroyed Yaqub Beg's regime and retook all of Xinjiang except Ili.
summary_zh: 左宗棠率军消灭阿古柏政权，收复除伊犁外的新疆。

title: Bell patents the telephone
place_zh: 波士顿（今美国马萨诸塞州）
summary: Alexander Graham Bell patented the telephone and made the first call to his assistant.
summary_zh: 亚历山大·格雷厄姆·贝尔获得电话专利，并首次通话。

title: First Ottoman constitution
title_zh: 奥斯曼帝国第一部宪法
summary: The empire got a constitution and parliament, but Abdul Hamid II suspended both in 1878 and ruled alone for thirty years.
summary_zh: 奥斯曼帝国颁布宪法并召开议会，但阿卜杜勒·哈米德二世于1878年将其中止，此后独裁三十年。

title: Battle of the Little Bighorn
place_zh: 小大角河（今美国蒙大拿州）
summary: Lakota and Cheyenne warriors led by Sitting Bull and Crazy Horse wiped out Custer's cavalry.
summary_zh: 坐牛和疯马率领的拉科塔人和夏延人全歼卡斯特的骑兵部队。

title: Satsuma Rebellion
place_zh: 鹿儿岛（今日本鹿儿岛市）
summary: Saigō Takamori led discontented samurai against the government and was defeated by the new conscript army, the last samurai revolt.
summary_zh: 西乡隆盛率不满的士族起兵反抗政府，被新式征兵军队击败，这是最后一次士族叛乱。

title: Rubber comes to Malaya
place_zh: 江沙（今马来西亚霹雳州）
summary: Rubber seedlings from Kew were planted in Malaya; rubber and tin made it a key colonial economy and drew Chinese and Indian workers.
summary_zh: 英国从邱园引种橡胶到马来亚，橡胶与锡矿成为殖民经济支柱，吸引大批华人和印度劳工。

title: Compromise of 1877 ends Reconstruction
place_zh: 华盛顿（今美国哥伦比亚特区）
summary: Federal troops left the South in return for Hayes becoming president, ending Reconstruction and leaving Black rights unprotected.
summary_zh: 以海斯就任总统为交换，联邦军队撤出南方，重建结束，黑人权利失去保障。

title: Conquest of the Desert
place_zh: 乔埃莱乔埃尔（今阿根廷内格罗河省）
summary: Argentina's army under Julio Roca conquered the Pampas and Patagonia from indigenous peoples, opening them to ranching.
summary_zh: 罗卡率阿根廷军队征服潘帕斯和巴塔哥尼亚的原住民，把这些土地开辟为牧场。

title: War of the Pacific
summary: Chile defeated Peru and Bolivia in a war over nitrate deposits, took the Atacama coast and left Bolivia without a seacoast.
summary_zh: 智利为争夺硝石产地击败秘鲁和玻利维亚，夺得阿塔卡马沿海地区，玻利维亚从此成为内陆国。

title: Urabi revolt
summary: Colonel Ahmed Urabi led Egyptian officers against the Khedive and European control under the slogan Egypt for the Egyptians.
summary_zh: 奥拉比上校率埃及军官反对赫迪夫和欧洲控制，提出“埃及是埃及人的埃及”。

title: Ryukyu Disposition
place_zh: 首里（今日本冲绳县那霸市）
summary: Japan abolished the Ryukyu Kingdom and made it Okinawa Prefecture, despite Qing protests.
summary_zh: 日本废除琉球王国，改设冲绳县，清政府虽表示抗议但未能阻止。

title: Battle of Isandlwana
place_zh: 伊散德尔瓦纳（今南非夸祖鲁-纳塔尔省）
summary: In the Anglo-Zulu War a Zulu army destroyed a British column, one of the worst defeats of a colonial army, though Britain conquered Zululand within months.
summary_zh: 英祖战争中祖鲁军队全歼一支英军，是殖民军队最惨重的失败之一，但英国数月后仍征服了祖鲁兰。

title: Edison's light bulb
place_zh: 门洛帕克（今美国新泽西州）
summary: Thomas Edison's lab made a long-lasting incandescent bulb and then built electric power systems.
summary_zh: 爱迪生实验室研制出耐用白炽灯，随后建立电力供应系统。

title: Amazon rubber boom
place_zh: 马瑙斯（今巴西亚马孙州）
summary: Demand for rubber made Manaus rich enough to build an opera house, while rubber tappers and indigenous people suffered harsh labour.
summary_zh: 世界对橡胶的需求使马瑙斯富甲一方，建起歌剧院，割胶工人和原住民却饱受奴役。

title: Mass European immigration to Argentina
title_zh: 欧洲移民大批涌入阿根廷
place_zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯（今阿根廷）
summary: Millions of Italians and Spaniards settled in Argentina, turning Buenos Aires into a great city and the pampas into a grain and beef exporter.
summary_zh: 数百万意大利和西班牙移民来到阿根廷，布宜诺斯艾利斯成为大都市，潘帕斯草原成为粮食和牛肉出口基地。

title: Battle of Geok Tepe
place_zh: 格奥克捷佩（今土库曼斯坦）
summary: Skobelev stormed the Teke Turkmen fortress of Geok Tepe with great slaughter, completing the conquest of the Turkmen.
summary_zh: 斯科别列夫攻破捷金土库曼人的格奥克捷佩要塞并大肆屠杀，沙俄完成对土库曼的征服。

title: Treaty of Bardo: French protectorate over Tunisia
summary: French troops forced the Bey of Tunis to accept a protectorate, bringing Tunisia under French rule.
summary_zh: 法军迫使突尼斯贝伊接受保护国地位，突尼斯沦为法国的保护国。

title: Freedom and People's Rights Movement
summary: Activists demanded an elected assembly; in 1881 the government promised a parliament within ten years.
summary_zh: 民间人士要求开设国会、制定宪法，1881年政府承诺十年后开设国会。

title: Battle of Tel el-Kebir and British occupation
place_zh: 泰勒凯比尔（今埃及东部省）
summary: British forces defeated Urabi at Tel el-Kebir and occupied Egypt, which became a de facto British protectorate.
summary_zh: 英军在泰勒凯比尔击败奥拉比，占领埃及，埃及实际上沦为英国的保护国。

title: Chinese Exclusion Act
place_zh: 华盛顿（今美国哥伦比亚特区）
summary: The first US law to bar immigrants by nationality stopped Chinese laborers from entering for decades.
summary_zh: 美国首部按国籍限制移民的法律，此后数十年禁止华工入境。

title: Triple Alliance
place_zh: 维也纳（今奥地利维也纳）
summary: Germany, Austria-Hungary and Italy formed a secret defensive alliance, one of the two blocs before World War I.
summary_zh: 德国、奥匈帝国和意大利缔结秘密军事同盟，形成一战前对立的两大军事集团之一。

title: First Aliyah
summary: Jews fleeing pogroms in Russia began settling in Ottoman Palestine, founding farming colonies; Zionism grew from this.
summary_zh: 躲避俄国迫害的犹太人开始移居奥斯曼统治下的巴勒斯坦，建立农业定居点，犹太复国运动由此兴起。

title: Imo Incident
summary: Unpaid soldiers rioted in Seoul and attacked the Japanese legation. Qing troops restored order and raised their influence.
summary_zh: 因军饷拖欠，汉城士兵发动兵变并袭击日本公使馆，清军入朝平定，加强了对朝鲜的控制。

title: Eruption of Krakatoa
place_zh: 喀拉喀托火山（今印度尼西亚巽他海峡）
summary: The explosion of Krakatoa and its tsunamis killed over 36,000 people, and its ash cooled the world's climate.
summary_zh: 喀拉喀托火山猛烈爆发并引发海啸，造成三万六千多人死亡，火山灰影响全球气候。

title: Berlin Conference
summary: European powers met in Berlin to set rules for claiming African territory, opening the Scramble for Africa without any African present.
summary_zh: 欧洲列强在柏林开会，制定瓜分非洲领土的规则，在没有任何非洲人参加的情况下开启了瓜分非洲的狂潮。

title: Battle of Fuzhou
summary: A French squadron destroys the Fujian Fleet in under an hour at the start of the Sino-French War.
summary_zh: 中法战争中，法国舰队在不到一小时内摧毁了福建水师。

title: Xinjiang becomes a province
summary: The Qing made Xinjiang a regular province with Liu Jintang as first governor.
summary_zh: 清廷设新疆省，刘锦棠任首任巡抚。

title: Gapsin Coup
summary: Reformers led by Kim Ok-gyun seized power with Japanese help, but Qing troops under Yuan Shikai crushed the coup in three days.
summary_zh: 金玉均等开化派在日本支持下发动政变，三天后被袁世凯率领的清军镇压。

title: Indian National Congress founded
place_zh: 孟买（今印度马哈拉施特拉邦）
summary: Educated Indians met in Bombay to found the Congress, which grew into the main party of the independence movement.
summary_zh: 受过教育的印度人在孟买创立国大党，后来发展为独立运动的主要政党。

title: Congo Free State
place_zh: 博马（今刚果民主共和国）
summary: King Leopold II of Belgium ruled the Congo as his private property, and forced rubber collection there cost millions of lives.
summary_zh: 比利时国王利奥波德二世把刚果当作私人领地，强迫当地人采集橡胶，造成数百万人死亡。

title: Victory at Zhennan Pass
summary: Veteran general Feng Zicai routed the French, leading to the fall of the Ferry ministry in Paris.
summary_zh: 冯子材在镇南关大败法军，法国茹费理内阁倒台。

title: Fall of Khartoum
summary: Forces of the Mahdi Muhammad Ahmad stormed Khartoum and killed General Gordon, founding a Mahdist state in Sudan.
summary_zh: 马赫迪穆罕默德·艾哈迈德的军队攻破喀土穆，击毙戈登将军，在苏丹建立马赫迪国家。

title: Canadian Pacific Railway completed
title_zh: 加拿大太平洋铁路建成
place_zh: 克雷格拉希（今加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省）
summary: The last spike linked eastern Canada with British Columbia; Chinese workers built much of the mountain section.
summary_zh: 最后一颗道钉打下，连通加拿大东部与不列颠哥伦比亚，山区路段多由华工修建。

title: Third Anglo-Burmese War
summary: Britain took Mandalay and exiled King Thibaw, ending the Burmese monarchy and annexing all of Burma to British India.
summary_zh: 英军攻占曼德勒，流放锡袍王，贡榜王朝灭亡，缅甸全境并入英属印度。

title: North-West Rebellion
place_zh: 巴托什（今加拿大萨斯喀彻温省）
summary: Louis Riel led the Métis in a second rising; it was crushed and Riel was hanged.
summary_zh: 路易·瑞尔领导梅蒂人再次起义，被镇压后瑞尔被处绞刑。

title: Benz Patent-Motorwagen
summary: Carl Benz patented a vehicle driven by a petrol engine, generally regarded as the first modern automobile.
summary_zh: 卡尔·本茨为内燃机驱动的三轮车申请专利，通常被视为第一辆现代汽车。

title: Witwatersrand Gold Rush
title_zh: 威特沃特斯兰德淘金热
summary: The discovery of the world's richest gold reef led to the founding of Johannesburg and drew Britain into conflict with the Boer republics.
summary_zh: 世界最大金矿脉的发现催生了约翰内斯堡，并使英国与布尔人共和国的矛盾激化。

title: Haymarket affair
place_zh: 芝加哥（今美国伊利诺伊州）
summary: A bomb at a rally for the eight-hour day in Chicago led to executions of anarchists; May Day commemorates it.
summary_zh: 芝加哥争取八小时工作制的集会发生爆炸，多名无政府主义者被处死，五一劳动节由此而来。

title: French Indochina formed
summary: France joined Cochinchina, Annam, Tonkin and Cambodia into the Indochinese Union; Laos was added in 1893.
summary_zh: 法国将交趾支那、安南、东京和柬埔寨合组为印度支那联邦，1893年又并入老挝。

title: Abolition of slavery in Brazil
summary: Princess Isabel signed the Golden Law freeing all slaves; Brazil was the last country in the Americas to end slavery.
summary_zh: 伊莎贝尔公主签署《黄金法》，解放全部奴隶，巴西是美洲最后一个废除奴隶制的国家。

title: Beiyang Fleet formally established
summary: Li Hongzhang's northern fleet, built around German battleships, became Asia's largest navy on paper.
summary_zh: 北洋水师正式成军，以定远、镇远为主力。

title: Trans-Caspian Railway reaches Samarkand
title_zh: 外里海铁路通到撒马尔罕
summary: The railway from the Caspian reached Samarkand, tying Central Asia to Russia and speeding the spread of cotton growing.
summary_zh: 外里海铁路修到撒马尔罕，把中亚与俄国连成一体，推动了棉花种植的扩张。

title: Meiji Constitution
summary: Drafted by Itō Hirobumi on the Prussian model, the constitution created a Diet but kept supreme power with the emperor.
summary_zh: 伊藤博文仿照普鲁士宪法起草的宪法颁布，设立帝国议会，但天皇握有最高权力，日本成为亚洲第一个立宪国家。

title: Proclamation of the Republic in Brazil
summary: Army officers overthrew Emperor Pedro II and declared Brazil a republic.
summary_zh: 军官发动政变推翻皇帝佩德罗二世，宣布巴西为共和国。

title: Wounded Knee Massacre
place_zh: 伤膝河（今美国南达科他州）
summary: US soldiers killed about 250 Lakota, marking the end of the Indian Wars.
summary_zh: 美军杀害约250名拉科塔人，标志着印第安战争的结束。

title: Abai's Book of Words
summary: The poet Abai Qunanbaiuly wrote his prose Book of Words, founding modern Kazakh written literature.
summary_zh: 诗人阿拜写成《箴言录》，倡导学习知识和改良社会，是现代哈萨克书面文学的奠基人。

title: Tobacco Protest
summary: After the shah sold a tobacco monopoly to a British company, a fatwa led Iranians to stop smoking until the concession was cancelled in 1892.
summary_zh: 国王把烟草专卖权卖给英国公司后，宗教学者发布禁烟教令，民众集体戒烟，1892年专卖权被迫取消。

title: First Sino-Japanese War
summary: Japan sinks the Beiyang Fleet. China gives up Taiwan in the Treaty of Shimonoseki.
summary_zh: 日本击溃北洋舰队，清朝在《马关条约》中割让台湾。

title: Donghak Peasant Revolution
place_zh: 古阜（今韩国全罗北道井邑）
summary: Peasants led by Jeon Bong-jun rose against corruption and foreign influence. Both Qing and Japan sent troops, which led to war.
summary_zh: 全琫准领导农民反抗贪官和外国势力，清朝和日本均出兵朝鲜，引发甲午战争。

title: Battle of the Yellow Sea
summary: The Beiyang Fleet lost five ships to Japan's fleet; Deng Shichang went down with the Zhiyuan.
summary_zh: 北洋水师与日舰激战，致远舰沉没，邓世昌殉国。

title: Gabo Reform
summary: Under Japanese pressure the government abolished the class system, the civil exam and slavery, and modernized the administration.
summary_zh: 在日本压力下，朝鲜政府废除身份等级制度、科举和奴婢制度，推行近代化改革。

title: Treaty of Shimonoseki
summary: Li Hongzhang ceded Taiwan and Penghu, recognised Korean independence, paid 200 million taels and opened ports to Japanese factories.
summary_zh: 李鸿章签约割台湾、澎湖，赔款二亿两，允日本设厂。

title: Petition of the examination candidates
summary: Kang Youwei and Liang Qichao led provincial candidates in petitioning against the treaty and for reform.
summary_zh: 康有为、梁启超联合举人上书，反对议和、要求变法。

title: Assassination of Queen Min
summary: Japanese agents broke into Gyeongbokgung and murdered Queen Min, who had sought Russian help against Japan.
summary_zh: 日本人闯入景福宫杀害主张联俄抗日的闵妃（明成皇后），激起朝鲜民众强烈反日。

title: Weihaiwei falls; Beiyang Fleet surrenders
summary: Japanese forces took Weihaiwei; Ding Ruchang killed himself and the Beiyang Fleet was lost.
summary_zh: 日军攻陷威海卫，丁汝昌自杀，北洋水师覆灭。

title: Triple Intervention
summary: Russia, Germany and France forced Japan to return the Liaodong Peninsula for extra indemnity.
summary_zh: 俄德法干涉，日本归还辽东半岛，清加赎银三千万两。

title: Republic of Formosa resists Japan
summary: Taiwanese officials declared a republic; Liu Yongfu's Black Flags resisted Japanese occupation for months.
summary_zh: 台湾士绅成立台湾民主国，刘永福等抗日数月。

title: Rontgen discovers X-rays
place_zh: 维尔茨堡（今德国维尔茨堡）
summary: Wilhelm Rontgen found rays that pass through flesh, at once used in medicine. He won the first Nobel Prize in Physics.
summary_zh: 伦琴发现能穿透人体的X射线，很快应用于医学，他因此获得首届诺贝尔物理学奖。

title: Philippine Revolution
summary: The Katipunan rose against Spanish rule; the Spanish execution of José Rizal that December made him a national martyr.
summary_zh: 秘密组织卡蒂普南发动反西班牙起义，同年12月黎刹被处决，成为菲律宾民族英雄。

title: Battle of Adwa
place_zh: 阿杜瓦（今埃塞俄比亚提格雷州）
summary: Emperor Menelik II defeated an Italian army, so Ethiopia kept its independence and became a symbol of African resistance.
summary_zh: 皇帝孟尼利克二世击败意大利军队，埃塞俄比亚保住独立，成为非洲反抗殖民的象征。

title: First modern Olympic Games
place_zh: 帕纳辛奈科体育场（今希腊雅典）
summary: Pierre de Coubertin revived the Olympic Games, held in Athens with athletes from 14 nations.
summary_zh: 在顾拜旦推动下，第一届现代奥林匹克运动会在雅典举行，14个国家的运动员参加。

title: Independence Club
summary: Seo Jae-pil and others founded the Independence Club and the Tongnip sinmun, the first Korean-language newspaper.
summary_zh: 徐载弼等人创立独立协会并发行《独立新闻》，这是第一份韩文报纸，宣传自主独立和民权思想。

title: Klondike Gold Rush
place_zh: 道森市（今加拿大育空地区）
summary: Gold in the Yukon drew about 100,000 prospectors north and opened up the Canadian far northwest.
summary_zh: 育空发现黄金，约十万淘金者北上，加拿大西北边疆由此开发。

title: Proclamation of the Korean Empire
summary: Gojong returned from the Russian legation and proclaimed himself emperor of the Korean Empire, asserting independence.
summary_zh: 高宗从俄国公使馆还宫，在圜丘坛称帝，改国号为大韩帝国，宣示独立自主。

title: Germany seizes Jiaozhou Bay
summary: Using the killing of two missionaries, Germany seized Jiaozhou Bay, triggering a scramble for concessions.
summary_zh: 德国借巨野教案强占胶州湾，列强掀起瓜分狂潮。

title: Hundred Days' Reform
summary: The Guangxu Emperor backs Kang Youwei's reforms until Empress Dowager Cixi stops them.
summary_zh: 光绪帝支持康有为推行变法，被慈禧太后发动政变中止。

title: Imperial University of Peking founded
summary: Founded during the Hundred Days' Reform, it survived the coup and became Peking University.
summary_zh: 戊戌变法中创办京师大学堂，即北京大学前身。

title: Spanish-American War
summary: After the USS Maine blew up in Havana, the United States beat Spain and took Puerto Rico, Guam and the Philippines.
summary_zh: 缅因号在哈瓦那爆炸后美国对西班牙开战，获胜后取得波多黎各、关岛和菲律宾。

title: Yan Fu's translation of Evolution and Ethics
summary: Yan Fu's adaptation of Huxley popularised social Darwinism: 'survival of the fittest'.
summary_zh: 严复译述《天演论》，传播物竞天择思想。

title: Six Gentlemen executed
summary: After Cixi's coup, Tan Sitong and five other reformers were executed without trial.
summary_zh: 慈禧政变后，谭嗣同等六人被斩于菜市口。

title: Battle of Omdurman
summary: Kitchener's Anglo-Egyptian army with machine guns destroyed the Mahdist forces, and Sudan came under Anglo-Egyptian rule.
summary_zh: 基奇纳率英埃联军以机枪击溃马赫迪军队，苏丹落入英埃共管之下。

title: Oracle bone script identified
summary: Wang Yirong recognised inscriptions on 'dragon bones' as Shang writing.
summary_zh: 王懿荣辨识龙骨上刻辞为商代文字。

title: Philippine-American War
summary: Filipino forces fought the United States, which defeated the First Republic and made the Philippines an American colony.
summary_zh: 菲律宾军队抗击美国，第一共和国失败，菲律宾沦为美国殖民地。

title: Second Boer War
summary: Britain fought the Transvaal and Orange Free State and won only after scorched-earth tactics and concentration camps where tens of thousands died.
summary_zh: 英国与德兰士瓦和奥兰治自由邦开战，靠焦土政策和集中营才取胜，数万人死于集中营。

title: United Fruit Company founded
summary: United Fruit built a banana empire of plantations and railways in Central America, giving rise to the term banana republic.
summary_zh: 联合果品公司在中美洲建立香蕉种植园和铁路帝国，催生了香蕉共和国一词。

title: Boxer Rebellion
summary: Boxers besiege the foreign legations and an eight-nation army occupies Beijing.
summary_zh: 义和团围攻各国使馆，八国联军攻占北京。

title: Dunhuang Library Cave discovered
summary: Wang Yuanlu found a sealed cave of tens of thousands of manuscripts, many later taken abroad.
summary_zh: 王圆箓发现藏经洞，大量文书后流散海外。

title: Mutual Protection of Southeast China
summary: Southern governors-general ignored the war edict and agreed with the powers to keep order.
summary_zh: 东南督抚拒奉宣战诏书，与列强约定互保。

title: New Policies proclaimed
summary: From exile in Xi'an, Cixi announced sweeping reforms in education, army and administration.
summary_zh: 慈禧在西安下诏变法，推行新政。

title: Boxer Protocol
summary: China must pay 450 million taels and let foreign troops guard the legations and the road to the sea.
summary_zh: 清朝须赔款四亿五千万两，并允许外国军队驻守使馆区及北京至海口的要地。

title: Ibn Saud retakes Riyadh
summary: Young Abdulaziz ibn Saud seized Riyadh from the Rashidis in a night raid, the start of the third Saudi state.
summary_zh: 年轻的阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹·伊本·沙特夜袭夺回利雅得，第三沙特国家由此开始。

title: Anglo-Japanese Alliance
summary: Britain and Japan allied against Russian expansion in East Asia, the first alliance between a Western power and an Asian state on equal terms.
summary_zh: 英国与日本结盟共同对付俄国在东亚的扩张，日本由此获得强国支持。

title: Wright brothers' first flight
place_zh: 基蒂霍克（今美国北卡罗来纳州）
summary: Orville and Wilbur Wright made the first controlled, powered airplane flight.
summary_zh: 莱特兄弟实现人类首次有动力、可操纵的飞机飞行。

title: Subao case
summary: Zhang Binglin and Zou Rong were tried in the International Settlement for revolutionary writings.
summary_zh: 章炳麟、邹容因鼓吹革命被租界会审公廨审判。

title: Separation of Panama from Colombia
title_zh: 巴拿马脱离哥伦比亚独立
summary: With US backing Panama broke away from Colombia and granted the United States the Canal Zone.
summary_zh: 巴拿马在美国支持下脱离哥伦比亚独立，并把运河区租让给美国。

title: Russo-Japanese War
summary: Japan and Russia fought over Korea and Manchuria, largely on Chinese soil; Japan's victory made it a world power.
summary_zh: 日俄两国为争夺朝鲜和中国东北在中国领土上交战，日本获胜，跻身列强。

title: Herero and Nama genocide
title_zh: 赫雷罗和纳马种族灭绝
summary: After the Herero rose against German rule, General von Trotha drove them into the desert, killing most of the Herero and half of the Nama.
summary_zh: 赫雷罗人起义反抗德国统治后，冯·特罗塔将军把他们驱入沙漠，大部分赫雷罗人和半数纳马人因此丧生。

title: British expedition to Tibet
summary: Younghusband's force fought its way to Lhasa; Tibetans defended Gyantse fortress.
summary_zh: 荣赫鹏率英军侵藏，江孜军民抗英。

title: Imperial examinations abolished
summary: After 1,300 years the examination system ends.
summary_zh: 延续一千三百年的科举制度宣告结束。

title: Eulsa Treaty
summary: After the Russo-Japanese War, Japan forced Korea to sign a treaty that made it a protectorate and took over its foreign affairs.
summary_zh: 日俄战争后，日本强迫大韩帝国签订《乙巳条约》，剥夺其外交权，使之沦为保护国。

title: Tongmenghui founded
summary: Sun Yat-sen unites revolutionary groups in Tokyo with a program to overthrow the Qing and found a republic.
summary_zh: 孙中山在东京联合各革命团体，提出推翻清朝、建立共和的纲领。

title: Einstein's special relativity
title_zh: 爱因斯坦提出狭义相对论
summary: Albert Einstein, a patent clerk in Bern, published special relativity and other papers that changed physics.
summary_zh: 在伯尔尼专利局任职的爱因斯坦发表狭义相对论等论文，这一年被称为“奇迹年”。

title: Partition of Bengal
place_zh: 加尔各答（今印度西孟加拉邦）
summary: Lord Curzon split Bengal, provoking the Swadeshi movement and boycotts of British goods; it was reversed in 1911.
summary_zh: 寇松将孟加拉省一分为二，引发抵制英货的司瓦德西运动，1911年被撤销。

title: Battle of Tsushima
place_zh: 对马海峡（今日本与韩国之间）
summary: Admiral Tōgō Heihachirō's fleet destroyed the Russian Baltic Fleet, deciding the war.
summary_zh: 东乡平八郎指挥的日本舰队全歼俄国波罗的海舰队，决定了日俄战争的胜负。

title: Russian Revolution of 1905
place_zh: 圣彼得堡（今俄罗斯圣彼得堡）
summary: Troops fired on peaceful marchers on Bloody Sunday, setting off strikes and mutinies that forced the tsar to grant a Duma.
summary_zh: “流血星期日”军队向请愿群众开枪，引发全国罢工和起义，沙皇被迫同意设立国家杜马。

title: Jadid reform movement
summary: Jadid reformers such as Mahmudkhodja Behbudiy opened new-method schools and newspapers to modernise Muslim society.
summary_zh: 以别赫布季为代表的扎吉德派开办新式学校和报刊，推动穆斯林社会的现代化改革。

title: Maji Maji Rebellion
summary: Peoples of southern German East Africa rose against forced cotton growing, trusting in sacred water to protect them, and the famine that followed killed many.
summary_zh: 德属东非南部各族反抗强制种植棉花，相信圣水能护身而起义，随后的饥荒造成大量死亡。

title: Persian Constitutional Revolution
summary: Merchants, clerics and reformers forced the shah to grant a constitution and an elected parliament, the Majlis, the first in the Middle East.
summary_zh: 商人、宗教学者和改革派迫使国王颁布宪法，设立民选议会，这是中东第一个议会。

title: All-India Muslim League founded
summary: Muslim leaders meeting in Dhaka founded the League to defend Muslim political interests.
summary_zh: 穆斯林领袖在达卡集会，成立全印穆斯林联盟以维护穆斯林的政治利益。

title: Preparation for constitutional government
summary: After five ministers studied abroad, the court announced preparation for constitutional government.
summary_zh: 五大臣出洋考察后，清廷宣布预备仿行立宪。

title: 1906 San Francisco earthquake
place_zh: 旧金山（今美国加利福尼亚州）
summary: An earthquake and fires destroyed most of San Francisco, including much of Chinatown, and killed about 3,000.
summary_zh: 地震和大火摧毁旧金山大部分城区，包括唐人街，约三千人死亡。

title: Qiu Jin executed
summary: After Xu Xilin's failed rising, revolutionary Qiu Jin was executed.
summary_zh: 徐锡麟起义失败后，秋瑾在绍兴就义。

title: Anglo-Russian Convention
summary: Britain and Russia divided Iran into a Russian zone in the north and a British zone in the southeast, and settled their rivalry over Afghanistan.
summary_zh: 英俄两国把伊朗划分为北部俄国势力范围和东南部英国势力范围，并解决了在阿富汗的争夺。

title: National Debt Repayment Movement
summary: Starting in Daegu, Koreans gave up tobacco and donated jewellery to repay the loans Japan had forced on Korea.
summary_zh: 国债报偿运动从大邱兴起，民众戒烟捐物，试图偿还日本强加的借款。

title: Guangxu and Cixi die
summary: The Guangxu Emperor died, followed a day later by Empress Dowager Cixi; the toddler Puyi was enthroned with Prince Chun as regent.
summary_zh: 光绪帝与慈禧太后相继去世，三岁的溥仪即位，载沣摄政。

title: Oil struck at Masjed Soleyman
title_zh: 马斯吉德苏莱曼发现石油
place_zh: 马斯吉德苏莱曼（今伊朗胡齐斯坦省）
summary: William D'Arcy's drillers found oil in Khuzestan, the first big strike in the Middle East. It led to the Anglo-Persian Oil Company.
summary_zh: 达西的钻井队在胡齐斯坦打出石油，这是中东第一次大规模发现石油，英波石油公司随之成立。

title: Hejaz Railway reaches Medina
summary: The railway from Damascus to Medina opened, carrying pilgrims and tying Arabia more closely to Istanbul.
summary_zh: 从大马士革到麦地那的铁路通车，方便了朝觐者，也加强了伊斯坦布尔对阿拉伯半岛的控制。

title: An Jung-geun assassinates Ito Hirobumi
place_zh: 哈尔滨火车站（今中国黑龙江）
summary: An Jung-geun shot Ito Hirobumi, the former Japanese resident-general of Korea, at Harbin station.
summary_zh: 朝鲜义士安重根在哈尔滨火车站刺杀日本前韩国统监伊藤博文。

title: Beijing-Zhangjiakou Railway opens
summary: Zhan Tianyou built the first railway designed by Chinese engineers, crossing Badaling with a switchback.
summary_zh: 詹天佑主持修建京张铁路，为首条中国自主设计铁路。

title: Founding of the NAACP
title_zh: 全国有色人种协进会成立
summary: W. E. B. Du Bois and others founded the NAACP to fight racial discrimination through the courts.
summary_zh: 杜波依斯等人创立全国有色人种协进会，通过法律途径反对种族歧视。

title: Japan annexes Korea
summary: Under the annexation treaty Korea became a Japanese colony ruled by a governor-general, ending the Korean Empire.
summary_zh: 根据《日韩合并条约》，朝鲜半岛沦为日本殖民地，由朝鲜总督府统治，大韩帝国灭亡。

title: Mexican Revolution begins
place_zh: 圣路易斯波托西（今墨西哥）
summary: Francisco Madero's Plan of San Luis Potosí called for revolt against Díaz, starting a decade of revolution.
summary_zh: 马德罗发表圣路易斯波托西计划号召推翻迪亚斯，引发长达十年的革命。

title: Manchurian plague
summary: Wu Lien-teh contained a pneumonic plague that killed about 60,000.
summary_zh: 伍连德主持防疫，扑灭东北鼠疫。

title: Colonial land survey
summary: The Government-General surveyed all land, and much unregistered or communal land passed to the colonial state and Japanese companies.
summary_zh: 朝鲜总督府开展土地调查，大量未申报土地和公有土地被收归总督府和日本公司。

title: Wuchang Uprising
summary: Army units revolt and province after province declares independence from the Qing.
summary_zh: 新军起义，各省纷纷宣布脱离清朝独立。

title: Huanghuagang uprising
summary: Huang Xing's Tongmenghui assault failed; 72 martyrs were buried at Huanghuagang.
summary_zh: 黄兴率同盟会起义失败，七十二烈士葬黄花岗。

title: Plan of Ayala
place_zh: 阿亚拉（今墨西哥莫雷洛斯州）
summary: Emiliano Zapata demanded that land be returned to the villages, the rallying cry of agrarian revolution.
summary_zh: 萨帕塔要求把土地归还村社，成为土地革命的纲领。

title: Hiram Bingham brings Machu Picchu to world attention
place_zh: 马丘比丘（今秘鲁库斯科大区）
summary: Guided by local farmers, the American Hiram Bingham reached Machu Picchu and made it famous around the world.
summary_zh: 在当地农民带领下，美国学者宾厄姆抵达马丘比丘，使这座遗址闻名世界。

title: Railway Protection Movement
summary: Anger at the nationalization of railways leads to protests and a massacre in Chengdu, months before the revolution.
summary_zh: 清廷将铁路收归国有，激起各地抗议，成都发生血案，几个月后革命爆发。

title: Outer Mongolia declares independence
summary: Amid the revolution, Khalkha princes declared independence and enthroned the Jebtsundamba Khutuktu as Bogd Khan in Urga.
summary_zh: 辛亥革命爆发后，喀尔喀王公宣布独立，拥立哲布尊丹巴为博克多汗。

title: Italy invades Libya
summary: Italy seized Tripolitania and Cyrenaica from the Ottomans; the war saw the first bombing from an aeroplane.
summary_zh: 意大利从奥斯曼帝国手中夺取的黎波里塔尼亚和昔兰尼加，这场战争出现了史上首次空中轰炸。

title: The last emperor abdicates
summary: Puyi abdicates on 12 February 1912, ending more than two thousand years of imperial rule.
summary_zh: 1912年2月12日溥仪退位，延续两千多年的帝制宣告终结。

title: Republic of China proclaimed
summary: Sun Yat-sen was inaugurated in Nanjing as provisional president of the Republic of China on 1 January 1912, weeks before the Qing abdication.
summary_zh: 1912年1月1日孙中山在南京就任临时大总统，中华民国成立。

title: Treaty of Fez: Morocco becomes a French protectorate
summary: After the Agadir Crisis, the sultan accepted a French protectorate, with Spain taking the north.
summary_zh: 阿加迪尔危机之后，摩洛哥苏丹接受法国保护，北部地区归西班牙。

title: African National Congress founded
summary: Black South African leaders founded the South African Native National Congress, later the ANC, to defend African rights.
summary_zh: 南非黑人领袖成立南非土著国民大会，即后来的非洲人国民大会，以捍卫非洲人权利。

title: Tagore wins the Nobel Prize
title_zh: 泰戈尔获诺贝尔文学奖
place_zh: 圣蒂尼克坦（今印度西孟加拉邦）
summary: Rabindranath Tagore, for Gitanjali, became the first non-European to win the Nobel Prize in Literature.
summary_zh: 泰戈尔以《吉檀迦利》获诺贝尔文学奖，是第一位获此奖的非欧洲人。

title: Ford's moving assembly line
place_zh: 海兰帕克（今美国密歇根州）
summary: Henry Ford's moving assembly line cut the cost of the Model T and made cars affordable for ordinary families.
summary_zh: 亨利·福特采用流水线生产，大幅降低T型车成本，使普通家庭也买得起汽车。

title: Taishō political crisis
summary: Mass protests forced Prime Minister Katsura Tarō to resign, a sign of the rising party politics called Taishō democracy.
summary_zh: 民众和政党发起护宪运动，迫使桂太郎内阁下台，标志着大正民主运动兴起。

title: Ten Tragic Days
summary: General Victoriano Huerta overthrew and murdered President Madero, renewing the civil war.
summary_zh: 韦尔塔将军推翻并杀害马德罗总统，内战再起。

title: World War I
summary: The Allies and the Central Powers fought a war of trenches and mass armies. Germany's advance was stopped at the Marne.
summary_zh: 协约国与同盟国展开大战，德军进攻在马恩河受阻，西线陷入堑壕战，战争延续四年多。

title: Panama Canal opens
summary: The United States finished the Panama Canal, linking the Atlantic and Pacific and changing world shipping.
summary_zh: 美国建成巴拿马运河，连通大西洋和太平洋，改变了世界航运格局。

title: Assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand
place_zh: 萨拉热窝（今波黑萨拉热窝）
summary: A Bosnian Serb shot the heir to the Austro-Hungarian throne, setting off the crisis that led to World War I.
summary_zh: 奥匈帝国皇储斐迪南大公在萨拉热窝被塞尔维亚族青年刺杀，成为第一次世界大战的导火线。

title: Siege of Tsingtao
summary: Japan entered the First World War and seized Germany's leased territory at Qingdao in Shandong.
summary_zh: 日本以对德宣战为名参加一战，攻占德国在山东的租借地青岛，夺取德国在山东的权益。

title: Armenian genocide
summary: The Ottoman government deported the Armenians of Anatolia to the Syrian desert; massacres and death marches killed about a million people.
summary_zh: 奥斯曼政府把安纳托利亚的亚美尼亚人驱逐到叙利亚沙漠，屠杀和死亡行军造成约百万人死亡。

title: Twenty-One Demands
summary: Japan pressed Yuan Shikai's government to accept demands that would have made China a Japanese protectorate, sparking Chinese anger.
summary_zh: 日本向袁世凯政府提出企图独占中国的“二十一条”，激起中国人民的强烈反对。

title: Gallipoli campaign
place_zh: 加里波利半岛（今土耳其恰纳卡莱省）
summary: Ottoman forces, with Mustafa Kemal among their commanders, defeated a British-French landing aimed at Istanbul.
summary_zh: 奥斯曼军队击退英法联军在加里波利的登陆，穆斯塔法·凯末尔在此役中崭露头角。

title: Sykes-Picot Agreement
summary: Britain and France secretly agreed to divide the Ottoman Arab lands into their own zones, shaping the borders of the modern Middle East.
summary_zh: 英法秘密约定瓜分奥斯曼帝国的阿拉伯领土，深刻影响了现代中东的国界。

title: Battle of Verdun
summary: Germany and France fought for ten months at Verdun, with huge losses on both sides. It was called the meat grinder.
summary_zh: 德法两军在凡尔登鏖战十个月，双方伤亡惨重，被称为“绞肉机”。

title: Arab Revolt
summary: Sharif Hussein of Mecca rose against the Ottomans with British support and T. E. Lawrence, hoping for an Arab kingdom.
summary_zh: 麦加谢里夫侯赛因在英国和劳伦斯的支持下起兵反抗奥斯曼，希望建立阿拉伯王国。

title: Central Asian revolt of 1916
place_zh: 七河地区（今哈萨克斯坦与吉尔吉斯斯坦）
summary: A decree drafting Central Asians for labour behind the front set off a revolt; its suppression drove many Kyrgyz and Kazakhs to flee to China.
summary_zh: 沙俄征召中亚人到前线服劳役引发大起义，镇压造成大量死亡，许多吉尔吉斯人和哈萨克人逃往中国。

title: October Revolution
place_zh: 冬宫（今俄罗斯圣彼得堡）
summary: Lenin's Bolsheviks stormed the Winter Palace and seized power, creating the first socialist state.
summary_zh: 列宁领导布尔什维克攻占冬宫，推翻临时政府，建立世界上第一个社会主义国家。

title: Balfour Declaration
summary: Britain declared support for a national home for the Jewish people in Palestine.
summary_zh: 英国政府宣布支持在巴勒斯坦为犹太人建立民族家园。

title: Constitution of 1917
place_zh: 克雷塔罗（今墨西哥克雷塔罗州）
summary: The new constitution provided land reform, labour rights and national ownership of the subsoil, and is still in force.
summary_zh: 新宪法规定土地改革、劳工权利和地下资源国有，至今仍然有效。

title: US enters World War I
title_zh: 美国参加第一次世界大战
place_zh: 华盛顿（今美国哥伦比亚特区）
summary: German submarine warfare and the Zimmermann Telegram led the United States to declare war on Germany.
summary_zh: 德国无限制潜艇战和齐默尔曼电报促使美国对德宣战。

title: Battle of Vimy Ridge
summary: All four Canadian divisions fought together for the first time and took the ridge, a founding moment for Canadian identity.
summary_zh: 加拿大四个师首次并肩作战并攻占维米岭，被视为加拿大民族认同形成的关键时刻。

title: February Revolution
place_zh: 圣彼得堡（今俄罗斯圣彼得堡）
summary: Strikes and mutinies in Petrograd forced Nicholas II to abdicate, ending the Romanov monarchy.
summary_zh: 彼得格勒工人罢工、士兵起义，沙皇尼古拉二世被迫退位，罗曼诺夫王朝灭亡。

title: British capture Jerusalem
summary: General Allenby's army took Jerusalem from the Ottomans, ending four centuries of Ottoman rule there.
summary_zh: 艾伦比将军率英军从奥斯曼手中夺取耶路撒冷，结束了奥斯曼在当地四百年的统治。

title: Alash Autonomy
summary: Kazakh intellectuals of the Alash party proclaimed an autonomous Kazakh state after the fall of the tsar.
summary_zh: 沙皇倒台后，阿拉什党的哈萨克知识分子宣布成立哈萨克自治政府。

title: Rice riots of 1918
place_zh: 鱼津（今日本富山县鱼津市）
summary: Fishermen's wives in Toyama protested soaring rice prices, and riots spread nationwide, bringing down the government.
summary_zh: 富山县渔民妻子抗议米价飞涨，骚动蔓延全国，寺内正毅内阁被迫下台。

title: Basmachi movement
summary: Muslim guerrillas known as the Basmachi fought Soviet rule for years, above all in the Ferghana valley and eastern Bukhara.
summary_zh: 被称为巴斯马奇的穆斯林游击队长期反抗苏维埃政权，主要活动在费尔干纳盆地和东布哈拉。

title: Armistice of 11 November 1918
place_zh: 贡比涅森林（今法国瓦兹省）
summary: Germany signed an armistice in a railway carriage, ending the fighting of World War I.
summary_zh: 德国代表在贡比涅森林的火车车厢里签署停战协定，第一次世界大战的战斗结束。

title: Fall of the Kokand Autonomy
summary: Bolshevik forces from Tashkent crushed the Muslim Kokand Autonomy and sacked the city.
summary_zh: 塔什干的布尔什维克军队镇压浩罕的穆斯林自治政府，洗劫浩罕城。

title: Treaty of Versailles
place_zh: 凡尔赛宫镜厅（今法国凡尔赛）
summary: The peace treaty made Germany accept war guilt, lose territory and pay reparations, building resentment.
summary_zh: 协约国与德国签订和约，德国承担战争责任、割地赔款，埋下了新的冲突隐患。

title: Jallianwala Bagh massacre
place_zh: 阿姆利则（今印度旁遮普邦）
summary: British troops under General Dyer fired on an unarmed crowd in a walled garden, killing hundreds and turning Indians against British rule.
summary_zh: 戴尔将军指挥英军向封闭花园中的手无寸铁的人群开枪，数百人死亡，激起全印反英浪潮。

title: March 1st Movement
summary: Leaders read a declaration of independence in Seoul, and peaceful protests spread nationwide before Japan crushed them.
summary_zh: 朝鲜民族代表在汉城宣读独立宣言，和平示威遍及全国，遭日本残酷镇压。

title: Egyptian Revolution of 1919
summary: The exile of Saad Zaghlul set off nationwide protests by Muslims and Copts, men and women, against British rule.
summary_zh: 萨阿德·扎格卢勒被流放，引发穆斯林和科普特人、男女民众参加的全国性反英运动。

title: Third Anglo-Afghan War and Afghan independence
title_zh: 第三次英阿战争与阿富汗独立
summary: King Amanullah attacked British India, and the Treaty of Rawalpindi gave Afghanistan full control of its foreign affairs.
summary_zh: 国王阿曼努拉进攻英属印度，随后签订的《拉瓦尔品第条约》使阿富汗完全掌握外交，获得独立。

title: Turkish War of Independence
summary: Mustafa Kemal led Turkish nationalists from Ankara against Greek, Armenian and Allied forces and overturned the Treaty of Sèvres.
summary_zh: 穆斯塔法·凯末尔以安卡拉为基地领导民族主义者抗击希腊等协约国势力，推翻了《色佛尔条约》。

title: Provisional Government in Shanghai
title_zh: 大韩民国临时政府成立
summary: Exiled independence activists formed a provisional government in Shanghai, later moving with China's wartime capital to Chongqing.
summary_zh: 流亡独立运动人士在上海成立大韩民国临时政府，抗战时期随中国政府迁至重庆。

title: Non-cooperation movement
place_zh: 加尔各答（今印度西孟加拉邦）
summary: Gandhi called on Indians to boycott British schools, courts and goods; he halted it after violence at Chauri Chaura in 1922.
summary_zh: 甘地号召抵制英国学校、法庭和商品，1922年乔里乔拉暴力事件后宣布停止。

title: League of Nations founded
summary: The first worldwide organisation to keep the peace was set up in Geneva, but it failed to stop aggression in the 1930s.
summary_zh: 第一个维护世界和平的国际组织在日内瓦成立，但未能制止20世纪30年代的侵略扩张。

title: Nineteenth Amendment
title_zh: 美国宪法第十九修正案
place_zh: 华盛顿（今美国哥伦比亚特区）
summary: Women won the right to vote nationwide after decades of struggle.
summary_zh: 经过数十年斗争，美国妇女获得全国性选举权。

title: Battle of Maysalun
place_zh: 麦塞仑（今叙利亚大马士革以西）
summary: French troops defeated the army of the short-lived Arab Kingdom of Syria and occupied Damascus, deposing King Faisal.
summary_zh: 法军击败短命的叙利亚阿拉伯王国军队，占领大马士革，废黜费萨尔国王。

title: Red Army takes Bukhara
summary: The Red Army under Frunze stormed Bukhara, the emir fled, and a Bukharan People's Soviet Republic was set up.
summary_zh: 伏龙芝率红军攻占布哈拉，埃米尔出逃，建立布哈拉人民苏维埃共和国。

title: Prohibition begins
place_zh: 华盛顿（今美国哥伦比亚特区）
summary: A constitutional ban on alcohol took effect; it fed organized crime and was repealed in 1933.
summary_zh: 宪法禁酒令生效，助长了有组织犯罪，1933年被废除。

title: Harlem Renaissance
summary: Black writers, artists and jazz musicians in Harlem such as Langston Hughes flourished.
summary_zh: 兰斯顿·休斯等黑人作家、艺术家和爵士乐手在哈莱姆大放异彩。

title: Rif War
place_zh: 阿努瓦勒（今摩洛哥里夫山区）
summary: Abd el-Krim's Berber fighters routed a Spanish army at Annual and founded the Rif Republic, crushed by France and Spain in 1926.
summary_zh: 阿卜杜·克里姆率柏柏尔战士在阿努瓦勒大败西班牙军，建立里夫共和国，1926年被法西联军镇压。

title: March on Rome
summary: Mussolini's Fascists marched on the capital and the king made him prime minister, the start of Fascist rule.
summary_zh: 墨索里尼率法西斯党徒向罗马进军，国王任命他为首相，意大利开始法西斯统治。

title: Founding of the Soviet Union
place_zh: 莫斯科（今俄罗斯莫斯科）
summary: Russia, Ukraine, Belarus and Transcaucasia joined to form the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics.
summary_zh: 俄罗斯、乌克兰、白俄罗斯和外高加索联邦联合组成苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟。

title: Britain recognises Egyptian independence
summary: Britain declared Egypt an independent kingdom under Fuad I but kept control of defence and the Suez Canal.
summary_zh: 英国宣布埃及为独立王国，由福阿德一世为国王，但仍控制国防和苏伊士运河。

title: Discovery of Tutankhamun's tomb
summary: Howard Carter found the nearly intact tomb of Tutankhamun, the most famous discovery in the history of archaeology.
summary_zh: 霍华德·卡特发现几乎完好的图坦卡蒙墓，是考古史上最著名的发现。

title: Mexican muralism
summary: Under José Vasconcelos, Diego Rivera, Orozco and Siqueiros painted public walls with the nation's history.
summary_zh: 在教育部长巴斯孔塞洛斯推动下，里维拉、奥罗斯科和西凯罗斯在公共建筑上绘制民族历史壁画。

title: Washington Naval Treaty
summary: Japan accepted a smaller battleship quota than Britain and the US at the Washington Conference.
summary_zh: 华盛顿会议上签订限制海军军备的条约，日本主力舰吨位被限定为英美的五分之三。

title: Modern Art Week in São Paulo
summary: Artists and writers in São Paulo launched Brazilian modernism, seeking a national art free of European models.
summary_zh: 圣保罗的艺术家和作家举办现代艺术周，开启巴西现代主义运动，追求摆脱欧洲模式的民族艺术。

title: Republic of Turkey proclaimed
summary: The Grand National Assembly proclaimed the republic with Ankara as capital and Mustafa Kemal as president.
summary_zh: 大国民议会宣布成立共和国，定都安卡拉，穆斯塔法·凯末尔任总统。

title: Great Kantō earthquake
summary: A great earthquake and fires destroyed much of Tokyo and Yokohama, killing over 100,000; Koreans and Chinese were massacred in the panic.
summary_zh: 强烈地震和大火摧毁东京和横滨大部，死者十余万人，混乱中大量朝鲜人和中国人遭到屠杀。

title: Treaty of Lausanne
summary: The Allies recognised Turkey's borders and sovereignty, and Greece and Turkey agreed a large population exchange.
summary_zh: 协约国承认土耳其的边界和主权，希腊与土耳其约定大规模交换人口。

title: National delimitation of Central Asia
summary: Moscow redrew Central Asia along ethnic lines, creating the Uzbek and Turkmen republics, the basis of today's five states.
summary_zh: 苏联按民族重新划分中亚，设立乌兹别克和土库曼加盟共和国等，奠定了今天五国的边界。

title: Abolition of the caliphate
summary: The Turkish parliament abolished the caliphate, ending an institution that dated back to 632.
summary_zh: 土耳其议会废除哈里发制度，这一始于632年的制度宣告终结。

title: Taung Child discovered
summary: Raymond Dart described a fossil child skull as Australopithecus africanus, the first evidence that humankind arose in Africa.
summary_zh: 雷蒙德·达特把一具幼儿头骨化石定名为南方古猿非洲种，这是人类起源于非洲的首个证据。

title: Reza Shah founds the Pahlavi dynasty
title_zh: 礼萨汗建立巴列维王朝
summary: Reza Khan, who had led a coup in 1921, had parliament depose the Qajars and was crowned shah in 1926.
summary_zh: 1921年发动政变的礼萨汗让议会废黜恺加王朝，1926年加冕为国王。

title: Universal male suffrage and the Peace Preservation Law
summary: All men over 25 gained the vote, but the same year the Peace Preservation Law gave police power to crush communists and dissenters.
summary_zh: 25岁以上男子获得选举权，同年颁布的治安维持法却成为镇压共产主义者和异见人士的工具。

title: Cristero War
summary: Catholics in western Mexico took up arms against the anti-clerical laws of President Calles.
summary_zh: 墨西哥西部的天主教徒拿起武器，反抗卡列斯总统的反教会法律。

title: Trans-Iranian Railway
place_zh: 维列斯克桥（今伊朗马赞德兰省）
summary: Paid for with taxes on tea and sugar, a railway from the Caspian Sea to the Persian Gulf was built over the Alborz and Zagros mountains.
summary_zh: 政府用茶糖税修建从里海到波斯湾的铁路，翻越厄尔布尔士山和扎格罗斯山，1938年通车。

title: Hujum unveiling campaign
summary: The Soviet Hujum campaign urged Uzbek women to burn their veils; many who did were attacked or killed.
summary_zh: 苏联发起“胡君”运动号召乌兹别克妇女焚烧面纱，许多响应的妇女遭到报复甚至杀害。

title: Sandino's war against US occupation
place_zh: 塞哥维亚山区（今尼加拉瓜）
summary: Augusto César Sandino led a guerrilla war against US Marines in Nicaragua until they left in 1933.
summary_zh: 桑地诺在尼加拉瓜领导游击战，抗击美国海军陆战队，直到1933年美军撤离。

title: Fleming discovers penicillin
place_zh: 圣玛丽医院（今英国伦敦）
summary: Alexander Fleming noticed that mould killed bacteria in a dish, leading to the first antibiotic.
summary_zh: 弗莱明发现青霉菌能杀死培养皿中的细菌，由此发现青霉素，开创抗生素时代。

title: Muslim Brotherhood founded
summary: The teacher Hassan al-Banna founded the Muslim Brotherhood, which became the most influential Islamist movement.
summary_zh: 教师哈桑·班纳在伊斯梅利亚创立穆斯林兄弟会，后成为影响最大的伊斯兰主义运动。

title: Turkish alphabet reform
summary: Atatürk replaced the Arabic script with a Latin alphabet for Turkish, part of his secular reforms.
summary_zh: 阿塔图尔克以拉丁字母取代阿拉伯字母书写土耳其语，这是他世俗化改革的一部分。

title: Raman effect discovered
place_zh: 加尔各答（今印度西孟加拉邦）
summary: C. V. Raman discovered the scattering of light that bears his name and won the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1930.
summary_zh: 拉曼发现了以其名字命名的光散射现象，1930年获诺贝尔物理学奖。

title: Youth Pledge
place_zh: 巴达维亚（今印度尼西亚雅加达）
summary: Young nationalists pledged one motherland, one nation and one language, Indonesian, laying the basis of Indonesian identity.
summary_zh: 青年代表大会宣誓“一个祖国、一个民族、一种语言”，奠定了印度尼西亚民族认同。

title: Wall Street Crash of 1929
summary: The stock market collapse began the Great Depression, which left a quarter of American workers jobless.
summary_zh: 股市崩盘引发大萧条，美国四分之一的工人失业。

title: National Revolutionary Party founded
place_zh: 克雷塔罗（今墨西哥克雷塔罗州）
summary: Calles founded the party later called the PRI, which ruled Mexico without a break for 71 years.
summary_zh: 卡列斯创建国民革命党，即后来的革命制度党，连续执政墨西哥71年。

title: Salt March
place_zh: 丹迪（今印度古吉拉特邦）
summary: Gandhi walked 385 km to the sea at Dandi and made salt in defiance of the British salt tax, starting civil disobedience.
summary_zh: 甘地徒步三百八十五公里到丹迪海边自制食盐，抗议英国盐税，掀起文明不服从运动。

title: Kazakh famine
summary: Forced collectivisation and the settling of nomads caused a famine that killed about 1.5 million Kazakhs.
summary_zh: 强制集体化和游牧民定居政策引发大饥荒，约150万哈萨克人死亡，许多人逃往中国等地。

title: Revolution of 1930 brings Vargas to power
summary: Getúlio Vargas took power by revolt, ending the coffee planters' republic and ruling Brazil for fifteen years.
summary_zh: 瓦加斯通过革命掌权，结束了咖啡种植园主控制的旧共和国，统治巴西十五年。

title: Founding of the Communist Party of Vietnam
summary: Hồ Chí Minh united rival communist groups into one party at a meeting in Hong Kong.
summary_zh: 胡志明在香港召集会议，将几个共产主义组织合并为越南共产党，同年改称印度支那共产党。

title: Dust Bowl
place_zh: 俄克拉何马州狭长地带（今美国）
summary: Drought and poor farming turned the southern plains into dust storms and drove many families west.
summary_zh: 干旱和不当耕作使南部大平原尘暴肆虐，大批家庭被迫西迁。

title: Mukden Incident
place_zh: 柳条湖（今中国辽宁沈阳）
summary: The Kwantung Army staged a railway explosion near Shenyang as a pretext to seize all of Manchuria.
summary_zh: 日本关东军制造柳条湖铁路爆炸事件，以此为借口侵占中国东北。

title: Execution of Omar Mukhtar
summary: Italy hanged the elderly leader of the Libyan resistance after twenty years of guerrilla war, making him a national hero.
summary_zh: 意大利绞死领导利比亚抵抗运动二十年的老人奥马尔·穆赫塔尔，他成为利比亚民族英雄。

title: Statute of Westminster 1931
place_zh: 渥太华（今加拿大安大略省）
summary: Britain gave Canada and the other dominions full legislative independence.
summary_zh: 英国议会通过法令，给予加拿大等自治领完全的立法独立。

title: Kingdom of Saudi Arabia founded
summary: Ibn Saud united Najd and the Hejaz into the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
summary_zh: 伊本·沙特把内志和汉志合并，建立沙特阿拉伯王国。

title: Manchukuo established
summary: Japan set up a puppet state in Northeast China with Puyi, the last Qing emperor, as its nominal head.
summary_zh: 日本在中国东北扶植以溥仪为首的傀儡政权伪满洲国，定都长春。

title: Siamese revolution of 1932
summary: The People's Party staged a bloodless coup that ended absolute monarchy and gave Siam its first constitution.
summary_zh: 民党发动不流血政变，结束君主专制，暹罗颁布第一部宪法，成为君主立宪国家。

title: Chaco War
summary: Bolivia and Paraguay fought over the dry Gran Chaco; Paraguay won most of the disputed land.
summary_zh: 玻利维亚和巴拉圭为争夺干旱的大查科地区交战，巴拉圭获胜并取得大部分争议领土。

title: Poona Pact
place_zh: 浦那（今印度马哈拉施特拉邦）
summary: Gandhi and Ambedkar agreed on reserved seats for Dalits within a joint electorate, ending Gandhi's fast in Yerwada jail.
summary_zh: 甘地与安贝德卡尔商定在联合选区内为贱民保留议席，甘地在耶拉夫达监狱结束绝食。

title: Iraq becomes independent
summary: The British mandate ended and the Kingdom of Iraq joined the League of Nations, though British bases remained.
summary_zh: 英国委任统治结束，伊拉克王国加入国际联盟，但英国仍保留军事基地。

title: Hongkou Park bombing
place_zh: 虹口公园（今中国上海鲁迅公园）
summary: Yun Bong-gil threw a bomb at a Japanese celebration in Shanghai, killing a general and winning Chinese support for the provisional government.
summary_zh: 尹奉吉在上海虹口公园向日军庆祝会场投掷炸弹，炸死日军大将白川义则，赢得中国对韩国临时政府的支持。

title: New Deal
place_zh: 华盛顿（今美国哥伦比亚特区）
summary: Franklin Roosevelt's programs regulated banks, created jobs and set up relief to fight the Depression.
summary_zh: 富兰克林·罗斯福推行一系列措施，整顿银行、兴办公共工程和社会救济以应对大萧条。

title: Hitler becomes chancellor
summary: Adolf Hitler was appointed chancellor and quickly set up the Nazi dictatorship.
summary_zh: 希特勒被任命为德国总理，随即建立纳粹独裁统治，德国走上对外扩张之路。

title: Cárdenas land reform
summary: President Lázaro Cárdenas gave about 18 million hectares to peasant communal farms called ejidos.
summary_zh: 卡德纳斯总统把约1800万公顷土地分给农民村社。

title: Second Italo-Ethiopian War
title_zh: 第二次意大利-埃塞俄比亚战争
summary: Fascist Italy invaded Ethiopia using poison gas and occupied it, while the League of Nations failed to act, until British and Ethiopian forces freed it in 1941.
summary_zh: 法西斯意大利动用毒气入侵并占领埃塞俄比亚，国际联盟无所作为，直到1941年英埃联军将其解放。

title: Government of India Act 1935
summary: The act gave the provinces elected self-government; Congress won most provinces in the 1937 elections.
summary_zh: 该法授予各省民选自治政府，国大党在1937年选举中赢得多数省份。

title: Spanish Civil War
place_zh: 马德里（今西班牙马德里）
summary: Franco's Nationalists, backed by Germany and Italy, defeated the Republic and set up a dictatorship.
summary_zh: 佛朗哥领导的国民军在德意支持下击败共和政府，建立独裁统治，被视为二战的预演。

title: February 26 Incident
summary: Young army officers killed several ministers in a failed coup; afterwards the army gained more control over the government.
summary_zh: 陆军青年军官发动政变，杀害多名大臣，政变失败后军部对政府的控制反而加强。

title: Unveiling decree
summary: Reza Shah banned the veil in public as part of his Westernising reforms, a move many religious Iranians resented.
summary_zh: 礼萨汗作为西化改革的一部分，禁止女性在公共场合戴面纱，引起许多宗教人士不满。

title: Arab revolt in Palestine
place_zh: 纳布卢斯（今约旦河西岸）
summary: Palestinian Arabs struck and rebelled against British rule and Jewish immigration; Britain then limited immigration in the 1939 White Paper.
summary_zh: 巴勒斯坦阿拉伯人以罢工和武装起义反抗英国统治和犹太移民，英国随后在1939年白皮书中限制移民。

title: Marco Polo Bridge Incident
place_zh: 卢沟桥（今中国北京丰台）
summary: A clash at the Marco Polo Bridge near Beijing began Japan's full-scale invasion of China.
summary_zh: 日军在北平卢沟桥制造事端，发动全面侵华战争，中国全面抗战开始。

title: Nanjing Massacre
summary: After taking Nanjing, Japanese troops killed hundreds of thousands of civilians and prisoners over six weeks.
summary_zh: 日军攻占南京后进行长达六周的大屠杀，遇难同胞达30万以上。

title: Deportation of Soviet Koreans
title_zh: 苏联朝鲜族被强制迁往中亚
place_zh: 乌什托别（今哈萨克斯坦）
summary: Stalin deported about 170,000 Koreans from the Far East to Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan, the first deportation of a whole people.
summary_zh: 斯大林把约17万朝鲜族人从远东强制迁往哈萨克斯坦和乌兹别克斯坦，是第一次整个民族被强迫迁移。

title: Munich Agreement
summary: Britain and France let Germany annex the Sudetenland from Czechoslovakia, the peak of appeasement.
summary_zh: 英法同意德国吞并捷克斯洛伐克的苏台德地区，绥靖政策达到顶峰。

title: Oil found in Saudi Arabia
place_zh: 达兰（今沙特阿拉伯东部省）
summary: The American company Casoc struck oil at Dammam No. 7, the start of Saudi Arabia's oil wealth.
summary_zh: 美国公司在达曼7号井打出石油，沙特阿拉伯的石油财富由此开始。

title: Mexican oil expropriation
summary: Cárdenas nationalised the foreign oil companies and created Pemex, a lasting symbol of Mexican sovereignty.
summary_zh: 卡德纳斯将外国石油公司收归国有，成立墨西哥石油公司，成为国家主权的象征。

title: Invasion of Poland
place_zh: 韦斯特普拉特（今波兰格但斯克）
summary: Germany attacked Poland on 1 September. Britain and France declared war, beginning World War II in Europe.
summary_zh: 9月1日德国闪击波兰，英法随即对德宣战，第二次世界大战在欧洲全面爆发。

title: Lahore Resolution
place_zh: 拉合尔（今巴基斯坦旁遮普省）
summary: The Muslim League under Jinnah demanded independent states for Muslim-majority areas, the basis of Pakistan.
summary_zh: 真纳领导的穆斯林联盟要求在穆斯林占多数的地区建立独立国家，成为巴基斯坦建国的基础。

title: Dunkirk evacuation
summary: Over 330,000 British and French troops were rescued from the beaches as France fell to Germany.
summary_zh: 德军突破法国防线，英法三十多万军队从敦刻尔克海滩撤回英国，保存了反攻力量。

title: Tripartite Pact
summary: Japan, Germany and Italy formed the Axis alliance, promising mutual support.
summary_zh: 日本与德国、意大利签订同盟条约，轴心国集团正式形成。

title: Name-change policy
summary: Japan pressed Koreans to adopt Japanese-style names as part of forced assimilation, along with banning Korean in schools.
summary_zh: 日本推行皇民化政策，强迫朝鲜人改用日本式姓名，并禁止学校使用朝鲜语。

title: Korean Liberation Army
summary: The provisional government formed the Korean Liberation Army in Chongqing, which fought alongside Chinese and Allied forces.
summary_zh: 大韩民国临时政府在重庆成立韩国光复军，与中国军队和盟军共同抗日。

title: Attack on Pearl Harbor
summary: Japanese carrier aircraft struck the US Pacific Fleet at Pearl Harbor, bringing the US into the Second World War.
summary_zh: 日本海军航空兵偷袭美国珍珠港海军基地，太平洋战争爆发，美国参加第二次世界大战。

title: Operation Barbarossa
place_zh: 布列斯特要塞（今白俄罗斯）
summary: Germany invaded the Soviet Union with over three million troops, opening the largest land war in history.
summary_zh: 德国出动三百多万军队入侵苏联，苏德战争爆发，成为史上规模最大的陆上战争。

title: The Holocaust
place_zh: 奥斯威辛（今波兰奥斯维辛）
summary: Nazi Germany systematically murdered about six million Jews, along with Roma and other victims, in death camps.
summary_zh: 纳粹德国在集中营系统屠杀约六百万犹太人以及罗姆人等其他群体，是人类历史上的空前罪行。

title: Anglo-Soviet invasion of Iran
summary: Britain and the Soviet Union occupied Iran to secure its oil and a supply route to the USSR, and forced Reza Shah to abdicate for his son.
summary_zh: 英国和苏联为控制石油和对苏补给线占领伊朗，迫使礼萨汗退位，由其子继位。

title: Japanese invasion of Malaya
place_zh: 哥打巴鲁（今马来西亚吉兰丹）
summary: Japan landed at Kota Bharu just before Pearl Harbor and swept down the Malay Peninsula; Singapore fell in February 1942.
summary_zh: 日军在珍珠港事件前登陆哥打巴鲁，迅速南下，1942年2月攻陷新加坡，英军大批投降。

title: Battle of Stalingrad
place_zh: 斯大林格勒（今俄罗斯伏尔加格勒）
summary: The Red Army encircled and destroyed the German Sixth Army, the turning point of the war in Europe.
summary_zh: 苏军包围并歼灭德军第六集团军，成为苏德战争和第二次世界大战欧洲战场的转折点。

title: Second Battle of El Alamein
place_zh: 阿拉曼（今埃及马特鲁省）
summary: Montgomery's Eighth Army defeated Rommel's Axis forces, ending the threat to Egypt and the Suez Canal.
summary_zh: 蒙哥马利的英国第八集团军击败隆美尔的轴心国军队，解除了对埃及和苏伊士运河的威胁。

title: Quit India Movement
place_zh: 孟买（今印度马哈拉施特拉邦）
summary: Gandhi demanded an immediate end to British rule with the call Do or Die; Congress leaders were jailed for the rest of the war.
summary_zh: 甘地以“行动或死亡”为口号要求英国立即撤出印度，国大党领导人随即被关押至战争结束。

title: Battle of Midway
summary: The US Navy sank four Japanese carriers, the turning point of the Pacific War.
summary_zh: 美国海军击沉日本四艘航空母舰，成为太平洋战争的转折点。

title: Manhattan Project
place_zh: 洛斯阿拉莫斯（今美国新墨西哥州）
summary: Scientists led by Robert Oppenheimer built the first atomic bomb, tested at Trinity in July 1945.
summary_zh: 奥本海默领导的科学家研制出第一颗原子弹，1945年7月在三一试验场试爆成功。

title: Internment of Japanese Americans
place_zh: 曼赞纳（今美国加利福尼亚州）
summary: About 120,000 Japanese Americans were forced into camps; Canada also interned Japanese Canadians.
summary_zh: 约十二万日裔美国人被关入拘留营，加拿大也拘禁了日裔加拿大人。

title: Bracero Program
place_zh: 华雷斯城（今墨西哥奇瓦瓦州）
summary: Mexico and the United States agreed to send Mexican farm workers north, starting large-scale labour migration.
summary_zh: 墨西哥与美国签约输送墨西哥农工北上，开启了大规模劳务移民。

title: Tehran Conference
summary: Roosevelt, Churchill and Stalin met for the first time and agreed on opening a second front in France in 1944.
summary_zh: 罗斯福、丘吉尔和斯大林首次会晤，商定1944年在法国开辟第二战场。

title: Bengal famine of 1943
place_zh: 加尔各答（今印度西孟加拉邦）
summary: War, the loss of Burmese rice, hoarding and British policy caused a famine that killed about three million people.
summary_zh: 战争、缅甸大米断供、囤积和英国的政策导致大饥荒，约三百万人死亡。

title: Wheat programme and the Green Revolution
place_zh: 奥夫雷贡城（今墨西哥索诺拉州）
summary: Norman Borlaug's team bred high-yield wheat in Mexico, the start of the Green Revolution that spread worldwide.
summary_zh: 博洛格团队在墨西哥培育高产小麦，由此开始的绿色革命后来推广到全世界。

title: Normandy landings
place_zh: 奥马哈海滩（今法国诺曼底）
summary: On D-Day the Western Allies landed in northern France, opening a second front against Germany.
summary_zh: 盟军在法国诺曼底登陆，开辟欧洲第二战场，加速了纳粹德国的灭亡。

title: Atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki
title_zh: 广岛和长崎原子弹爆炸
summary: The US dropped atomic bombs on Hiroshima on 6 August and Nagasaki on 9 August, killing over 200,000 people.
summary_zh: 美国于8月6日和9日先后向广岛和长崎投下原子弹，死亡人数超过二十万。

title: Surrender of Japan
summary: Emperor Hirohito broadcast the acceptance of the Potsdam Declaration on 15 August; Japan signed the surrender on the USS Missouri on 2 September.
summary_zh: 8月15日裕仁天皇广播接受《波茨坦公告》，9月2日日本在美舰密苏里号上签署投降书。

title: Liberation and division of Korea
place_zh: 三八线（今朝鲜半岛中部）
summary: Japan's surrender freed Korea, but Soviet troops occupied the north and US troops the south of the 38th parallel.
summary_zh: 日本投降，朝鲜半岛获得解放，但以北纬38度线为界，北部由苏军、南部由美军占领。

title: Proclamation of Indonesian Independence
summary: Sukarno and Hatta declared Indonesia independent two days after Japan's surrender.
summary_zh: 日本投降后两天，苏加诺和哈达宣读独立宣言，宣布印度尼西亚独立。

title: Founding of the Democratic Republic of Vietnam
summary: After the August Revolution, Hồ Chí Minh read the Declaration of Independence in Hanoi on 2 September.
summary_zh: 八月革命后，胡志明于9月2日在河内巴亭广场宣读独立宣言，越南民主共和国成立。

title: Yalta Conference
place_zh: 利瓦几亚宫（今克里米亚雅尔塔）
summary: Roosevelt, Churchill and Stalin planned the post-war order, shaping the division of Europe.
summary_zh: 罗斯福、丘吉尔和斯大林商定战后安排，形成雅尔塔体系，影响了战后欧洲的格局。

title: Arab League founded in Cairo
summary: Egypt and six other Arab states founded the Arab League, with its headquarters in Cairo.
summary_zh: 埃及等七个阿拉伯国家成立阿拉伯国家联盟，总部设在开罗。

title: Battle of Okinawa
summary: In the bloodiest battle of the Pacific War, US forces took Okinawa; a quarter of the island's civilians died.
summary_zh: 太平洋战争中最惨烈的战役之一，美军攻占冲绳，岛上约四分之一的居民死亡。

title: Allied occupation of Japan
summary: Under General MacArthur, the occupation disbanded the army, broke up the zaibatsu and carried out land reform.
summary_zh: 以麦克阿瑟为首的盟军总部占领日本，解散军队，解散财阀，实行农地改革等民主化改革。

title: San Francisco Conference and UN Charter
place_zh: 旧金山（今美国加利福尼亚州）
summary: Fifty nations signed the United Nations Charter in San Francisco, creating a new world body with its seat in New York.
summary_zh: 五十国在旧金山签署《联合国宪章》，新的国际组织成立，总部设在纽约。

title: Battle of Berlin and German surrender
summary: The Red Army took Berlin, Hitler killed himself and Germany surrendered unconditionally on 8 May.
summary_zh: 苏军攻克柏林，希特勒自杀，德国于5月8日无条件投降，二战欧洲战场结束。

title: Juan Perón elected president
place_zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯（今阿根廷）
summary: Backed by the unions, Juan Perón won the presidency and, with his wife Evita, built a populist movement that still shapes Argentina.
summary_zh: 庇隆在工会支持下当选总统，与夫人埃娃一起建立了民粹主义的庇隆主义运动，至今影响阿根廷政治。

title: Tokyo Trial
place_zh: 市谷（今日本东京都新宿区）
summary: The International Military Tribunal for the Far East tried Japan's wartime leaders; Tōjō Hideki and six others were hanged.
summary_zh: 远东国际军事法庭审判日本战犯，东条英机等七名甲级战犯被判处绞刑。

title: First Indochina War
summary: France fought the Việt Minh to restore colonial rule in Indochina and lost after eight years.
summary_zh: 法国为恢复殖民统治与越盟作战八年，最终失败。

title: Philippine independence
summary: The United States recognized the independence of the Republic of the Philippines on 4 July 1946.
summary_zh: 1946年7月4日美国承认菲律宾独立，菲律宾共和国成立。

title: Independence and Partition of India
summary: British India became independent as India and Pakistan; partition displaced some 15 million people amid mass killing.
summary_zh: 英属印度分为印度和巴基斯坦两个国家独立，约一千五百万人被迫迁徙，伴随大规模屠杀。

title: Constitution of Japan takes effect
summary: The new constitution made the emperor a symbol, gave sovereignty to the people and renounced war in Article 9.
summary_zh: 新宪法规定天皇为国家象征，主权在民，第九条宣布放弃战争。

title: First Kashmir War
summary: Tribal and Pakistani forces invaded Kashmir, its ruler joined India, and the war left the region divided along a ceasefire line.
summary_zh: 部落武装和巴基斯坦军队进入克什米尔，土邦王公加入印度，战后克什米尔沿停火线分治。

title: UN Partition Plan for Palestine
title_zh: 联合国巴勒斯坦分治决议
summary: The UN General Assembly voted to divide Palestine into Jewish and Arab states with Jerusalem under international rule.
summary_zh: 联合国大会通过决议，把巴勒斯坦分为犹太国和阿拉伯国，耶路撒冷由国际共管。

title: Truman Doctrine
place_zh: 华盛顿（今美国哥伦比亚特区）
summary: Truman pledged to support nations resisting communism, starting the US policy of containment.
summary_zh: 杜鲁门承诺援助抵抗共产主义的国家，开启美国的遏制政策。

title: State of Israel founded
summary: David Ben-Gurion proclaimed the State of Israel as the British mandate ended.
summary_zh: 英国委任统治结束之际，本-古里安宣布以色列国成立。

title: Republic of Korea founded
summary: After UN-supervised elections in the south, the Republic of Korea was proclaimed with Syngman Rhee as president.
summary_zh: 南部在联合国监督下举行选举，大韩民国宣告成立，李承晚任总统。

title: Democratic People's Republic of Korea founded
title_zh: 朝鲜民主主义人民共和国成立
summary: The Democratic People's Republic of Korea was proclaimed in the north with Kim Il Sung as premier.
summary_zh: 北部宣布成立朝鲜民主主义人民共和国，金日成任首相，半岛正式分裂为两个国家。

title: Apartheid begins in South Africa
summary: The National Party won the election and built apartheid, a legal system classifying people by race and segregating housing, schools and jobs.
summary_zh: 国民党赢得大选后建立种族隔离制度，以法律按种族划分国民，在居住、教育和就业上实行隔离。

title: Marshall Plan
summary: The United States gave Western Europe billions of dollars to rebuild, tying it closer to America.
summary_zh: 美国向西欧提供大量援助助其战后重建，加强了对西欧的影响，加深了欧洲的东西分裂。

title: Assassination of Gandhi
summary: Mahatma Gandhi was shot dead by the Hindu nationalist Nathuram Godse in New Delhi.
summary_zh: 圣雄甘地在新德里被印度教民族主义者戈德塞枪杀身亡。

title: First Arab-Israeli War
summary: Arab states invaded Israel; Israel won and enlarged its territory, while Jordan held the West Bank and Egypt Gaza.
summary_zh: 阿拉伯国家进攻以色列，以色列获胜并扩大领土，约旦占据约旦河西岸，埃及占据加沙。

title: Nakba, the Palestinian exodus
title_zh: 巴勒斯坦难民问题（纳克巴）
place_zh: 雅法（今以色列特拉维夫）
summary: About 700,000 Palestinian Arabs fled or were driven from their homes during the war, creating the refugee question.
summary_zh: 战争中约七十万巴勒斯坦阿拉伯人逃离或被逐出家园，形成了巴勒斯坦难民问题。

title: Burmese independence
summary: Burma left British rule as an independent republic, months after its leader Aung San was assassinated.
summary_zh: 缅甸脱离英国独立并退出英联邦，独立前数月领导人昂山遇刺身亡。

title: Bogotazo
summary: The murder of the Liberal leader Jorge Eliécer Gaitán set off riots in Bogotá and a decade of civil violence known as La Violencia.
summary_zh: 自由党领袖盖坦遇刺引发波哥大大暴动，哥伦比亚随后陷入长达十年的“暴力时期”。

title: Berlin Blockade
summary: The Soviets cut land routes to West Berlin; the Western Allies supplied the city by air for almost a year.
summary_zh: 苏联切断通往西柏林的陆路交通，美英以空运维持西柏林供给近一年，冷战第一次危机。

title: Ceylon gains independence
summary: Ceylon became an independent dominion; it was renamed Sri Lanka in 1972.
summary_zh: 锡兰成为独立的自治领，1972年改国名为斯里兰卡。

title: Jeju uprising
summary: A leftist uprising on Jeju against separate elections in the south was crushed, and tens of thousands of islanders died.
summary_zh: 济州岛左翼人士反对南部单独选举而起事，遭到镇压，数万岛民遇难。

title: Costa Rica abolishes its army
summary: After a short civil war, José Figueres abolished the army and spent the money on schools and health.
summary_zh: 短暂内战后，菲格雷斯废除军队，把军费用于教育和医疗。

title: Founding of NATO
title_zh: 北大西洋公约组织成立
summary: The United States, Canada and Western European states formed a military alliance against the Soviet Union.
summary_zh: 美国、加拿大与西欧国家签订《北大西洋公约》，组成针对苏联的军事同盟。

title: First Soviet atomic bomb
title_zh: 苏联第一颗原子弹试爆
place_zh: 塞米巴拉金斯克核试验场（今哈萨克斯坦）
summary: The Soviet Union tested its first atomic bomb at Semipalatinsk, where over 450 tests later harmed local people.
summary_zh: 苏联在塞米巴拉金斯克核试验场试爆第一颗原子弹，此后在这里进行了450多次核试验，严重危害当地居民。

title: Constitution of India
summary: India became a republic under a constitution drafted by a committee led by B. R. Ambedkar, abolishing untouchability.
summary_zh: 以安贝德卡尔为首起草的宪法生效，印度成为共和国，宪法宣布废除“不可接触”制度。

title: Korean War
place_zh: 瓮津半岛（今朝鲜黄海南道）
summary: North Korean forces invaded the south. UN forces led by the US and Chinese volunteers joined, and the war ended in stalemate.
summary_zh: 朝鲜军队越过三八线南进，以美国为首的联合国军和中国人民志愿军先后参战，战争以僵持告终。

title: Incheon landing
summary: UN forces under MacArthur landed at Incheon behind North Korean lines and retook Seoul.
summary_zh: 麦克阿瑟指挥联合国军在仁川登陆，切断朝鲜军队后路并收复汉城。

title: McCarthyism
place_zh: 惠灵（今美国西弗吉尼亚州）
summary: Senator Joseph McCarthy claimed communists had infiltrated the government, launching a wave of political persecution.
summary_zh: 参议员麦卡锡声称共产党人渗透政府，掀起政治迫害浪潮。

title: Iranian oil nationalised
place_zh: 阿巴丹（今伊朗胡齐斯坦省）
summary: Prime Minister Mohammad Mosaddegh nationalised the Anglo-Iranian Oil Company and its Abadan refinery, and Britain answered with a boycott.
summary_zh: 首相摩萨台将英伊石油公司及阿巴丹炼油厂收归国有，英国以石油禁运回应。

title: Treaty of San Francisco
summary: Japan signed a peace treaty with 48 nations, regaining sovereignty in 1952, and a security treaty with the US; China was not invited.
summary_zh: 日本与48国签订和约，1952年恢复主权，同时与美国签订安保条约，中国未被邀请参加。

title: Libya becomes independent
summary: Under a UN plan Libya became an independent kingdom under King Idris, the first African country freed through the UN.
summary_zh: 根据联合国决议，利比亚在伊德里斯国王领导下独立，是第一个经联合国实现独立的非洲国家。

title: Egyptian Revolution of 1952
summary: The Free Officers led by Nasser and Naguib overthrew King Farouk; Egypt became a republic in 1953.
summary_zh: 纳赛尔和纳吉布领导的自由军官组织推翻法鲁克国王，埃及于1953年成为共和国。

title: Mau Mau Uprising
summary: Kikuyu fighters rose against British settler rule over land in Kenya. Britain declared an emergency and crushed the revolt, but it hastened independence.
summary_zh: 基库尤人为争夺土地起兵反抗英国殖民统治，英国宣布紧急状态加以镇压，但起义加速了肯尼亚独立。

title: Bolivian National Revolution
summary: The MNR took power by revolt, nationalised the tin mines, gave Indians the vote and carried out land reform.
summary_zh: 民族主义革命运动党通过起义掌权，将锡矿收归国有，给予印第安人选举权并实行土地改革。

title: Bengali Language Movement
