summary: Police killed students in Dhaka protesting to make Bengali a state language of Pakistan, a seed of Bangladeshi nationalism.
summary_zh: 达卡学生要求将孟加拉语定为巴基斯坦国语，遭警察开枪镇压，成为孟加拉民族主义的起点。

title: 1953 Iranian coup
summary: A coup backed by the CIA and Britain overthrew Mosaddegh and restored the power of Shah Mohammad Reza Pahlavi.
summary_zh: 美国中央情报局和英国支持的政变推翻摩萨台，恢复了穆罕默德·礼萨·巴列维国王的权力。

title: Structure of DNA discovered
summary: Watson and Crick, using Rosalind Franklin's X-ray data, proposed the double helix structure of DNA.
summary_zh: 沃森和克里克借助富兰克林的X射线衍射数据，提出DNA双螺旋结构模型，开启分子生物学时代。

title: Korean Armistice Agreement
place_zh: 板门店（今朝鲜半岛军事分界线上）
summary: The armistice signed at Panmunjom ended the fighting and set up the Demilitarized Zone, but no peace treaty followed.
summary_zh: 交战双方在板门店签订停战协定，划定非军事区，但此后一直未签订和平条约。

title: Algerian War of Independence
place_zh: 奥雷斯山区（今阿尔及利亚）
summary: The FLN began an armed uprising against French rule; after eight years of brutal war Algeria won independence in 1962.
summary_zh: 民族解放阵线发动反法武装起义，经过八年残酷战争，阿尔及利亚于1962年获得独立。

title: Battle of Điện Biên Phủ
summary: The Việt Minh under Võ Nguyên Giáp besieged and took the French base, ending French rule in Indochina.
summary_zh: 武元甲指挥越盟围攻奠边府法军据点并取胜，法国随后在日内瓦会议上同意撤出印度支那。

title: Virgin Lands Campaign
summary: Khrushchev sent hundreds of thousands of settlers to plough the northern Kazakh steppe for wheat.
summary_zh: 赫鲁晓夫派数十万人开垦哈萨克斯坦北部草原种植小麦，改变了当地的人口和生态。

title: Brown v. Board of Education
title_zh: 布朗诉托皮卡教育局案
place_zh: 托皮卡（今美国堪萨斯州）
summary: The Supreme Court ruled racial segregation in public schools unconstitutional.
summary_zh: 最高法院一致裁定公立学校种族隔离违宪，推翻“隔离但平等”原则。

title: 1954 Guatemalan coup
summary: A CIA-backed invasion overthrew President Jacobo Árbenz after his land reform hurt United Fruit.
summary_zh: 阿本斯总统的土地改革损害了联合果品公司利益，美国中央情报局支持的入侵将其推翻。

title: Japanese economic miracle
summary: From the mid-1950s Japan's economy grew about 10 percent a year, and by 1968 it was the second largest in the capitalist world.
summary_zh: 20世纪50年代中期起日本经济年均增长约10%，1968年成为资本主义世界第二大经济体。

title: Bandung Conference
summary: Twenty-nine Asian and African countries met in Bandung and adopted principles of peaceful coexistence.
summary_zh: 亚非二十九国在万隆举行会议，通过和平共处原则，周恩来提出“求同存异”。

title: Vietnam War
summary: North Vietnam and the Viet Cong fought South Vietnam and the United States for twenty years.
summary_zh: 北越和南方民族解放阵线与南越及美国作战二十年，最终越南统一。

title: Montgomery bus boycott
title_zh: 蒙哥马利公交车抵制运动
place_zh: 蒙哥马利（今美国亚拉巴马州）
summary: After Rosa Parks was arrested, Black residents led by Martin Luther King Jr. boycotted the buses for a year and ended segregated seating.
summary_zh: 罗莎·帕克斯被捕后，马丁·路德·金领导黑人抵制公交车一年，废除了座位隔离。

title: Warsaw Pact
summary: The Soviet Union and its Eastern European allies formed a military alliance in response to NATO.
summary_zh: 苏联与东欧国家签订《华沙条约》，组成与北约对抗的军事同盟。

title: Juche idea
summary: Kim Il Sung first spoke of Juche, or self-reliance, which later became North Korea's official ideology.
summary_zh: 金日成首次提出“主体”思想，强调自主自立，后来成为朝鲜的官方指导思想。

title: Freedom Charter
place_zh: 克利普敦（今南非索韦托）
summary: The Congress of the People adopted the Freedom Charter, declaring that South Africa belongs to all who live in it, black and white.
summary_zh: 人民大会通过《自由宪章》，宣告南非属于生活在这里的所有人，无论黑人白人。

title: Suez Crisis
summary: Nasser nationalised the canal; Britain, France and Israel invaded but withdrew under US and Soviet pressure, a turning point in decolonisation.
summary_zh: 纳赛尔将运河收归国有，英法以三国入侵埃及，在美苏压力下撤军，成为非殖民化的转折点。

title: Morocco and Tunisia gain independence
summary: France ended its protectorates in March 1956; Mohammed V ruled Morocco and Habib Bourguiba led Tunisia.
summary_zh: 1956年3月法国结束对两国的保护，穆罕默德五世统治摩洛哥，布尔吉巴领导突尼斯。

title: Hungarian Revolution of 1956
place_zh: 布达佩斯（今匈牙利布达佩斯）
summary: A popular uprising against the Soviet-backed government was crushed by Soviet tanks.
summary_zh: 匈牙利民众反对亲苏政府的起义被苏联军队镇压，数千人死亡。

title: Tunisia's Code of Personal Status
summary: Bourguiba's family law banned polygamy and let women seek divorce, the most far-reaching women's rights reform in the Arab world.
summary_zh: 布尔吉巴颁布的家庭法禁止一夫多妻，允许女性提出离婚，是阿拉伯世界最彻底的妇女权利改革。

title: Minamata disease identified
place_zh: 水俣（今日本熊本县水俣市）
summary: Mercury poisoning from a chemical factory's waste was found in Minamata, one of Japan's worst pollution disasters.
summary_zh: 熊本县水俣发现工厂排放汞污染引起的水俣病，成为日本最严重的公害事件之一。

title: Launch of Sputnik 1
place_zh: 拜科努尔航天发射场（今哈萨克斯坦）
summary: The first artificial satellite was launched from Baikonur, opening the space age.
summary_zh: 世界上第一颗人造卫星从拜科努尔发射，开启了航天时代。

title: Ghana becomes independent
summary: Led by Kwame Nkrumah, the Gold Coast became Ghana, the first colony in sub-Saharan Africa to win independence, inspiring the rest of the continent.
summary_zh: 在克瓦米·恩克鲁玛领导下，黄金海岸独立为加纳，成为撒哈拉以南第一个获得独立的殖民地，鼓舞了整个非洲。

title: Treaty of Rome
place_zh: 卡比托利欧山（今意大利罗马）
summary: Six states created the European Economic Community, a common market that grew into the European Union.
summary_zh: 六国签订《罗马条约》，建立欧洲经济共同体，后来发展为欧盟。

title: Malayan independence
place_zh: 默迪卡体育场（今马来西亚吉隆坡）
summary: Tunku Abdul Rahman proclaimed the independence of the Federation of Malaya from Britain.
summary_zh: 东姑阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼在默迪卡体育场宣布马来亚联合邦脱离英国独立。

title: Achebe publishes Things Fall Apart
place_zh: 奥吉迪（今尼日利亚阿南布拉州）
summary: Chinua Achebe's novel about an Igbo village facing colonial rule became the most widely read work of modern African literature.
summary_zh: 钦努阿·阿契贝描写伊博村庄遭遇殖民统治的小说出版，成为现代非洲文学中读者最多的作品。

title: 14 July Revolution in Iraq
title_zh: 伊拉克七月十四日革命
summary: Army officers led by Abd al-Karim Qasim overthrew and killed the Iraqi royal family and declared a republic.
summary_zh: 卡塞姆等军官推翻并杀害伊拉克王室，宣布成立共和国。

title: Shrinking of the Aral Sea
summary: Soviet irrigation for cotton diverted the Amu Darya and Syr Darya, and the Aral Sea began to shrink, one of the worst environmental disasters.
summary_zh: 苏联为种植棉花大量引走阿姆河和锡尔河河水，咸海开始萎缩，成为最严重的生态灾难之一。

title: Year of Africa
summary: Seventeen African countries became independent in one year, including Nigeria, the Congo and most of French West and Equatorial Africa.
summary_zh: 这一年有十七个非洲国家获得独立，包括尼日利亚、刚果以及法属西非和赤道非洲的大部分地区。

title: Aswan High Dam built
summary: Built with Soviet aid, the dam ended the Nile's yearly floods and created Lake Nasser; Abu Simbel was moved to save it.
summary_zh: 高坝在苏联援助下建成，终结了尼罗河每年的泛滥，形成纳赛尔湖，阿布辛贝神庙为此整体迁移。

title: OPEC founded
summary: Iraq, Iran, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia and Venezuela founded OPEC in Baghdad to gain control over oil prices.
summary_zh: 伊拉克、伊朗、科威特、沙特阿拉伯和委内瑞拉在巴格达成立欧佩克，争取对石油价格的控制权。

title: April Revolution
summary: Student-led protests against a rigged election forced Syngman Rhee to resign.
summary_zh: 学生领导的群众抗议选举舞弊，迫使李承晚下台。

title: Sharpeville massacre
summary: Police fired on a crowd protesting the pass laws and killed 69 people. The ANC was banned and turned to armed struggle.
summary_zh: 警察向抗议通行证法的人群开枪，打死69人。非洲人国民大会随后被取缔，转向武装斗争。

title: Congo Crisis
place_zh: 利奥波德维尔（今刚果民主共和国金沙萨）
summary: Days after independence the Congo fell into mutiny and secession. Prime Minister Patrice Lumumba was overthrown and murdered, and the Cold War powers intervened.
summary_zh: 刚果独立数日后即发生兵变和分裂，总理帕特里斯·卢蒙巴被推翻并遇害，冷战双方介入。

title: Guatemalan Civil War
summary: Leftist guerrillas fought military governments for 36 years; army massacres killed many Maya villagers.
summary_zh: 左翼游击队与军政府交战36年，军队屠杀了大量玛雅村民。

title: Brasília becomes the capital
summary: President Kubitschek moved the capital to Brasília, a planned modernist city built in four years on the inland plateau.
summary_zh: 库比契克总统把首都迁往巴西利亚，这座现代主义规划城市在内陆高原上用四年时间建成。

title: Quiet Revolution
place_zh: 魁北克城（今加拿大魁北克省）
summary: Quebec's Liberal government took schools and health care from the Church and built a modern French-speaking state.
summary_zh: 魁北克自由党政府从教会手中接管教育和医疗，建立现代法语社会。

title: Gagarin's spaceflight
place_zh: 拜科努尔航天发射场（今哈萨克斯坦）
summary: Yuri Gagarin lifted off from Baikonur aboard Vostok 1 and became the first person in space.
summary_zh: 尤里·加加林乘东方1号从拜科努尔起飞，成为第一个进入太空的人。

title: Berlin Wall built
summary: East Germany sealed off West Berlin with a wall to stop its citizens fleeing west. It became the symbol of the Cold War.
summary_zh: 东德修建柏林墙，阻止民众逃往西柏林，柏林墙成为冷战的象征。

title: May 16 coup
summary: General Park Chung-hee seized power in a military coup and ruled South Korea until 1979.
summary_zh: 朴正熙发动军事政变夺取政权，此后统治韩国直到1979年。

title: Sino-Indian War
summary: A border dispute led to a short war in which Chinese forces advanced and then declared a ceasefire and withdrew.
summary_zh: 边界争端引发短暂战争，中国军队推进后宣布停火并主动后撤。

title: Cuban Missile Crisis
place_zh: 华盛顿（今美国哥伦比亚特区）
summary: The United States and the Soviet Union came close to nuclear war over Soviet missiles in Cuba before Khrushchev withdrew them.
summary_zh: 美苏因苏联在古巴部署导弹濒临核战争，最终赫鲁晓夫撤走导弹。

title: Miracle on the Han River
summary: The first five-year plan began export-led industrialization that made South Korea one of the four Asian Tigers.
summary_zh: 韩国实施第一个五年经济计划，推行出口导向工业化，成为亚洲四小龙之一。

title: Organisation of African Unity founded
place_zh: 亚的斯亚贝巴（今埃塞俄比亚）
summary: Thirty-two independent African states founded the OAU to promote unity, defend sovereignty and end colonial rule on the continent.
summary_zh: 三十二个独立非洲国家成立非洲统一组织，以促进团结、捍卫主权并结束非洲大陆的殖民统治。

title: White Revolution
summary: The Shah launched land reform, votes for women and literacy campaigns. Clerics led by Khomeini protested, and Khomeini was exiled in 1964.
summary_zh: 国王推行土地改革、妇女选举权和扫盲运动。霍梅尼领导宗教人士抗议，1964年被流放。

title: Formation of Malaysia
summary: Malaya joined Singapore, Sarawak and North Borneo to form Malaysia; Singapore left in 1965.
summary_zh: 马来亚与新加坡、沙捞越、北婆罗洲合组马来西亚，1965年新加坡退出并独立。

title: March on Washington
place_zh: 林肯纪念堂（今美国华盛顿）
summary: About 250,000 people marched for civil rights, and Martin Luther King Jr. gave his I Have a Dream speech.
summary_zh: 约25万人为民权游行，马丁·路德·金发表《我有一个梦想》演讲。

title: Assassination of John F. Kennedy
place_zh: 达拉斯（今美国得克萨斯州）
summary: President Kennedy was shot dead in Dallas by Lee Harvey Oswald.
summary_zh: 肯尼迪总统乘车经过达拉斯时遭奥斯瓦尔德枪杀，举国震惊。

title: Astro Boy airs on television
summary: Tezuka Osamu's Astro Boy became Japan's first popular weekly TV anime series, the start of the anime industry.
summary_zh: 手冢治虫的《铁臂阿童木》成为日本第一部热门的电视动画连续剧，日本动画产业由此起步。

title: Civil Rights Act of 1964
place_zh: 华盛顿（今美国哥伦比亚特区）
summary: The law banned discrimination by race, color, religion, sex or national origin and ended legal segregation.
summary_zh: 该法禁止基于种族、肤色、宗教、性别或出身的歧视，终结了合法的种族隔离。

title: Tōkaidō Shinkansen opens
summary: The world's first high-speed railway linked Tokyo and Osaka just before the Olympics.
summary_zh: 世界第一条高速铁路东海道新干线在奥运会前通车，连接东京和大阪。

title: 1964 Brazilian coup
summary: The army overthrew President João Goulart and ruled Brazil until 1985.
summary_zh: 军方推翻古拉特总统，此后军政府统治巴西直到1985年。

title: 1964 Tokyo Olympics
place_zh: 国立竞技场（今日本东京都新宿区）
summary: The first Olympics held in Asia showed the world Japan's recovery from the war.
summary_zh: 亚洲首次举办的奥运会，向世界展示了日本的战后复兴。

title: 30 September Movement
summary: A failed coup was blamed on the communists; mass killings followed and Suharto took power from Sukarno.
summary_zh: 一场未遂政变被归咎于印尼共产党，随后发生大规模屠杀，苏哈托逐步取代苏加诺掌权。

title: Indo-Pakistani War of 1965
summary: Fighting over Kashmir spread to Punjab; the Soviet-brokered Tashkent Declaration restored the earlier lines.
summary_zh: 克什米尔冲突扩大至旁遮普，经苏联调停签署《塔什干宣言》，双方恢复战前界线。

title: Green Revolution in India
place_zh: 卢迪亚纳（今印度旁遮普邦）
summary: High-yield wheat and rice, irrigation and fertiliser, led in Punjab, made India self-sufficient in grain.
summary_zh: 以旁遮普为先导推广高产小麦和水稻、灌溉与化肥，使印度实现粮食自给。

title: Six-Day War
summary: Israel destroyed Egypt's air force on the ground and captured the Sinai up to the Suez Canal in six days.
summary_zh: 以色列先发制人摧毁埃及空军，六天内占领直至苏伊士运河的西奈半岛。

title: Six-Day War
title_zh: 第三次中东战争（六日战争）
summary: In six days Israel took Sinai, Gaza, the West Bank, East Jerusalem and the Golan Heights from Egypt, Jordan and Syria.
summary_zh: 以色列在六天内从埃及、约旦和叙利亚手中夺取西奈半岛、加沙、约旦河西岸、东耶路撒冷和戈兰高地。

title: Founding of ASEAN
summary: Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore and Thailand signed the Bangkok Declaration founding ASEAN.
summary_zh: 印尼、马来西亚、菲律宾、新加坡和泰国签署《曼谷宣言》，成立东南亚国家联盟。

title: Nigerian Civil War
summary: The southeast seceded as Biafra. Federal forces won after a blockade that caused famine and the deaths of perhaps a million people.
summary_zh: 东南部宣布脱离成立比夫拉，联邦军队封锁该地造成饥荒，约百万人死亡后联邦一方获胜。

title: Arusha Declaration
summary: Julius Nyerere set out Tanzania's path of African socialism and self-reliance, including ujamaa village collectivisation.
summary_zh: 朱利叶斯·尼雷尔提出坦桑尼亚走非洲社会主义和自力更生的道路，包括乌贾马村社集体化。

title: One Hundred Years of Solitude published
place_zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯（今阿根廷）
summary: Gabriel García Márquez's novel of the town of Macondo became the landmark of magical realism and the Latin American literary boom.
summary_zh: 哥伦比亚作家加西亚·马尔克斯的小说出版，成为魔幻现实主义和拉美文学爆炸的代表作。

title: Death of Che Guevara
place_zh: 拉伊格拉（今玻利维亚圣克鲁斯省）
summary: Che Guevara's guerrilla band in Bolivia was hunted down by the army, and he was captured and shot at La Higuera.
summary_zh: 切·格瓦拉在玻利维亚的游击队遭政府军围剿，他在拉伊格拉被俘后遭枪杀。

title: Tlatelolco massacre
place_zh: 特拉特洛尔科（今墨西哥城）
summary: Days before the Olympics, troops fired on student protesters in the Plaza de las Tres Culturas, killing many.
summary_zh: 奥运会开幕前几天，军队向三文化广场的学生示威者开枪，造成大量伤亡。

title: Prague Spring
summary: Alexander Dubcek's reforms in Czechoslovakia were ended by a Warsaw Pact invasion in August.
summary_zh: 捷克斯洛伐克领导人杜布切克推行改革，8月苏联率华约军队入侵，改革被扼杀。

title: Yasunari Kawabata wins the Nobel Prize
title_zh: 川端康成获诺贝尔文学奖
place_zh: 镰仓（今日本神奈川县镰仓市）
summary: Kawabata, author of Snow Country, became the first Japanese writer to win the Nobel Prize in Literature.
summary_zh: 《雪国》作者川端康成获得诺贝尔文学奖，是第一位获此奖的日本作家。

title: Apollo 11 Moon landing
place_zh: 肯尼迪航天中心（今美国佛罗里达州）
summary: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin became the first people to walk on the Moon.
summary_zh: 阿姆斯特朗和奥尔德林成为最早登上月球的人类。

title: Gaddafi seizes power in Libya
summary: Colonel Muammar Gaddafi overthrew King Idris in a bloodless coup and ruled Libya for 42 years.
summary_zh: 卡扎菲上校发动不流血政变推翻伊德里斯国王，此后统治利比亚四十二年。

title: ARPANET
place_zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校（今美国洛杉矶）
summary: The first message was sent between UCLA and Stanford over ARPANET, the network that grew into the Internet.
summary_zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校与斯坦福之间通过阿帕网发出第一条信息，这一网络后来发展为互联网。

title: 13 May incident
summary: Riots between Malays and Chinese after an election led to the New Economic Policy favoring Malays.
summary_zh: 大选后吉隆坡爆发马来人与华人的种族冲突，政府随后推行偏向马来人的新经济政策。

title: Stonewall riots
place_zh: 格林尼治村（今美国纽约市）
summary: Gay patrons of the Stonewall Inn fought back against a police raid, starting the modern gay rights movement.
summary_zh: 石墙酒吧的同性恋顾客反抗警察搜查，开启了现代同性恋权利运动。

title: Salvador Allende elected
summary: Salvador Allende became the first Marxist elected president in Latin America and nationalised the copper mines.
summary_zh: 阿连德成为拉美第一位通过选举上台的马克思主义总统，将铜矿收归国有。

title: Saemaul Movement
summary: Park Chung-hee launched the New Village Movement to modernize the countryside through self-help projects.
summary_zh: 朴正熙发起新村运动，通过农民自助建设改善农村面貌。

title: Tanzania-Zambia Railway
place_zh: 达累斯萨拉姆（今坦桑尼亚）
summary: China financed and built a 1,860-kilometre railway linking landlocked Zambia's copperbelt to the sea, its largest foreign aid project of the time.
summary_zh: 中国援建全长1860公里的铁路，把内陆国赞比亚的铜矿带与海港连接起来，是当时中国最大的援外项目。

title: Bangladesh Liberation War
summary: East Pakistan rose against West Pakistani rule; after Indian intervention, Pakistan's army surrendered at Dhaka and Bangladesh was born.
summary_zh: 东巴基斯坦反抗西巴统治，印度出兵干预，巴军在达卡投降，孟加拉国诞生。

title: United Arab Emirates founded
title_zh: 阿拉伯联合酋长国成立
summary: As Britain withdrew from the Gulf, six (later seven) sheikhdoms formed the UAE under Sheikh Zayed of Abu Dhabi.
summary_zh: 英国撤出海湾后，六个（后为七个）酋长国组成阿联酋，由阿布扎比的扎耶德酋长任总统。

title: Pablo Neruda wins the Nobel Prize
title_zh: 聂鲁达获诺贝尔文学奖
place_zh: 黑岛（今智利瓦尔帕莱索大区）
summary: The Chilean poet Pablo Neruda, author of Canto General, won the Nobel Prize in Literature.
summary_zh: 著有《漫歌》的智利诗人聂鲁达获得诺贝尔文学奖。

title: Normalisation of Japan-China relations
summary: Prime Minister Tanaka Kakuei visited Beijing and signed a joint statement establishing diplomatic relations with the People's Republic.
summary_zh: 日本首相田中角荣访华，两国发表联合声明，正式建立外交关系。

title: Nixon visits China
summary: Richard Nixon met Mao Zedong in Beijing and signed the Shanghai Communiqué, opening US-China relations.
summary_zh: 尼克松在北京会见毛泽东，签署《上海公报》，打开中美关系大门。

title: Watergate scandal
place_zh: 水门大厦（今美国华盛顿）
summary: A break-in at Democratic headquarters and its cover-up forced Richard Nixon to resign in 1974.
summary_zh: 民主党总部遭窃听及随后的掩盖行为曝光，尼克松于1974年被迫辞职。

title: Simla Agreement
place_zh: 西姆拉（今印度喜马偕尔邦）
summary: Indira Gandhi and Zulfikar Ali Bhutto agreed to settle disputes bilaterally and turned the Kashmir ceasefire line into the Line of Control.
summary_zh: 英迪拉·甘地与布托同意双边解决争端，克什米尔停火线改为实际控制线。

title: Okinawa returned to Japan
place_zh: 那霸（今日本冲绳县那霸市）
summary: The US returned Okinawa to Japanese rule, though large American bases remained.
summary_zh: 美国将冲绳的施政权交还日本，但大量美军基地仍保留在岛上。

title: October War
place_zh: 苏伊士运河（今埃及伊斯梅利亚附近）
summary: Egypt crossed the Suez Canal in a surprise attack on Israel; the war led to the Arab oil embargo and later peace talks.
summary_zh: 埃及突袭渡过苏伊士运河进攻以色列，战争引发阿拉伯石油禁运并促成后来的和谈。

title: 1973 Chilean coup
place_zh: 拉莫内达宫（今智利圣地亚哥）
summary: General Augusto Pinochet's forces bombed the presidential palace; Allende died and a military dictatorship ruled until 1990.
summary_zh: 皮诺切特率军队轰炸总统府，阿连德身亡，军政府统治智利直到1990年。

title: 1973 oil crisis
summary: Arab oil producers cut output and embargoed the US and others, quadrupling oil prices and shaking the world economy.
summary_zh: 阿拉伯产油国减产并对美国等国实行石油禁运，油价上涨四倍，冲击了世界经济。

title: Lucy discovered
place_zh: 哈达尔（今埃塞俄比亚阿法尔州）
summary: Researchers found a 3.2-million-year-old skeleton of Australopithecus afarensis, showing that human ancestors walked upright long before their brains grew large.
summary_zh: 研究者发现距今320万年的南方古猿阿法种骨架，表明人类祖先在大脑变大之前很久就已直立行走。

title: India's first nuclear test
place_zh: 博格伦（今印度拉贾斯坦邦）
summary: India tested a nuclear device code-named Smiling Buddha, calling it a peaceful explosion.
summary_zh: 印度进行代号“微笑的佛陀”的核试验，自称为和平核爆炸。

title: Fall of Saigon
summary: North Vietnamese tanks entered Saigon on 30 April, ending the Vietnam War and leading to reunification.
summary_zh: 4月30日北越军队攻入西贡，南越政权投降，越南战争结束。

title: Cambodian genocide
summary: The Khmer Rouge emptied the cities; by 1979 about 1.5 to 2 million Cambodians had died from executions, forced labor and famine.
summary_zh: 红色高棉攻占金边后驱散城市居民，至1979年约一百五十万至两百万柬埔寨人死于处决、劳役和饥荒。

title: The Emergency
summary: Indira Gandhi declared a state of emergency, jailing opponents and censoring the press until she lost the 1977 election.
summary_zh: 英迪拉·甘地宣布紧急状态，逮捕反对派并审查新闻，直到1977年大选失利。

title: Lebanese Civil War
summary: Christian, Muslim and Palestinian militias, with Syria and Israel involved, fought a war that killed about 150,000 people.
summary_zh: 基督教、穆斯林和巴勒斯坦各派武装混战，叙利亚和以色列卷入其中，约15万人死亡。

title: Angolan independence and civil war
summary: After Portugal's revolution Angola and Mozambique became independent. In Angola rival movements backed by Cold War powers fought a civil war until 2002.
summary_zh: 葡萄牙革命后安哥拉和莫桑比克独立，安哥拉各派在冷战双方支持下陷入内战，直到2002年。

title: Green March into Western Sahara
summary: About 350,000 Moroccans marched into Spanish Sahara, leading Spain to hand over the territory and starting the Western Sahara conflict.
summary_zh: 约三十五万摩洛哥人进入西属撒哈拉，西班牙随后移交该地，西撒哈拉冲突由此开始。

title: Founding of the Lao PDR
title_zh: 老挝人民民主共和国成立
summary: The Pathet Lao abolished the monarchy and founded the Lao People's Democratic Republic.
summary_zh: 老挝爱国阵线废除君主制，建立老挝人民民主共和国。

title: Soweto uprising
summary: Black schoolchildren protesting compulsory Afrikaans teaching were shot by police, sparking nationwide revolt against apartheid.
summary_zh: 抗议强制使用阿非利卡语教学的黑人学生遭警察枪击，引发全国性的反种族隔离抗争。

title: Argentine coup and the Dirty War
place: Plaza de Mayo, Buenos Aires, Argentina
place_zh: 五月广场（今阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯）
summary: A military junta seized power in Argentina and made thousands of opponents disappear; mothers of the missing marched in the Plaza de Mayo.
summary_zh: 军政府在阿根廷夺权，数以万计的反对者“被失踪”，失踪者的母亲们在五月广场游行抗议。

title: Socialist Republic of Vietnam
title_zh: 越南社会主义共和国成立
summary: North and South Vietnam were formally united as the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.
summary_zh: 越南南北正式统一，国号改为越南社会主义共和国，西贡改名胡志明市。

title: Founding of Apple
place_zh: 洛斯阿尔托斯（今美国加利福尼亚州）
summary: Steve Jobs and Steve Wozniak founded Apple, helping bring personal computers into homes as Silicon Valley grew.
summary_zh: 乔布斯和沃兹尼亚克创立苹果公司，推动个人电脑进入家庭，硅谷随之兴起。

title: Cambodian-Vietnamese War
summary: Vietnam invaded Cambodia, drove the Khmer Rouge from Phnom Penh in January 1979 and occupied the country for ten years.
summary_zh: 越南出兵柬埔寨，1979年初攻占金边推翻红色高棉，此后占领柬埔寨十年。

title: Saur Revolution
summary: Afghan communists killed President Daoud Khan and seized power. Their harsh reforms set off a rural revolt.
summary_zh: 阿富汗共产党人杀死总统达乌德汗夺取政权，激进改革引发农村大规模反抗。

title: Treaty of Peace and Friendship between Japan and China
summary: Japan and China signed a treaty of peace and friendship; Deng Xiaoping visited Japan for its ratification.
summary_zh: 中日两国签订和平友好条约，邓小平访日出席换文仪式，两国关系进一步发展。

title: Iranian Revolution
summary: Mass protests drove out the Shah, Khomeini returned from exile, and a referendum made Iran an Islamic Republic.
summary_zh: 大规模抗议迫使国王出走，霍梅尼结束流亡回国，全民公决后伊朗成为伊斯兰共和国。

title: Soviet invasion of Afghanistan
summary: Soviet troops entered Afghanistan to prop up the communist government and fought the mujahideen for ten years before withdrawing in 1989.
summary_zh: 苏军进入阿富汗扶持共产党政府，与圣战者游击队作战十年，1989年撤军。

title: Egypt-Israel peace treaty
summary: Following the Camp David Accords, Sadat and Begin signed peace; Israel returned the Sinai and Egypt was expelled from the Arab League.
summary_zh: 继戴维营协议之后，萨达特与贝京签署和约，以色列归还西奈半岛，埃及被逐出阿拉伯联盟。

title: Iran hostage crisis
summary: Students seized the US embassy and held 52 Americans for 444 days, breaking relations between Iran and the United States.
summary_zh: 学生占领美国大使馆，扣押52名美国人长达444天，伊美两国从此断交。

title: Nicaraguan Revolution
summary: The Sandinista front overthrew the Somoza dictatorship, followed by a war with US-backed Contras.
summary_zh: 桑地诺民族解放阵线推翻索摩查独裁，随后与美国支持的反政府武装交战。

title: Salvadoran Civil War
place_zh: 圣萨尔瓦多（今萨尔瓦多）
summary: The army and the FMLN guerrillas fought a civil war that killed about 75,000 people before peace accords in 1992.
summary_zh: 军政府与法拉本多·马蒂民族解放阵线游击队内战，约7.5万人死亡，1992年签署和平协议。

title: Grand Mosque seizure
summary: Militants seized the Grand Mosque in Mecca for two weeks; afterwards the Saudi state gave more power to conservative clerics.
summary_zh: 武装分子占领麦加禁寺两周，事后沙特政府给予保守派宗教人士更大权力。

title: Assassination of Park Chung-hee
summary: Park Chung-hee was shot by his intelligence chief Kim Jae-gyu, ending his 18-year rule.
summary_zh: 朴正熙被中央情报部部长金载圭枪杀，结束了长达18年的统治。

title: Iran-Iraq War
summary: Saddam Hussein invaded Iran; eight years of trench warfare and gas attacks killed hundreds of thousands with no gain.
summary_zh: 萨达姆·侯赛因入侵伊朗，八年堑壕战和毒气战造成数十万人死亡，双方均无所得。

title: Gwangju Uprising
summary: Citizens of Gwangju rose against Chun Doo-hwan's martial law and were crushed by troops, with hundreds killed.
summary_zh: 光州市民反对全斗焕的戒严统治而起义，遭军队血腥镇压，数百人死亡。

title: Solidarity founded
place_zh: 格但斯克造船厂（今波兰）
summary: Strikes at the Gdansk shipyard led by Lech Walesa created the first independent trade union in the Soviet bloc.
summary_zh: 瓦文萨领导格但斯克造船厂工人罢工，成立苏联阵营第一个独立工会团结工会。

title: Shining Path begins its armed struggle
title_zh: 光辉道路发动武装斗争
place_zh: 丘斯基（今秘鲁阿亚库乔大区）
summary: The Maoist Shining Path burned ballot boxes at Chuschi and began a war that killed about 70,000 people in Peru.
summary_zh: 毛主义组织“光辉道路”在丘斯基焚烧选票箱，发动武装斗争，秘鲁内乱造成约七万人死亡。

title: Assassination of Anwar Sadat
summary: Islamist soldiers killed Sadat at a military parade; Hosni Mubarak succeeded him and ruled for thirty years.
summary_zh: 伊斯兰极端分子在阅兵式上刺杀萨达特，穆巴拉克继任并执政三十年。

title: Constitution Act 1982
place_zh: 渥太华（今加拿大安大略省）
summary: Canada patriated its constitution from Britain and added the Charter of Rights and Freedoms.
summary_zh: 加拿大从英国收回修宪权，并加入《权利与自由宪章》。

title: Falklands War
place_zh: 斯坦利港（马尔维纳斯群岛）
summary: Argentina seized the Falkland (Malvinas) Islands and Britain took them back; the defeat brought down the Argentine junta.
summary_zh: 阿根廷出兵占领马尔维纳斯群岛，英国派舰队夺回，战败导致阿根廷军政府垮台。

title: Sri Lankan Civil War begins
summary: After the Black July riots, the Tamil Tigers fought the government for an independent Tamil state in the north and east.
summary_zh: “黑色七月”骚乱后，泰米尔猛虎组织与政府军开战，谋求在北部和东部建立泰米尔国家。

title: Ethiopian famine
summary: Drought and war caused a famine that killed hundreds of thousands, and television images from relief camps prompted Live Aid.
summary_zh: 旱灾和战争造成大饥荒，数十万人死亡，救济营的电视画面促成了“拯救生命”慈善音乐会。

title: Operation Blue Star and Indira Gandhi's assassination
title_zh: 蓝星行动与英迪拉·甘地遇刺
place_zh: 阿姆利则（今印度旁遮普邦）
summary: The army stormed the Golden Temple to remove Sikh militants; months later Indira Gandhi was killed by her Sikh bodyguards.
summary_zh: 印军攻入金庙清剿锡克武装，数月后英迪拉·甘地被其锡克族卫兵刺杀。

title: Bhopal disaster
summary: A gas leak at the Union Carbide pesticide plant killed thousands, the worst industrial disaster in history.
summary_zh: 联合碳化公司农药厂发生毒气泄漏，数千人死亡，是史上最严重的工业灾难。

title: Gorbachev's perestroika
place_zh: 莫斯科（今俄罗斯莫斯科）
summary: Mikhail Gorbachev launched restructuring and openness, loosening Soviet control and accelerating its collapse.
summary_zh: 戈尔巴乔夫上台后推行“改革”与“公开性”，放松控制，最终加速了苏联的解体。

title: Plaza Accord
summary: The major economies agreed to push down the US dollar; the strong yen and easy money that followed fed Japan's asset bubble.
summary_zh: 五国财长达成协议促使美元贬值，日元大幅升值，随后的宽松政策催生了日本泡沫经济。

title: 1985 Mexico City earthquake
summary: A great earthquake killed thousands in Mexico City; the slow government response spurred civic organising.
summary_zh: 大地震造成墨西哥城数千人死亡，政府救灾迟缓，促使民间社会组织兴起。

title: Đổi Mới
summary: The Vietnamese Communist Party adopted market reforms and opened to foreign investment.
summary_zh: 越南共产党六大决定实行革新开放，引入市场经济和外资，经济开始快速增长。

title: Chernobyl disaster
summary: A reactor exploded at the Chernobyl nuclear plant, spreading radiation across Europe, the worst nuclear accident in history.
summary_zh: 切尔诺贝利核电站反应堆爆炸，放射性物质扩散到欧洲多地，是史上最严重的核事故。

title: People Power Revolution
place_zh: 乙沙大道（今菲律宾奎松市）
summary: Mass peaceful protests on EDSA forced Marcos to flee, and Corazon Aquino became president.
summary_zh: 数百万民众在乙沙大道和平示威，迫使马科斯出逃，科拉松·阿基诺就任总统。

title: Jeltoqsan protests
summary: When Moscow replaced Kazakh party leader Kunayev with a Russian, students protested in Almaty and were put down by force.
summary_zh: 莫斯科以俄罗斯人取代哈萨克共产党领导人库纳耶夫，阿拉木图学生上街抗议，遭到武力镇压。

title: First Intifada
title_zh: 第一次巴勒斯坦大起义
summary: Palestinians in Gaza and the West Bank rose against Israeli occupation with strikes, boycotts and stone-throwing.
summary_zh: 加沙和约旦河西岸的巴勒斯坦人以罢工、抵制和投掷石块反抗以色列占领。

title: June Democratic Struggle
summary: Nationwide protests forced the government to accept direct presidential elections, starting South Korea's democracy.
summary_zh: 全国性抗议迫使政府接受总统直选，韩国走上民主化道路。

title: Naguib Mahfouz wins the Nobel Prize
title_zh: 马哈福兹获诺贝尔文学奖
summary: The author of the Cairo Trilogy became the first Arabic-language writer to win the Nobel Prize in Literature.
summary_zh: 《开罗三部曲》的作者纳吉布·马哈福兹成为第一位获得诺贝尔文学奖的阿拉伯语作家。

title: Seoul Olympics
place_zh: 汉城奥林匹克体育场（今韩国首尔）
summary: Seoul hosted the Summer Olympics, showing South Korea's economic rise to the world.
summary_zh: 汉城举办夏季奥运会，向世界展示了韩国的经济腾飞。

title: 8888 Uprising
summary: Nationwide protests against military rule were crushed, and Aung San Suu Kyi emerged as the opposition leader.
summary_zh: 缅甸爆发全国性反军政府示威，遭到镇压，昂山素季成为反对派领袖。

title: 1988 Chilean plebiscite
summary: Chileans voted No to eight more years of Pinochet, opening the way to elected government in 1990.
summary_zh: 智利选民投票拒绝皮诺切特再执政八年，为1990年恢复民选政府铺平道路。

title: Fall of the Berlin Wall
place_zh: 勃兰登堡门（今德国柏林）
summary: East Germany opened its border and crowds broke down the wall, the symbolic end of communist rule in Eastern Europe.
summary_zh: 东德开放边境，民众拆毁柏林墙，象征东欧剧变和冷战走向终结。

title: Invention of the World Wide Web
place_zh: 欧洲核子研究中心（今瑞士日内瓦）
summary: Tim Berners-Lee proposed the World Wide Web at CERN, later released free to the world.
summary_zh: 伯纳斯-李在欧洲核子研究中心提出万维网构想，后来免费向全世界开放。

title: Gulf War
summary: Iraq invaded and annexed Kuwait; a US-led coalition drove it out in early 1991.
summary_zh: 伊拉克入侵并吞并科威特，1991年初以美国为首的多国部队将伊军逐出科威特。

title: Nelson Mandela released
summary: President F. W. de Klerk lifted the ban on the ANC and freed Mandela after 27 years in prison, opening talks to end apartheid.
summary_zh: 德克勒克总统解除对非洲人国民大会的禁令，释放被关押27年的曼德拉，开启结束种族隔离的谈判。

title: German reunification
summary: East Germany joined the Federal Republic on 3 October, reuniting Germany after 41 years.
summary_zh: 10月3日东德并入联邦德国，分裂41年的德国重新统一。

title: Octavio Paz wins the Nobel Prize
summary: The poet and essayist Octavio Paz, author of The Labyrinth of Solitude, became Mexico's first Nobel laureate in literature.
summary_zh: 《孤独的迷宫》作者、诗人帕斯成为墨西哥第一位诺贝尔文学奖得主。

title: Dissolution of the Soviet Union
place_zh: 克里姆林宫（今俄罗斯莫斯科）
summary: After a failed coup, the republics declared independence. Gorbachev resigned and the Soviet flag came down on 25 December.
summary_zh: 八一九事件失败后各加盟共和国纷纷独立，12月25日戈尔巴乔夫辞职，苏联解体，冷战结束。

title: Independence of the Central Asian republics
summary: As the Soviet Union broke up, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan became independent; Kazakhstan was last, on 16 December.
summary_zh: 苏联解体之际，哈萨克斯坦、乌兹别克斯坦、土库曼斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦和塔吉克斯坦相继独立。

title: Yugoslav Wars
summary: The breakup of Yugoslavia led to a decade of wars in Croatia, Bosnia and Kosovo, the bloodiest in Europe since 1945.
summary_zh: 南斯拉夫解体引发克罗地亚、波黑、科索沃等地十年战乱，是二战后欧洲最血腥的冲突。

title: Algerian Civil War
place_zh: 阿尔及尔（今阿尔及利亚）
summary: The army cancelled elections the Islamic Salvation Front was winning, setting off a decade of war that killed up to 200,000.
summary_zh: 军方取消伊斯兰拯救阵线即将获胜的选举，引发长达十年、造成多达二十万人死亡的内战。

title: Economic liberalisation in India
summary: Facing a currency crisis, Narasimha Rao and Manmohan Singh cut licences and tariffs and opened India to foreign investment.
summary_zh: 面对外汇危机，拉奥政府和财长曼莫汉·辛格取消许可证制度，降低关税，向外资开放。

title: Japanese asset price bubble bursts
summary: Stock and land prices collapsed after 1990, leaving banks with bad loans and starting the 'lost decades' of slow growth.
summary_zh: 股价和地价暴跌，银行背负大量坏账，日本经济陷入长期低迷，被称为“失去的十年”。

title: Alma-Ata Protocol
summary: Eleven former Soviet republics met in Alma-Ata and agreed to form the Commonwealth of Independent States, ending the Soviet Union.
summary_zh: 11个前苏联加盟共和国在阿拉木图签署宣言，成立独立国家联合体，苏联正式终结。

title: Somali Civil War
summary: The fall of Siad Barre left Somalia without a central government, and clan war and famine led to a failed UN and US intervention.
summary_zh: 西亚德·巴雷政权倒台后索马里失去中央政府，部族战争和饥荒导致联合国和美国的干预以失败告终。

title: Mercosur founded
summary: Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay and Uruguay signed the Treaty of Asunción, creating a common market in the south of the continent.
summary_zh: 阿根廷、巴西、巴拉圭和乌拉圭签订《亚松森条约》，建立南方共同市场。

title: Maastricht Treaty
summary: The member states created the European Union and planned a single currency.
summary_zh: 欧共体成员国签署《马斯特里赫特条约》，建立欧洲联盟，并规划统一货币。

title: Demolition of the Babri Masjid
place_zh: 阿约提亚（今印度北方邦）
summary: Hindu activists tore down a 16th-century mosque they claimed stood on Rama's birthplace, setting off deadly riots.
summary_zh: 印度教激进分子拆毁一座他们认为建于罗摩出生地的十六世纪清真寺，引发致命骚乱。

title: Tajikistani Civil War
summary: Regional and Islamist opposition groups fought the government in a civil war that killed tens of thousands.
summary_zh: 地方势力和伊斯兰反对派与政府爆发内战，造成数万人死亡，1997年签署和平协议结束。

title: China and South Korea establish relations
summary: China and South Korea established diplomatic relations, and China soon became South Korea's largest trading partner.
summary_zh: 中国与韩国建立外交关系，此后中国成为韩国最大的贸易伙伴。

title: Oslo Accords
summary: Israel and the PLO recognised each other and set up the Palestinian Authority with limited self-rule.
summary_zh: 以色列与巴解组织相互承认，建立有限自治的巴勒斯坦民族权力机构。

title: Rwandan genocide
summary: In about a hundred days Hutu extremists killed some 800,000 Tutsi and moderate Hutu, while the world failed to intervene.
summary_zh: 约一百天内，胡图族极端分子杀害约80万图西族人和温和派胡图族人，国际社会未能干预。

title: South Africa's first democratic election
summary: In the first election open to all races the ANC won and Nelson Mandela became president, ending apartheid.
summary_zh: 南非举行首次不分种族的大选，非洲人国民大会获胜，曼德拉就任总统，种族隔离制度终结。

title: NAFTA takes effect
title_zh: 北美自由贸易协定生效
summary: Mexico joined the United States and Canada in a free trade area, tying its economy closely to North America.
summary_zh: 墨西哥与美国、加拿大组成自由贸易区，经济与北美紧密相连。

title: North American Free Trade Agreement
place_zh: 渥太华（今加拿大安大略省）
summary: Canada, the United States and Mexico created one of the world's largest free-trade areas.
summary_zh: 加拿大、美国和墨西哥建立世界上最大的自由贸易区之一。

title: Zapatista uprising
title_zh: 萨帕塔民族解放军起义
place: San Cristóbal de las Casas, Chiapas
place_zh: 圣克里斯托瓦尔-德拉斯卡萨斯（今墨西哥恰帕斯州）
summary: On the day NAFTA began, the Zapatista Army of National Liberation rose in Chiapas for indigenous rights.
summary_zh: 北美自由贸易协定生效当天，萨帕塔民族解放军在恰帕斯起义，争取原住民权利。

title: Death of Kim Il Sung
summary: Kim Il Sung died and was succeeded by his son Kim Jong Il. A severe famine soon followed in the north.
summary_zh: 金日成逝世，其子金正日继承权力，此后朝鲜遭遇严重饥荒。

title: Great Hanshin earthquake
place_zh: 神户（今日本兵库县神户市）
summary: A strong quake struck Kobe, killing over 6,400 people and exposing weaknesses in disaster response.
summary_zh: 强烈地震袭击神户一带，6400多人死亡，暴露出政府救灾体制的不足。

title: Schengen Agreement takes effect
summary: Border checks between the first Schengen states were removed, allowing free movement of people.
summary_zh: 首批申根国家取消相互间的边境检查，人员可以自由流动，申根区后来扩大到欧洲大部分国家。

title: Srebrenica massacre
summary: Bosnian Serb forces killed over 8,000 Bosniak men and boys, the worst atrocity in Europe since World War II.
summary_zh: 波黑塞族武装屠杀八千多名波什尼亚克族男子，是二战后欧洲最严重的屠杀事件。

title: Tokyo subway sarin attack
title_zh: 东京地铁沙林毒气事件
place_zh: 霞关（今日本东京都千代田区）
summary: Members of the Aum Shinrikyo cult released sarin gas on Tokyo subway trains, killing 14 people and injuring thousands.
summary_zh: 奥姆真理教成员在东京地铁列车上释放沙林毒气，造成14人死亡、数千人受伤。

title: 1995 Quebec referendum
place_zh: 蒙特利尔（今加拿大魁北克省）
summary: Quebec voters rejected sovereignty by 50.6 percent to 49.4 percent.
summary_zh: 魁北克选民以50.6%对49.4%的微弱多数否决独立。

title: Taliban take Kabul
summary: After years of civil war among the mujahideen, the Taliban captured Kabul and imposed strict religious rule over most of Afghanistan.
summary_zh: 圣战者各派内战多年后，塔利班攻占喀布尔，在阿富汗大部推行严苛的宗教统治。

title: Truth and Reconciliation Commission
summary: Chaired by Desmond Tutu, the commission heard victims and offered amnesty for full confession of apartheid-era crimes.
summary_zh: 由德斯蒙德·图图主持的委员会听取受害者陈述，对完整供述种族隔离时期罪行者给予特赦。

title: Asian financial crisis
summary: The collapse of the Thai baht set off a financial crisis that spread to Indonesia, Malaysia and the rest of East Asia.
summary_zh: 泰铢崩溃引发金融危机，迅速蔓延到印尼、马来西亚、韩国等地，东亚经济遭受重创。

title: Kazakhstan moves its capital to Astana
title_zh: 哈萨克斯坦迁都阿斯塔纳
summary: Kazakhstan moved its capital from Almaty to Akmola, renamed Astana, and built a new city on the northern steppe.
summary_zh: 哈萨克斯坦把首都从阿拉木图迁到阿克莫拉（改名阿斯塔纳），在北方草原上建起新城。

title: Kyoto Protocol adopted
summary: A UN climate conference in Kyoto set the first binding targets for developed countries to cut greenhouse gases.
summary_zh: 联合国气候变化大会在京都通过议定书，首次为发达国家规定了具有约束力的温室气体减排目标。

title: India and Pakistan nuclear tests
place_zh: 博格伦（今印度拉贾斯坦邦）
summary: India tested five nuclear weapons at Pokhran and Pakistan answered with tests at Chagai, making both declared nuclear powers.
summary_zh: 印度在博格伦进行五次核试验，巴基斯坦随即在查盖进行核试验，两国均成为公开拥核国家。

title: Fall of Suharto
summary: Riots and student protests during the crisis forced Suharto to resign after 32 years, opening Indonesia's democratic reform era.
summary_zh: 金融危机中爆发骚乱和学生运动，执政32年的苏哈托被迫辞职，印尼进入民主改革时期。

title: Second Congo War
place_zh: 戈马（今刚果民主共和国）
summary: Nine African countries were drawn into war in the Congo, and violence, disease and famine killed millions, the deadliest conflict since 1945.
summary_zh: 九个非洲国家卷入刚果战争，暴力、疾病和饥荒造成数百万人死亡，是1945年以来死亡最惨重的冲突。

title: Hugo Chávez elected
title_zh: 查韦斯当选委内瑞拉总统
summary: Former paratrooper Hugo Chávez won Venezuela's presidency and launched his Bolivarian Revolution funded by oil.
summary_zh: 前伞兵军官查韦斯当选委内瑞拉总统，依靠石油收入推行“玻利瓦尔革命”。

title: Good Friday Agreement
place_zh: 贝尔法斯特（今英国北爱尔兰）
summary: A peace deal for Northern Ireland ended three decades of the Troubles and set up power-sharing.
summary_zh: 英国、爱尔兰与北爱各党派达成和平协议，结束北爱尔兰三十年冲突，建立分权政府。

title: Euro introduced
place_zh: 法兰克福（今德国法兰克福）
summary: Eleven EU states adopted a common currency managed by the European Central Bank. Notes and coins followed in 2002.
summary_zh: 欧盟11国启用统一货币欧元，由欧洲中央银行管理，2002年欧元纸币和硬币正式流通。

title: Kargil War
summary: Indian forces drove Pakistani troops and militants from heights they had seized across the Line of Control.
summary_zh: 印军将越过实际控制线占据高地的巴基斯坦军队和武装分子驱逐出去。

title: Creation of Nunavut
place_zh: 伊卡卢伊特（今加拿大努纳武特地区）
summary: Canada created the Inuit-majority territory of Nunavut out of the Northwest Territories.
summary_zh: 加拿大从西北地区划出以因纽特人为主的努纳武特地区。

title: First inter-Korean summit
summary: Kim Dae-jung met Kim Jong Il in Pyongyang, the first summit between the two Koreas, under his Sunshine Policy.
summary_zh: 金大中赴平壤与金正日举行首次南北首脑会谈，这是其阳光政策的成果。

title: PRI loses the presidency
summary: Vicente Fox of the PAN won the presidential election, ending 71 years of PRI rule peacefully.
summary_zh: 国家行动党的福克斯赢得总统选举，和平结束了革命制度党71年的执政。

title: Forum on China-Africa Cooperation
summary: China and African states set up a regular forum, and China became Africa's largest trading partner and a major lender for railways, ports and roads.
summary_zh: 中国与非洲国家建立定期合作论坛，此后中国成为非洲最大贸易伙伴和铁路、港口、公路建设的重要出资方。

title: US-led war in Afghanistan
summary: After the September 11 attacks, the United States and its allies overthrew the Taliban, who had sheltered al-Qaeda, and stayed for twenty years.
summary_zh: 九一一事件后，美国及其盟国推翻庇护基地组织的塔利班政权，此后驻军二十年。

title: September 11 attacks
place: World Trade Center, New York City
place_zh: 世界贸易中心（今美国纽约市）
summary: Al-Qaeda hijackers crashed planes into the World Trade Center and the Pentagon, killing nearly 3,000, and the US began the war on terror.
summary_zh: 基地组织劫机撞击世界贸易中心和五角大楼，近三千人遇难，美国随即发动反恐战争。

title: Koizumi's structural reforms
summary: Prime Minister Koizumi Jun'ichirō pushed deregulation and postal privatisation, while his Yasukuni visits strained ties with China and Korea.
summary_zh: 首相小泉纯一郎推行邮政民营化等结构改革，但多次参拜靖国神社，使中日、日韩关系恶化。

title: Argentine economic crisis
place_zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯（今阿根廷）
summary: A frozen bank system and riots brought down the government; Argentina defaulted on its foreign debt and ended the peso's link to the dollar.
summary_zh: 银行存款冻结引发骚乱，政府倒台，阿根廷宣布外债违约，放弃比索与美元挂钩。

title: African Union founded
summary: The OAU was replaced by the African Union, with a mandate to intervene against genocide and war crimes in member states.
summary_zh: 非洲统一组织由非洲联盟取代，新组织有权对成员国内的种族灭绝和战争罪行进行干预。

title: Lula elected president of Brazil
summary: The former metalworker Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva won the presidency; his cash transfer programmes lifted millions out of poverty.
summary_zh: 前五金工人卢拉当选巴西总统，推行家庭补助金等计划，使数千万人摆脱贫困。

title: Independence of East Timor
summary: After a UN referendum and a period of UN rule, East Timor became an independent state.
summary_zh: 经联合国主持公投和过渡管理，东帝汶正式独立，成为21世纪第一个新国家。

title: Iraq War
summary: A US-led invasion overthrew Saddam Hussein, followed by insurgency and sectarian war until US troops left in 2011.
summary_zh: 美国主导的联军推翻萨达姆政权，随后叛乱和教派冲突持续不断，直到2011年美军撤出。

title: War in Darfur
place_zh: 法希尔（今苏丹达尔富尔）
summary: Rebels rose against the Sudanese government, and its Janjaweed militias killed and drove out hundreds of thousands of civilians.
summary_zh: 达尔富尔反政府武装起事，苏丹政府支持的金戈威德民兵杀害和驱逐数十万平民。

title: Commodity boom driven by China
place_zh: 桑托斯港（今巴西圣保罗州）
summary: Chinese demand for soybeans, iron ore, copper and oil drove a decade of growth, and China became the region's leading trade partner.
summary_zh: 中国对大豆、铁矿石、铜和石油的需求带动南美十年增长，中国成为南美主要贸易伙伴。

title: 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami
place_zh: 班达亚齐（今印度尼西亚）
summary: A huge earthquake off Sumatra sent tsunamis across the Indian Ocean, killing about 230,000 people, most in Aceh.
summary_zh: 苏门答腊外海发生大地震并引发海啸，造成约23万人死亡，亚齐受灾最重，此后亚齐冲突和解。

title: EU enlargement of 2004
place_zh: 布鲁塞尔（今比利时布鲁塞尔）
summary: Ten countries, most of them former communist states, joined the EU in its largest single expansion.
summary_zh: 波兰、捷克等十国同时加入欧盟，以原东欧国家为主，是欧盟规模最大的一次扩大。

title: Morocco reforms its family code
summary: King Mohammed VI's new Moudawana raised the marriage age to 18 and gave wives more rights in marriage and divorce.
summary_zh: 国王穆罕默德六世推行新家庭法，把结婚年龄提高到18岁，扩大妻子在婚姻和离婚中的权利。

title: Andijan massacre
place_zh: 安集延（今乌兹别克斯坦）
summary: Uzbek troops fired on protesters in Andijan, killing hundreds, and Uzbekistan turned away from the West.
summary_zh: 乌兹别克军队向安集延的抗议人群开火，造成数百人死亡，此后乌兹别克斯坦与西方关系疏远。

title: Tulip Revolution
summary: Protests over rigged elections toppled Kyrgyz president Askar Akayev.
summary_zh: 吉尔吉斯斯坦因选举舞弊爆发抗议，总统阿卡耶夫被推翻。

title: Evo Morales elected
title_zh: 莫拉莱斯当选玻利维亚总统
summary: The coca growers' leader Evo Morales became Bolivia's first indigenous president and nationalised natural gas.
summary_zh: 古柯种植者领袖莫拉莱斯成为玻利维亚第一位原住民总统，并将天然气收归国有。

title: North Korea's first nuclear test
place_zh: 丰溪里（今朝鲜咸镜北道）
summary: North Korea carried out its first underground nuclear test, drawing UN sanctions.
summary_zh: 朝鲜进行首次地下核试验，联合国安理会随即对其实施制裁。

title: Mexican drug war
summary: President Calderón sent the army against drug cartels, starting a conflict that has killed hundreds of thousands.
summary_zh: 卡尔德龙总统派军队打击贩毒集团，冲突造成数十万人死亡。

title: 2008 financial crisis
summary: The collapse of the housing bubble and of Lehman Brothers set off the worst global recession since the 1930s.
summary_zh: 房地产泡沫和雷曼兄弟破产引发20世纪30年代以来最严重的全球经济衰退。

title: Nepal abolishes the monarchy
summary: After a decade of Maoist insurgency and mass protests, the Constituent Assembly ended the 240-year Shah monarchy.
summary_zh: 经过十年毛派武装斗争和大规模抗议，制宪会议废除延续二百四十年的沙阿王朝。

title: 2008 Mumbai attacks
place_zh: 孟买（今印度马哈拉施特拉邦）
summary: Ten Lashkar-e-Taiba gunmen from Pakistan attacked hotels, a station and other sites, killing 166 people over four days.
summary_zh: 十名来自巴基斯坦的虔诚军枪手袭击酒店、火车站等地，持续四天，造成一百六十六人死亡。

title: Barack Obama elected president
place_zh: 格兰特公园（今美国芝加哥）
summary: Barack Obama was elected the first African American President of the United States.
summary_zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马当选总统，成为美国历史上首位非洲裔总统。

title: European debt crisis
summary: Greece's hidden deficits set off a crisis in several eurozone states, leading to bailouts and harsh austerity.
summary_zh: 希腊债务问题引发欧元区多国主权债务危机，各国接受救助并实行紧缩政策。

title: Green Movement protests
summary: Millions protested the disputed re-election of President Ahmadinejad, the largest unrest since 1979, before a crackdown.
summary_zh: 数百万人抗议内贾德有争议的连任结果，这是1979年以来最大的抗议，随后遭到镇压。

title: Boko Haram insurgency
summary: The jihadist group Boko Haram launched an armed uprising in northeast Nigeria, later kidnapping the Chibok schoolgirls in 2014.
summary_zh: 圣战组织博科圣地在尼日利亚东北部发动武装叛乱，2014年绑架了奇博克女学生。

title: Tunisian Revolution
summary: The self-immolation of the street vendor Mohamed Bouazizi set off protests that toppled Ben Ali and began the Arab Spring.
summary_zh: 街头小贩布瓦吉吉自焚引发抗议，推翻本·阿里政权，揭开阿拉伯之春序幕。

title: Affordable Care Act
place_zh: 华盛顿（今美国哥伦比亚特区）
summary: The health care law extended insurance to about 20 million more Americans.
summary_zh: 该医疗改革法使约两千万美国人获得医疗保险。

title: Vargas Llosa wins the Nobel Prize
title_zh: 巴尔加斯·略萨获诺贝尔文学奖
summary: The Peruvian novelist Mario Vargas Llosa, born in Arequipa, won the Nobel Prize in Literature.
summary_zh: 出生于阿雷基帕的秘鲁小说家巴尔加斯·略萨获得诺贝尔文学奖。

title: Syrian civil war
summary: Protests in the Arab Spring, starting in Daraa, met violent repression and became a civil war that drew in foreign powers.
summary_zh: 阿拉伯之春中德拉等地爆发抗议，遭到暴力镇压后演变为内战，多个外国势力卷入。

title: Great East Japan earthquake
place_zh: 石卷（今日本宫城县石卷市）
summary: A magnitude 9.0 earthquake and tsunami struck northeast Japan on 11 March, killing about 18,000 people.
summary_zh: 3月11日日本东北近海发生9.0级地震并引发巨大海啸，约1.8万人死亡或失踪。

title: Egyptian Revolution of 2011
summary: Eighteen days of mass protests centred on Tahrir Square forced Hosni Mubarak to resign.
summary_zh: 以解放广场为中心的十八天大规模抗议迫使穆巴拉克下台。

title: Libyan Civil War and fall of Gaddafi
summary: An uprising in Benghazi, backed by NATO air strikes, overthrew Gaddafi, who was killed in Sirte; Libya then split among rival factions.
summary_zh: 班加西起义在北约空袭支持下推翻卡扎菲，卡扎菲在苏尔特被杀，此后利比亚陷入派系割据。

title: Fukushima Daiichi nuclear disaster
summary: The tsunami knocked out cooling at the Fukushima Daiichi plant, causing three meltdowns and forcing over 100,000 people to leave.
summary_zh: 海啸导致福岛第一核电站冷却系统失灵，三座反应堆堆芯熔毁，十多万居民被迫撤离。

title: South Sudan becomes independent
summary: After decades of war and a referendum, South Sudan separated from Sudan as the world's newest country, but fell into civil war in 2013.
summary_zh: 经过数十年战争和全民公投，南苏丹脱离苏丹成为世界上最年轻的国家，但2013年陷入内战。

title: Abenomics
summary: Prime Minister Abe Shinzō launched monetary easing, public spending and structural reform to end deflation.
summary_zh: 首相安倍晋三推出大规模货币宽松、财政刺激和结构改革三支箭，试图摆脱通货紧缩。

title: Mali War
summary: Tuareg rebels and jihadists seized northern Mali and damaged Timbuktu's shrines, and a French intervention in 2013 began a long Sahel conflict.
summary_zh: 图阿雷格叛军和圣战分子占领马里北部，破坏廷巴克图圣墓，2013年法国出兵干预，萨赫勒由此陷入长期冲突。

title: Silk Road Economic Belt proposed in Astana
place_zh: 纳扎尔巴耶夫大学（今哈萨克斯坦阿斯塔纳）
summary: In a speech at Nazarbayev University, Xi Jinping proposed the Silk Road Economic Belt, the land half of the Belt and Road Initiative.
summary_zh: 习近平在纳扎尔巴耶夫大学演讲，提出共建“丝绸之路经济带”，即后来“一带一路”倡议的陆上部分。

title: Army removes Morsi; Sisi takes power
summary: After mass protests the army deposed Egypt's first elected president Mohamed Morsi; Abdel Fattah el-Sisi became president in 2014.
summary_zh: 大规模抗议后，军方罢黜民选总统穆尔西，塞西于2014年就任总统。

title: Russian annexation of Crimea
place_zh: 辛菲罗波尔（今克里米亚）
summary: After Ukraine's Euromaidan protests toppled its president, Russia seized and annexed Crimea, and war began in Donbas.
summary_zh: 乌克兰亲欧示威推翻总统后，俄罗斯控制并吞并克里米亚，顿巴斯地区随后爆发冲突。

title: Islamic State takes Mosul
summary: The Islamic State seized Mosul and proclaimed a caliphate over parts of Iraq and Syria until its defeat by 2019.
summary_zh: “伊斯兰国”攻占摩苏尔，在伊拉克和叙利亚部分地区宣布建立“哈里发国”，2019年前后被击败。

title: West African Ebola epidemic
summary: The largest Ebola outbreak in history spread through Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone and killed over 11,000 people.
summary_zh: 史上最大的埃博拉疫情在几内亚、利比里亚和塞拉利昂蔓延，造成一万一千多人死亡。

title: Yemeni civil war
summary: Houthi rebels took Sanaa; a Saudi-led coalition intervened in 2015, causing one of the world's worst humanitarian crises.
summary_zh: 胡塞武装占领萨那，2015年沙特领导的联军介入，造成世界上最严重的人道危机之一。

title: Crisis in Venezuela
summary: Falling oil prices and mismanagement brought hyperinflation and shortages, and millions of Venezuelans left the country.
summary_zh: 油价下跌和管理不善造成恶性通胀和物资短缺，数百万委内瑞拉人移居国外。

title: Iran nuclear deal
summary: Iran agreed with six world powers, China among them, to limit its nuclear programme in return for lifting sanctions. The US left the deal in 2018.
summary_zh: 伊朗与包括中国在内的六国达成协议，限制核计划以换取解除制裁。2018年美国退出协议。

title: European migrant crisis
summary: Over a million refugees and migrants, many fleeing the Syrian war, reached Europe, dividing EU states.
summary_zh: 逾百万难民和移民经地中海涌入欧洲，许多人逃离叙利亚战乱，欧盟各国就安置问题产生分歧。

title: Truth and Reconciliation Commission report
title_zh: 加拿大真相与和解委员会报告
place_zh: 渥太华（今加拿大安大略省）
summary: Canada's commission called the residential school system for Indigenous children a cultural genocide.
summary_zh: 加拿大真相与和解委员会将原住民儿童寄宿学校制度定性为文化灭绝。

title: Brexit
summary: Britain voted to leave the European Union in a referendum and formally left in 2020.
summary_zh: 英国举行全民公投决定退出欧盟，经过多年谈判，于2020年正式脱离欧盟。

title: Colombian peace agreement with FARC
summary: Colombia's government and the FARC guerrillas signed a peace deal ending a war of over fifty years; President Santos won the Nobel Peace Prize.
summary_zh: 哥伦比亚政府与哥伦比亚革命武装力量签署和平协议，结束了五十多年的内战，桑托斯总统获诺贝尔和平奖。

title: Mirziyoyev's reforms in Uzbekistan
summary: After Islam Karimov's death, Shavkat Mirziyoyev freed the currency, eased controls and reopened ties with neighbours.
summary_zh: 卡里莫夫去世后，米尔济约耶夫放开汇率、放松管制并改善与邻国关系，乌兹别克斯坦走向开放。

title: Donald Trump elected president
place_zh: 华盛顿（今美国哥伦比亚特区）
summary: Donald Trump won the presidency on an America First platform, reshaping US trade and foreign policy.
summary_zh: 特朗普以“美国优先”纲领当选总统，改变了美国的贸易和外交政策。

title: Panmunjom Declaration
place_zh: 板门店（今朝鲜半岛军事分界线上）
summary: Moon Jae-in and Kim Jong Un met at Panmunjom and pledged to work toward peace and denuclearization.
summary_zh: 文在寅与金正恩在板门店会晤，发表宣言，承诺推进半岛和平与无核化。

title: African Continental Free Trade Area
summary: African leaders signed an agreement in Kigali to create a single continental market, the largest free trade area by number of member countries.
summary_zh: 非洲各国领导人在基加利签署协定，建立统一的大陆市场，按成员国数量计是世界最大的自由贸易区。

title: Emperor Akihito abdicates; the Reiwa era begins
summary: Akihito became the first emperor to abdicate in two centuries, and his son Naruhito took the throne as the Reiwa era began.
summary_zh: 明仁天皇退位，这是两百年来首次天皇生前退位，德仁天皇即位，年号改为令和。

title: COVID-19 pandemic in Europe
place_zh: 贝加莫（今意大利伦巴第）
summary: Northern Italy became the first major outbreak in Europe, and countries across the continent imposed lockdowns.
summary_zh: 新冠疫情在意大利北部率先大规模暴发，欧洲各国相继封锁，造成巨大的人员和经济损失。

title: Parasite wins Best Picture
summary: Bong Joon-ho's Parasite became the first non-English film to win the Oscar for Best Picture, a high point of the Korean Wave.
summary_zh: 奉俊昊的《寄生虫》成为首部获奥斯卡最佳影片的非英语电影，是韩流的标志性成就。

title: Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership
title_zh: 区域全面经济伙伴关系协定签署
summary: ASEAN and five partners including China and Japan signed RCEP, the world's largest free trade agreement.
summary_zh: 东盟十国与中国、日本、韩国、澳大利亚、新西兰签署RCEP，形成世界最大的自由贸易区。

title: Tigray War
place_zh: 默克莱（今埃塞俄比亚提格雷州）
summary: War between the Ethiopian government and Tigrayan forces caused famine and hundreds of thousands of deaths before a peace deal in 2022.
summary_zh: 埃塞俄比亚政府与提格雷武装爆发战争，造成饥荒和数十万人死亡，2022年签署和平协议。

title: COVID-19 pandemic in the United States
place_zh: 华盛顿（今美国哥伦比亚特区）
summary: The pandemic killed over a million Americans and caused a sharp economic downturn.
summary_zh: 新冠疫情造成一百多万美国人死亡，并引发经济急剧衰退。

title: George Floyd protests
title_zh: 乔治·弗洛伊德抗议活动
place_zh: 明尼阿波利斯（今美国明尼苏达州）
summary: The killing of George Floyd by a police officer set off nationwide protests against racism and police violence.
summary_zh: 乔治·弗洛伊德被警察压颈致死，引发全国反对种族主义和警察暴力的抗议。

title: Taliban return to power
summary: As US troops withdrew, the Taliban swept the country and took Kabul, and the American-backed government collapsed.
summary_zh: 美军撤离之际，塔利班迅速占领全国并进入喀布尔，美国支持的政府垮台。

title: 2021 Myanmar coup d'état
summary: The military detained Aung San Suu Kyi and seized power, setting off mass protests and civil war.
summary_zh: 缅甸军方扣押昂山素季等领导人夺取政权，引发大规模抗议和内战。

title: January 6 United States Capitol attack
place_zh: 国会大厦（今美国华盛顿）
summary: Supporters of Donald Trump stormed the Capitol to stop the certification of the 2020 election.
summary_zh: 特朗普支持者冲击国会大厦，试图阻止国会确认2020年大选结果。

title: 2020 Tokyo Olympics held
place_zh: 国立竞技场（今日本东京都新宿区）
summary: Postponed for a year by the COVID-19 pandemic, the Tokyo Olympics were held almost without spectators.
summary_zh: 因新冠疫情推迟一年的东京奥运会于2021年举行，比赛基本无观众。

title: Russian invasion of Ukraine
summary: Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine, the largest war in Europe since 1945.
summary_zh: 俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰，这是二战以来欧洲规模最大的战争，深刻改变了欧洲安全格局。

title: Mahsa Amini protests
summary: The death in custody of a young woman arrested for her headscarf set off months of protests under the slogan Woman, Life, Freedom.
summary_zh: 一名因头巾问题被捕的年轻女子在羁押中死亡，引发以“妇女、生命、自由”为口号、持续数月的抗议。

title: Assassination of Shinzo Abe
place_zh: 大和西大寺站（今日本奈良市）
summary: Former Prime Minister Abe Shinzō was shot dead while giving a campaign speech in Nara.
summary_zh: 前首相安倍晋三在奈良街头发表竞选演讲时遭枪击身亡。

title: January events in Kazakhstan
summary: Protests over fuel prices turned into deadly unrest; Tokayev called in CSTO troops and removed Nazarbayev's circle from power.
summary_zh: 燃料涨价引发全国抗议并演变为流血骚乱，托卡耶夫请集体安全条约组织出兵，并清除纳扎尔巴耶夫的势力。

title: Nuri rocket reaches orbit
title_zh: 世界号运载火箭发射成功
place_zh: 罗老宇航中心（今韩国全罗南道高兴）
summary: South Korea's own Nuri rocket put satellites into orbit, making it a country able to launch its own satellites.
summary_zh: 韩国自主研发的世界号运载火箭成功将卫星送入轨道，韩国具备了自主发射卫星的能力。

title: Indonesia's new capital Nusantara
title_zh: 印度尼西亚迁都努山塔拉
place_zh: 努山塔拉（今印度尼西亚东加里曼丹）
summary: Indonesia passed a law to move its capital from crowded, sinking Jakarta to a new city on Borneo.
summary_zh: 印度尼西亚通过法律，决定将首都从拥挤下沉的雅加达迁往加里曼丹岛的新城努山塔拉。

title: Gaza war
summary: After Hamas attacked southern Israel on 7 October, Israel's war in Gaza killed tens of thousands and spread into a regional conflict.
summary_zh: 哈马斯10月7日袭击以色列南部后，以色列在加沙发动战争，造成数万人死亡，并扩大为地区冲突。

title: Chandrayaan-3 lands near the Moon's south pole
title_zh: 月船三号登陆月球南极附近
place_zh: 斯里赫里戈达（今印度安得拉邦）
summary: India's Chandrayaan-3 made the first soft landing near the lunar south pole, making India the fourth country to land on the Moon.
summary_zh: 印度月船三号首次在月球南极附近软着陆，印度成为第四个实现登月的国家。

title: Sudanese civil war
summary: Fighting between the army and the Rapid Support Forces wrecked Khartoum and displaced over ten million people, the world's largest displacement crisis.
summary_zh: 苏丹军队与快速支援部队交战，喀土穆遭到严重破坏，一千多万人流离失所，成为世界最大的流离失所危机。

title: Turkey-Syria earthquakes
place_zh: 卡赫拉曼马拉什（今土耳其）
summary: Two great earthquakes struck southern Turkey and northern Syria, killing more than 55,000 people.
summary_zh: 土耳其南部和叙利亚北部接连发生两次强烈地震，死亡人数超过5.5万。

title: Javier Milei elected
place_zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯（今阿根廷）
summary: The libertarian economist Javier Milei won Argentina's presidency promising deep spending cuts to end high inflation.
summary_zh: 自由意志主义经济学家米莱当选阿根廷总统，承诺大幅削减开支以遏制高通胀。

title: Fall of the Assad regime
summary: A rebel offensive took Damascus in December and Bashar al-Assad fled to Russia, ending more than fifty years of Assad family rule.
summary_zh: 反对派武装12月攻入大马士革，巴沙尔·阿萨德出逃俄罗斯，阿萨德家族五十多年的统治结束。

title: South Korean martial law crisis
place_zh: 国会（今韩国首尔汝矣岛）
summary: President Yoon Suk Yeol declared martial law, but the National Assembly voted it down within hours. He was impeached and removed in 2025.
summary_zh: 尹锡悦总统宣布紧急戒严，国会数小时内表决解除，尹锡悦随后被弹劾，2025年被罢免。

title: EU Artificial Intelligence Act
place_zh: 布鲁塞尔（今比利时布鲁塞尔）
summary: The EU adopted the world's first comprehensive law regulating artificial intelligence by risk level.
summary_zh: 欧盟通过世界上第一部全面监管人工智能的法律，按风险等级对人工智能系统加以规范。

title: Fall of Sheikh Hasina
summary: Student protests against job quotas grew into a mass uprising; Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina resigned and fled to India.
summary_zh: 学生反对公职配额的抗议演变为大规模起义，总理谢赫·哈西娜辞职并出逃印度。

title: SLIM lands on the Moon
place_zh: 相模原（今日本神奈川县相模原市）
summary: JAXA's SLIM probe made a precise landing on the Moon, making Japan the fifth country to soft-land there.
summary_zh: 日本宇宙航空研究开发机构的SLIM探测器实现月面精准着陆，日本成为第五个实现月球软着陆的国家。

title: Iran-Israel war
summary: Israel struck Iran's nuclear sites and military leaders and Iran fired missiles back. The United States bombed Fordow before a ceasefire after twelve days.
summary_zh: 以色列空袭伊朗核设施和军方高层，伊朗以导弹回击，美国轰炸福尔多核设施，十二天后停火。

title: Grand Egyptian Museum opens
summary: The world's largest museum of a single civilisation opened near the Giza pyramids, displaying Tutankhamun's full treasures.
summary_zh: 世界上最大的单一文明博物馆在吉萨金字塔附近开馆，完整展出图坦卡蒙的珍宝。

title: Sanae Takaichi becomes prime minister
summary: Takaichi Sanae became Japan's first woman prime minister after winning the LDP leadership.
summary_zh: 高市早苗当选自民党总裁后就任首相，成为日本历史上第一位女性首相。
